name: Ashvamedhika Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRitodakaM tu rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM yudhiShThiraH |
puraskRRitya mahAbAhuruttatArAkulendriyaH
shlokas.2:
uttIrya cha mahIpAlo bAShpavyAkulalochanaH |
papAta tIre ga~NgAyA vyAdhaviddha iva dvipaH
shlokas.3:
taM sIdamAnaM jagrAha bhImaH kRRiShNena choditaH |
maivamityabravIchchainaM kRRiShNaH parabalArdanaH
shlokas.4:
tamArtaM patitaM bhUmau nishvasantaM punaH punaH |
dadRRishuH pANDavA rAjandharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.5:
taM dRRiShTvA dInamanasaM gatasattvaM janeshvaram |
bhUyaH shokasamAviShTAH pANDavAH samupAvishan
shlokas.6:
rAjA cha dhRRitarAShTrastamupAsIno mahAbhujaH |
vAkyamAha mahAprAj~no mahAshokaprapIDitam
shlokas.7:
uttiShTha kurushArdUla kuru kAryamanantaram |
kShatradharmeNa kauravya jiteyamavanistvayA
shlokas.8:
tAM bhu~NkShva bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM suhRRidbhishcha janeshvara |
na shochitavyaM pashyAmi tvayA dharmabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.9:
shochitavyaM mayA chaiva gAndhAryA cha vishAM pate |
putrairvihIno rAjyena svapnalabdhadhano yathA
shlokas.10:
ashrutvA hitakAmasya vidurasya mahAtmanaH |
vAkyAni sumahArthAni paritapyAmi durmatiH
shlokas.11:
uktavAneSha mAM pUrvaM dharmAtmA divyadarshanaH |
duryodhanAparAdhena kulaM te vinashiShyati
shlokas.12:
svasti chedichChase rAjankulasyAtmana eva cha |
vadhyatAmeSha duShTAtmA mando rAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.13:
karNashcha shakunishchaiva mainaM pashyatu karhichit |
dyUtasampAtamapyeShAmapramatto nivAraya
shlokas.14:
abhiShechaya rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
sa pAlayiShyati vashI dharmeNa pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.15:
atha nechChasi rAjAnaM kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
meDhIbhUtaH svayaM rAjyaM pratigRRihNIShva pArthiva
shlokas.16:
samaM sarveShu bhUteShu vartamAnaM narAdhipa |
anujIvantu sarve tvAM j~nAtayo j~nAtivardhana
shlokas.17:
evaM bruvati kaunteya vidure dIrghadarshini |
duryodhanamahaM pApamanvavartaM vRRithAmatiH
shlokas.18:
ashrutvA hyasya vIrasya vAkyAni madhurANyaham |
phalaM prApya mahadduHkhaM nimagnaH shokasAgare
shlokas.19:
vRRiddhau hi te svaH pitarau pashyAvAM duHkhitau nRRipa |
na shochitavyaM bhavatA pashyAmIha janAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu rAj~nA sa dhRRitarAShTreNa dhImatA |
tUShNIM babhUva medhAvI tamuvAchAtha keshavaH
shlokas.2:
atIva manasA shokaH kriyamANo janAdhipa |
santApayati vaitasya pUrvapretAnpitAmahAn
shlokas.3:
yajasva vividhairyaj~nairbahubhiH svAptadakShiNaiH |
devA.nstarpaya somena svadhayA cha pitR^Inapi
shlokas.4:
tvadvidhasya mahAbuddhe naitadadyopapadyate |
viditaM veditavyaM te kartavyamapi te kRRitam
shlokas.5:
shrutAshcha rAjadharmAste bhIShmAdbhAgIrathIsutAt |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAchchaiva nAradAdvidurAttathA
shlokas.6:
nemAmarhasi mUDhAnAM vRRittiM tvamanuvartitum |
pitRRipaitAmahIM vRRittimAsthAya dhuramudvaha
shlokas.7:
yuktaM hi yashasA kShatraM svargaM prAptumasa.nshayam |
na hi kashchana shUrANAM nihato.atra parA~NmukhaH
shlokas.8:
tyaja shokaM mahArAja bhavitavyaM hi tattathA |
na shakyAste punardraShTuM tvayA hyasminraNe hatAH
shlokas.9:
etAvaduktvA govindo dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
virarAma mahAtejAstamuvAcha yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
govinda mayi yA prItistava sA viditA mama |
sauhRRidena tathA premNA sadA mAmanukampase
shlokas.11:
priyaM tu me syAtsumahatkRRitaM chakragadAdhara |
shrImanprItena manasA sarvaM yAvadanandana
shlokas.12:
yadi mAmanujAnIyAdbhavAngantuM tapovanam |
na hi shAntiM prapashyAmi ghAtayitvA pitAmaham
karNaM cha puruShavyAghraM sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinam
shlokas.13:
karmaNA yena muchyeyamasmAtkrUrAdari.ndama |
karmaNastadvidhatsveha yena shudhyati me manaH
shlokas.14:
tameva.nvAdinaM vyAsastataH provAcha dharmavit |
sAntvayansumahAtejAH shubhaM vachanamarthavat
shlokas.15:
akRRitA te matistAta punarbAlyena muhyase |
kimAkAshe vayaM sarve pralapAma muhurmuhuH
shlokas.16:
viditAH kShatradharmAste yeShAM yuddhena jIvikA |
yathA pravRRitto nRRipatirnAdhibandhena yujyate
shlokas.17:
mokShadharmAshcha nikhilA yAthAtathyena te shrutAH |
asakRRichchaiva sa.ndehAshChinnAste kAmajA mayA
shlokas.18:
ashraddadhAno durmedhA luptasmRRitirasi dhruvam |
maivaM bhava na te yuktamidamaj~nAnamIdRRisham
shlokas.19:
prAyashchittAni sarvANi viditAni cha te.anagha |
yuddhadharmAshcha te sarve dAnadharmAshcha te shrutAH
shlokas.20:
sa kathaM sarvadharmaj~naH sarvAgamavishAradaH |
parimuhyasi bhUyastvamaj~nAnAdiva bhArata

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yudhiShThira tava praj~nA na samyagiti me matiH |
na hi kashchitsvayaM martyaH svavashaH kurute kriyAH
shlokas.2:
IshvareNa niyukto.ayaM sAdhvasAdhu cha mAnavaH |
karoti puruShaH karma tatra kA paridevanA
shlokas.3:
AtmAnaM manyase chAtha pApakarmANamantataH |
shRRiNu tatra yathA pApamapakRRiShyeta bhArata
shlokas.4:
tapobhiH kratubhishchaiva dAnena cha yudhiShThira |
taranti nityaM puruShA ye sma pApAni kurvate
shlokas.5:
yaj~nena tapasA chaiva dAnena cha narAdhipa |
pUyante rAjashArdUla narA duShkRRitakarmiNaH
shlokas.6:
asurAshcha surAshchaiva puNyahetormakhakriyAm |
prayatante mahAtmAnastasmAdyaj~nAH parAyaNam
shlokas.7:
yaj~naireva mahAtmAno babhUvuradhikAH surAH |
tato devAH kriyAvanto dAnavAnabhyadharShayan
shlokas.8:
rAjasUyAshvamedhau cha sarvamedhaM cha bhArata |
naramedhaM cha nRRipate tvamAhara yudhiShThira
shlokas.9:
yajasva vAjimedhena vidhivaddakShiNAvatA |
bahukAmAnnavittena rAmo dAsharathiryathA
shlokas.10:
yathA cha bharato rAjA dauHShantiH pRRithivIpatiH |
shAkuntalo mahAvIryastava pUrvapitAmahaH
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
asa.nshayaM vAjimedhaH pAvayetpRRithivImapi |
abhiprAyastu me kashchittaM tvaM shrotumihArhasi
shlokas.12:
imaM j~nAtivadhaM kRRitvA sumahAntaM dvijottama |
dAnamalpaM na shakyAmi dAtuM vittaM cha nAsti me
shlokas.13:
na cha bAlAnimAndInAnutsahe vasu yAchitum |
tathaivArdravraNAnkRRichChre vartamAnAnnRRipAtmajAn
shlokas.14:
svayaM vinAshya pRRithivIM yaj~nArthe dvijasattama |
karamAhArayiShyAmi kathaM shokaparAyaNAn
shlokas.15:
duryodhanAparAdhena vasudhA vasudhAdhipAH |
pranaShTA yojayitvAsmAnakIrtyA munisattama
shlokas.16:
duryodhanena pRRithivI kShayitA vittakAraNAt |
koshashchApi vishIrNo.asau dhArtarAShTrasya durmateH
shlokas.17:
pRRithivI dakShiNA chAtra vidhiH prathamakalpikaH |
vidvadbhiH paridRRiShTo.ayaM shiShTo vidhiviparyayaH
shlokas.18:
na cha pratinidhiM kartuM chikIrShAmi tapodhana |
atra me bhagavansamyaksAchivyaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu pArthena kRRiShNadvaipAyanastadA |
muhUrtamanusa~nchintya dharmarAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.20:
vidyate draviNaM pArtha girau himavati sthitam |
utsRRiShTaM brAhmaNairyaj~ne maruttasya mahIpateH
tadAnayasva kaunteya paryAptaM tadbhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
kathaM yaj~ne maruttasya draviNaM tatsamAchitam |
kasmi.nshcha kAle sa nRRipo babhUva vadatAM vara
shlokas.22:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yadi shushrUShase pArtha shRRiNu kArandhamaM nRRipam |
yasminkAle mahAvIryaH sa rAjAsInmahAdhanaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shushrUShe tasya dharmaj~na rAjarSheH parikIrtanam |
dvaipAyana maruttasya kathAM prabrUhi me.anagha
shlokas.2:
vyAsa uvAcha||
AsItkRRitayuge pUrvaM manurdaNDadharaH prabhuH |
tasya putro maheShvAsaH prajAtiriti vishrutaH
shlokas.3:
prajAterabhavatputraH kShupa ityabhivishrutaH |
kShupasya putrastvikShvAkurmahIpAlo.abhavatprabhuH
shlokas.4:
tasya putrashataM rAjannAsItparamadhArmikam |
tA.nstu sarvAnmahIpAlAnikShvAkurakarotprabhuH
shlokas.5:
teShAM jyeShThastu vi.nsho.abhUtpratimAnaM dhanuShmatAm |
vi.nshasya putraH kalyANo vivi.nsho nAma bhArata
shlokas.6:
vivi.nshasya sutA rAjanbabhUvurdasha pa~ncha cha |
sarve dhanuShi vikrAntA brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH
shlokas.7:
dAnadharmaratAH santaH satataM priyavAdinaH |
teShAM jyeShThaH khanInetraH sa tAnsarvAnapIDayat
shlokas.8:
khanInetrastu vikrAnto jitvA rAjyamakaNTakam |
nAshaknodrakShituM rAjyaM nAnvarajyanta taM prajAH
shlokas.9:
tamapAsya cha tadrAShTraM tasya putraM suvarchasam |
abhyaShi~nchata rAjendra muditaM chAbhavattadA
shlokas.10:
sa piturvikriyAM dRRiShTvA rAjyAnnirasanaM tathA |
niyato vartayAmAsa prajAhitachikIrShayA
shlokas.11:
brahmaNyaH satyavAdI cha shuchiH shamadamAnvitaH |
prajAstaM chAnvarajyanta dharmanityaM manasvinam
shlokas.12:
tasya dharmapravRRittasya vyashIryatkoshavAhanam |
taM kShINakoshaM sAmantAH samantAtparyapIDayan
shlokas.13:
sa pIDyamAno bahubhiH kShINakoshastvavAhanaH |
ArtimArChatparAM rAjA saha bhRRityaiH pureNa cha
shlokas.14:
na chainaM parihartuM te.ashaknuvanparisa~NkShaye |
samyagvRRitto hi rAjA sa dharmanityo yudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
yadA tu paramAmArtiM gato.asau sapuro nRRipaH |
tataH pradadhmau sa karaM prAdurAsIttato balam
shlokas.16:
tatastAnajayatsarvAnprAtisImAnnarAdhipAn |
etasmAtkAraNAdrAjanvishrutaH sa karandhamaH
shlokas.17:
tasya kArandhamaH putrastretAyugamukhe.abhavat |
indrAdanavaraH shrImAndevairapi sudurjayaH
shlokas.18:
tasya sarve mahIpAlA vartante sma vashe tadA |
sa hi samrADabhUtteShAM vRRittena cha balena cha
shlokas.19:
avikShinnAma dharmAtmA shauryeNendrasamo.abhavat |
yaj~nashIlaH karmaratirdhRRitimAnsa.nyatendriyaH
shlokas.20:
tejasAdityasadRRishaH kShamayA pRRithivIsamaH |
bRRihaspatisamo buddhyA himavAniva susthiraH
shlokas.21:
karmaNA manasA vAchA damena prashamena cha |
manA.nsyArAdhayAmAsa prajAnAM sa mahIpatiH
shlokas.22:
ya Ije hayamedhAnAM shatena vidhivatprabhuH |
yAjayAmAsa yaM vidvAnsvayamevA~NgirAH prabhuH
shlokas.23:
tasya putro.atichakrAma pitaraM guNavattayA |
marutto nAma dharmaj~nashchakravartI mahAyashAH
shlokas.24:
nAgAyutasamaprANaH sAkShAdviShNurivAparaH |
sa yakShyamANo dharmAtmA shAtakumbhamayAnyuta
kArayAmAsa shubhrANi bhAjanAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.25:
meruM parvatamAsAdya himavatpArshva uttare |
kA~nchanaH sumahAnpAdastatra karma chakAra saH
shlokas.26:
tataH kuNDAni pAtrIshcha piTharANyAsanAni cha |
chakruH suvarNakartAro yeShAM sa~NkhyA na vidyate
shlokas.27:
tasyaiva cha samIpe sa yaj~navATo babhUva ha |
Ije tatra sa dharmAtmA vidhivatpRRithivIpatiH
maruttaH sahitaiH sarvaiH prajApAlairnarAdhipaH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
katha.nvIryaH samabhavatsa rAjA vadatAM varaH |
kathaM cha jAtarUpeNa samayujyata sa dvija
shlokas.2:
kva cha tatsAmprataM dravyaM bhagavannavatiShThate |
kathaM cha shakyamasmAbhistadavAptuM tapodhana
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
asurAshchaiva devAshcha dakShasyAsanprajApateH |
apatyaM bahulaM tAta te.aspardhanta parasparam
shlokas.4:
tathaivA~NgirasaH putrau vratatulyau babhUvatuH |
bRRihaspatirbRRihattejAH sa.nvartashcha tapodhanaH
shlokas.5:
tAvapi spardhinau rAjanpRRithagAstAM parasparam |
bRRihaspatishcha sa.nvartaM bAdhate sma punaH punaH
shlokas.6:
sa bAdhyamAnaH satataM bhrAtrA jyeShThena bhArata |
arthAnutsRRijya digvAsA vanavAsamarochayat
shlokas.7:
vAsavo.apyasurAnsarvAnnirjitya cha nihatya cha |
indratvaM prApya lokeShu tato vavre purohitam
putrama~Ngiraso jyeShThaM viprashreShThaM bRRihaspatim
shlokas.8:
yAjyastva~NgirasaH pUrvamAsIdrAjA karandhamaH |
vIryeNApratimo loke vRRittena cha balena cha
shatakraturivaujasvI dharmAtmA sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.9:
vAhanaM yasya yodhAshcha dravyANi vividhAni cha |
dhyAnAdevAbhavadrAjanmukhavAtena sarvashaH
shlokas.10:
sa guNaiH pArthivAnsarvAnvashe chakre narAdhipaH |
sa~njIvya kAlamiShTaM cha sasharIro divaM gataH
shlokas.11:
babhUva tasya putrastu yayAtiriva dharmavit |
avikShinnAma shatrukShitsa vashe kRRitavAnmahIm
vikrameNa guNaishchaiva pitevAsItsa pArthivaH
shlokas.12:
tasya vAsavatulyo.abhUnmarutto nAma vIryavAn |
putrastamanuraktAbhUtpRRithivI sAgarAmbarA
shlokas.13:
spardhate satataM sa sma devarAjena pArthivaH |
vAsavo.api maruttena spardhate pANDunandana
shlokas.14:
shuchiH sa guNavAnAsInmaruttaH pRRithivIpatiH |
yatamAno.api yaM shakro na visheShayati sma ha
shlokas.15:
so.ashaknuvanvisheShAya samAhUya bRRihaspatim |
uvAchedaM vacho devaiH sahito harivAhanaH
shlokas.16:
bRRihaspate maruttasya mA sma kArShIH katha~nchana |
daivaM karmAtha vA pitryaM kartAsi mama chetpriyam
shlokas.17:
ahaM hi triShu lokeShu surANAM cha bRRihaspate |
indratvaM prAptavAneko maruttastu mahIpatiH
shlokas.18:
kathaM hyamartyaM brahma.nstvaM yAjayitvA surAdhipam |
yAjayermRRityusa.nyuktaM maruttamavisha~NkayA
shlokas.19:
mAM vA vRRiNIShva bhadraM te maruttaM vA mahIpatim |
parityajya maruttaM vA yathAjoShaM bhajasva mAm
shlokas.20:
evamuktaH sa kauravya devarAj~nA bRRihaspatiH |
muhUrtamiva sa~nchintya devarAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.21:
tvaM bhUtAnAmadhipatistvayi lokAH pratiShThitAH |
namuchervishvarUpasya nihantA tvaM balasya cha
shlokas.22:
tvamAjahartha devAnAmeko vIra shriyaM parAm |
tvaM bibharShi bhuvaM dyAM cha sadaiva balasUdana
shlokas.23:
paurohityaM kathaM kRRitvA tava devagaNeshvara |
yAjayeyamahaM martyaM maruttaM pAkashAsana
shlokas.24:
samAshvasihi devesha nAhaM martyAya karhichit |
grahIShyAmi sruvaM yaj~ne shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.25:
hiraNyaretaso.ambhaH syAtparivarteta medinI |
bhAsaM cha na raviH kuryAnmatsatyaM vichaledyadi
shlokas.26:
bRRihaspativachaH shrutvA shakro vigatamatsaraH |
prashasyainaM viveshAtha svameva bhavanaM tadA

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
bRRihaspateshcha sa.nvAdaM maruttasya cha bhArata
shlokas.2:
devarAjasya samayaM kRRitamA~Ngirasena ha |
shrutvA marutto nRRipatirmanyumAhArayattadA
shlokas.3:
sa~Nkalpya manasA yaj~naM karandhamasutAtmajaH |
bRRihaspatimupAgamya vAgmI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.4:
bhagavanyanmayA pUrvamabhigamya tapodhana |
kRRito.abhisandhiryaj~nAya bhavato vachanAdguro
shlokas.5:
tamahaM yaShTumichChAmi sambhArAH sambhRRitAshcha me |
yAjyo.asmi bhavataH sAdho tatprApnuhi vidhatsva cha
shlokas.6:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
na kAmaye yAjayituM tvAmahaM pRRithivIpate |
vRRito.asmi devarAjena pratij~nAtaM cha tasya me
shlokas.7:
marutta uvAcha||
pitryamasmi tava kShetraM bahu manye cha te bhRRisham |
na chAsmyayAjyatAM prApto bhajamAnaM bhajasva mAm
shlokas.8:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
amartyaM yAjayitvAhaM yAjayiShye na mAnuSham |
marutta gachCha vA mA vA nivRRitto.asmyadya yAjanAt
shlokas.9:
na tvAM yAjayitAsmyadya vRRiNu tvaM yamihechChasi |
upAdhyAyaM mahAbAho yaste yaj~naM kariShyati
shlokas.10:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evamuktastu nRRipatirmarutto vrIDito.abhavat |
pratyAgachChachcha sa.nvigno dadarsha pathi nAradam
shlokas.11:
devarShiNA samAgamya nAradena sa pArthivaH |
vidhivatprA~njalistasthAvathainaM nArado.abravIt
shlokas.12:
rAjarShe nAtihRRiShTo.asi kachchitkShemaM tavAnagha |
kva gato.asi kuto vedamaprItisthAnamAgatam
shlokas.13:
shrotavyaM chenmayA rAjanbrUhi me pArthivarShabha |
vyapaneShyAmi te manyuM sarvayatnairnarAdhipa
shlokas.14:
evamukto maruttastu nAradena maharShiNA |
vipralambhamupAdhyAyAtsarvameva nyavedayat
shlokas.15:
gato.asmya~NgirasaH putraM devAchAryaM bRRihaspatim |
yaj~nArthamRRitvijaM draShTuM sa cha mAM nAbhyanandata
shlokas.16:
pratyAkhyAtashcha tenAhaM jIvituM nAdya kAmaye |
parityaktashcha guruNA dUShitashchAsmi nArada
shlokas.17:
evamuktastu rAj~nA sa nAradaH pratyuvAcha ha |
AvikShitaM mahArAja vAchA sa~njIvayanniva
shlokas.18:
rAjanna~NgirasaH putraH sa.nvarto nAma dhArmikaH |
cha~NkramIti dishaH sarvA digvAsA mohayanprajAH
shlokas.19:
taM gachCha yadi yAjyaM tvAM na vA~nChati bRRihaspatiH |
prasannastvAM mahArAja sa.nvarto yAjayiShyati
shlokas.20:
marutta uvAcha||
sa~njIvito.ahaM bhavatA vAkyenAnena nArada |
pashyeyaM kva nu sa.nvartaM sha.nsa me vadatAM vara
shlokas.21:
kathaM cha tasmai varteyaM kathaM mAM na parityajet |
pratyAkhyAtashcha tenApi nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
shlokas.22:
nArada uvAcha||
unmattaveShaM bibhratsa cha~NkramIti yathAsukham |
vArANasIM tu nagarImabhIkShNamupasevate
shlokas.23:
tasyA dvAraM samAsAdya nyasethAH kuNapaM kvachit |
taM dRRiShTvA yo nivarteta sa sa.nvarto mahIpate
shlokas.24:
taM pRRiShThato.anugachChethA yatra gachChetsa vIryavAn |
tamekAnte samAsAdya prA~njaliH sharaNaM vrajeH
shlokas.25:
pRRichChettvAM yadi kenAhaM tavAkhyAta iti sma ha |
brUyAstvaM nAradeneti santapta iva shatruhan
shlokas.26:
sa chettvAmanuyu~njIta mamAbhigamanepsayA |
sha.nsethA vahnimArUDhaM mAmapi tvamasha~NkayA
shlokas.27:
vyAsa uvAcha||
sa tatheti pratishrutya pUjayitvA cha nAradam |
abhyanuj~nAya rAjarShiryayau vArANasIM purIm
shlokas.28:
tatra gatvA yathoktaM sa puryA dvAre mahAyashAH |
kuNapaM sthApayAmAsa nAradasya vachaH smaran
shlokas.29:
yaugapadyena viprashcha sa purIdvAramAvishat |
tataH sa kuNapaM dRRiShTvA sahasA sa nyavartata
shlokas.30:
sa taM nivRRittamAlakShya prA~njaliH pRRiShThato.anvagAt |
AvikShito mahIpAlaH sa.nvartamupashikShitum
shlokas.31:
sa enaM vijane dRRiShTvA pA.nsubhiH kardamena cha |
shleShmaNA chApi rAjAnaM ShThIvanaishcha samAkirat
shlokas.32:
sa tathA bAdhyamAno.api sa.nvartena mahIpatiH |
anvagAdeva tamRRiShiM prA~njaliH samprasAdayan
shlokas.33:
tato nivRRitya sa.nvartaH parishrAnta upAvishat |
shItalachChAyamAsAdya nyagrodhaM bahushAkhinam

shlokas.1:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
kathamasmi tvayA j~nAtaH kena vA kathito.asmi te |
etadAchakShva me tattvamichChase chetpriyaM mama
shlokas.2:
satyaM te bruvataH sarve sampatsyante manorathAH |
mithyA tu bruvato mUrdhA saptadhA te phaliShyati
shlokas.3:
marutta uvAcha||
nAradena bhavAnmahyamAkhyAto hyaTatA pathi |
guruputro mameti tvaM tato me prItiruttamA
shlokas.4:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
satyametadbhavAnAha sa mAM jAnAti satriNam |
kathayasvaitadekaM me kva nu samprati nAradaH
shlokas.5:
marutta uvAcha||
bhavantaM kathayitvA tu mama devarShisattamaH |
tato mAmabhyanuj~nAya praviShTo havyavAhanam
shlokas.6:
vyAsa uvAcha||
shrutvA tu pArthivasyaitatsa.nvartaH parayA mudA |
etAvadahamapyenaM kuryAmiti tadAbravIt
shlokas.7:
tato maruttamunmatto vAchA nirbhartsayanniva |
rUkShayA brAhmaNo rAjanpunaH punarathAbravIt
shlokas.8:
vAtapradhAnena mayA svachittavashavartinA |
evaM vikRRitarUpeNa kathaM yAjitumichChasi
shlokas.9:
bhrAtA mama samarthashcha vAsavena cha satkRRitaH |
vartate yAjane chaiva tena karmANi kAraya
shlokas.10:
gRRihaM svaM chaiva yAjyAshcha sarvA gRRihyAshcha devatAH |
pUrvajena mamAkShiptaM sharIraM varjitaM tvidam
shlokas.11:
nAhaM tenAnanuj~nAtastvAmAvikShita karhichit |
yAjayeyaM katha~nchidvai sa hi pUjyatamo mama
shlokas.12:
sa tvaM bRRihaspatiM gachCha tamanuj~nApya chAvraja |
tato.ahaM yAjayiShye tvAM yadi yaShTumihechChasi
shlokas.13:
marutta uvAcha||
bRRihaspatiM gataH pUrvamahaM sa.nvarta tachChRRiNu |
na mAM kAmayate yAjyamasau vAsavavAritaH
shlokas.14:
amaraM yAjyamAsAdya mAmRRiShe mA sma mAnuSham |
yAjayethA maruttaM tvaM martyadharmANamAturam
shlokas.15:
spardhate cha mayA vipra sadA vai sa hi pArthivaH |
evamastviti chApyukto bhrAtrA te balavRRitrahA
shlokas.16:
sa mAmabhigataM premNA yAjyavanna bubhUShati |
devarAjamupAshritya tadviddhi munipu~Ngava
shlokas.17:
so.ahamichChAmi bhavatA sarvasvenApi yAjitum |
kAmaye samatikrAntuM vAsavaM tvatkRRitairguNaiH
shlokas.18:
na hi me vartate buddhirgantuM brahmanbRRihaspatim |
pratyAkhyAto hi tenAsmi tathAnapakRRite sati
shlokas.19:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
chikIrShasi yathAkAmaM sarvametattvayi dhruvam |
yadi sarvAnabhiprAyAnkartAsi mama pArthiva
shlokas.20:
yAjyamAnaM mayA hi tvAM bRRihaspatipura.ndarau |
dviShetAM samabhikruddhAvetadekaM samarthaya
shlokas.21:
sthairyamatra kathaM te syAtsa tvaM niHsa.nshayaM kuru |
kupitastvAM na hIdAnIM bhasma kuryAM sabAndhavam
shlokas.22:
marutta uvAcha||
yAvattapetsahasrA.nshustiShThera.nshchApi parvatAH |
tAvallokAnna labheyaM tyajeyaM sa~NgataM yadi
shlokas.23:
mA chApi shubhabuddhitvaM labheyamiha karhichit |
samyagj~nAne vaiShaye vA tyajeyaM sa~NgataM yadi
shlokas.24:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
AvikShita shubhA buddhirdhIyatAM tava karmasu |
yAjanaM hi mamApyevaM vartate tvayi pArthiva
shlokas.25:
sa.nvidhAsye cha te rAjannakShayaM dravyamuttamam |
yena devAnsagandharvA~nshakraM chAbhibhaviShyasi
shlokas.26:
na tu me vartate buddhirdhane yAjyeShu vA punaH |
vipriyaM tu chikIrShAmi bhrAtushchendrasya chobhayoH
shlokas.27:
gamayiShyAmi chendreNa samatAmapi te dhruvam |
priyaM cha te kariShyAmi satyametadbravImi te

shlokas.1:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
girerhimavataH pRRiShThe mu~njavAnnAma parvataH |
tapyate yatra bhagavA.nstapo nityamumApatiH
shlokas.2:
vanaspatInAM mUleShu Ta~NkeShu shikhareShu cha |
guhAsu shailarAjasya yathAkAmaM yathAsukham
shlokas.3:
umAsahAyo bhagavAnyatra nityaM maheshvaraH |
Aste shUlI mahAtejA nAnAbhUtagaNAvRRitaH
shlokas.4:
tatra rudrAshcha sAdhyAshcha vishve.atha vasavastathA |
yamashcha varuNashchaiva kuberashcha sahAnugaH
shlokas.5:
bhUtAni cha pishAchAshcha nAsatyAvashvinAvapi |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva yakShA devarShayastathA
shlokas.6:
AdityA marutashchaiva yAtudhAnAshcha sarvashaH |
upAsante mahAtmAnaM bahurUpamumApatim
shlokas.7:
ramate bhagavA.nstatra kuberAnucharaiH saha |
vikRRitairvikRRitAkAraiH krIDadbhiH pRRithivIpate
shriyA jvalandRRishyate vai bAlAdityasamadyutiH
shlokas.8:
na rUpaM dRRishyate tasya sa.nsthAnaM vA katha~nchana |
nirdeShTuM prANibhiH kaishchitprAkRRitairmA.nsalochanaiH
shlokas.9:
noShNaM na shishiraM tatra na vAyurna cha bhAskaraH |
na jarA kShutpipAse vA na mRRityurna bhayaM nRRipa
shlokas.10:
tasya shailasya pArshveShu sarveShu jayatAM vara |
dhAtavo jAtarUpasya rashmayaH savituryathA
shlokas.11:
rakShyante te kuberasya sahAyairudyatAyudhaiH |
chikIrShadbhiH priyaM rAjankuberasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
tasmai bhagavate kRRitvA namaH sharvAya vedhase |
rudrAya shitikaNThAya surUpAya suvarchase
shlokas.13:
kapardine karAlAya haryakShNe varadAya cha |
tryakShNe pUShNo dantabhide vAmanAya shivAya cha
shlokas.14:
yAmyAyAvyaktakeshAya sadvRRitte sha~NkarAya cha |
kShemyAya harinetrAya sthANave puruShAya cha
shlokas.15:
harikeshAya muNDAya kRRishAyottAraNAya cha |
bhAskarAya sutIrthAya devadevAya raMhase
shlokas.16:
uShNIShiNe suvaktrAya sahasrAkShAya mIDhuShe |
girishAya prashAntAya yataye chIravAsase
shlokas.17:
bilvadaNDAya siddhAya sarvadaNDadharAya cha |
mRRigavyAdhAya mahate dhanvine.atha bhavAya cha
shlokas.18:
varAya saumyavaktrAya pashuhastAya varShiNe |
hiraNyabAhave rAjannugrAya pataye dishAm
shlokas.19:
pashUnAM pataye chaiva bhUtAnAM pataye tathA |
vRRiShAya mAtRRibhaktAya senAnye madhyamAya cha
shlokas.20:
sruvahastAya pataye dhanvine bhArgavAya cha |
ajAya kRRiShNanetrAya virUpAkShAya chaiva ha
shlokas.21:
tIkShNadaMShTrAya tIkShNAya vaishvAnaramukhAya cha |
mahAdyutaye.ana~NgAya sarvA~NgAya prajAvate
shlokas.22:
tathA shukrAdhipataye pRRithave kRRittivAsase |
kapAlamAline nityaM suvarNamukuTAya cha
shlokas.23:
mahAdevAya kRRiShNAya tryambakAyAnaghAya cha |
krodhanAya nRRisha.nsAya mRRidave bAhushAline
shlokas.24:
daNDine taptatapase tathaiva krUrakarmaNe |
sahasrashirase chaiva sahasracharaNAya cha
namaH svadhAsvarUpAya bahurUpAya daMShTriNe
shlokas.25:
pinAkinaM mahAdevaM mahAyoginamavyayam |
trishUlapANiM varadaM tryambakaM bhuvaneshvaram
shlokas.26:
tripuraghnaM trinayanaM trilokeshaM mahaujasam |
prabhavaM sarvabhUtAnAM dhAraNaM dharaNIdharam
shlokas.27:
IshAnaM sha~NkaraM sarvaM shivaM vishveshvaraM bhavam |
umApatiM pashupatiM vishvarUpaM maheshvaram
shlokas.28:
virUpAkShaM dashabhujaM tiShyagovRRiShabhadhvajam |
ugraM sthANuM shivaM ghoraM sharvaM gaurIshamIshvaram
shlokas.29:
shitikaNThamajaM shukraM pRRithuM pRRithuharaM haram |
vishvarUpaM virUpAkShaM bahurUpamumApatim
shlokas.30:
praNamya shirasA devamana~NgA~NgaharaM haram |
sharaNyaM sharaNaM yAhi mahAdevaM chaturmukham
shlokas.31:
evaM kRRitvA namastasmai mahAdevAya raMhase |
mahAtmane kShitipate tatsuvarNamavApsyasi
suvarNamAhariShyantastatra gachChantu te narAH
shlokas.32:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa vachastasya chakre kArandhamAtmajaH |
tato.atimAnuShaM sarvaM chakre yaj~nasya sa.nvidhim
sauvarNAni cha bhANDAni sa~nchakrustatra shilpinaH
shlokas.33:
bRRihaspatistu tAM shrutvA maruttasya mahIpateH |
samRRiddhimati devebhyaH santApamakarodbhRRisham
shlokas.34:
sa tapyamAno vaivarNyaM kRRishatvaM chAgamatparam |
bhaviShyati hi me shatruH sa.nvarto vasumAniti
shlokas.35:
taM shrutvA bhRRishasantaptaM devarAjo bRRihaspatim |
abhigamyAmaravRRitaH provAchedaM vachastadA

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
kachchitsukhaM svapiShi tvaM bRRihaspate; kachchinmanoj~nAH parichArakAste |
kachchiddevAnAM sukhakAmo.asi vipra; kachchiddevAstvAM paripAlayanti
shlokas.2:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
sukhaM shaye.ahaM shayane mahendra; tathA manoj~nAH parichArakA me |
tathA devAnAM sukhakAmo.asmi shakra; devAshcha mAM subhRRishaM pAlayanti
shlokas.3:
indra uvAcha||
kuto duHkhaM mAnasaM dehajaM vA; pANDurvivarNashcha kutastvamadya |
AchakShva me taddvija yAvadetA;nnihanmi sarvA.nstava duHkhakartR^In
shlokas.4:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
maruttamAhurmaghavanyakShyamANaM; mahAyaj~nenottamadakShiNena |
taM sa.nvarto yAjayiteti me shrutaM; tadichChAmi na sa taM yAjayeta
shlokas.5:
indra uvAcha||
sarvAnkAmAnanujAto.asi vipra; yastvaM devAnAM mantrayase purodhAH |
ubhau cha te janmamRRityU vyatItau; kiM sa.nvartastava kartAdya vipra
shlokas.6:
bRRihaspatiruvAcha||
devaiH saha tvamasurAnsampraNudya; jighA.nsase.adyApyuta sAnubandhAn |
yaM yaM samRRiddhaM pashyasi tatra tatra; duHkhaM sapatneShu samRRiddhabhAvaH
shlokas.7:
ato.asmi devendra vivarNarUpaH; sapatno me vardhate tannishamya |
sarvopAyairmaghavansaMniyachCha; sa.nvartaM vA pArthivaM vA maruttam
shlokas.8:
indra uvAcha||
ehi gachCha prahito jAtavedo; bRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
ayaM vai tvA yAjayitA bRRihaspati;stathAmaraM chaiva kariShyatIti
shlokas.9:
agniruvAcha||
ayaM gachChAmi tava shakrAdya dUto; bRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
vAchaM satyAM puruhUtasya kartuM; bRRihaspateshchApachitiM chikIrShuH
shlokas.10:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tataH prAyAddhUmaketurmahAtmA; vanaspatInvIrudhashchAvamRRidnan |
kAmAddhimAnte parivartamAnaH; kAShThAtigo mAtarishveva nardan
shlokas.11:
marutta uvAcha||
Ashcharyamadya pashyAmi rUpiNaM vahnimAgatam |
AsanaM salilaM pAdyaM gAM chopAnaya vai mune
shlokas.12:
agniruvAcha||
AsanaM salilaM pAdyaM pratinandAmi te.anagha |
indreNa tu samAdiShTaM viddhi mAM dUtamAgatam
shlokas.13:
marutta uvAcha||
kachchichChrImAndevarAjaH sukhI cha; kachchichchAsmAnprIyate dhUmaketo |
kachchiddevAshchAsya vashe yathAva;ttadbrUhi tvaM mama kArtsnyena deva
shlokas.14:
agniruvAcha||
shakro bhRRishaM susukhI pArthivendra; prItiM chechChatyajarAM vai tvayA saH |
devAshcha sarve vashagAstasya rAja;nsa.ndeshaM tvaM shRRiNu me devarAj~naH
shlokas.15:
yadarthaM mAM prAhiNottvatsakAshaM; bRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
ayaM gururyAjayitA nRRipa tvAM; martyaM santamamaraM tvAM karotu
shlokas.16:
marutta uvAcha||
sa.nvarto.ayaM yAjayitA dvijo me; bRRihaspatera~njalireSha tasya |
nAsau devaM yAjayitvA mahendraM; martyaM santaM yAjayannadya shobhet
shlokas.17:
agniruvAcha||
ye vai lokA devaloke mahAntaH; samprApsyase tAndevarAjaprasAdAt |
tvAM chedasau yAjayedvai bRRihaspati;rnUnaM svargaM tvaM jayeH kIrtiyuktaH
shlokas.18:
tathA lokA mAnuShA ye cha divyAH; prajApateshchApi ye vai mahAntaH |
te te jitA devarAjyaM cha kRRitsnaM; bRRihaspatishchedyAjayettvAM narendra
shlokas.19:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
mAsmAnevaM tvaM punarAgAH kathaM chi;dbRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
mA tvAM dhakShye chakShuShA dAruNena; sa~Nkruddho.ahaM pAvaka tannibodha
shlokas.20:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tato devAnagamaddhUmaketu;rdAhAdbhIto vyathito.ashvatthaparNavat |
taM vai dRRiShTvA prAha shakro mahAtmA; bRRihaspateH saMnidhau havyavAham
shlokas.21:
yattvaM gataH prahito jAtavedo; bRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
tatkiM prAha sa nRRipo yakShyamANaH; kachchidvachaH pratigRRihNAti tachcha
shlokas.22:
agniruvAcha||
na te vAchaM rochayate marutto; bRRihaspatera~njaliM prAhiNotsaH |
sa.nvarto mAM yAjayitetyabhIkShNaM; punaH punaH sa mayA prochyamAnaH
shlokas.23:
uvAchedaM mAnuShA ye cha divyAH; prajApaterye cha lokA mahAntaH |
tA.nshchellabheyaM sa.nvidaM tena kRRitvA; tathApi nechCheyamiti pratItaH
shlokas.24:
indra uvAcha||
punarbhavAnpArthivaM taM sametya; vAkyaM madIyaM prApaya svArthayuktam |
punaryadyukto na kariShyate vacha;stato vajraM samprahartAsmi tasmai
shlokas.25:
agniruvAcha||
gandharvarADyAtvayaM tatra dUto; bibhemyahaM vAsava tatra gantum |
sa.nrabdho mAmabravIttIkShNaroShaH; sa.nvarto vAkyaM charitabrahmacharyaH
shlokas.26:
yadyAgachCheH punarevaM kathaM chi;dbRRihaspatiM paridAtuM marutte |
daheyaM tvAM chakShuShA dAruNena; sa~Nkruddha ityetadavaihi shakra
shlokas.27:
indra uvAcha||
tvamevAnyAndahase jAtavedo; na hi tvadanyo vidyate bhasmakartA |
tvatsa.nsparshAtsarvaloko bibhe;tyashraddheyaM vadase havyavAha
shlokas.28:
agniruvAcha||
divaM devendra pRRithivIM chaiva sarvAM; sa.nveShTayestvaM svabalenaiva shakra |
eva.nvidhasyeha satastavAsau; kathaM vRRitrastridivaM prAgjahAra
shlokas.29:
indra uvAcha||
na chaNDikA ja~NgamA no kareNu;rna vArisomaM prapibAmi vahne |
na durbale vai visRRijAmi vajraM; ko me.asukhAya praharenmanuShyaH
shlokas.30:
pravrAjayeyaM kAlakeyAnpRRithivyA;mapAkarShaM dAnavAnantarikShAt |
divaH prahrAdamavasAnamAnayaM; ko me.asukhAya prahareta martyaH
shlokas.31:
agniruvAcha||
yatra sharyAtiM chyavano yAjayiShya;nsahAshvibhyAM somamagRRihNadekaH |
taM tvaM kruddhaH pratyaShedhIH purastA;chCharyAtiyaj~naM smara taM mahendra
shlokas.32:
vajraM gRRihItvA cha pura.ndara tvaM; samprAhArShIshchyavanasyAtighoram |
sa te vipraH saha vajreNa bAhu;mapAgRRihNAttapasA jAtamanyuH
shlokas.33:
tato roShAtsarvato ghorarUpaM; sapatnaM te janayAmAsa bhUyaH |
madaM nAmAsuraM vishvarUpaM; yaM tvaM dRRiShTvA chakShuShI saMnyamIlaH
shlokas.34:
hanurekA jagatIsthA tathaikA; divaM gatA mahato dAnavasya |
sahasraM dantAnAM shatayojanAnAM; sutIkShNAnAM ghorarUpaM babhUva
shlokas.35:
vRRittAH sthUlA rajatastambhavarNA; daMShTrAshchatasro dve shate yojanAnAm |
sa tvAM dantAnvidashannabhyadhAva;jjighA.nsayA shUlamudyamya ghoram
shlokas.36:
apashyastvaM taM tadA ghorarUpaM; sarve tvanye dadRRishurdarshanIyam |
yasmAdbhItaH prA~njalistvaM maharShi;mAgachChethAH sharaNaM dAnavaghna
shlokas.37:
kShatrAdevaM brahmabalaM garIyo; na brahmataH ki~nchidanyadgarIyaH |
so.ahaM jAnanbrahmatejo yathAva;nna sa.nvartaM gantumichChAmi shakra

shlokas.1:
indra uvAcha||
evametadbrahmabalaM garIyo; na brahmataH ki~nchidanyadgarIyaH |
AvikShitasya tu balaM na mRRiShye; vajramasmai prahariShyAmi ghoram
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTra prahito gachCha maruttaM; sa.nvartena sahitaM taM vadasva |
bRRihaspatiM tvamupashikShasva rAja;nvajraM vA te prahariShyAmi ghoram
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tato gatvA dhRRitarAShTro narendraM; provAchedaM vachanaM vAsavasya |
gandharvaM mAM dhRRitarAShTraM nibodha; tvAmAgataM vaktukAmaM narendra
shlokas.4:
aindraM vAkyaM shRRiNu me rAjasiMha; yatprAha lokAdhipatirmahAtmA |
bRRihaspatiM yAjakaM tvaM vRRiNIShva; vajraM vA te prahariShyAmi ghoram
vachashchedetanna kariShyase me; prAhaitadetAvadachintyakarmA
shlokas.5:
marutta uvAcha||
tvaM chaivaitadvettha pura.ndarashcha; vishvedevA vasavashchAshvinau cha |
mitradrohe niShkRRitirvai yathaiva; nAstIti lokeShu sadaiva vAdaH
shlokas.6:
bRRihaspatiryAjayitA mahendraM; devashreShThaM vajrabhRRitAM variShTham |
sa.nvarto mAM yAjayitAdya rAja;nna te vAkyaM tasya vA rochayAmi
shlokas.7:
gandharva uvAcha||
ghoro nAdaH shrUyate vAsavasya; nabhastale garjato rAjasiMha |
vyaktaM vajraM mokShyate te mahendraH; kShemaM rAja.nshchintyatAmeSha kAlaH
shlokas.8:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ityevamukto dhRRitarAShTreNa rAjA; shrutvA nAdaM nadato vAsavasya |
taponityaM dharmavidAM variShThaM; sa.nvartaM taM j~nApayAmAsa kAryam
shlokas.9:
marutta uvAcha||
imamashmAnaM plavamAnamArA;dadhvA dUraM tena na dRRishyate.adya |
prapadye.ahaM sharma viprendra tvattaH; prayachCha tasmAdabhayaM vipramukhya
shlokas.10:
ayamAyAti vai vajrI disho vidyotayandasha |
amAnuSheNa ghoreNa sadasyAstrAsitA hi naH
shlokas.11:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
bhayaM shakrAdvyetu te rAjasiMha; praNotsye.ahaM bhayametatsughoram |
sa.nstambhinyA vidyayA kShiprameva; mA bhaistvamasmAdbhava chApi pratItaH
shlokas.12:
ahaM sa.nstambhayiShyAmi mA bhaistvaM shakrato nRRipa |
sarveShAmeva devAnAM kShapitAnyAyudhAni me
shlokas.13:
disho vajraM vrajatAM vAyuretu; varShaM bhUtvA nipatatu kAnaneShu |
ApaH plavantvantarikShe vRRithA cha; saudAminI dRRishyatAM mA bibhastvam
shlokas.14:
atho vahnistrAtu vA sarvataste; kAmaM varShaM varShatu vAsavo vA |
vajraM tathA sthApayatAM cha vAyu;rmahAghoraM plavamAnaM jalaughaiH
shlokas.15:
marutta uvAcha||
ghoraH shabdaH shrUyate vai mahAsvano; vajrasyaiSha sahito mArutena |
AtmA hi me pravyathate muhurmuhu;rna me svAsthyaM jAyate chAdya vipra
shlokas.16:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
vajrAdugrAdvyetu bhayaM tavAdya; vAto bhUtvA hanmi narendra vajram |
bhayaM tyaktvA varamanyaM vRRiNIShva; kaM te kAmaM tapasA sAdhayAmi
shlokas.17:
marutta uvAcha||
indraH sAkShAtsahasAbhyetu vipra; haviryaj~ne pratigRRihNAtu chaiva |
svaM svaM dhiShNyaM chaiva juShantu devAH; sutaM somaM pratigRRihNantu chaiva
shlokas.18:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
ayamindro haribhirAyAti rAja;ndevaiH sarvaiH sahitaH somapIthI |
mantrAhUto yaj~namimaM mayAdya; pashyasvainaM mantravisrastakAyam
shlokas.19:
vyAsa uvAcha||
tato devaiH sahito devarAjo; rathe yuktvA tAnharInvAjimukhyAn |
AyAdyaj~namadhi rAj~naH pipAsu;rAvikShitasyAprameyasya somam
shlokas.20:
tamAyAntaM sahitaM devasa~NghaiH; pratyudyayau sapurodhA maruttaH |
chakre pUjAM devarAjAya chAgryAM; yathAshAstraM vidhivatprIyamANaH
shlokas.21:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
svAgataM te puruhUteha vidva;nyaj~no.adyAyaM saMnihite tvayIndra |
shoshubhyate balavRRitraghna bhUyaH; pibasva somaM sutamudyataM mayA
shlokas.22:
marutta uvAcha||
shivena mAM pashya namashcha te.astu; prApto yaj~naH saphalaM jIvitaM me |
ayaM yaj~naM kurute me surendra; bRRihaspateravaro janmanA yaH
shlokas.23:
indra uvAcha||
jAnAmi te gurumenaM tapodhanaM; bRRihaspateranujaM tigmatejasam |
yasyAhvAnAdAgato.ahaM narendra; prItirme.adya tvayi manuH pranaShTaH
shlokas.24:
sa.nvarta uvAcha||
yadi prItastvamasi vai devarAja; tasmAtsvayaM shAdhi yaj~ne vidhAnam |
svayaM sarvAnkuru mArgAnsurendra; jAnAtvayaM sarvalokashcha deva
shlokas.25:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evamuktastvA~Ngirasena shakraH; samAdidesha svayameva devAn |
sabhAH kriyantAmAvasathAshcha mukhyAH; sahasrashashchitrabhaumAH samRRiddhAH
shlokas.26:
kL^iptasthUNAH kurutArohaNAni; gandharvANAmapsarasAM cha shIghram |
yeShu nRRityerannapsarasaH sahasrashaH; svargoddeshaH kriyatAM yaj~navATaH
shlokas.27:
ityuktAste chakrurAshu pratItA; divaukasaH shakravAkyAnnarendra |
tato vAkyaM prAha rAjAnamindraH; prIto rAjanpUjayAno maruttam
shlokas.28:
eSha tvayAhamiha rAjansametya; ye chApyanye tava pUrve narendrAH |
sarvAshchAnyA devatAH prIyamANA; havistubhyaM pratigRRihNantu rAjan
shlokas.29:
AgneyaM vai lohitamAlabhantAM; vaishvadevaM bahurUpaM virAjan |
nIlaM chokShANaM medhyamabhyAlabhantAM; chalachChishnaM matpradiShTaM dvijendrAH
shlokas.30:
tato yaj~no vavRRidhe tasya rAj~no; yatra devAH svayamannAni jahruH |
yasmi~nshakro brAhmaNaiH pUjyamAnaH; sadasyo.abhUddharimAndevarAjaH
shlokas.31:
tataH sa.nvartashchityagato mahAtmA; yathA vahniH prajvalito dvitIyaH |
havIMShyuchchairAhvayandevasa~NghA;~njuhAvAgnau mantravatsupratItaH
shlokas.32:
tataH pItvA balabhitsomamagryaM; ye chApyanye somapA vai divaukasaH |
sarve.anuj~nAtAH prayayuH pArthivena; yathAjoShaM tarpitAH prItimantaH
shlokas.33:
tato rAjA jAtarUpasya rAshI;npade pade kArayAmAsa hRRiShTaH |
dvijAtibhyo visRRijanbhUri vittaM; rarAja vittesha ivArihantA
shlokas.34:
tato vittaM vividhaM saMnidhAya; yathotsAhaM kArayitvA cha kosham |
anuj~nAto guruNA saMnivRRitya; shashAsa gAmakhilAM sAgarAntAm
shlokas.35:
eva~NguNaH sambabhUveha rAjA; yasya kratau tatsuvarNaM prabhUtam |
tattvaM samAdAya narendra vittaM; yajasva devA.nstarpayAno vidhAnaiH
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAjA pANDavo hRRiShTarUpaH; shrutvA vAkyaM satyavatyAH sutasya |
manashchakre tena vittena yaShTuM; tato.amAtyairmantrayAmAsa bhUyaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityukte nRRipatau tasminvyAsenAdbhutakarmaNA |
vAsudevo mahAtejAstato vachanamAdade
shlokas.2:
taM nRRipaM dInamanasaM nihataj~nAtibAndhavam |
upaplutamivAdityaM sadhUmamiva pAvakam
shlokas.3:
nirviNNamanasaM pArthaM j~nAtvA vRRiShNikulodvahaH |
AshvAsayandharmasutaM pravaktumupachakrame
shlokas.4:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
sarvaM jihmaM mRRityupadamArjavaM brahmaNaH padam |
etAvA~nj~nAnaviShayaH kiM pralApaH kariShyati
shlokas.5:
naiva te niShThitaM karma naiva te shatravo jitAH |
kathaM shatruM sharIrasthamAtmAnaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.6:
atra te vartayiShyAmi yathAdharmaM yathAshrutam |
indrasya saha vRRitreNa yathA yuddhamavartata
shlokas.7:
vRRitreNa pRRithivI vyAptA purA kila narAdhipa |
dRRiShTvA sa pRRithivIM vyAptAM gandhasya viShaye hRRite
dharAharaNadurgandho viShayaH samapadyata
shlokas.8:
shatakratushchukopAtha gandhasya viShaye hRRite |
vRRitrasya sa tataH kruddho vajraM ghoramavAsRRijat
shlokas.9:
sa vadhyamAno vajreNa pRRithivyAM bhUritejasA |
vivesha sahasaivApo jagrAha viShayaM tataH
shlokas.10:
vyAptAsvathApsu vRRitreNa rase cha viShaye hRRite |
shatakraturabhikruddhastAsu vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.11:
sa vadhyamAno vajreNa salile bhUritejasA |
vivesha sahasA jyotirjagrAha viShayaM tataH
shlokas.12:
vyApte jyotiShi vRRitreNa rUpe.atha viShaye hRRite |
shatakraturabhikruddhastatra vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.13:
sa vadhyamAno vajreNa subhRRishaM bhUritejasA |
vivesha sahasA vAyuM jagrAha viShayaM tataH
shlokas.14:
vyApte vAyau tu vRRitreNa sparshe.atha viShaye hRRite |
shatakraturabhikruddhastatra vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.15:
sa vadhyamAno vajreNa tasminnamitatejasA |
AkAshamabhidudrAva jagrAha viShayaM tataH
shlokas.16:
AkAshe vRRitrabhUte cha shabde cha viShaye hRRite |
shatakraturabhikruddhastatra vajramavAsRRijat
shlokas.17:
sa vadhyamAno vajreNa tasminnamitatejasA |
vivesha sahasA shakraM jagrAha viShayaM tataH
shlokas.18:
tasya vRRitragRRihItasya mohaH samabhavanmahAn |
rathantareNa taM tAta vasiShThaH pratyabodhayat
shlokas.19:
tato vRRitraM sharIrasthaM jaghAna bharatarShabha |
shatakraturadRRishyena vajreNetIha naH shrutam
shlokas.20:
idaM dharmarahasyaM cha shakreNoktaM maharShiShu |
RRiShibhishcha mama proktaM tannibodha narAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
dvividho jAyate vyAdhiH shArIro mAnasastathA |
parasparaM tayorjanma nirdva.ndvaM nopalabhyate
shlokas.2:
sharIre jAyate vyAdhiH shArIro nAtra sa.nshayaH |
mAnaso jAyate vyAdhirmanasyeveti nishchayaH
shlokas.3:
shItoShNe chaiva vAyushcha guNA rAja~nsharIrajAH |
teShAM guNAnAM sAmyaM chettadAhuH svasthalakShaNam
uShNena bAdhyate shItaM shItenoShNaM cha bAdhyate
shlokas.4:
sattvaM rajastamashcheti trayastvAtmaguNAH smRRitAH |
teShAM guNAnAM sAmyaM chettadAhuH svasthalakShaNam
teShAmanyatamotseke vidhAnamupadishyate
shlokas.5:
harSheNa bAdhyate shoko harShaH shokena bAdhyate |
kashchidduHkhe vartamAnaH sukhasya smartumichChati
kashchitsukhe vartamAno duHkhasya smartumichChati
shlokas.6:
sa tvaM na duHkhI duHkhasya na sukhI susukhasya vA |
smartumichChasi kaunteya diShTaM hi balavattaram
shlokas.7:
atha vA te svabhAvo.ayaM yena pArthAvakRRiShyase |
dRRiShTvA sabhAgatAM kRRiShNAmekavastrAM rajasvalAm
miShatAM pANDaveyAnAM na tatsa.nsmartumichChasi
shlokas.8:
pravrAjanaM cha nagarAdajinaishcha vivAsanam |
mahAraNyanivAsashcha na tasya smartumichChasi
shlokas.9:
jaTAsurAtparikleshashchitrasenena chAhavaH |
saindhavAchcha pariklesho na tasya smartumichChasi
shlokas.10:
punaraj~nAtacharyAyAM kIchakena padA vadhaH |
yAj~nasenyAstadA pArtha na tasya smartumichChasi
shlokas.11:
yachcha te droNabhIShmAbhyAM yuddhamAsIdari.ndama |
manasaikena yoddhavyaM tatte yuddhamupasthitam
tasmAdabhyupagantavyaM yuddhAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
paramavyaktarUpasya paraM muktvA svakarmabhiH |
yatra naiva sharaiH kAryaM na bhRRityairna cha bandhubhiH
Atmanaikena yoddhavyaM tatte yuddhamupasthitam
shlokas.13:
tasminnanirjite yuddhe kAmavasthAM gamiShyasi |
etajj~nAtvA tu kaunteya kRRitakRRityo bhaviShyasi
shlokas.14:
etAM buddhiM vinishchitya bhUtAnAmAgatiM gatim |
pitRRipaitAmahe vRRitte shAdhi rAjyaM yathochitam

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
na bAhyaM dravyamutsRRijya siddhirbhavati bhArata |
shArIraM dravyamutsRRijya siddhirbhavati vA na vA
shlokas.2:
bAhyadravyavimuktasya shArIreShu cha gRRidhyataH |
yo dharmo yatsukhaM chaiva dviShatAmastu tattathA
shlokas.3:
dvyakSharastu bhavenmRRityustryakSharaM brahma shAshvatam |
mameti dvyakSharo mRRityurna mameti cha shAshvatam
shlokas.4:
brahma mRRityushcha tau rAjannAtmanyeva vyavasthitau |
adRRishyamAnau bhUtAni yodhayetAmasa.nshayam
shlokas.5:
avinAsho.asya sattvasya niyato yadi bhArata |
bhittvA sharIraM bhUtAnAmahi.nsAM pratipadyate
shlokas.6:
labdhvApi pRRithivIM sarvAM sahasthAvaraja~NgamAm |
mamatvaM yasya naiva syAtkiM tayA sa kariShyati
shlokas.7:
atha vA vasataH pArtha vane vanyena jIvataH |
mamatA yasya dravyeShu mRRityorAsye sa vartate
shlokas.8:
bAhyAntarANAM shatrUNAM svabhAvaM pashya bhArata |
yanna pashyati tadbhUtaM muchyate sa mahAbhayAt
shlokas.9:
kAmAtmAnaM na prasha.nsanti loke; na chAkAmAtkAchidasti pravRRittiH |
dAnaM hi vedAdhyayanaM tapashcha; kAmena karmANi cha vaidikAni
shlokas.10:
vrataM yaj~nAnniyamAndhyAnayogA;nkAmena yo nArabhate viditvA |
yadyaddhyayaM kAmayate sa dharmo; na yo dharmo niyamastasya mUlam
shlokas.11:
atra gAthAH kAmagItAH kIrtayanti purAvidaH |
shRRiNu sa~NkIrtyamAnAstA nikhilena yudhiShThira
shlokas.12:
nAhaM shakyo.anupAyena hantuM bhUtena kenachit |
yo mAM prayatate hantuM j~nAtvA praharaNe balam
tasya tasminpraharaNe punaH prAdurbhavAmyaham
shlokas.13:
yo mAM prayatate hantuM yaj~nairvividhadakShiNaiH |
ja~NgameShviva karmAtmA punaH prAdurbhavAmyaham
shlokas.14:
yo mAM prayatate hantuM vedairvedAntasAdhanaiH |
sthAvareShviva shAntAtmA tasya prAdurbhavAmyaham
shlokas.15:
yo mAM prayatate hantuM dhRRityA satyaparAkramaH |
bhAvo bhavAmi tasyAhaM sa cha mAM nAvabudhyate
shlokas.16:
yo mAM prayatate hantuM tapasA sa.nshitavrataH |
tatastapasi tasyAtha punaH prAdurbhavAmyaham
shlokas.17:
yo mAM prayatate hantuM mokShamAsthAya paNDitaH |
tasya mokSharatisthasya nRRityAmi cha hasAmi cha
avadhyaH sarvabhUtAnAmahamekaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.18:
tasmAttvamapi taM kAmaM yaj~nairvividhadakShiNaiH |
dharmaM kuru mahArAja tatra te sa bhaviShyati
shlokas.19:
yajasva vAjimedhena vidhivaddakShiNAvatA |
anyaishcha vividhairyaj~naiH samRRiddhairAptadakShiNaiH
shlokas.20:
mA te vyathAstu nihatAnbandhUnvIkShya punaH punaH |
na shakyAste punardraShTuM ye hatAsminraNAjire
shlokas.21:
sa tvamiShTvA mahAyaj~naiH samRRiddhairAptadakShiNaiH |
loke kIrtiM parAM prApya gatimagryAM gamiShyasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM bahuvidhairvAkyairmunibhistaistapodhanaiH |
samAshvasyata rAjarShirhatabandhuryudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
so.anunIto bhagavatA viShTarashravasA svayam |
dvaipAyanena kRRiShNena devasthAnena chAbhibhUH
shlokas.3:
nAradenAtha bhImena nakulena cha pArthivaH |
kRRiShNayA sahadevena vijayena cha dhImatA
shlokas.4:
anyaishcha puruShavyAghrairbrAhmaNaiH shAstradRRiShTibhiH |
vyajahAchChokajaM duHkhaM santApaM chaiva mAnasam
shlokas.5:
archayAmAsa devA.nshcha brAhmaNA.nshcha yudhiShThiraH |
kRRitvAtha pretakAryANi bandhUnAM sa punarnRRipaH
anvashAsata dharmAtmA pRRithivIM sAgarAmbarAm
shlokas.6:
prashAntachetAH kauravyaH svarAjyaM prApya kevalam |
vyAsaM cha nAradaM chaiva tA.nshchAnyAnabravInnRRipaH
shlokas.7:
AshvAsito.ahaM prAgvRRiddhairbhavadbhirmunipu~NgavaiH |
na sUkShmamapi me ki~nchidvyalIkamiha vidyate
shlokas.8:
arthashcha sumahAnprApto yena yakShyAmi devatAH |
puraskRRityeha bhavataH samAneShyAmahe makham
shlokas.9:
himavantaM tvayA guptA gamiShyAmaH pitAmaha |
bahvAshcharyo hi deshaH sa shrUyate dvijasattama
shlokas.10:
tathA bhagavatA chitraM kalyANaM bahu bhAShitam |
devarShiNA nAradena devasthAnena chaiva ha
shlokas.11:
nAbhAgadheyaH puruShaH kashchideva.nvidhAngurUn |
labhate vyasanaM prApya suhRRidaH sAdhusaMmatAn
shlokas.12:
evamuktAstu te rAj~nA sarva eva maharShayaH |
abhyanuj~nApya rAjAnaM tathobhau kRRiShNaphalgunau
pashyatAmeva sarveShAM tatraivAdarshanaM yayuH
shlokas.13:
tato dharmasuto rAjA tatraivopAvishatprabhuH |
evaM nAtimahAnkAlaH sa teShAmabhyavartata
shlokas.14:
kurvatAM shauchakarmANi bhIShmasya nidhane tadA |
mahAdAnAni viprebhyo dadatAmaurdhvadaihikam
shlokas.15:
bhIShmakarNapurogANAM kurUNAM kurunandana |
sahito dhRRitarAShTreNa pradadAvaurdhvadaihikam
shlokas.16:
tato dattvA bahu dhanaM viprebhyaH pANDavarShabhaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya vivesha gajasAhvayam
shlokas.17:
sa samAshvAsya pitaraM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram |
anvashAdvai sa dharmAtmA pRRithivIM bhrAtRRibhiH saha

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
vijite pANDaveyaistu prashAnte cha dvijottama |
rAShTre kiM chakraturvIrau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vijite pANDaveyaistu prashAnte cha vishAM pate |
rAShTre babhUvaturhRRiShTau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.3:
vijahrAte mudA yuktau divi deveshvarAviva |
tau vaneShu vichitreShu parvatAnAM cha sAnuShu
shlokas.4:
shaileShu ramaNIyeShu palvaleShu nadIShu cha |
cha~NkramyamANau saMhRRiShTAvashvinAviva nandane
shlokas.5:
indraprasthe mahAtmAnau remAte kRRiShNapANDavau |
pravishya tAM sabhAM ramyAM vijahrAte cha bhArata
shlokas.6:
tatra yuddhakathAshchitrAH parikleshA.nshcha pArthiva |
kathAyoge kathAyoge kathayAmAsatustadA
shlokas.7:
RRiShINAM devatAnAM cha va.nshA.nstAvAhatustadA |
prIyamANau mahAtmAnau purANAvRRiShisattamau
shlokas.8:
madhurAstu kathAshchitrAshchitrArthapadanishchayAH |
nishchayaj~naH sa pArthAya kathayAmAsa keshavaH
shlokas.9:
putrashokAbhisantaptaM j~nAtInAM cha sahasrashaH |
kathAbhiH shamayAmAsa pArthaM shaurirjanArdanaH
shlokas.10:
sa tamAshvAsya vidhivadvidhAnaj~no mahAtapAH |
apahRRityAtmano bhAraM vishashrAmeva sAtvataH
shlokas.11:
tataH kathAnte govindo guDAkeshamuvAcha ha |
sAntvaya~nshlakShNayA vAchA hetuyuktamidaM vachaH
shlokas.12:
vijiteyaM dharA kRRitsnA savyasAchinparantapa |
tvadbAhubalamAshritya rAj~nA dharmasutena ha
shlokas.13:
asapatnAM mahIM bhu~Nkte dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenaprabhAvena yamayoshcha narottama
shlokas.14:
dharmeNa rAj~nA dharmaj~na prAptaM rAjyamakaNTakam |
dharmeNa nihataH sa~Nkhye sa cha rAjA suyodhanaH
shlokas.15:
adharmaruchayo lubdhAH sadA chApriyavAdinaH |
dhArtarAShTrA durAtmAnaH sAnubandhA nipAtitAH
shlokas.16:
prashAntAmakhilAM pArtha pRRithivIM pRRithivIpatiH |
bhu~Nkte dharmasuto rAjA tvayA guptaH kurUdvaha
shlokas.17:
rame chAhaM tvayA sArdhamaraNyeShvapi pANDava |
kimu yatra jano.ayaM vai pRRithA chAmitrakarshana
shlokas.18:
yatra dharmasuto rAjA yatra bhImo mahAbalaH |
yatra mAdravatIputrau ratistatra parA mama
shlokas.19:
tathaiva svargakalpeShu sabhoddesheShu bhArata |
ramaNIyeShu puNyeShu sahitasya tvayAnagha
shlokas.20:
kAlo mahA.nstvatIto me shUraputramapashyataH |
baladevaM cha kauravya tathAnyAnvRRiShNipu~NgavAn
shlokas.21:
so.ahaM gantumabhIpsAmi purIM dvAravatIM prati |
rochatAM gamanaM mahyaM tavApi puruSharShabha
shlokas.22:
ukto bahuvidhaM rAjA tatra tatra yudhiShThiraH |
sa ha bhIShmeNa yadyuktamasmAbhiH shokakArite
shlokas.23:
shiShTo yudhiShThiro.asmAbhiH shAstA sannapi pANDavaH |
tena tachcha vachaH samyaggRRihItaM sumahAtmanA
shlokas.24:
dharmaputre hi dharmaj~ne kRRitaj~ne satyavAdini |
satyaM dharmo matishchAgryA sthitishcha satataM sthirA
shlokas.25:
tadgatvA taM mahAtmAnaM yadi te rochate.arjuna |
asmadgamanasa.nyuktaM vacho brUhi janAdhipam
shlokas.26:
na hi tasyApriyaM kuryAM prANatyAge.apyupasthite |
kuto gantuM mahAbAho purIM dvAravatIM prati
shlokas.27:
sarvaM tvidamahaM pArtha tvatprItihitakAmyayA |
bravImi satyaM kauravya na mithyaitatkatha~nchana
shlokas.28:
prayojanaM cha nirvRRittamiha vAse mamArjuna |
dhArtarAShTro hato rAjA sabalaH sapadAnugaH
shlokas.29:
pRRithivI cha vashe tAta dharmaputrasya dhImataH |
sthitA samudravasanA sashailavanakAnanA
chitA ratnairbahuvidhaiH kururAjasya pANDava
shlokas.30:
dharmeNa rAjA dharmaj~naH pAtu sarvAM vasundharAm |
upAsyamAno bahubhiH siddhaishchApi mahAtmabhiH
stUyamAnashcha satataM bandibhirbharatarShabha
shlokas.31:
tanmayA saha gatvAdya rAjAnaM kuruvardhanam |
ApRRichCha kurushArdUla gamanaM dvArakAM prati
shlokas.32:
idaM sharIraM vasu yachcha me gRRihe; niveditaM pArtha sadA yudhiShThire |
priyashcha mAnyashcha hi me yudhiShThiraH; sadA kurUNAmadhipo mahAmatiH
shlokas.33:
prayojanaM chApi nivAsakAraNe; na vidyate me tvadRRite mahAbhuja |
sthitA hi pRRithvI tava pArtha shAsane; guroH suvRRittasya yudhiShThirasya ha
shlokas.34:
itIdamuktaM sa tadA mahAtmanA; janArdanenAmitavikramo.arjunaH |
tatheti kRRichChrAdiva vAchamIraya;jjanArdanaM sampratipUjya pArthiva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sabhAyAM vasatostasyAM nihatyArInmahAtmanoH |
keshavArjunayoH kA nu kathA samabhavaddvija
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kRRiShNena sahitaH pArthaH svarAjyaM prApya kevalam |
tasyAM sabhAyAM ramyAyAM vijahAra mudA yutaH
shlokas.3:
tataH ka~nchitsabhoddeshaM svargoddeshasamaM nRRipa |
yadRRichChayA tau muditau jagmatuH svajanAvRRitau
shlokas.4:
tataH pratItaH kRRiShNena sahitaH pANDavo.arjunaH |
nirIkShya tAM sabhAM ramyAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.5:
viditaM te mahAbAho sa~NgrAme samupasthite |
mAhAtmyaM devakImAtastachcha te rUpamaishvaram
shlokas.6:
yattu tadbhavatA proktaM tadA keshava sauhRRidAt |
tatsarvaM puruShavyAghra naShTaM me naShTachetasaH
shlokas.7:
mama kautUhalaM tvasti teShvartheShu punaH prabho |
bhavA.nshcha dvArakAM gantA nachirAdiva mAdhava
shlokas.8:
evamuktastataH kRRiShNaH phalgunaM pratyabhAShata |
pariShvajya mahAtejA vachanaM vadatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
shrAvitastvaM mayA guhyaM j~nApitashcha sanAtanam |
dharmaM svarUpiNaM pArtha sarvalokA.nshcha shAshvatAn
shlokas.10:
abuddhvA yanna gRRihNIthAstanme sumahadapriyam |
nUnamashraddadhAno.asi durmedhAshchAsi pANDava
shlokas.11:
sa hi dharmaH suparyApto brahmaNaH padavedane |
na shakyaM tanmayA bhUyastathA vaktumasheShataH
shlokas.12:
paraM hi brahma kathitaM yogayuktena tanmayA |
itihAsaM tu vakShyAmi tasminnarthe purAtanam
shlokas.13:
yathA tAM buddhimAsthAya gatimagryAM gamiShyasi |
shRRiNu dharmabhRRitAM shreShTha gadataH sarvameva me
shlokas.14:
AgachChadbrAhmaNaH kashchitsvargalokAdari.ndama |
brahmalokAchcha durdharShaH so.asmAbhiH pUjito.abhavat
shlokas.15:
asmAbhiH paripRRiShTashcha yadAha bharatarShabha |
divyena vidhinA pArtha tachChRRiNuShvAvichArayan
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
mokShadharmaM samAshritya kRRiShNa yanmAnupRRichChasi |
bhUtAnAmanukampArthaM yanmohachChedanaM prabho
shlokas.17:
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi yathAvanmadhusUdana |
shRRiNuShvAvahito bhUtvA gadato mama mAdhava
shlokas.18:
kashchidviprastapoyuktaH kAshyapo dharmavittamaH |
AsasAda dvijaM ka~nchiddharmANAmAgatAgamam
shlokas.19:
gatAgate subahusho j~nAnavij~nAnapAragam |
lokatattvArthakushalaM j~nAtAraM sukhaduHkhayoH
shlokas.20:
jAtImaraNatattvaj~naM kovidaM puNyapApayoH |
draShTAramuchchanIchAnAM karmabhirdehinAM gatim
shlokas.21:
charantaM muktavatsiddhaM prashAntaM sa.nyatendriyam |
dIpyamAnaM shriyA brAhmyA kramamANaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.22:
antardhAnagatij~naM cha shrutvA tattvena kAshyapaH |
tathaivAntarhitaiH siddhairyAntaM chakradharaiH saha
shlokas.23:
sambhAShamANamekAnte samAsInaM cha taiH saha |
yadRRichChayA cha gachChantamasaktaM pavanaM yathA
shlokas.24:
taM samAsAdya medhAvI sa tadA dvijasattamaH |
charaNau dharmakAmo vai tapasvI susamAhitaH
pratipede yathAnyAyaM bhaktyA paramayA yutaH
shlokas.25:
vismitashchAdbhutaM dRRiShTvA kAshyapastaM dvijottamam |
parichAreNa mahatA guruM vaidyamatoShayat
shlokas.26:
prItAtmA chopapannashcha shrutachAritrasa.nyutaH |
bhAvena toShayachchainaM guruvRRittyA parantapaH
shlokas.27:
tasmai tuShTaH sa shiShyAya prasanno.athAbravIdguruH |
siddhiM parAmabhiprekShya shRRiNu tanme janArdana
shlokas.28:
vividhaiH karmabhistAta puNyayogaishcha kevalaiH |
gachChantIha gatiM martyA devaloke.api cha sthitim
shlokas.29:
na kvachitsukhamatyantaM na kvachichChAshvatI sthitiH |
sthAnAchcha mahato bhra.nsho duHkhalabdhAtpunaH punaH
shlokas.30:
ashubhA gatayaH prAptAH kaShTA me pApasevanAt |
kAmamanyuparItena tRRiShNayA mohitena cha
shlokas.31:
punaH punashcha maraNaM janma chaiva punaH punaH |
AhArA vividhA bhuktAH pItA nAnAvidhAH stanAH
shlokas.32:
mAtaro vividhA dRRiShTAH pitarashcha pRRithagvidhAH |
sukhAni cha vichitrANi duHkhAni cha mayAnagha
shlokas.33:
priyairvivAso bahushaH sa.nvAsashchApriyaiH saha |
dhananAshashcha samprApto labdhvA duHkhena taddhanam
shlokas.34:
avamAnAH sukaShTAshcha parataH svajanAttathA |
shArIrA mAnasAshchApi vedanA bhRRishadAruNAH
shlokas.35:
prAptA vimAnanAshchogrA vadhabandhAshcha dAruNAH |
patanaM niraye chaiva yAtanAshcha yamakShaye
shlokas.36:
jarA rogAshcha satataM vAsanAni cha bhUrishaH |
loke.asminnanubhUtAni dva.ndvajAni bhRRishaM mayA
shlokas.37:
tataH kadAchinnirvedAnnikArAnnikRRitena cha |
lokatantraM parityaktaM duHkhArtena bhRRishaM mayA
tataH siddhiriyaM prAptA prasAdAdAtmano mayA
shlokas.38:
nAhaM punarihAgantA lokAnAlokayAmyaham |
A siddherA prajAsargAdAtmano me gatiH shubhA
shlokas.39:
upalabdhA dvijashreShTha tatheyaM siddhiruttamA |
itaH paraM gamiShyAmi tataH parataraM punaH
brahmaNaH padamavyagraM mA te bhUdatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.40:
nAhaM punarihAgantA martyalokaM parantapa |
prIto.asmi te mahAprAj~na brUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.41:
yadIpsurupapannastvaM tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH |
abhijAne cha tadahaM yadarthaM mA tvamAgataH
achirAttu gamiShyAmi yenAhaM tvAmachUchudam
shlokas.42:
bhRRishaM prIto.asmi bhavatashchAritreNa vichakShaNa |
paripRRichCha yAvadbhavate bhASheyaM yattavepsitam
shlokas.43:
bahu manye cha te buddhiM bhRRishaM sampUjayAmi cha |
yenAhaM bhavatA buddho medhAvI hyasi kAshyapa

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tatastasyopasa~NgRRihya pAdau prashnAnsudurvachAn |
paprachCha tA.nshcha sarvAnsa prAha dharmabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.2:
kAshyapa uvAcha||
kathaM sharIraM chyavate kathaM chaivopapadyate |
kathaM kaShTAchcha sa.nsArAtsa.nsaranparimuchyate
shlokas.3:
AtmAnaM vA kathaM yuktvA tachCharIraM vimu~nchati |
sharIratashcha nirmuktaH kathamanyatprapadyate
shlokas.4:
kathaM shubhAshubhe chAyaM karmaNI svakRRite naraH |
upabhu~Nkte kva vA karma videhasyopatiShThati
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
evaM sa~nchoditaH siddhaH prashnA.nstAnpratyabhAShata |
AnupUrvyeNa vArShNeya yathA tanme vachaH shRRiNu
shlokas.6:
siddha uvAcha||
AyuHkIrtikarANIha yAni karmANi sevate |
sharIragrahaNe.anyasmi.nsteShu kShINeShu sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
AyuHkShayaparItAtmA viparItAni sevate |
buddhirvyAvartate chAsya vinAshe pratyupasthite
shlokas.8:
sattvaM balaM cha kAlaM chApyaviditvAtmanastathA |
ativelamupAshnAti tairviruddhAnyanAtmavAn
shlokas.9:
yadAyamatikaShTAni sarvANyupaniShevate |
atyarthamapi vA bhu~Nkte na vA bhu~Nkte kadAchana
shlokas.10:
duShTAnnaM viShamAnnaM cha so.anyonyena virodhi cha |
guru vApi samaM bhu~Nkte nAtijIrNe.api vA punaH
shlokas.11:
vyAyAmamatimAtraM vA vyavAyaM chopasevate |
satataM karmalobhAdvA prAptaM vegavidhAraNam
shlokas.12:
rasAtiyuktamannaM vA divAsvapnaM niShevate |
apakvAnAgate kAle svayaM doShAnprakopayan
shlokas.13:
svadoShakopanAdrogaM labhate maraNAntikam |
atha chodbandhanAdIni parItAni vyavasyati
shlokas.14:
tasya taiH kAraNairjantoH sharIrAchchyavate yathA |
jIvitaM prochyamAnaM tadyathAvadupadhAraya
shlokas.15:
UShmA prakupitaH kAye tIvravAyusamIritaH |
sharIramanuparyeti sarvAnprANAnruNaddhi vai
shlokas.16:
atyarthaM balavAnUShmA sharIre parikopitaH |
bhinatti jIvasthAnAni tAni marmANi viddhi cha
shlokas.17:
tataH savedanaH sadyo jIvaH prachyavate kSharan |
sharIraM tyajate jantushChidyamAneShu marmasu
vedanAbhiH parItAtmA tadviddhi dvijasattama
shlokas.18:
jAtImaraNasa.nvignAH satataM sarvajantavaH |
dRRishyante santyajantashcha sharIrANi dvijarShabha
shlokas.19:
garbhasa~NkramaNe chApi marmaNAmatisarpaNe |
tAdRRishImeva labhate vedanAM mAnavaH punaH
shlokas.20:
bhinnasandhiratha kledamadbhiH sa labhate naraH |
yathA pa~nchasu bhUteShu sa.nshritatvaM nigachChati
shaityAtprakupitaH kAye tIvravAyusamIritaH
shlokas.21:
yaH sa pa~nchasu bhUteShu prANApAne vyavasthitaH |
sa gachChatyUrdhvago vAyuH kRRichChrAnmuktvA sharIriNam
shlokas.22:
sharIraM cha jahAtyeva niruchChvAsashcha dRRishyate |
nirUShmA sa niruchChvAso niHshrIko gatachetanaH
shlokas.23:
brahmaNA samparityakto mRRita ityuchyate naraH |
srotobhiryairvijAnAti indriyArthA~nsharIrabhRRit
taireva na vijAnAti prANamAhArasambhavam
shlokas.24:
tatraiva kurute kAye yaH sa jIvaH sanAtanaH |
teShAM yadyadbhavedyuktaM saMnipAte kvachitkvachit
tattanmarma vijAnIhi shAstradRRiShTaM hi tattathA
shlokas.25:
teShu marmasu bhinneShu tataH sa samudIrayan |
Avishya hRRidayaM jantoH sattvaM chAshu ruNaddhi vai
tataH sa chetano janturnAbhijAnAti ki~nchana
shlokas.26:
tamasA sa.nvRRitaj~nAnaH sa.nvRRiteShvatha marmasu |
sa jIvo niradhiShThAnashchAvyate mAtarishvanA
shlokas.27:
tataH sa taM mahochChvAsaM bhRRishamuchChvasya dAruNam |
niShkrAmankampayatyAshu tachCharIramachetanam
shlokas.28:
sa jIvaH prachyutaH kAyAtkarmabhiH svaiH samAvRRitaH |
a~NkitaH svaiH shubhaiH puNyaiH pApairvApyupapadyate
shlokas.29:
brAhmaNA j~nAnasampannA yathAvachChrutanishchayAH |
itaraM kRRitapuNyaM vA taM vijAnanti lakShaNaiH
shlokas.30:
yathAndhakAre khadyotaM lIyamAnaM tatastataH |
chakShuShmantaH prapashyanti tathA taM j~nAnachakShuShaH
shlokas.31:
pashyantyeva.nvidhAH siddhA jIvaM divyena chakShuShA |
chyavantaM jAyamAnaM cha yoniM chAnupraveshitam
shlokas.32:
tasya sthAnAni dRRiShTAni trividhAnIha shAstrataH |
karmabhUmiriyaM bhUmiryatra tiShThanti jantavaH
shlokas.33:
tataH shubhAshubhaM kRRitvA labhante sarvadehinaH |
ihaivochchAvachAnbhogAnprApnuvanti svakarmabhiH
shlokas.34:
ihaivAshubhakarmA tu karmabhirnirayaM gataH |
avAksa niraye pApo mAnavaH pachyate bhRRisham
tasmAtsudurlabho mokSha AtmA rakShyo bhRRishaM tataH
shlokas.35:
UrdhvaM tu jantavo gatvA yeShu sthAneShvavasthitAH |
kIrtyamAnAni tAnIha tattvataH saMnibodha me
tachChrutvA naiShThikIM buddhiM budhyethAH karmanishchayAt
shlokas.36:
tArArUpANi sarvANi yachchaitachchandramaNDalam |
yachcha vibhrAjate loke svabhAsA sUryamaNDalam
sthAnAnyetAni jAnIhi narANAM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.37:
karmakShayAchcha te sarve chyavante vai punaH punaH |
tatrApi cha visheSho.asti divi nIchochchamadhyamaH
shlokas.38:
na tatrApyasti santoSho dRRiShTvA dIptatarAM shriyam |
ityetA gatayaH sarvAH pRRithaktve samudIritAH
shlokas.39:
upapattiM tu garbhasya vakShyAmyahamataH param |
yathAvattAM nigadataH shRRiNuShvAvahito dvija

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
shubhAnAmashubhAnAM cha neha nAsho.asti karmaNAm |
prApya prApya tu pachyante kShetraM kShetraM tathA tathA
shlokas.2:
yathA prasUyamAnastu phalI dadyAtphalaM bahu |
tathA syAdvipulaM puNyaM shuddhena manasA kRRitam
shlokas.3:
pApaM chApi tathaiva syAtpApena manasA kRRitam |
purodhAya mano hIha karmaNyAtmA pravartate
shlokas.4:
yathA karmasamAdiShTaM kAmamanyusamAvRRitaH |
naro garbhaM pravishati tachchApi shRRiNu chottaram
shlokas.5:
shukraM shoNitasa.nsRRiShTaM striyA garbhAshayaM gatam |
kShetraM karmajamApnoti shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham
shlokas.6:
saukShmyAdavyaktabhAvAchcha na sa kvachana sajjate |
samprApya brahmaNaH kAyaM tasmAttadbrahma shAshvatam
tadbIjaM sarvabhUtAnAM tena jIvanti jantavaH
shlokas.7:
sa jIvaH sarvagAtrANi garbhasyAvishya bhAgashaH |
dadhAti chetasA sadyaH prANasthAneShvavasthitaH
tataH spandayate.a~NgAni sa garbhashchetanAnvitaH
shlokas.8:
yathA hi lohaniShyando niShikto bimbavigraham |
upaiti tadvajjAnIhi garbhe jIvapraveshanam
shlokas.9:
lohapiNDaM yathA vahniH pravishatyabhitApayan |
tathA tvamapi jAnIhi garbhe jIvopapAdanam
shlokas.10:
yathA cha dIpaH sharaNaM dIpyamAnaH prakAshayet |
evameva sharIrANi prakAshayati chetanA
shlokas.11:
yadyachcha kurute karma shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
pUrvadehakRRitaM sarvamavashyamupabhujyate
shlokas.12:
tatastatkShIyate chaiva punashchAnyatprachIyate |
yAvattanmokShayogasthaM dharmaM naivAvabudhyate
shlokas.13:
tatra dharmaM pravakShyAmi sukhI bhavati yena vai |
AvartamAno jAtIShu tathAnyonyAsu sattama
shlokas.14:
dAnaM vrataM brahmacharyaM yathoktavratadhAraNam |
damaH prashAntatA chaiva bhUtAnAM chAnukampanam
shlokas.15:
sa.nyamashchAnRRisha.nsyaM cha parasvAdAnavarjanam |
vyalIkAnAmakaraNaM bhUtAnAM yatra sA bhuvi
shlokas.16:
mAtApitroshcha shushrUShA devatAtithipUjanam |
gurupUjA ghRRiNA shauchaM nityamindriyasa.nyamaH
shlokas.17:
pravartanaM shubhAnAM cha tatsatAM vRRittamuchyate |
tato dharmaH prabhavati yaH prajAH pAti shAshvatIH
shlokas.18:
evaM satsu sadA pashyettatra hyeShA dhruvA sthitiH |
AchAro dharmamAchaShTe yasminsanto vyavasthitAH
shlokas.19:
teShu taddharmanikShiptaM yaH sa dharmaH sanAtanaH |
yastaM samabhipadyeta na sa durgatimApnuyAt
shlokas.20:
ato niyamyate lokaH pramuhya dharmavartmasu |
yastu yogI cha muktashcha sa etebhyo vishiShyate
shlokas.21:
vartamAnasya dharmeNa puruShasya yathA tathA |
sa.nsAratAraNaM hyasya kAlena mahatA bhavet
shlokas.22:
evaM pUrvakRRitaM karma sarvo janturniShevate |
sarvaM tatkAraNaM yena nikRRito.ayamihAgataH
shlokas.23:
sharIragrahaNaM chAsya kena pUrvaM prakalpitam |
ityevaM sa.nshayo loke tachcha vakShyAmyataH param
shlokas.24:
sharIramAtmanaH kRRitvA sarvabhUtapitAmahaH |
trailokyamasRRijadbrahmA kRRitsnaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.25:
tataH pradhAnamasRRijachchetanA sA sharIriNAm |
yayA sarvamidaM vyAptaM yAM loke paramAM viduH
shlokas.26:
iha tatkSharamityuktaM paraM tvamRRitamakSharam |
trayANAM mithunaM sarvamekaikasya pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.27:
asRRijatsarvabhUtAni pUrvasRRiShTaH prajApatiH |
sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni ityeShA paurvikI shrutiH
shlokas.28:
tasya kAlaparImANamakarotsa pitAmahaH |
bhUteShu parivRRittiM cha punarAvRRittimeva cha
shlokas.29:
yathAtra kashchinmedhAvI dRRiShTAtmA pUrvajanmani |
yatpravakShyAmi tatsarvaM yathAvadupapadyate
shlokas.30:
sukhaduHkhe sadA samyaganitye yaH prapashyati |
kAyaM chAmedhyasa~NghAtaM vinAshaM karmasaMhitam
shlokas.31:
yachcha ki~nchitsukhaM tachcha sarvaM duHkhamiti smaran |
sa.nsArasAgaraM ghoraM tariShyati sudustaram
shlokas.32:
jAtImaraNarogaishcha samAviShTaH pradhAnavit |
chetanAvatsu chaitanyaM samaM bhUteShu pashyati
shlokas.33:
nirvidyate tataH kRRitsnaM mArgamANaH paraM padam |
tasyopadeshaM vakShyAmi yAthAtathyena sattama
shlokas.34:
shAshvatasyAvyayasyAtha padasya j~nAnamuttamam |
prochyamAnaM mayA vipra nibodhedamasheShataH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
yaH syAdekAyane lInastUShNIM ki~nchidachintayan |
pUrvaM pUrvaM parityajya sa nirArambhako bhavet
shlokas.2:
sarvamitraH sarvasahaH samarakto jitendriyaH |
vyapetabhayamanyushcha kAmahA muchyate naraH
shlokas.3:
AtmavatsarvabhUteShu yashcharenniyataH shuchiH |
amAnI nirabhImAnaH sarvato mukta eva saH
shlokas.4:
jIvitaM maraNaM chobhe sukhaduHkhe tathaiva cha |
lAbhAlAbhe priyadveShye yaH samaH sa cha muchyate
shlokas.5:
na kasyachitspRRihayate nAvajAnAti ki~nchana |
nirdva.ndvo vItarAgAtmA sarvato mukta eva saH
shlokas.6:
anamitro.atha nirbandhuranapatyashcha yaH kvachit |
tyaktadharmArthakAmashcha nirAkA~NkShI sa muchyate
shlokas.7:
naiva dharmI na chAdharmI pUrvopachitahA cha yaH |
dhAtukShayaprashAntAtmA nirdva.ndvaH sa vimuchyate
shlokas.8:
akarmA chAvikA~NkShashcha pashya~njagadashAshvatam |
asvasthamavashaM nityaM janmasa.nsAramohitam
shlokas.9:
vairAgyabuddhiH satataM tApadoShavyapekShakaH |
AtmabandhavinirmokShaM sa karotyachirAdiva
shlokas.10:
agandharasamasparshamashabdamaparigraham |
arUpamanabhij~neyaM dRRiShTvAtmAnaM vimuchyate
shlokas.11:
pa~nchabhUtaguNairhInamamUrtimadalepakam |
aguNaM guNabhoktAraM yaH pashyati sa muchyate
shlokas.12:
vihAya sarvasa~NkalpAnbuddhyA shArIramAnasAn |
shanairnirvANamApnoti nirindhana ivAnalaH
shlokas.13:
vimuktaH sarvasa.nskAraistato brahma sanAtanam |
paramApnoti sa.nshAntamachalaM divyamakSharam
shlokas.14:
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi yogashAstramanuttamam |
yajj~nAtvA siddhamAtmAnaM loke pashyanti yoginaH
shlokas.15:
tasyopadeshaM pashyAmi yathAvattannibodha me |
yairdvAraishchArayannityaM pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.16:
indriyANi tu saMhRRitya mana Atmani dhArayet |
tIvraM taptvA tapaH pUrvaM tato yoktumupakramet
shlokas.17:
tapasvI tyaktasa~Nkalpo dambhAha~NkAravarjitaH |
manIShI manasA vipraH pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.18:
sa chechChaknotyayaM sAdhuryoktumAtmAnamAtmani |
tata ekAntashIlaH sa pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.19:
sa.nyataH satataM yukta AtmavAnvijitendriyaH |
tathAyamAtmanAtmAnaM sAdhu yuktaH prapashyati
shlokas.20:
yathA hi puruShaH svapne dRRiShTvA pashyatyasAviti |
tathArUpamivAtmAnaM sAdhu yuktaH prapashyati
shlokas.21:
iShIkAM vA yathA mu~njAtkashchinnirhRRitya darshayet |
yogI niShkRRiShTamAtmAnaM tathA sampashyate tanau
shlokas.22:
mu~njaM sharIraM tasyAhuriShIkAmAtmani shritAm |
etannidarshanaM proktaM yogavidbhiranuttamam
shlokas.23:
yadA hi yuktamAtmAnaM samyakpashyati dehabhRRit |
tadAsya neshate kashchittrailokyasyApi yaH prabhuH
shlokas.24:
anyonyAshchaiva tanavo yatheShTaM pratipadyate |
vinivRRitya jarAmRRityU na hRRiShyati na shochati
shlokas.25:
devAnAmapi devatvaM yuktaH kArayate vashI |
brahma chAvyayamApnoti hitvA dehamashAshvatam
shlokas.26:
vinashyatsvapi lokeShu na bhayaM tasya jAyate |
klishyamAneShu bhUteShu na sa klishyati kenachit
shlokas.27:
duHkhashokamayairghoraiH sa~NgasnehasamudbhavaiH |
na vichAlyeta yuktAtmA niHspRRihaH shAntamAnasaH
shlokas.28:
nainaM shastrANi vidhyante na mRRityushchAsya vidyate |
nAtaH sukhataraM ki~nchilloke kvachana vidyate
shlokas.29:
samyagyuktvA yadAtmAnamAtmanyeva prapashyati |
tadaiva na spRRihayate sAkShAdapi shatakratoH
shlokas.30:
nirvedastu na gantavyo yu~njAnena katha~nchana |
yogamekAntashIlastu yathA yu~njIta tachChRRiNu
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTapUrvAM dishaM chintya yasminsaMnivasetpure |
purasyAbhyantare tasya manashchAryaM na bAhyataH
shlokas.32:
purasyAbhyantare tiShThanyasminnAvasathe vaset |
tasminnAvasathe dhAryaM sabAhyAbhyantaraM manaH
shlokas.33:
prachintyAvasathaM kRRitsnaM yasminkAye.avatiShThate |
tasminkAye manashchAryaM na katha~nchana bAhyataH
shlokas.34:
saMniyamyendriyagrAmaM nirghoShe nirjane vane |
kAyamabhyantaraM kRRitsnamekAgraH parichintayet
shlokas.35:
dantA.nstAlu cha jihvAM cha galaM grIvAM tathaiva cha |
hRRidayaM chintayechchApi tathA hRRidayabandhanam
shlokas.36:
ityuktaH sa mayA shiShyo medhAvI madhusUdana |
paprachCha punarevemaM mokShadharmaM sudurvacham
shlokas.37:
bhuktaM bhuktaM kathamidamannaM koShThe vipachyate |
kathaM rasatvaM vrajati shoNitaM jAyate katham
tathA mA.nsaM cha medashcha snAyvasthIni cha poShati
shlokas.38:
kathametAni sarvANi sharIrANi sharIriNAm |
vardhante vardhamAnasya vardhate cha kathaM balam
nirojasAM niShkramaNaM malAnAM cha pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.39:
kuto vAyaM prashvasiti uchChvasityapi vA punaH |
kaM cha deshamadhiShThAya tiShThatyAtmAyamAtmani
shlokas.40:
jIvaH kAyaM vahati chechcheShTayAnaH kalevaram |
ki.nvarNaM kIdRRishaM chaiva niveshayati vai manaH
yAthAtathyena bhagavanvaktumarhasi me.anagha
shlokas.41:
iti samparipRRiShTo.ahaM tena vipreNa mAdhava |
pratyabruvaM mahAbAho yathAshrutamari.ndama
shlokas.42:
yathA svakoShThe prakShipya koShThaM bhANDamanA bhavet |
tathA svakAye prakShipya mano dvArairanishchalaiH
AtmAnaM tatra mArgeta pramAdaM parivarjayet
shlokas.43:
evaM satatamudyuktaH prItAtmA nachirAdiva |
AsAdayati tadbrahma yaddRRiShTvA syAtpradhAnavit
shlokas.44:
na tvasau chakShuShA grAhyo na cha sarvairapIndriyaiH |
manasaiva pradIpena mahAnAtmani dRRishyate
shlokas.45:
sarvataHpANipAdaM taM sarvatokShishiromukham |
jIvo niShkrAntamAtmAnaM sharIrAtsamprapashyati
shlokas.46:
sa tadutsRRijya dehaM svaM dhArayanbrahma kevalam |
AtmAnamAlokayati manasA prahasanniva
shlokas.47:
idaM sarvarahasyaM te mayoktaM dvijasattama |
ApRRichChe sAdhayiShyAmi gachCha shiShya yathAsukham
shlokas.48:
ityuktaH sa tadA kRRiShNa mayA shiShyo mahAtapAH |
agachChata yathAkAmaM brAhmaNashChinnasa.nshayaH
shlokas.49:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
ityuktvA sa tadA vAkyaM mAM pArtha dvijapu~NgavaH |
mokShadharmAshritaH samyaktatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.50:
kachchidetattvayA pArtha shrutamekAgrachetasA |
tadApi hi rathasthastvaM shrutavAnetadeva hi
shlokas.51:
naitatpArtha suvij~neyaM vyAmishreNeti me matiH |
nareNAkRRitasa~nj~nena vidagdhenAkRRitAtmanA
shlokas.52:
surahasyamidaM proktaM devAnAM bharatarShabha |
kachchinnedaM shrutaM pArtha martyenAnyena kenachit
shlokas.53:
na hyetachChrotumarho.anyo manuShyastvAmRRite.anagha |
naitadadya suvij~neyaM vyAmishreNAntarAtmanA
shlokas.54:
kriyAvadbhirhi kaunteya devalokaH samAvRRitaH |
na chaitadiShTaM devAnAM martyai rUpanivartanam
shlokas.55:
parA hi sA gatiH pArtha yattadbrahma sanAtanam |
yatrAmRRitatvaM prApnoti tyaktvA duHkhaM sadA sukhI
shlokas.56:
evaM hi dharmamAsthAya ye.api syuH pApayonayaH |
striyo vaishyAstathA shUdrAste.api yAnti parAM gatim
shlokas.57:
kiM punarbrAhmaNAH pArtha kShatriyA vA bahushrutAH |
svadharmaratayo nityaM brahmalokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.58:
hetumachchaitaduddiShTamupAyAshchAsya sAdhane |
siddheH phalaM cha mokShashcha duHkhasya cha vinirNayaH
ataH paraM sukhaM tvanyatkiM nu syAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.59:
shrutavA~nshraddadhAnashcha parAkrAntashcha pANDava |
yaH parityajate martyo lokatantramasAravat
etairupAyaiH sa kShipraM parAM gatimavApnuyAt
shlokas.60:
etAvadeva vaktavyaM nAto bhUyo.asti ki~nchana |
ShaNmAsAnnityayuktasya yogaH pArtha pravartate

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
dampatyoH pArtha sa.nvAdamabhayaM nAma nAmataH
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNI brAhmaNaM ka~nchijj~nAnavij~nAnapAragam |
dRRiShTvA vivikta AsInaM bhAryA bhartAramabravIt
shlokas.3:
kaM nu lokaM gamiShyAmi tvAmahaM patimAshritA |
nyastakarmANamAsInaM kInAshamavichakShaNam
shlokas.4:
bhAryAH patikRRitA.NllokAnApnuvantIti naH shrutam |
tvAmahaM patimAsAdya kAM gamiShyAmi vai gatim
shlokas.5:
evamuktaH sa shAntAtmA tAmuvAcha hasanniva |
subhage nAbhyasUyAmi vAkyasyAsya tavAnaghe
shlokas.6:
grAhyaM dRRishyaM cha shrAvyaM cha yadidaM karma vidyate |
etadeva vyavasyanti karma karmeti karmiNaH
shlokas.7:
mohameva niyachChanti karmaNA j~nAnavarjitAH |
naiShkarmyaM na cha loke.asminmaurtamityupalabhyate
shlokas.8:
karmaNA manasA vAchA shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
janmAdimUrtibhedAnAM karma bhUteShu vartate
shlokas.9:
rakShobhirvadhyamAneShu dRRishyadravyeShu karmasu |
AtmasthamAtmanA tena dRRiShTamAyatanaM mayA
shlokas.10:
yatra tadbrahma nirdva.ndvaM yatra somaH sahAgninA |
vyavAyaM kurute nityaM dhIro bhUtAni dhArayan
shlokas.11:
yatra brahmAdayo yuktAstadakSharamupAsate |
vidvA.nsaH suvratA yatra shAntAtmAno jitendriyAH
shlokas.12:
ghrANena na tadAghreyaM na tadAdyaM cha jihvayA |
sparshena cha na tatspRRishyaM manasA tveva gamyate
shlokas.13:
chakShuShA na viShahyaM cha yatki~nchichChravaNAtparam |
agandhamarasasparshamarUpAshabdamavyayam
shlokas.14:
yataH pravartate tantraM yatra cha pratitiShThati |
prANo.apAnaH samAnashcha vyAnashchodAna eva cha
shlokas.15:
tata eva pravartante tameva pravishanti cha |
samAnavyAnayormadhye prANApAnau vicheratuH
shlokas.16:
tasminsupte pralIyete samAno vyAna eva cha |
apAnaprANayormadhye udAno vyApya tiShThati
tasmAchChayAnaM puruShaM prANApAnau na mu~nchataH
shlokas.17:
prANAnAyamyate yena tamudAnaM prachakShate |
tasmAttapo vyavasyanti tadbhavaM brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.18:
teShAmanyonyabhakShANAM sarveShAM dehachAriNAm |
agnirvaishvAnaro madhye saptadhA vihito.antarA
shlokas.19:
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha tvakcha shrotraM cha pa~nchamam |
mano buddhishcha saptaitA jihvA vaishvAnarArchiShaH
shlokas.20:
ghreyaM peyaM cha dRRishyaM cha spRRishyaM shravyaM tathaiva cha |
mantavyamatha boddhavyaM tAH sapta samidho mama
shlokas.21:
ghrAtA bhakShayitA draShTA spraShTA shrotA cha pa~nchamaH |
mantA boddhA cha saptaite bhavanti paramartvijaH
shlokas.22:
ghreye peye cha dRRishye cha spRRishye shravye tathaiva cha |
havIMShyagniShu hotAraH saptadhA sapta saptasu
samyakprakShipya vidvA.nso janayanti svayoniShu
shlokas.23:
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam |
mano buddhishcha saptaite yonirityeva shabditAH
shlokas.24:
havirbhUtA guNAH sarve pravishantyagnijaM mukham |
antarvAsamuShitvA cha jAyante svAsu yoniShu
tatraiva cha nirudhyante pralaye bhUtabhAvane
shlokas.25:
tataH sa~njAyate gandhastataH sa~njAyate rasaH |
tataH sa~njAyate rUpaM tataH sparsho.abhijAyate
shlokas.26:
tataH sa~njAyate shabdaH sa.nshayastatra jAyate |
tataH sa~njAyate niShThA janmaitatsaptadhA viduH
shlokas.27:
anenaiva prakAreNa pragRRihItaM purAtanaiH |
pUrNAhutibhirApUrNAste.abhipUryanti tejasA

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nibodha dashahotR^INAM vidhAnamiha yAdRRisham
shlokas.2:
sarvamevAtra vij~neyaM chittaM j~nAnamavekShate |
retaH sharIrabhRRitkAye vij~nAtA tu sharIrabhRRit
shlokas.3:
sharIrabhRRidgArhapatyastasmAdanyaH praNIyate |
tatashchAhavanIyastu tasminsa~NkShipyate haviH
shlokas.4:
tato vAchaspatirjaj~ne samAnaH paryavekShate |
rUpaM bhavati vai vyaktaM tadanudravate manaH
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
kasmAdvAgabhavatpUrvaM kasmAtpashchAnmano.abhavat |
manasA chintitaM vAkyaM yadA samabhipadyate
shlokas.6:
kena vij~nAnayogena matishchittaM samAsthitA |
samunnItA nAdhyagachChatko vainAM pratiShedhati
shlokas.7:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
tAmapAnaH patirbhUtvA tasmAtpreShyatyapAnatAm |
tAM matiM manasaH prAhurmanastasmAdavekShate
shlokas.8:
prashnaM tu vA~NmanasormAM yasmAttvamanupRRichChasi |
tasmAtte vartayiShyAmi tayoreva samAhvayam
shlokas.9:
ubhe vA~NmanasI gatvA bhUtAtmAnamapRRichChatAm |
AvayoH shreShThamAchakShva Chindhi nau sa.nshayaM vibho
shlokas.10:
mana ityeva bhagavA.nstadA prAha sarasvatIm |
ahaM vai kAmadhuktubhyamiti taM prAha vAgatha
shlokas.11:
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva viddhyubhe manasI mama |
sthAvaraM matsakAshe vai ja~NgamaM viShaye tava
shlokas.12:
yastu te viShayaM gachChenmantro varNaH svaro.api vA |
tanmano ja~NgamaM nAma tasmAdasi garIyasI
shlokas.13:
yasmAdasi cha mA vochaH svayamabhyetya shobhane |
tasmAduchChvAsamAsAdya na vakShyasi sarasvati
shlokas.14:
prANApAnAntare devI vAgvai nityaM sma tiShThati |
preryamANA mahAbhAge vinA prANamapAnatI
prajApatimupAdhAvatprasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.15:
tataH prANaH prAdurabhUdvAchamApyAyayanpunaH |
tasmAduchChvAsamAsAdya na vAgvadati karhichit
shlokas.16:
ghoShiNI jAtanirghoShA nityameva pravartate |
tayorapi cha ghoShiNyornirghoShaiva garIyasI
shlokas.17:
gauriva prasravatyeShA rasamuttamashAlinI |
satataM syandate hyeShA shAshvataM brahmavAdinI
shlokas.18:
divyAdivyaprabhAvena bhAratI gauH shuchismite |
etayorantaraM pashya sUkShmayoH syandamAnayoH
shlokas.19:
anutpanneShu vAkyeShu chodyamAnA sisRRikShayA |
kiM nu pUrvaM tato devI vyAjahAra sarasvatI
shlokas.20:
prANena yA sambhavate sharIre; prANAdapAnaM pratipadyate cha |
udAnabhUtA cha visRRijya dehaM; vyAnena sarvaM divamAvRRiNoti
shlokas.21:
tataH samAne pratitiShThatIha; ityeva pUrvaM prajajalpa chApi |
tasmAnmanaH sthAvaratvAdvishiShTaM; tathA devI ja~NgamatvAdvishiShTA

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
subhage saptahotR^INAM vidhAnamiha yAdRRisham
shlokas.2:
ghrANaM chakShushcha jihvA cha tvakShrotraM chaiva pa~nchamam |
mano buddhishcha saptaite hotAraH pRRithagAshritAH
shlokas.3:
sUkShme.avakAshe santaste na pashyantItaretaram |
etAnvai saptahotR^I.nstvaM svabhAvAdviddhi shobhane
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
sUkShme.avakAshe santaste kathaM nAnyonyadarshinaH |
katha.nsvabhAvA bhagavannetadAchakShva me vibho
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
guNAj~nAnamavij~nAnaM guNij~nAnamabhij~natA |
parasparaguNAnete na vijAnanti karhichit
shlokas.6:
jihvA chakShustathA shrotraM tva~Nmano buddhireva cha |
na gandhAnadhigachChanti ghrANastAnadhigachChati
shlokas.7:
ghrANaM chakShustathA shrotraM tva~Nmano buddhireva cha |
na rasAnadhigachChanti jihvA tAnadhigachChati
shlokas.8:
ghrANaM jihvA tathA shrotraM tva~Nmano buddhireva cha |
na rUpANyadhigachChanti chakShustAnyadhigachChati
shlokas.9:
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha shrotraM buddhirmanastathA |
na sparshAnadhigachChanti tvakcha tAnadhigachChati
shlokas.10:
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha tva~Nmano buddhireva cha |
na shabdAnadhigachChanti shrotraM tAnadhigachChati
shlokas.11:
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha tvakShrotraM buddhireva cha |
sa.nshayAnnAdhigachChanti manastAnadhigachChati
shlokas.12:
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha tvakShrotraM mana eva cha |
na niShThAmadhigachChanti buddhistAmadhigachChati
shlokas.13:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
indriyANAM cha sa.nvAdaM manasashchaiva bhAmini
shlokas.14:
mana uvAcha||
na ghrAti mAmRRite ghrANaM rasaM jihvA na budhyate |
rUpaM chakShurna gRRihNAti tvaksparshaM nAvabudhyate
shlokas.15:
na shrotraM budhyate shabdaM mayA hInaM katha~nchana |
pravaraM sarvabhUtAnAmahamasmi sanAtanam
shlokas.16:
agArANIva shUnyAni shAntArchiSha ivAgnayaH |
indriyANi na bhAsante mayA hInAni nityashaH
shlokas.17:
kAShThAnIvArdrashuShkANi yatamAnairapIndriyaiH |
guNArthAnnAdhigachChanti mAmRRite sarvajantavaH
shlokas.18:
indriyANyUchuH||
evametadbhavetsatyaM yathaitanmanyate bhavAn |
RRite.asmAnasmadarthA.nstu bhogAnbhu~Nkte bhavAnyadi
shlokas.19:
yadyasmAsu pralIneShu tarpaNaM prANadhAraNam |
bhogAnbhu~NkShe rasAnbhu~NkShe yathaitanmanyate tathA
shlokas.20:
atha vAsmAsu lIneShu tiShThatsu viShayeShu cha |
yadi sa~NkalpamAtreNa bhu~Nkte bhogAnyathArthavat
shlokas.21:
atha chenmanyase siddhimasmadartheShu nityadA |
ghrANena rUpamAdatsva rasamAdatsva chakShuShA
shlokas.22:
shrotreNa gandhamAdatsva niShThAmAdatsva jihvayA |
tvachA cha shabdamAdatsva buddhyA sparshamathApi cha
shlokas.23:
balavanto hyaniyamA niyamA durbalIyasAm |
bhogAnapUrvAnAdatsva nochChiShTaM bhoktumarhasi
shlokas.24:
yathA hi shiShyaH shAstAraM shrutyarthamabhidhAvati |
tataH shrutamupAdAya shrutArthamupatiShThati
shlokas.25:
viShayAnevamasmAbhirdarshitAnabhimanyase |
anAgatAnatItA.nshcha svapne jAgaraNe tathA
shlokas.26:
vaimanasyaM gatAnAM cha jantUnAmalpachetasAm |
asmadarthe kRRite kArye dRRishyate prANadhAraNam
shlokas.27:
bahUnapi hi sa~NkalpAnmatvA svapnAnupAsya cha |
bubhukShayA pIDyamAno viShayAneva dhAvasi
shlokas.28:
agAramadvAramiva pravishya; sa~Nkalpabhogo viShayAnavindan |
prANakShaye shAntimupaiti nityaM; dArukShaye.agnirjvalito yathaiva
shlokas.29:
kAmaM tu naH sveShu guNeShu sa~NgaH; kAmaM cha nAnyonyaguNopalabdhiH |
asmAnRRite nAsti tavopalabdhi;stvAmapyRRite.asmAnna bhajeta harShaH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
subhage pa~nchahotR^INAM vidhAnamiha yAdRRisham
shlokas.2:
prANApAnAvudAnashcha samAno vyAna eva cha |
pa~nchahotR^InathaitAnvai paraM bhAvaM vidurbudhAH
shlokas.3:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
svabhAvAtsapta hotAra iti te pUrvikA matiH |
yathA vai pa~ncha hotAraH paro bhAvastathochyatAm
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
prANena sambhRRito vAyurapAno jAyate tataH |
apAne sambhRRito vAyustato vyAnaH pravartate
shlokas.5:
vyAnena sambhRRito vAyustatodAnaH pravartate |
udAne sambhRRito vAyuH samAnaH sampravartate
shlokas.6:
te.apRRichChanta purA gatvA pUrvajAtaM prajApatim |
yo no jyeShThastamAchakShva sa naH shreShTho bhaviShyati
shlokas.7:
brahmovAcha||
yasminpralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
yasminprachIrNe cha punashcharanti; sa vai shreShTho gachChata yatra kAmaH
shlokas.8:
prANa uvAcha||
mayi pralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
mayi prachIrNe cha punashcharanti; shreShTho hyahaM pashyata mAM pralInam
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
prANaH pralIyata tataH punashcha prachachAra ha |
samAnashchApyudAnashcha vacho.abrUtAM tataH shubhe
shlokas.10:
na tvaM sarvamidaM vyApya tiShThasIha yathA vayam |
na tvaM shreShTho.asi naH prANa apAno hi vashe tava
prachachAra punaH prANastamapAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.11:
mayi pralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
mayi prachIrNe cha punashcharanti; shreShTho hyahaM pashyata mAM pralInam
shlokas.12:
vyAnashcha tamudAnashcha bhAShamANamathochatuH |
apAna na tvaM shreShTho.asi prANo hi vashagastava
shlokas.13:
apAnaH prachachArAtha vyAnastaM punarabravIt |
shreShTho.ahamasmi sarveShAM shrUyatAM yena hetunA
shlokas.14:
mayi pralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
mayi prachIrNe cha punashcharanti; shreShTho hyahaM pashyata mAM pralInam
shlokas.15:
prAlIyata tato vyAnaH punashcha prachachAra ha |
prANApAnAvudAnashcha samAnashcha tamabruvan
na tvaM shreShTho.asi no vyAna samAno hi vashe tava
shlokas.16:
prachachAra punarvyAnaH samAnaH punarabravIt |
shreShTho.ahamasmi sarveShAM shrUyatAM yena hetunA
shlokas.17:
mayi pralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
mayi prachIrNe cha punashcharanti; shreShTho hyahaM pashyata mAM pralInam
shlokas.18:
tataH samAnaH prAlilye punashcha prachachAra ha |
prANApAnAvudAnashcha vyAnashchaiva tamabruvan
samAna na tvaM shreShTho.asi vyAna eva vashe tava
shlokas.19:
samAnaH prachachArAtha udAnastamuvAcha ha |
shreShTho.ahamasmi sarveShAM shrUyatAM yena hetunA
shlokas.20:
mayi pralIne pralayaM vrajanti; sarve prANAH prANabhRRitAM sharIre |
mayi prachIrNe cha punashcharanti; shreShTho hyahaM pashyata mAM pralInam
shlokas.21:
tataH prAlIyatodAnaH punashcha prachachAra ha |
prANApAnau samAnashcha vyAnashchaiva tamabruvan
udAna na tvaM shreShTho.asi vyAna eva vashe tava
shlokas.22:
tatastAnabravIdbrahmA samavetAnprajApatiH |
sarve shreShThA na vA shreShThAH sarve chAnyonyadharmiNaH
sarve svaviShaye shreShThAH sarve chAnyonyarakShiNaH
shlokas.23:
ekaH sthirashchAsthirashcha visheShAtpa~ncha vAyavaH |
eka eva mamaivAtmA bahudhApyupachIyate
shlokas.24:
parasparasya suhRRido bhAvayantaH parasparam |
svasti vrajata bhadraM vo dhArayadhvaM parasparam

shlokas.1:
