brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
nAradasya cha sa.nvAdamRRiSherdevamatasya cha
shlokas.2:
devamata uvAcha||
jantoH sa~njAyamAnasya kiM nu pUrvaM pravartate |
prANo.apAnaH samAno vA vyAno vodAna eva cha
shlokas.3:
nArada uvAcha||
yenAyaM sRRijyate jantustato.anyaH pUrvameti tam |
prANadva.ndvaM cha vij~neyaM tiryagaM chordhvagaM cha yat
shlokas.4:
devamata uvAcha||
kenAyaM sRRijyate jantuH kashchAnyaH pUrvameti tam |
prANadva.ndvaM cha me brUhi tiryagUrdhvaM cha nishchayAt
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
sa~NkalpAjjAyate harShaH shabdAdapi cha jAyate |
rasAtsa~njAyate chApi rUpAdapi cha jAyate
shlokas.6:
sparshAtsa~njAyate chApi gandhAdapi cha jAyate |
etadrUpamudAnasya harSho mithunasambhavaH
shlokas.7:
kAmAtsa~njAyate shukraM kAmAtsa~njAyate rasaH |
samAnavyAnajanite sAmAnye shukrashoNite
shlokas.8:
shukrAchChoNitasa.nsRRiShTAtpUrvaM prANaH pravartate |
prANena vikRRite shukre tato.apAnaH pravartate
shlokas.9:
prANApAnAvidaM dva.ndvamavAkchordhvaM cha gachChataH |
vyAnaH samAnashchaivobhau tiryagdva.ndvatvamuchyate
shlokas.10:
agnirvai devatAH sarvA iti vedasya shAsanam |
sa~njAyate brAhmaNeShu j~nAnaM buddhisamanvitam
shlokas.11:
tasya dhUmastamorUpaM rajo bhasma suretasaH |
sattvaM sa~njAyate tasya yatra prakShipyate haviH
shlokas.12:
AghArau samAno vyAnashcha iti yaj~navido viduH |
prANApAnAvAjyabhAgau tayormadhye hutAshanaH
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.14:
nirdva.ndvamiti yattvetattanme nigadataH shRRiNu |
ahorAtramidaM dva.ndvaM tayormadhye hutAshanaH |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.15:
ubhe chaivAyane dva.ndvaM tayormadhye hutAshanaH |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.16:
ubhe satyAnRRite dva.ndvaM tayormadhye hutAshanaH |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.17:
ubhe shubhAshubhe dva.ndvaM tayormadhye hutAshanaH |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.18:
sachchAsachchaiva taddva.ndvaM tayormadhye hutAshanaH |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH
shlokas.19:
prathamaM samAno vyAno vyasyate karma tena tat |
tRRitIyaM tu samAnena punareva vyavasyate
shlokas.20:
shAntyarthaM vAmadevaM cha shAntirbrahma sanAtanam |
etadrUpamudAnasya paramaM brAhmaNA viduH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
chAturhotravidhAnasya vidhAnamiha yAdRRisham
shlokas.2:
tasya sarvasya vidhivadvidhAnamupadekShyate |
shRRiNu me gadato bhadre rahasyamidamuttamam
shlokas.3:
karaNaM karma kartA cha mokSha ityeva bhAmini |
chatvAra ete hotAro yairidaM jagadAvRRitam
shlokas.4:
hotR^INAM sAdhanaM chaiva shRRiNu sarvamasheShataH |
ghrANaM jihvA cha chakShushcha tvakcha shrotraM cha pa~nchamam
mano buddhishcha saptaite vij~neyA guNahetavaH
shlokas.5:
gandho rasashcha rUpaM cha shabdaH sparshashcha pa~nchamaH |
mantavyamatha boddhavyaM saptaite karmahetavaH
shlokas.6:
ghrAtA bhakShayitA draShTA spraShTA shrotA cha pa~nchamaH |
mantA boddhA cha saptaite vij~neyAH kartRRihetavaH
shlokas.7:
svaguNaM bhakShayantyete guNavantaH shubhAshubham |
ahaM cha nirguNo.atreti saptaite mokShahetavaH
shlokas.8:
viduShAM budhyamAnAnAM svaM svaM sthAnaM yathAvidhi |
guNAste devatAbhUtAH satataM bhu~njate haviH
shlokas.9:
adanhyavidvAnannAni mamatvenopapadyate |
AtmArthaM pAchayannityaM mamatvenopahanyate
shlokas.10:
abhakShyabhakShaNaM chaiva madyapAnaM cha hanti tam |
sa chAnnaM hanti tachchAnnaM sa hatvA hanyate budhaH
shlokas.11:
attA hyannamidaM vidvAnpunarjanayatIshvaraH |
sa chAnnAjjAyate tasminsUkShmo nAma vyatikramaH
shlokas.12:
manasA gamyate yachcha yachcha vAchA nirudyate |
shrotreNa shrUyate yachcha chakShuShA yachcha dRRishyate
shlokas.13:
sparshena spRRishyate yachcha ghrANena ghrAyate cha yat |
manaHShaShThAni sa.nyamya havIMShyetAni sarvashaH
shlokas.14:
guNavatpAvako mahyaM dIpyate havyavAhanaH |
yogayaj~naH pravRRitto me j~nAnabrahmamanodbhavaH
prANastotro.apAnashastraH sarvatyAgasudakShiNaH
shlokas.15:
karmAnumantA brahmA me kartAdhvaryuH kRRitastutiH |
kRRitaprashAstA tachChAstramapavargo.asya dakShiNA
shlokas.16:
RRichashchApyatra sha.nsanti nArAyaNavido janAH |
nArAyaNAya devAya yadabadhnanpashUnpurA
shlokas.17:
tatra sAmAni gAyanti tAni chAhurnidarshanam |
devaM nArAyaNaM bhIru sarvAtmAnaM nibodha me

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ekaH shAstA na dvitIyo.asti shAstA; yathA niyukto.asmi tathA charAmi |
hRRidyeSha tiShThanpuruShaH shAsti shAstA; tenaiva yuktaH pravaNAdivodakam
shlokas.2:
eko gururnAsti tato dvitIyo; yo hRRichChayastamahamanubravImi |
tenAnushiShTA guruNA sadaiva; parAbhUtA dAnavAH sarva eva
shlokas.3:
eko bandhurnAsti tato dvitIyo; yo hRRichChayastamahamanubravImi |
tenAnushiShTA bAndhavA bandhumantaH; saptarShayaH sapta divi prabhAnti
shlokas.4:
ekaH shrotA nAsti tato dvitIyo; yo hRRichChayastamahamanubravImi |
tasmingurau guruvAsaM niruShya; shakro gataH sarvalokAmaratvam
shlokas.5:
eko dveShTA nAsti tato dvitIyo; yo hRRichChayastamahamanubravImi |
tenAnushiShTA guruNA sadaiva; lokadviShTAH pannagAH sarva eva
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
prajApatau pannagAnAM devarShINAM cha sa.nvidam
shlokas.7:
devarShayashcha nAgAshcha asurAshcha prajApatim |
paryapRRichChannupAsInAH shreyo naH prochyatAmiti
shlokas.8:
teShAM provAcha bhagavA~nshreyaH samanupRRichChatAm |
omityekAkSharaM brahma te shrutvA prAdravandishaH
shlokas.9:
teShAM prAdravamANAnAmupadeshArthamAtmanaH |
sarpANAM dashane bhAvaH pravRRittaH pUrvameva tu
shlokas.10:
asurANAM pravRRittastu dambhabhAvaH svabhAvajaH |
dAnaM devA vyavasitA damameva maharShayaH
shlokas.11:
ekaM shAstAramAsAdya shabdenaikena sa.nskRRitAH |
nAnA vyavasitAH sarve sarpadevarShidAnavAH
shlokas.12:
shRRiNotyayaM prochyamAnaM gRRihNAti cha yathAtatham |
pRRichChatastAvato bhUyo gururanyo.anumanyate
shlokas.13:
tasya chAnumate karma tataH pashchAtpravartate |
gururboddhA cha shatrushcha dveShTA cha hRRidi sa.nshritaH
shlokas.14:
pApena vichara.Nlloke pApachArI bhavatyayam |
shubhena vichara.Nlloke shubhachArI bhavatyuta
shlokas.15:
kAmachArI tu kAmena ya indriyasukhe rataH |
vratavArI sadaivaiSha ya indriyajaye rataH
shlokas.16:
apetavratakarmA tu kevalaM brahmaNi shritaH |
brahmabhUtashchara.Nlloke brahmachArI bhavatyayam
shlokas.17:
brahmaiva samidhastasya brahmAgnirbrahmasa.nstaraH |
Apo brahma gururbrahma sa brahmaNi samAhitaH
shlokas.18:
etadetAdRRishaM sUkShmaM brahmacharyaM vidurbudhAH |
viditvA chAnvapadyanta kShetraj~nenAnudarshinaH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
sa~Nkalpada.nshamashakaM shokaharShahimAtapam |
mohAndhakAratimiraM lobhavyAlasarIsRRipam
shlokas.2:
viShayaikAtyayAdhvAnaM kAmakrodhavirodhakam |
tadatItya mahAdurgaM praviShTo.asmi mahadvanam
shlokas.3:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
kva tadvanaM mahAprAj~na ke vRRikShAH saritashcha kAH |
girayaH parvatAshchaiva kiyatyadhvani tadvanam
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
na tadasti pRRithagbhAve ki~nchidanyattataH samam |
na tadastyapRRithagbhAve ki~nchiddUrataraM tataH
shlokas.5:
tasmAddhrasvataraM nAsti na tato.asti bRRihattaram |
nAsti tasmAdduHkhataraM nAstyanyattatsamaM sukham
shlokas.6:
na tatpravishya shochanti na prahRRiShyanti cha dvijAH |
na cha bibhyati keShA~nchittebhyo bibhyati ke cha na
shlokas.7:
tasminvane sapta mahAdrumAshcha; phalAni saptAtithayashcha sapta |
saptAshramAH sapta samAdhayashcha; dIkShAshcha saptaitadaraNyarUpam
shlokas.8:
pa~nchavarNAni divyAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
sRRijantaH pAdapAstatra vyApya tiShThanti tadvanam
shlokas.9:
suvarNAni dvivarNAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
sRRijantaH pAdapAstatra vyApya tiShThanti tadvanam
shlokas.10:
chaturvarNAni divyAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
sRRijantaH pAdapAstatra vyApya tiShThanti tadvanam
shlokas.11:
sha~NkarANi trivarNAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
sRRijantaH pAdapAstatra vyApya tiShThanti tadvanam
shlokas.12:
surabhINyekavarNAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
sRRijantaH pAdapAstatra vyApya tiShThanti tadvanam
shlokas.13:
bahUnyavyaktavarNAni puShpANi cha phalAni cha |
visRRijantau mahAvRRikShau tadvanaM vyApya tiShThataH
shlokas.14:
eko hyagniH sumanA brAhmaNo.atra; pa~nchendriyANi samidhashchAtra santi |
tebhyo mokShAH sapta bhavanti dIkShA; guNAH phalAnyatithayaH phalAshAH
shlokas.15:
AtithyaM pratigRRihNanti tatra sapta maharShayaH |
architeShu pralIneShu teShvanyadrochate vanam
shlokas.16:
pratij~nAvRRikShamaphalaM shAntichChAyAsamanvitam |
j~nAnAshrayaM tRRiptitoyamantaHkShetraj~nabhAskaram
shlokas.17:
ye.adhigachChanti tatsantasteShAM nAsti bhayaM punaH |
UrdhvaM chAvAkcha tiryakcha tasya nAnto.adhigamyate
shlokas.18:
sapta striyastatra vasanti sadyo; avA~NmukhA bhAnumatyo janitryaH |
UrdhvaM rasAnAM dadate prajAbhyaH; sarvAnyathA sarvamanityatAM cha
shlokas.19:
tatraiva pratitiShThanti punastatrodayanti cha |
sapta saptarShayaH siddhA vasiShThapramukhAH saha
shlokas.20:
yasho varcho bhagashchaiva vijayaH siddhitejasI |
evamevAnuvartante sapta jyotIMShi bhAskaram
shlokas.21:
girayaH parvatAshchaiva santi tatra samAsataH |
nadyashcha sarito vAri vahantyo brahmasambhavam
shlokas.22:
nadInAM sa~Ngamastatra vaitAnaH samupahvare |
svAtmatRRiptA yato yAnti sAkShAddAntAH pitAmaham
shlokas.23:
kRRishAshAH suvratAshAshcha tapasA dagdhakilbiShAH |
AtmanyAtmAnamAveshya brahmANaM samupAsate
shlokas.24:
RRichamapyatra sha.nsanti vidyAraNyavido janAH |
tadaraNyamabhipretya yathAdhIramajAyata
shlokas.25:
etadetAdRRishaM divyamaraNyaM brAhmaNA viduH |
viditvA chAnvatiShThanta kShetraj~nenAnudarshitam

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
gandhAnna jighrAmi rasAnna vedmi; rUpaM na pashyAmi na cha spRRishAmi |
na chApi shabdAnvividhA~nshRRiNomi; na chApi sa~Nkalpamupaimi ki~nchit
shlokas.2:
arthAniShTAnkAmayate svabhAvaH; sarvAndveShyAnpradviShate svabhAvaH |
kAmadveShAvudbhavataH svabhAvA;tprANApAnau jantudehAnniveshya
shlokas.3:
tebhyashchAnyA.nsteShvanityA.nshcha bhAvA;nbhUtAtmAnaM lakShayeyaM sharIre |
tasmi.nstiShThannAsmi shakyaH kathaM chi;tkAmakrodhAbhyAM jarayA mRRityunA cha
shlokas.4:
akAmayAnasya cha sarvakAmA;navidviShANasya cha sarvadoShAn |
na me svabhAveShu bhavanti lepA;stoyasya bindoriva puShkareShu
shlokas.5:
nityasya chaitasya bhavanti nityA; nirIkShamANasya bahUnsvabhAvAn |
na sajjate karmasu bhogajAlaM; divIva sUryasya mayUkhajAlam
shlokas.6:
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
adhvaryuyatisa.nvAdaM taM nibodha yashasvini
shlokas.7:
prokShyamANaM pashuM dRRiShTvA yaj~nakarmaNyathAbravIt |
yatiradhvaryumAsIno hi.nseyamiti kutsayan
shlokas.8:
tamadhvaryuH pratyuvAcha nAyaM ChAgo vinashyati |
shreyasA yokShyate janturyadi shrutiriyaM tathA
shlokas.9:
yo hyasya pArthivo bhAgaH pRRithivIM sa gamiShyati |
yadasya vArijaM ki~nchidapastatpratipadyate
shlokas.10:
sUryaM chakShurdishaH shrotre prANo.asya divameva cha |
Agame vartamAnasya na me doSho.asti kashchana
shlokas.11:
yatiruvAcha||
prANairviyoge ChAgasya yadi shreyaH prapashyasi |
ChAgArthe vartate yaj~no bhavataH kiM prayojanam
shlokas.12:
anu tvA manyatAM mAtA pitA bhrAtA sakhApi cha |
mantrayasvainamunnIya paravantaM visheShataH
shlokas.13:
ya evamanumanyera.nstAnbhavAnpraShTumarhati |
teShAmanumataM shrutvA shakyA kartuM vichAraNA
shlokas.14:
prANA apyasya ChAgasya prApitAste svayoniShu |
sharIraM kevalaM shiShTaM nishcheShTamiti me matiH
shlokas.15:
indhanasya tu tulyena sharIreNa vichetasA |
hi.nsA nirveShTukAmAnAmindhanaM pashusa~nj~nitam
shlokas.16:
ahi.nsA sarvadharmANAmiti vRRiddhAnushAsanam |
yadahi.nsraM bhavetkarma tatkAryamiti vidmahe
shlokas.17:
ahi.nseti pratij~neyaM yadi vakShyAmyataH param |
shakyaM bahuvidhaM vaktuM bhavataH kAryadUShaNam
shlokas.18:
ahi.nsA sarvabhUtAnAM nityamasmAsu rochate |
pratyakShataH sAdhayAmo na parokShamupAsmahe
shlokas.19:
adhvaryuruvAcha||
bhUmergandhaguNAnbhu~NkShe pibasyApomayAnrasAn |
jyotiShAM pashyase rUpaM spRRishasyanilajAnguNAn
shlokas.20:
shRRiNoShyAkAshajaM shabdaM manasA manyase matim |
sarvANyetAni bhUtAni prANA iti cha manyase
shlokas.21:
prANAdAne cha nityo.asi hi.nsAyAM vartate bhavAn |
nAsti cheShTA vinA hi.nsAM kiM vA tvaM manyase dvija
shlokas.22:
yatiruvAcha||
akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva dvaidhIbhAvo.ayamAtmanaH |
akSharaM tatra sadbhAvaH svabhAvaH kShara uchyate
shlokas.23:
prANo jihvA manaH sattvaM svabhAvo rajasA saha |
bhAvairetairvimuktasya nirdva.ndvasya nirAshiShaH
shlokas.24:
samasya sarvabhUteShu nirmamasya jitAtmanaH |
samantAtparimuktasya na bhayaM vidyate kvachit
shlokas.25:
adhvaryuruvAcha||
sadbhireveha sa.nvAsaH kAryo matimatAM vara |
bhavato hi mataM shrutvA pratibhAti matirmama
shlokas.26:
bhagavanbhagavadbuddhyA pratibuddho bravImyaham |
mataM mantuM kratuM kartuM nAparAdho.asti me dvija
shlokas.27:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
upapattyA yatistUShNIM vartamAnastataH param |
adhvaryurapi nirmohaH prachachAra mahAmakhe
shlokas.28:
evametAdRRishaM mokShaM susUkShmaM brAhmaNA viduH |
viditvA chAnutiShThanti kShetraj~nenAnudarshinA

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
kArtavIryasya sa.nvAdaM samudrasya cha bhAmini
shlokas.2:
kArtavIryArjuno nAma rAjA bAhusahasravAn |
yena sAgaraparyantA dhanuShA nirjitA mahI
shlokas.3:
sa kadAchitsamudrAnte vicharanbaladarpitaH |
avAkirachCharashataiH samudramiti naH shrutam
shlokas.4:
taM samudro namaskRRitya kRRitA~njaliruvAcha ha |
mA mu~ncha vIra nArAchAnbrUhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.5:
madAshrayANi bhUtAni tvadvisRRiShTairmaheShubhiH |
vadhyante rAjashArdUla tebhyo dehyabhayaM vibho
shlokas.6:
arjuna uvAcha||
matsamo yadi sa~NgrAme sharAsanadharaH kvachit |
vidyate taM mamAchakShva yaH samAsIta mAM mRRidhe
shlokas.7:
samudra uvAcha||
maharShirjamadagniste yadi rAjanparishrutaH |
tasya putrastavAtithyaM yathAvatkartumarhati
shlokas.8:
tataH sa rAjA prayayau krodhena mahatA vRRitaH |
sa tamAshramamAgamya rAmamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.9:
sa rAmapratikUlAni chakAra saha bandhubhiH |
AyAsaM janayAmAsa rAmasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
tatastejaH prajajvAla rAmasyAmitatejasaH |
pradahadripusainyAni tadA kamalalochane
shlokas.11:
tataH parashumAdAya sa taM bAhusahasriNam |
chichCheda sahasA rAmo bAhushAkhamiva drumam
shlokas.12:
taM hataM patitaM dRRiShTvA sametAH sarvabAndhavAH |
asInAdAya shaktIshcha bhArgavaM paryavArayan
shlokas.13:
rAmo.api dhanurAdAya rathamAruhya satvaraH |
visRRija~nsharavarShANi vyadhamatpArthivaM balam
shlokas.14:
tatastu kShatriyAH kechijjamadagniM nihatya cha |
vivishurgiridurgANi mRRigAH siMhArditA iva
shlokas.15:
teShAM svavihitaM karma tadbhayAnnAnutiShThatAm |
prajA vRRiShalatAM prAptA brAhmaNAnAmadarshanAt
shlokas.16:
ta ete dramiDAH kAshAH puNDrAshcha shabaraiH saha |
vRRiShalatvaM parigatA vyutthAnAtkShatradharmataH
shlokas.17:
tatastu hatavIrAsu kShatriyAsu punaH punaH |
dvijairutpAditaM kShatraM jAmadagnyo nyakRRintata
shlokas.18:
ekavi.nshatimedhAnte rAmaM vAgasharIriNI |
divyA provAcha madhurA sarvalokaparishrutA
shlokas.19:
rAma rAma nivartasva kaM guNaM tAta pashyasi |
kShatrabandhUnimAnprANairviprayojya punaH punaH
shlokas.20:
tathaiva taM mahAtmAnamRRichIkapramukhAstadA |
pitAmahA mahAbhAga nivartasvetyathAbruvan
shlokas.21:
piturvadhamamRRiShya.nstu rAmaH provAcha tAnRRiShIn |
nArhantIha bhavanto mAM nivArayitumityuta
shlokas.22:
pitara UchuH||
nArhase kShatrabandhU.nstvaM nihantuM jayatAM vara |
na hi yuktaM tvayA hantuM brAhmaNena satA nRRipAn

shlokas.1:
pitara UchuH||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
shrutvA cha tattathA kAryaM bhavatA dvijasattama
shlokas.2:
alarko nAma rAjarShirabhavatsumahAtapAH |
dharmaj~naH satyasandhashcha mahAtmA sumahAvrataH
shlokas.3:
sa sAgarAntAM dhanuShA vinirjitya mahImimAm |
kRRitvA suduShkaraM karma manaH sUkShme samAdadhe
shlokas.4:
sthitasya vRRikShamUle.atha tasya chintA babhUva ha |
utsRRijya sumahadrAjyaM sUkShmaM prati mahAmate
shlokas.5:
alarka uvAcha||
manaso me balaM jAtaM mano jitvA dhruvo jayaH |
anyatra bANAnasyAmi shatrubhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.6:
yadidaM chApalAnmUrteH sarvametachchikIrShati |
manaH prati sutIkShNAgrAnahaM mokShyAmi sAyakAn
shlokas.7:
mana uvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.8:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
alarka uvAcha||
AghrAya subahUngandhA.nstAneva pratigRRidhyati |
tasmAdghrANaM prati sharAnpratimokShyAmyahaM shitAn
shlokas.10:
ghrANa uvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.11:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
alarka uvAcha||
iyaM svAdUnrasAnbhuktvA tAneva pratigRRidhyati |
tasmAjjihvAM prati sharAnpratimokShyAmyahaM shitAn
shlokas.13:
jihvovAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.14:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.15:
alarka uvAcha||
spRRiShTvA tvagvividhAnsparshA.nstAneva pratigRRidhyati |
tasmAttvachaM pATayiShye vividhaiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.16:
tvaguvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.17:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.18:
alarka uvAcha||
shrutvA vai vividhA~nshabdA.nstAneva pratigRRidhyati |
tasmAchChrotraM prati sharAnpratimokShyAmyahaM shitAn
shlokas.19:
shrotra uvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti tato hAsyasi jIvitam
shlokas.20:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.21:
alarka uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA vai vividhAnbhAvA.nstAneva pratigRRidhyati |
tasmAchchakShuH prati sharAnpratimokShyAmyahaM shitAn
shlokas.22:
chakShuruvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.23:
anyAnbANAnsamIkShasva yaistvaM mAM sUdayiShyasi |
tachChrutvA sa vichintyAtha tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.24:
alarka uvAcha||
iyaM niShThA bahuvidhA praj~nayA tvadhyavasyati |
tasmAdbuddhiM prati sharAnpratimokShyAmyahaM shitAn
shlokas.25:
buddhiruvAcha||
neme bANAstariShyanti mAmalarka katha~nchana |
tavaiva marma bhetsyanti bhinnamarmA mariShyasi
shlokas.26:
pitara UchuH||
tato.alarkastapo ghoramAsthAyAtha suduShkaram |
nAdhyagachChatparaM shaktyA bANameteShu saptasu
susamAhitachetAstu tato.achintayata prabhuH
shlokas.27:
sa vichintya chiraM kAlamalarko dvijasattama |
nAdhyagachChatparaM shreyo yogAnmatimatAM varaH
shlokas.28:
sa ekAgraM manaH kRRitvA nishchalo yogamAsthitaH |
indriyANi jaghAnAshu bANenaikena vIryavAn
yogenAtmAnamAvishya sa.nsiddhiM paramAM yayau
shlokas.29:
vismitashchApi rAjarShirimAM gAthAM jagAda ha |
aho kaShTaM yadasmAbhiH pUrvaM rAjyamanuShThitam
iti pashchAnmayA j~nAtaM yogAnnAsti paraM sukham
shlokas.30:
iti tvamapi jAnIhi rAma mA kShatriyA~njahi |
tapo ghoramupAtiShTha tataH shreyo.abhipatsyase
shlokas.31:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tapo ghoraM jAmadagnyaH pitAmahaiH |
AsthitaH sumahAbhAgo yayau siddhiM cha durgamAm

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
trayo vai ripavo loke nava vai guNataH smRRitAH |
harShaH stambho.abhimAnashcha trayaste sAttvikA guNAH
shlokas.2:
shokaH krodho.atisa.nrambho rAjasAste guNAH smRRitAH |
svapnastandrI cha mohashcha trayaste tAmasA guNAH
shlokas.3:
etAnnikRRitya dhRRitimAnbANasa~NghairatandritaH |
jetuM parAnutsahate prashAntAtmA jitendriyaH
shlokas.4:
atra gAthAH kIrtayanti purAkalpavido janAH |
ambarISheNa yA gItA rAj~nA rAjyaM prashAsatA
shlokas.5:
samudIrNeShu doSheShu vadhyamAneShu sAdhuShu |
jagrAha tarasA rAjyamambarISha iti shrutiH
shlokas.6:
sa nigRRihya mahAdoShAnsAdhUnsamabhipUjya cha |
jagAma mahatIM siddhiM gAthAM chemAM jagAda ha
shlokas.7:
bhUyiShThaM me jitA doShA nihatAH sarvashatravaH |
eko doSho.avashiShTastu vadhyaH sa na hato mayA
shlokas.8:
yena yukto janturayaM vaitRRiShNyaM nAdhigachChati |
tRRiShNArta iva nimnAni dhAvamAno na budhyate
shlokas.9:
akAryamapi yeneha prayuktaH sevate naraH |
taM lobhamasibhistIkShNairnikRRintantaM nikRRintata
shlokas.10:
lobhAddhi jAyate tRRiShNA tatashchintA prasajyate |
sa lipsamAno labhate bhUyiShThaM rAjasAnguNAn
shlokas.11:
sa tairguNaiH saMhatadehabandhanaH; punaH punarjAyati karma chehate |
janmakShaye bhinnavikIrNadehaH; punarmRRityuM gachChati janmani sve
shlokas.12:
tasmAdenaM samyagavekShya lobhaM; nigRRihya dhRRityAtmani rAjyamichChet |
etadrAjyaM nAnyadastIti vidyA;dyastvatra rAjA vijito mamaikaH
shlokas.13:
iti rAj~nAmbarISheNa gAthA gItA yashasvinA |
AdhirAjyaM puraskRRitya lobhamekaM nikRRintatA

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
brAhmaNasya cha sa.nvAdaM janakasya cha bhAmini
shlokas.2:
brAhmaNaM janako rAjA sannaM kasmi.nshchidAgame |
viShaye me na vastavyamiti shiShTyarthamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchAtha brAhmaNo rAjasattamam |
AchakShva viShayaM rAjanyAvA.nstava vashe sthitaH
shlokas.4:
so.anyasya viShaye rAj~no vastumichChAmyahaM vibho |
vachaste kartumichChAmi yathAshAstraM mahIpate
shlokas.5:
ityuktaH sa tadA rAjA brAhmaNena yashasvinA |
muhuruShNaM cha niHshvasya na sa taM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.6:
tamAsInaM dhyAyamAnaM rAjAnamamitaujasam |
kashmalaM sahasAgachChadbhAnumantamiva grahaH
shlokas.7:
samAshvAsya tato rAjA vyapete kashmale tadA |
tato muhUrtAdiva taM brAhmaNaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.8:
pitRRipaitAmahe rAjye vashye janapade sati |
viShayaM nAdhigachChAmi vichinvanpRRithivImimAm
shlokas.9:
nAdhyagachChaM yadA pRRithvyAM mithilA mArgitA mayA |
nAdhyagachChaM yadA tasyAM svaprajA mArgitA mayA
shlokas.10:
nAdhyagachChaM yadA tAsu tadA me kashmalo.abhavat |
tato me kashmalasyAnte matiH punarupasthitA
shlokas.11:
tayA na viShayaM manye sarvo vA viShayo mama |
AtmApi chAyaM na mama sarvA vA pRRithivI mama
uShyatAM yAvadutsAho bhujyatAM yAvadiShyate
shlokas.12:
pitRRipaitAmahe rAjye vashye janapade sati |
brUhi kAM buddhimAsthAya mamatvaM varjitaM tvayA
shlokas.13:
kAM vA buddhiM vinishchitya sarvo vai viShayastava |
nAvaiShi viShayaM yena sarvo vA viShayastava
shlokas.14:
janaka uvAcha||
antavanta ihArambhA viditAH sarvakarmasu |
nAdhyagachChamahaM yasmAnmamedamiti yadbhavet
shlokas.15:
kasyedamiti kasya svamiti vedavachastathA |
nAdhyagachChamahaM buddhyA mamedamiti yadbhavet
shlokas.16:
etAM buddhiM vinishchitya mamatvaM varjitaM mayA |
shRRiNu buddhiM tu yAM j~nAtvA sarvatra viShayo mama
shlokas.17:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi gandhAnghrANagatAnapi |
tasmAnme nirjitA bhUmirvashe tiShThati nityadA
shlokas.18:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi rasAnAsye.api vartataH |
Apo me nirjitAstasmAdvashe tiShThanti nityadA
shlokas.19:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi rUpaM jyotishcha chakShuShA |
tasmAnme nirjitaM jyotirvashe tiShThati nityadA
shlokas.20:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi sparshA.nstvachi gatAshcha ye |
tasmAnme nirjito vAyurvashe tiShThati nityadA
shlokas.21:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi shabdA~nshrotragatAnapi |
tasmAnme nirjitAH shabdA vashe tiShThanti nityadA
shlokas.22:
nAhamAtmArthamichChAmi mano nityaM manontare |
mano me nirjitaM tasmAdvashe tiShThati nityadA
shlokas.23:
devebhyashcha pitRRibhyashcha bhUtebhyo.atithibhiH saha |
ityarthaM sarva eveme samArambhA bhavanti vai
shlokas.24:
tataH prahasya janakaM brAhmaNaH punarabravIt |
tvajjij~nAsArthamadyeha viddhi mAM dharmamAgatam
shlokas.25:
tvamasya brahmanAbhasya buddhyArasyAnivartinaH |
sattvaneminiruddhasya chakrasyaikaH pravartakaH

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
nAhaM tathA bhIru charAmi loke; tathA tvaM mAM tarkayase svabuddhyA |
vipro.asmi mukto.asmi vanecharo.asmi; gRRihasthadharmA brahmachArI tathAsmi
shlokas.2:
nAhamasmi yathA mAM tvaM pashyase chakShuShA shubhe |
mayA vyAptamidaM sarvaM yatki~nchijjagatIgatam
shlokas.3:
ye kechijjantavo loke ja~NgamAH sthAvarAshcha ha |
teShAM mAmantakaM viddhi dArUNAmiva pAvakam
shlokas.4:
rAjyaM pRRithivyAM sarvasyAmatha vApi triviShTape |
tathA buddhiriyaM vetti buddhireva dhanaM mama
shlokas.5:
ekaH panthA brAhmaNAnAM yena gachChanti tadvidaH |
gRRiheShu vanavAseShu guruvAseShu bhikShuShu
li~NgairbahubhiravyagrairekA buddhirupAsyate
shlokas.6:
nAnAli~NgAshramasthAnAM yeShAM buddhiH shamAtmikA |
te bhAvamekamAyAnti saritaH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.7:
buddhyAyaM gamyate mArgaH sharIreNa na gamyate |
Adyantavanti karmANi sharIraM karmabandhanam
shlokas.8:
tasmAtte subhage nAsti paralokakRRitaM bhayam |
madbhAvabhAvaniratA mamaivAtmAnameShyasi

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
nedamalpAtmanA shakyaM vedituM nAkRRitAtmanA |
bahu chAlpaM cha sa~NkShiptaM viplutaM cha mataM mama
shlokas.2:
upAyaM tu mama brUhi yenaiShA labhyate matiH |
tanmanye kAraNatamaM yata eShA pravartate
shlokas.3:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
araNIM brAhmaNIM viddhi gururasyottarAraNiH |
tapaHshrute.abhimathnIto j~nAnAgnirjAyate tataH
shlokas.4:
brAhmaNyuvAcha||
yadidaM brahmaNo li~NgaM kShetraj~namiti sa~nj~nitam |
grahItuM yena tachChakyaM lakShaNaM tasya tatkva nu
shlokas.5:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
ali~Ngo nirguNashchaiva kAraNaM nAsya vidyate |
upAyameva vakShyAmi yena gRRihyeta vA na vA
shlokas.6:
samyagapyupadiShTashcha bhramarairiva lakShyate |
karmabuddhirabuddhitvAjj~nAnali~NgairivAshritam
shlokas.7:
idaM kAryamidaM neti na mokSheShUpadishyate |
pashyataH shRRiNvato buddhirAtmano yeShu jAyate
shlokas.8:
yAvanta iha shakyera.nstAvatoM.ashAnprakalpayet |
vyaktAnavyaktarUpA.nshcha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
sarvAnnAnAtvayuktA.nshcha sarvAnpratyakShahetukAn |
yataH paraM na vidyeta tato.abhyAse bhaviShyati
shlokas.10:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tatastu tasyA brAhmaNyA matiH kShetraj~nasa~NkShaye |
kShetraj~nAdeva parataH kShetraj~no.anyaH pravartate
shlokas.11:
arjuna uvAcha||
kva nu sA brAhmaNI kRRiShNa kva chAsau brAhmaNarShabhaH |
yAbhyAM siddhiriyaM prAptA tAvubhau vada me.achyuta
shlokas.12:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
mano me brAhmaNaM viddhi buddhiM me viddhi brAhmaNIm |
kShetraj~na iti yashchoktaH so.ahameva dhana~njaya

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
brahma yatparamaM vedyaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi |
bhavato hi prasAdena sUkShme me ramate matiH
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
sa.nvAdaM mokShasa.nyuktaM shiShyasya guruNA saha
shlokas.3:
kashchidbrAhmaNamAsInamAchAryaM sa.nshitavratam |
shiShyaH paprachCha medhAvI kiM svichChreyaH parantapa
shlokas.4:
bhagavantaM prapanno.ahaM niHshreyasaparAyaNaH |
yAche tvAM shirasA vipra yadbrUyAM tadvichakShva me
shlokas.5:
tameva.nvAdinaM pArtha shiShyaM gururuvAcha ha |
kathayasva pravakShyAmi yatra te sa.nshayo dvija
shlokas.6:
ityuktaH sa kurushreShTha guruNA guruvatsalaH |
prA~njaliH paripaprachCha yattachChRRiNu mahAmate
shlokas.7:
shiShya uvAcha||
kutashchAhaM kutashcha tvaM tatsatyaM brUhi yatparam |
kuto jAtAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha
shlokas.8:
kena jIvanti bhUtAni teShAmAyuH kimAtmakam |
kiM satyaM kiM tapo vipra ke guNAH sadbhirIritAH
ke panthAnaH shivAH santi kiM sukhaM kiM cha duShkRRitam
shlokas.9:
etAnme bhagavanprashnAnyAthAtathyena sattama |
vaktumarhasi viprarShe yathAvadiha tattvataH
shlokas.10:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tasmai sampratipannAya yathAvatparipRRichChate |
shiShyAya guNayuktAya shAntAya guruvartine
ChAyAbhUtAya dAntAya yataye brahmachAriNe
shlokas.11:
tAnprashnAnabravItpArtha medhAvI sa dhRRitavrataH |
guruH kurukulashreShTha samyaksarvAnari.ndama
shlokas.12:
brahmaproktamidaM dharmamRRiShipravarasevitam |
vedavidyAsamAvApyaM tattvabhUtArthabhAvanam
shlokas.13:
bhUtabhavyabhaviShyAdidharmakAmArthanishchayam |
siddhasa~Nghaparij~nAtaM purAkalpaM sanAtanam
shlokas.14:
pravakShye.ahaM mahAprAj~na padamuttamamadya te |
buddhvA yadiha sa.nsiddhA bhavantIha manIShiNaH
shlokas.15:
upagamyarShayaH pUrvaM jij~nAsantaH parasparam |
bRRihaspatibharadvAjau gautamo bhArgavastathA
shlokas.16:
vasiShThaH kAshyapashchaiva vishvAmitro.atrireva cha |
mArgAnsarvAnparikramya parishrAntAH svakarmabhiH
shlokas.17:
RRiShimA~NgirasaM vRRiddhaM puraskRRitya tu te dvijAH |
dadRRishurbrahmabhavane brahmANaM vItakalmaSham
shlokas.18:
taM praNamya mahAtmAnaM sukhAsInaM maharShayaH |
paprachChurvinayopetA niHshreyasamidaM param
shlokas.19:
kathaM karma kriyAtsAdhu kathaM muchyeta kilbiShAt |
ke no mArgAH shivAshcha syuH kiM satyaM kiM cha duShkRRitam
shlokas.20:
kenobhau karmapanthAnau mahattvaM kena vindati |
pralayaM chApavargaM cha bhUtAnAM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.21:
ityuktaH sa munishreShThairyadAha prapitAmahaH |
tatte.ahaM sampravakShyAmi shRRiNu shiShya yathAgamam
shlokas.22:
brahmovAcha||
satyAdbhUtAni jAtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
tapasA tAni jIvanti iti tadvitta suvratAH
shlokas.23:
svAM yoniM punarAgamya vartante svena karmaNA |
satyaM hi guNasa.nyuktaM niyataM pa~nchalakShaNam
shlokas.24:
brahma satyaM tapaH satyaM satyaM chaiva prajApatiH |
satyAdbhUtAni jAtAni bhUtaM satyamayaM mahat
shlokas.25:
tasmAtsatyAshrayA viprA nityaM yogaparAyaNAH |
atItakrodhasantApA niyatA dharmasetavaH
shlokas.26:
anyonyaniyatAnvaidyAndharmasetupravartakAn |
tAnahaM sampravakShyAmi shAshvatAnlokabhAvanAn
shlokas.27:
chAturvidyaM tathA varNA.nshchaturashchAshramAnpRRithak |
dharmamekaM chatuShpAdaM nityamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.28:
panthAnaM vaH pravakShyAmi shivaM kShemakaraM dvijAH |
niyataM brahmabhAvAya yAtaM pUrvaM manIShibhiH
shlokas.29:
gadatastaM mamAdyeha panthAnaM durvidaM param |
nibodhata mahAbhAgA nikhilena paraM padam
shlokas.30:
brahmachArikamevAhurAshramaM prathamaM padam |
gArhasthyaM tu dvitIyaM syAdvAnaprasthamataH param
tataH paraM tu vij~neyamadhyAtmaM paramaM padam
shlokas.31:
jyotirAkAshamAdityo vAyurindraH prajApatiH |
nopaiti yAvadadhyAtmaM tAvadetAnna pashyati
tasyopAyaM pravakShyAmi purastAttaM nibodhata
shlokas.32:
phalamUlAnilabhujAM munInAM vasatAM vane |
vAnaprasthaM dvijAtInAM trayANAmupadishyate
shlokas.33:
sarveShAmeva varNAnAM gArhasthyaM tadvidhIyate |
shraddhAlakShaNamityevaM dharmaM dhIrAH prachakShate
shlokas.34:
ityete devayAnA vaH panthAnaH parikIrtitAH |
sadbhiradhyAsitA dhIraiH karmabhirdharmasetavaH
shlokas.35:
eteShAM pRRithagadhyAste yo dharmaM sa.nshitavrataH |
kAlAtpashyati bhUtAnAM sadaiva prabhavApyayau
shlokas.36:
atastattvAni vakShyAmi yAthAtathyena hetunA |
viShayasthAni sarvANi vartamAnAni bhAgashaH
shlokas.37:
mahAnAtmA tathAvyaktamaha~NkArastathaiva cha |
indriyANi dashaikaM cha mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha cha
shlokas.38:
visheShAH pa~nchabhUtAnAmityeShA vaidikI shrutiH |
chaturvi.nshatireShA vastattvAnAM samprakIrtitA
shlokas.39:
tattvAnAmatha yo veda sarveShAM prabhavApyayau |
sa dhIraH sarvabhUteShu na mohamadhigachChati
shlokas.40:
tattvAni yo vedayate yathAtathaM; guNA.nshcha sarvAnakhilAshcha devatAH |
vidhUtapApmA pravimuchya bandhanaM; sa sarvalokAnamalAnsamashnute

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
tadavyaktamanudriktaM sarvavyApi dhruvaM sthiram |
navadvAraM puraM vidyAttriguNaM pa~nchadhAtukam
shlokas.2:
ekAdashaparikShepaM mano vyAkaraNAtmakam |
buddhisvAmikamityetatparamekAdashaM bhavet
shlokas.3:
trINi srotA.nsi yAnyasminnApyAyante punaH punaH |
praNADyastisra evaitAH pravartante guNAtmikAH
shlokas.4:
tamo rajastathA sattvaM guNAnetAnprachakShate |
anyonyamithunAH sarve tathAnyonyAnujIvinaH
shlokas.5:
anyonyApAshrayAshchaiva tathAnyonyAnuvartinaH |
anyonyavyatiShaktAshcha triguNAH pa~ncha dhAtavaH
shlokas.6:
tamaso mithunaM sattvaM sattvasya mithunaM rajaH |
rajasashchApi sattvaM syAtsattvasya mithunaM tamaH
shlokas.7:
niyamyate tamo yatra rajastatra pravartate |
niyamyate rajo yatra sattvaM tatra pravartate
shlokas.8:
naishAtmakaM tamo vidyAttriguNaM mohasa~nj~nitam |
adharmalakShaNaM chaiva niyataM pApakarmasu
shlokas.9:
pravRRittyAtmakamevAhU rajaH paryAyakArakam |
pravRRittaM sarvabhUteShu dRRishyatotpattilakShaNam
shlokas.10:
prakAshaM sarvabhUteShu lAghavaM shraddadhAnatA |
sAttvikaM rUpamevaM tu lAghavaM sAdhusaMmitam
shlokas.11:
eteShAM guNatattvaM hi vakShyate hetvahetubhiH |
samAsavyAsayuktAni tattvatastAni vitta me
shlokas.12:
saMmoho.aj~nAnamatyAgaH karmaNAmavinirNayaH |
svapnaH stambho bhayaM lobhaH shokaH sukRRitadUShaNam
shlokas.13:
asmRRitishchAvipAkashcha nAstikyaM bhinnavRRittitA |
nirvisheShatvamandhatvaM jaghanyaguNavRRittitA
shlokas.14:
akRRite kRRitamAnitvamaj~nAne j~nAnamAnitA |
amaitrI vikRRito bhAvo ashraddhA mUDhabhAvanA
shlokas.15:
anArjavamasa~nj~natvaM karma pApamachetanA |
gurutvaM sannabhAvatvamasitatvamavAggatiH
shlokas.16:
sarva ete guNA viprAstAmasAH samprakIrtitAH |
ye chAnye niyatA bhAvA loke.asminmohasa~nj~nitAH
shlokas.17:
tatra tatra niyamyante sarve te tAmasA guNAH |
parivAdakathA nityaM devabrAhmaNavaidikAH
shlokas.18:
atyAgashchAbhimAnashcha moho manyustathAkShamA |
matsarashchaiva bhUteShu tAmasaM vRRittamiShyate
shlokas.19:
vRRithArambhAshcha ye kechidvRRithAdAnAni yAni cha |
vRRithAbhakShaNamityetattAmasaM vRRittamiShyate
shlokas.20:
ativAdo.atitikShA cha mAtsaryamatimAnitA |
ashraddadhAnatA chaiva tAmasaM vRRittamiShyate
shlokas.21:
eva.nvidhAstu ye kechilloke.asminpApakarmiNaH |
manuShyA bhinnamaryAdAH sarve te tAmasA janAH
shlokas.22:
teShAM yoniM pravakShyAmi niyatAM pApakarmaNAm |
avA~NnirayabhAvAya tirya~NnirayagAminaH
shlokas.23:
sthAvarANi cha bhUtAni pashavo vAhanAni cha |
kravyAdA dandashUkAshcha kRRimikITaviha~NgamAH
shlokas.24:
aNDajA jantavo ye cha sarve chApi chatuShpadAH |
unmattA badhirA mUkA ye chAnye pAparogiNaH
shlokas.25:
magnAstamasi durvRRittAH svakarmakRRitalakShaNAH |
avAksrotasa ityete magnAstamasi tAmasAH
shlokas.26:
teShAmutkarShamudrekaM vakShyAmyahamataH param |
yathA te sukRRitA.NllokA.Nllabhante puNyakarmiNaH
shlokas.27:
anyathA pratipannAstu vivRRiddhA ye cha karmasu |
svakarmaniratAnAM cha brAhmaNAnAM shubhaiShiNAm
shlokas.28:
sa.nskAreNordhvamAyAnti yatamAnAH salokatAm |
svargaM gachChanti devAnAmityeShA vaidikI shrutiH
shlokas.29:
anyathA pratipannAstu vivRRiddhAH sveShu karmasu |
punarAvRRittidharmANaste bhavantIha mAnuShAH
shlokas.30:
pApayoniM samApannAshchaNDAlA mUkachUchukAH |
varNAnparyAyashashchApi prApnuvantyuttarottaram
shlokas.31:
shUdrayonimatikramya ye chAnye tAmasA guNAH |
srotomadhye samAgamya vartante tAmase guNe
shlokas.32:
abhiSha~Ngastu kAmeShu mahAmoha iti smRRitaH |
RRiShayo munayo devA muhyantyatra sukhepsavaH
shlokas.33:
tamo moho mahAmohastAmisraH krodhasa~nj~nitaH |
maraNaM tvandhatAmisraM tAmisraM krodha uchyate
shlokas.34:
bhAvato guNatashchaiva yonitashchaiva tattvataH |
sarvametattamo viprAH kIrtitaM vo yathAvidhi
shlokas.35:
ko nvetadbudhyate sAdhu ko nvetatsAdhu pashyati |
atattve tattvadarshI yastamasastattvalakShaNam
shlokas.36:
tamoguNA vo bahudhA prakIrtitA; yathAvaduktaM cha tamaH parAvaram |
naro hi yo veda guNAnimAnsadA; sa tAmasaiH sarvaguNaiH pramuchyate

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
rajo.ahaM vaH pravakShyAmi yAthAtathyena sattamAH |
nibodhata mahAbhAgA guNavRRittaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
sa~NghAto rUpamAyAsaH sukhaduHkhe himAtapau |
aishvaryaM vigrahaH sandhirhetuvAdo.aratiH kShamA
shlokas.3:
balaM shauryaM mado roSho vyAyAmakalahAvapi |
IrShyepsA paishunaM yuddhaM mamatvaM paripAlanam
shlokas.4:
vadhabandhaparikleshAH krayo vikraya eva cha |
nikRRinta Chindhi bhindhIti paramarmAvakartanam
shlokas.5:
ugraM dAruNamAkroshaH paravittAnushAsanam |
lokachintA vichintA cha matsaraH paribhAShaNam
shlokas.6:
mRRiShAvAdo mRRiShAdAnaM vikalpaH paribhAShaNam |
nindA stutiH prasha.nsA cha pratApaH paritarpaNam
shlokas.7:
paricharyA cha shushrUShA sevA tRRiShNA vyapAshrayaH |
vyUho.anayaH pramAdashcha paritApaH parigrahaH
shlokas.8:
sa.nskArA ye cha loke.asminpravartante pRRithakpRRithak |
nRRiShu nArIShu bhUteShu dravyeShu sharaNeShu cha
shlokas.9:
santApo.apratyayashchaiva vratAni niyamAshcha ye |
pradAnamAshIryuktaM cha satataM me bhavatviti
shlokas.10:
svadhAkAro namaskAraH svAhAkAro vaShaTkriyA |
yAjanAdhyApane chobhe tathaivAhuH parigraham
shlokas.11:
idaM me syAdidaM me syAtsneho guNasamudbhavaH |
abhidrohastathA mAyA nikRRitirmAna eva cha
shlokas.12:
stainyaM hi.nsA parIvAdaH paritApaH prajAgaraH |
stambho dambho.atha rAgashcha bhaktiH prItiH pramodanam
shlokas.13:
dyUtaM cha janavAdashcha sambandhAH strIkRRitAshcha ye |
nRRittavAditragItAni prasa~NgA ye cha kechana
sarva ete guNA viprA rAjasAH samprakIrtitAH
shlokas.14:
bhUtabhavyabhaviShyANAM bhAvAnAM bhuvi bhAvanAH |
trivarganiratA nityaM dharmo.arthaH kAma ityapi
shlokas.15:
kAmavRRittAH pramodante sarvakAmasamRRiddhibhiH |
arvAksrotasa ityete taijasA rajasAvRRitAH
shlokas.16:
asmi.Nlloke pramodante jAyamAnAH punaH punaH |
pretyabhAvikamIhanta iha laukikameva cha
dadati pratigRRihNanti japantyatha cha juhvati
shlokas.17:
rajoguNA vo bahudhAnukIrtitA; yathAvaduktaM guNavRRittameva cha |
naro hi yo veda guNAnimAnsadA; sa rAjasaiH sarvaguNairvimuchyate

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi tRRitIyaM guNamuttamam |
sarvabhUtahitaM loke satAM dharmamaninditam
shlokas.2:
AnandaH prItirudrekaH prAkAshyaM sukhameva cha |
akArpaNyamasa.nrambhaH santoShaH shraddadhAnatA
shlokas.3:
kShamA dhRRitirahi.nsA cha samatA satyamArjavam |
akrodhashchAnasUyA cha shauchaM dAkShyaM parAkramaH
shlokas.4:
mudhA j~nAnaM mudhA vRRittaM mudhA sevA mudhA shramaH |
evaM yo yuktadharmaH syAtso.amutrAnantyamashnute
shlokas.5:
nirmamo niraha~NkAro nirAshIH sarvataH samaH |
akAmahata ityeSha satAM dharmaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.6:
vishrambho hrIstitikShA cha tyAgaH shauchamatandritA |
AnRRisha.nsyamasaMmoho dayA bhUteShvapaishunam
shlokas.7:
harShastuShTirvismayashcha vinayaH sAdhuvRRittatA |
shAntikarma vishuddhishcha shubhA buddhirvimochanam
shlokas.8:
upekShA brahmacharyaM cha parityAgashcha sarvashaH |
nirmamatvamanAshIstvamaparikrItadharmatA
shlokas.9:
mudhA dAnaM mudhA yaj~no mudhAdhItaM mudhA vratam |
mudhA pratigrahashchaiva mudhA dharmo mudhA tapaH
shlokas.10:
eva.nvRRittAstu ye kechilloke.asminsattvasa.nshrayAH |
brAhmaNA brahmayonisthAste dhIrAH sAdhudarshinaH
shlokas.11:
hitvA sarvANi pApAni niHshokA hyajarAmarAH |
divaM prApya tu te dhIrAH kurvate vai tatastataH
shlokas.12:
IshitvaM cha vashitvaM cha laghutvaM manasashcha te |
vikurvate mahAtmAno devAstridivagA iva
shlokas.13:
Urdhvasrotasa ityete devA vaikArikAH smRRitAH |
vikurvate prakRRityA vai divaM prAptAstatastataH
yadyadichChanti tatsarvaM bhajante vibhajanti cha
shlokas.14:
ityetatsAttvikaM vRRittaM kathitaM vo dvijarShabhAH |
etadvij~nAya vidhivallabhate yadyadichChati
shlokas.15:
prakIrtitAH sattvaguNA visheShato; yathAvaduktaM guNavRRittameva cha |
narastu yo veda guNAnimAnsadA; guNAnsa bhu~Nkte na guNaiH sa bhujyate

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
naiva shakyA guNA vaktuM pRRithaktveneha sarvashaH |
avichChinnAni dRRishyante rajaH sattvaM tamastathA
shlokas.2:
anyonyamanuShajjante anyonyaM chAnujIvinaH |
anyonyApAshrayAH sarve tathAnyonyAnuvartinaH
shlokas.3:
yAvatsattvaM tamastAvadvartate nAtra sa.nshayaH |
yAvattamashcha sattvaM cha rajastAvadihochyate
shlokas.4:
saMhatya kurvate yAtrAM sahitAH sa~NghachAriNaH |
sa~NghAtavRRittayo hyete vartante hetvahetubhiH
shlokas.5:
udrekavyatirekANAM teShAmanyonyavartinAm |
vartate tadyathAnyUnaM vyatiriktaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
vyatiriktaM tamo yatra tiryagbhAvagataM bhavet |
alpaM tatra rajo j~neyaM sattvaM chAlpataraM tataH
shlokas.7:
udriktaM cha rajo yatra madhyasrotogataM bhavet |
alpaM tatra tamo j~neyaM sattvaM chAlpataraM tataH
shlokas.8:
udriktaM cha yadA sattvamUrdhvasrotogataM bhavet |
alpaM tatra rajo j~neyaM tamashchAlpataraM tataH
shlokas.9:
sattvaM vaikArikaM yonirindriyANAM prakAshikA |
na hi sattvAtparo bhAvaH kashchidanyo vidhIyate
shlokas.10:
UrdhvaM gachChanti sattvasthA madhye tiShThanti rAjasAH |
jaghanyaguNasa.nyuktA yAntyadhastAmasA janAH
shlokas.11:
tamaH shUdre rajaH kShatre brAhmaNe sattvamuttamam |
ityevaM triShu varNeShu vivartante guNAstrayaH
shlokas.12:
dUrAdapi hi dRRishyante sahitAH sa~NghachAriNaH |
tamaH sattvaM rajashchaiva pRRithaktvaM nAnushushruma
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA chAdityamudyantaM kuchorANAM bhayaM bhavet |
adhvagAH paritapyera.nstRRiShNArtA duHkhabhAginaH
shlokas.14:
AdityaH sattvamuddiShTaM kuchorAstu yathA tamaH |
paritApo.adhvagAnAM cha rAjaso guNa uchyate
shlokas.15:
prAkAshyaM sattvamAditye santApo rAjaso guNaH |
upaplavastu vij~neyastAmasastasya parvasu
shlokas.16:
evaM jyotiHShu sarveShu vivartante guNAstrayaH |
paryAyeNa cha vartante tatra tatra tathA tathA
shlokas.17:
sthAvareShu cha bhUteShu tiryagbhAvagataM tamaH |
rAjasAstu vivartante snehabhAvastu sAttvikaH
shlokas.18:
ahastridhA tu vij~neyaM tridhA rAtrirvidhIyate |
mAsArdhamAsavarShANi RRitavaH sandhayastathA
shlokas.19:
tridhA dAnAni dIyante tridhA yaj~naH pravartate |
tridhA lokAstridhA vedAstridhA vidyAstridhA gatiH
shlokas.20:
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha dharmo.arthaH kAma ityapi |
prANApAnAvudAnashchApyeta eva trayo guNAH
shlokas.21:
yatki~nchidiha vai loke sarvameShveva tattriShu |
trayo guNAH pravartante avyaktA nityameva tu
sattvaM rajastamashchaiva guNasargaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.22:
tamo.avyaktaM shivaM nityamajaM yoniH sanAtanaH |
prakRRitirvikAraH pralayaH pradhAnaM prabhavApyayau
shlokas.23:
anudriktamanUnaM cha hyakampamachalaM dhruvam |
sadasachchaiva tatsarvamavyaktaM triguNaM smRRitam
j~neyAni nAmadheyAni narairadhyAtmachintakaiH
shlokas.24:
avyaktanAmAni guNA.nshcha tattvato; yo veda sarvANi gatIshcha kevalAH |
vimuktadehaH pravibhAgatattvavi;tsa muchyate sarvaguNairnirAmayaH

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
avyaktAtpUrvamutpanno mahAnAtmA mahAmatiH |
AdirguNAnAM sarveShAM prathamaH sarga uchyate
shlokas.2:
mahAnAtmA matirviShNurvishvaH shambhushcha vIryavAn |
buddhiH praj~nopalabdhishcha tathA khyAtirdhRRitiH smRRitiH
shlokas.3:
paryAyavAchakaiH shabdairmahAnAtmA vibhAvyate |
taM jAnanbrAhmaNo vidvAnna pramohaM nigachChati
shlokas.4:
sarvataHpANipAdashcha sarvatokShishiromukhaH |
sarvataHshrutimA.Nlloke sarvaM vyApya sa tiShThati
shlokas.5:
mahAprabhArchiH puruShaH sarvasya hRRidi nishritaH |
aNimA laghimA prAptirIshAno jyotiravyayaH
shlokas.6:
tatra buddhimatAM lokAH saMnyAsaniratAshcha ye |
dhyAnino nityayogAshcha satyasandhA jitendriyAH
shlokas.7:
j~nAnavantashcha ye kechidalubdhA jitamanyavaH |
prasannamanaso dhIrA nirmamA niraha~NkRRitAH
vimuktAH sarva evaite mahattvamupayAnti vai
shlokas.8:
Atmano mahato veda yaH puNyAM gatimuttamAm |
sa dhIraH sarvalokeShu na mohamadhigachChati
viShNurevAdisargeShu svayambhUrbhavati prabhuH
shlokas.9:
evaM hi yo veda guhAshayaM prabhuM; naraH purANaM puruShaM vishvarUpam |
hiraNmayaM buddhimatAM parAM gatiM; sa buddhimAnbuddhimatItya tiShThati

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
ya utpanno mahAnpUrvamaha~NkAraH sa uchyate |
ahamityeva sambhUto dvitIyaH sarga uchyate
shlokas.2:
aha~NkArashcha bhUtAdirvaikArika iti smRRitaH |
tejasashchetanA dhAtuH prajAsargaH prajApatiH
shlokas.3:
devAnAM prabhavo devo manasashcha trilokakRRit |
ahamityeva tatsarvamabhimantA sa uchyate
shlokas.4:
adhyAtmaj~nAnanityAnAM munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm |
svAdhyAyakratusiddhAnAmeSha lokaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.5:
aha~NkAreNAharato guNAnimA;nbhUtAdirevaM sRRijate sa bhUtakRRit |
vaikArikaH sarvamidaM vicheShTate; svatejasA ra~njayate jagattathA

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
aha~NkArAtprasUtAni mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha vai |
pRRithivI vAyurAkAshamApo jyotishcha pa~nchamam
shlokas.2:
teShu bhUtAni muhyante mahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu |
shabdasparshanarUpeShu rasagandhakriyAsu cha
shlokas.3:
mahAbhUtavinAshAnte pralaye pratyupasthite |
sarvaprANabhRRitAM dhIrA mahadutpadyate bhayam
shlokas.4:
yadyasmAjjAyate bhUtaM tatra tatpravilIyate |
lIyante pratilomAni jAyante chottarottaram
shlokas.5:
tataH pralIne sarvasminbhUte sthAvaraja~Ngame |
smRRitimantastadA dhIrA na lIyante kadAchana
shlokas.6:
shabdaH sparshastathA rUpaM raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH |
kriyAkAraNayuktAH syuranityA mohasa~nj~nitAH
shlokas.7:
lobhaprajanasa.nyuktA nirvisheShA hyaki~nchanAH |
mA.nsashoNitasa~NghAtA anyonyasyopajIvinaH
shlokas.8:
bahirAtmAna ityete dInAH kRRipaNavRRittayaH |
prANApAnAvudAnashcha samAno vyAna eva cha
shlokas.9:
antarAtmeti chApyete niyatAH pa~ncha vAyavaH |
vA~NmanobuddhirityebhiH sArdhamaShTAtmakaM jagat
shlokas.10:
tvagghrANashrotrachakShUMShi rasanaM vAkcha sa.nyatA |
vishuddhaM cha mano yasya buddhishchAvyabhichAriNI
shlokas.11:
aShTau yasyAgnayo hyete na dahante manaH sadA |
sa tadbrahma shubhaM yAti yasmAdbhUyo na vidyate
shlokas.12:
ekAdasha cha yAnyAhurindriyANi visheShataH |
aha~NkAraprasUtAni tAni vakShyAmyahaM dvijAH
shlokas.13:
shrotraM tvakchakShuShI jihvA nAsikA chaiva pa~nchamI |
pAdau pAyurupasthaM cha hastau vAgdashamI bhavet
shlokas.14:
indriyagrAma ityeSha mana ekAdashaM bhavet |
etaM grAmaM jayetpUrvaM tato brahma prakAshate
shlokas.15:
buddhIndriyANi pa~nchAhuH pa~ncha karmendriyANi cha |
shrotrAdInyapi pa~nchAhurbuddhiyuktAni tattvataH
shlokas.16:
avisheShANi chAnyAni karmayuktAni tAni tu |
ubhayatra mano j~neyaM buddhirdvAdashamI bhavet
shlokas.17:
ityuktAnIndriyANImAnyekAdasha mayA kramAt |
manyante kRRitamityeva viditvaitAni paNDitAH
shlokas.18:
trINi sthAnAni bhUtAnAM chaturthaM nopapadyate |
sthalamApastathAkAshaM janma chApi chaturvidham
shlokas.19:
aNDajodbhijjasa.nsvedajarAyujamathApi cha |
chaturdhA janma ityetadbhUtagrAmasya lakShyate
shlokas.20:
acharANyapi bhUtAni khecharANi tathaiva cha |
aNDajAni vijAnIyAtsarvA.nshchaiva sarIsRRipAn
shlokas.21:
sa.nsvedAH kRRimayaH proktA jantavashcha tathAvidhAH |
janma dvitIyamityetajjaghanyataramuchyate
shlokas.22:
bhittvA tu pRRithivIM yAni jAyante kAlaparyayAt |
udbhijjAnIti tAnyAhurbhUtAni dvijasattamAH
shlokas.23:
dvipAdabahupAdAni tiryaggatimatIni cha |
jarAyujAni bhUtAni vitta tAnyapi sattamAH
shlokas.24:
dvividhApIha vij~neyA brahmayoniH sanAtanA |
tapaH karma cha yatpuNyamityeSha viduShAM nayaH
shlokas.25:
dvividhaM karma vij~neyamijyA dAnaM cha yanmakhe |
jAtasyAdhyayanaM puNyamiti vRRiddhAnushAsanam
shlokas.26:
etadyo veda vidhivatsa muktaH syAddvijarShabhAH |
vimuktaH sarvapApebhya iti chaiva nibodhata
shlokas.27:
AkAshaM prathamaM bhUtaM shrotramadhyAtmamuchyate |
adhibhUtaM tathA shabdo dishastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.28:
dvitIyaM mAruto bhUtaM tvagadhyAtmaM cha vishrutam |
spraShTavyamadhibhUtaM cha vidyuttatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.29:
tRRitIyaM jyotirityAhushchakShuradhyAtmamuchyate |
adhibhUtaM tato rUpaM sUryastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.30:
chaturthamApo vij~neyaM jihvA chAdhyAtmamiShyate |
adhibhUtaM rasashchAtra somastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.31:
pRRithivI pa~nchamaM bhUtaM ghrANashchAdhyAtmamiShyate |
adhibhUtaM tathA gandho vAyustatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.32:
eSha pa~nchasu bhUteShu chatuShTayavidhiH smRRitaH |
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sarvaM trividhamindriyam
shlokas.33:
pAdAvadhyAtmamityAhurbrAhmaNAstattvadarshinaH |
adhibhUtaM tu gantavyaM viShNustatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.34:
avAggatirapAnashcha pAyuradhyAtmamiShyate |
adhibhUtaM visargashcha mitrastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.35:
prajanaH sarvabhUtAnAmupastho.adhyAtmamuchyate |
adhibhUtaM tathA shukraM daivataM cha prajApatiH
shlokas.36:
hastAvadhyAtmamityAhuradhyAtmaviduSho janAH |
adhibhUtaM tu karmANi shakrastatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.37:
vaishvadevI manaHpUrvA vAgadhyAtmamihochyate |
vaktavyamadhibhUtaM cha vahnistatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.38:
adhyAtmaM mana ityAhuH pa~nchabhUtAnuchArakam |
adhibhUtaM cha mantavyaM chandramAshchAdhidaivatam
shlokas.39:
adhyAtmaM buddhirityAhuH ShaDindriyavichAriNI |
adhibhUtaM tu vij~neyaM brahmA tatrAdhidaivatam
shlokas.40:
yathAvadadhyAtmavidhireSha vaH kIrtito mayA |
j~nAnamasya hi dharmaj~nAH prAptaM buddhimatAmiha
shlokas.41:
indriyANIndriyArthAshcha mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha cha |
sarvANyetAni sandhAya manasA sampradhArayet
shlokas.42:
kShINe manasi sarvasminna janmasukhamiShyate |
j~nAnasampannasattvAnAM tatsukhaM viduShAM matam
shlokas.43:
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sUkShmabhAvakarIM shivAm |
nivRRittiM sarvabhUteShu mRRidunA dAruNena vA
shlokas.45:
vidvAnkUrma ivA~NgAni kAmAnsaMhRRitya sarvashaH |
virajAH sarvato mukto yo naraH sa sukhI sadA
shlokas.46:
kAmAnAtmani sa.nyamya kShINatRRiShNaH samAhitaH |
sarvabhUtasuhRRinmaitro brahmabhUyaM sa gachChati
shlokas.47:
indriyANAM nirodhena sarveShAM viShayaiShiNAm |
munerjanapadatyAgAdadhyAtmAgniH samidhyate
shlokas.48:
yathAgnirindhanairiddho mahAjyotiH prakAshate |
tathendriyanirodhena mahAnAtmA prakAshate
shlokas.49:
yadA pashyati bhUtAni prasannAtmAtmano hRRidi |
svaya.nyonistadA sUkShmAtsUkShmamApnotyanuttamam
shlokas.50:
agnI rUpaM payaH sroto vAyuH sparshanameva cha |
mahI pa~NkadharaM ghoramAkAshaM shravaNaM tathA
shlokas.52:
rajasvalamathAdRRishyaM triguNaM cha tridhAtukam |
sa.nsargAbhirataM mUDhaM sharIramiti dhAraNA
shlokas.53:
dushcharaM jIvaloke.asminsattvaM prati samAshritam |
etadeva hi loke.asminkAlachakraM pravartate
shlokas.54:
etanmahArNavaM ghoramagAdhaM mohasa~nj~nitam |
visRRijetsa~NkShipechchaiva bodhayetsAmaraM jagat
shlokas.55:
kAmakrodhau bhayaM mohamabhidrohamathAnRRitam |
indriyANAM nirodhena sa tA.nstyajati dustyajAn
shlokas.56:
yasyaite nirjitA loke triguNAH pa~ncha dhAtavaH |
vyomni tasya paraM sthAnamanantamatha lakShyate
shlokas.57:
kAmakUlAmapArAntAM manaHsrotobhayAvahAm |
nadIM durgahradAM tIrNaH kAmakrodhAvubhau jayet
shlokas.58:
sa sarvadoShanirmuktastataH pashyati yatparam |
mano manasi sandhAya pashyatyAtmAnamAtmani
shlokas.59:
sarvavitsarvabhUteShu vIkShatyAtmAnamAtmani |
ekadhA bahudhA chaiva vikurvANastatastataH
shlokas.60:
dhruvaM pashyati rUpANi dIpAddIpashataM yathA |
sa vai viShNushcha mitrashcha varuNo.agniH prajApatiH
shlokas.61:
sa hi dhAtA vidhAtA cha sa prabhuH sarvatomukhaH |
hRRidayaM sarvabhUtAnAM mahAnAtmA prakAshate
shlokas.62:
taM viprasa~NghAshcha surAsurAshcha; yakShAH pishAchAH pitaro vayA.nsi |
rakShogaNA bhUtagaNAshcha sarve; maharShayashchaiva sadA stuvanti

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
manuShyANAM tu rAjanyaH kShatriyo madhyamo guNaH |
ku~njaro vAhanAnAM cha siMhashchAraNyavAsinAm
shlokas.2:
aviH pashUnAM sarveShAmAkhushcha bilavAsinAm |
gavAM govRRiShabhashchaiva strINAM puruSha eva cha
shlokas.3:
nyagrodho jambuvRRikShashcha pippalaH shAlmalistathA |
shi.nshapA meShashRRi~Ngashcha tathA kIchakaveNavaH
ete drumANAM rAjAno loke.asminnAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
himavAnpAriyAtrashcha sahyo vindhyastrikUTavAn |
shveto nIlashcha bhAsashcha kAShThavA.nshchaiva parvataH
shlokas.5:
shubhaskandho mahendrashcha mAlyavAnparvatastathA |
ete parvatarAjAno gaNAnAM marutastathA
shlokas.6:
sUryo grahANAmadhipo nakShatrANAM cha chandramAH |
yamaH pitR^INAmadhipaH saritAmatha sAgaraH
shlokas.7:
ambhasAM varuNo rAjA sattvAnAM mitra uchyate |
arko.adhipatiruShNAnAM jyotiShAminduruchyate
shlokas.8:
agnirbhUtapatirnityaM brAhmaNAnAM bRRihaspatiH |
oShadhInAM patiH somo viShNurbalavatAM varaH
shlokas.9:
tvaShTAdhirAjo rUpANAM pashUnAmIshvaraH shivaH |
dakShiNAnAM tathA yaj~no vedAnAmRRiShayastathA
shlokas.10:
dishAmudIchI viprANAM somo rAjA pratApavAn |
kuberaH sarvayakShANAM devatAnAM pura.ndaraH
eSha bhUtAdikaH sargaH prajAnAM cha prajApatiH
shlokas.11:
sarveShAmeva bhUtAnAmahaM brahmamayo mahAn |
bhUtaM parataraM matto viShNorvApi na vidyate
shlokas.12:
rAjAdhirAjaH sarvAsAM viShNurbrahmamayo mahAn |
IshvaraM taM vijAnImaH sa vibhuH sa prajApatiH
shlokas.13:
narakiMnarayakShANAM gandharvoragarakShasAm |
devadAnavanAgAnAM sarveShAmIshvaro hi saH
shlokas.14:
bhagadevAnuyAtAnAM sarvAsAM vAmalochanA |
mAheshvarI mahAdevI prochyate pArvatIti yA
shlokas.15:
umAM devIM vijAnIta nArINAmuttamAM shubhAm |
ratInAM vasumatyastu strINAmapsarasastathA
shlokas.16:
dharmakAmAshcha rAjAno brAhmaNA dharmalakShaNAH |
tasmAdrAjA dvijAtInAM prayateteha rakShaNe
shlokas.17:
rAj~nAM hi viShaye yeShAmavasIdanti sAdhavaH |
hInAste svaguNaiH sarvaiH pretyAvA~NmArgagAminaH
shlokas.18:
rAj~nAM tu viShaye yeShAM sAdhavaH parirakShitAH |
te.asmi.Nlloke pramodante pretya chAnantyameva cha
prApnuvanti mahAtmAna iti vitta dvijarShabhAH
shlokas.19:
ata UrdhvaM pravakShyAmi niyataM dharmalakShaNam |
ahi.nsAlakShaNo dharmo hi.nsA chAdharmalakShaNA
shlokas.20:
prakAshalakShaNA devA manuShyAH karmalakShaNAH |
shabdalakShaNamAkAshaM vAyustu sparshalakShaNaH
shlokas.21:
jyotiShAM lakShaNaM rUpamApashcha rasalakShaNAH |
dharaNI sarvabhUtAnAM pRRithivI gandhalakShaNA
shlokas.22:
svaravya~njanasa.nskArA bhAratI satyalakShaNA |
manaso lakShaNaM chintA tathoktA buddhiranvayAt
shlokas.23:
manasA chintayAno.arthAnbuddhyA chaiva vyavasyati |
buddhirhi vyavasAyena lakShyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
lakShaNaM mahato dhyAnamavyaktaM sAdhulakShaNam |
pravRRittilakShaNo yogo j~nAnaM saMnyAsalakShaNam
shlokas.25:
tasmAjj~nAnaM puraskRRitya saMnyasediha buddhimAn |
saMnyAsI j~nAnasa.nyuktaH prApnoti paramAM gatim
atIto.adva.ndvamabhyeti tamomRRityujarAtigam
shlokas.26:
dharmalakShaNasa.nyuktamuktaM vo vidhivanmayA |
guNAnAM grahaNaM samyagvakShyAmyahamataH param
shlokas.27:
pArthivo yastu gandho vai ghrANeneha sa gRRihyate |
ghrANasthashcha tathA vAyurgandhaj~nAne vidhIyate
shlokas.28:
apAM dhAturaso nityaM jihvayA sa tu gRRihyate |
jihvAsthashcha tathA somo rasaj~nAne vidhIyate
shlokas.29:
jyotiShashcha guNo rUpaM chakShuShA tachcha gRRihyate |
chakShuHsthashcha tathAdityo rUpaj~nAne vidhIyate
shlokas.30:
vAyavyastu tathA sparshastvachA praj~nAyate cha saH |
tvaksthashchaiva tathA vAyuH sparshaj~nAne vidhIyate
shlokas.31:
AkAshasya guNo ghoShaH shrotreNa sa tu gRRihyate |
shrotrasthAshcha dishaH sarvAH shabdaj~nAne prakIrtitAH
shlokas.32:
manasastu guNashchintA praj~nayA sa tu gRRihyate |
hRRidisthachetanAdhAturmanoj~nAne vidhIyate
shlokas.33:
buddhiradhyavasAyena dhyAnena cha mahA.nstathA |
nishchitya grahaNaM nityamavyaktaM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.34:
ali~NgagrahaNo nityaH kShetraj~no nirguNAtmakaH |
tasmAdali~NgaH kShetraj~naH kevalaM j~nAnalakShaNaH
shlokas.35:
avyaktaM kShetramuddiShTaM guNAnAM prabhavApyayam |
sadA pashyAmyahaM lInaM vijAnAmi shRRiNomi cha
shlokas.36:
puruShastadvijAnIte tasmAtkShetraj~na uchyate |
guNavRRittaM tathA kRRitsnaM kShetraj~naH paripashyati
shlokas.37:
AdimadhyAvasAnAntaM sRRijyamAnamachetanam |
na guNA vidurAtmAnaM sRRijyamAnaM punaH punaH
shlokas.38:
na satyaM veda vai kashchitkShetraj~nastveva vindati |
guNAnAM guNabhUtAnAM yatparaM parato mahat
shlokas.39:
tasmAdguNA.nshcha tattvaM cha parityajyeha tattvavit |
kShINadoSho guNAnhitvA kShetraj~naM pravishatyatha
shlokas.40:
nirdva.ndvo nirnamaskAro niHsvadhAkAra eva cha |
achalashchAniketashcha kShetraj~naH sa paro vibhuH

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
yadAdimadhyaparyantaM grahaNopAyameva cha |
nAmalakShaNasa.nyuktaM sarvaM vakShyAmi tattvataH
shlokas.2:
ahaH pUrvaM tato rAtrirmAsAH shuklAdayaH smRRitAH |
shraviShThAdIni RRikShANi RRitavaH shishirAdayaH
shlokas.3:
bhUmirAdistu gandhAnAM rasAnAmApa eva cha |
rUpANAM jyotirAdistu sparshAdirvAyuruchyate
shabdasyAdistathAkAshameSha bhUtakRRito guNaH
shlokas.4:
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi bhUtAnAmAdimuttamam |
Adityo jyotiShAmAdiragnirbhUtAdiriShyate
shlokas.5:
sAvitrI sarvavidyAnAM devatAnAM prajApatiH |
o~NkAraH sarvavedAnAM vachasAM prANa eva cha
yadyasminniyataM loke sarvaM sAvitramuchyate
shlokas.6:
gAyatrI ChandasAmAdiH pashUnAmaja uchyate |
gAvashchatuShpadAmAdirmanuShyANAM dvijAtayaH
shlokas.7:
shyenaH patatriNAmAdiryaj~nAnAM hutamuttamam |
parisarpiNAM tu sarveShAM jyeShThaH sarpo dvijottamAH
shlokas.8:
kRRitamAdiryugAnAM cha sarveShAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
hiraNyaM sarvaratnAnAmoShadhInAM yavAstathA
shlokas.9:
sarveShAM bhakShyabhojyAnAmannaM paramamuchyate |
dravANAM chaiva sarveShAM peyAnAmApa uttamAH
shlokas.10:
sthAvarANAM cha bhUtAnAM sarveShAmavisheShataH |
brahmakShetraM sadA puNyaM plakShaH prathamajaH smRRitaH
shlokas.11:
ahaM prajApatInAM cha sarveShAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
mama viShNurachintyAtmA svayambhUriti sa smRRitaH
shlokas.12:
parvatAnAM mahAmeruH sarveShAmagrajaH smRRitaH |
dishAM cha pradishAM chordhvA digjAtA prathamaM tathA
shlokas.13:
tathA tripathagA ga~NgA nadInAmagrajA smRRitA |
tathA sarodapAnAnAM sarveShAM sAgaro.agrajaH
shlokas.14:
devadAnavabhUtAnAM pishAchoragarakShasAm |
narakiMnarayakShANAM sarveShAmIshvaraH prabhuH
shlokas.15:
Adirvishvasya jagato viShNurbrahmamayo mahAn |
bhUtaM parataraM tasmAttrailokye neha vidyate
shlokas.16:
AshramANAM cha gArhasthyaM sarveShAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
lokAnAmAdiravyaktaM sarvasyAntastadeva cha
shlokas.17:
ahAnyastamayAntAni udayAntA cha sharvarI |
sukhasyAntaH sadA duHkhaM duHkhasyAntaH sadA sukham
shlokas.18:
sarve kShayAntA nichayAH patanAntAH samuchChrayAH |
sa.nyogA viprayogAntA maraNAntaM hi jIvitam
shlokas.19:
sarvaM kRRitaM vinAshAntaM jAtasya maraNaM dhruvam |
ashAshvataM hi loke.asminsarvaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam
shlokas.20:
iShTaM dattaM tapo.adhItaM vratAni niyamAshcha ye |
sarvametadvinAshAntaM j~nAnasyAnto na vidyate
shlokas.21:
tasmAjj~nAnena shuddhena prasannAtmA samAhitaH |
nirmamo niraha~NkAro muchyate sarvapApmabhiH

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
buddhisAraM manastambhamindriyagrAmabandhanam |
mahAbhUtAraviShkambhaM nimeShapariveShTanam
shlokas.2:
jarAshokasamAviShTaM vyAdhivyasanasa~ncharam |
deshakAlavichArIdaM shramavyAyAmanisvanam
shlokas.3:
ahorAtraparikShepaM shItoShNaparimaNDalam |
sukhaduHkhAntasa~NkleshaM kShutpipAsAvakIlanam
shlokas.4:
ChAyAtapavilekhaM cha nimeShonmeShavihvalam |
ghoramohajanAkIrNaM vartamAnamachetanam
shlokas.5:
mAsArdhamAsagaNitaM viShamaM lokasa~ncharam |
tamonichayapa~NkaM cha rajovegapravartakam
shlokas.6:
sattvAla~NkAradIptaM cha guNasa~NghAtamaNDalam |
svaravigrahanAbhIkaM shokasa~NghAtavartanam
shlokas.7:
kriyAkAraNasa.nyuktaM rAgavistAramAyatam |
lobhepsAparisa~NkhyAtaM viviktaj~nAnasambhavam
shlokas.8:
bhayamohaparIvAraM bhUtasaMmohakArakam |
AnandaprItidhAraM cha kAmakrodhaparigraham
shlokas.9:
mahadAdivisheShAntamasaktaprabhavAvyayam |
manojavanamashrAntaM kAlachakraM pravartate
shlokas.10:
etaddva.ndvasamAyuktaM kAlachakramachetanam |
visRRijetsa~NkShipechchApi bodhayetsAmaraM jagat
shlokas.11:
kAlachakrapravRRittiM cha nivRRittiM chaiva tattvataH |
yastu veda naro nityaM na sa bhUteShu muhyati
shlokas.12:
vimuktaH sarvasa~NkleshaiH sarvadva.ndvAtigo muniH |
vimuktaH sarvapApebhyaH prApnoti paramAM gatim
shlokas.13:
gRRihastho brahmachArI cha vAnaprastho.atha bhikShukaH |
chatvAra AshramAH proktAH sarve gArhasthyamUlakAH
shlokas.14:
yaH kashchidiha loke cha hyAgamaH samprakIrtitaH |
tasyAntagamanaM shreyaH kIrtireShA sanAtanI
shlokas.15:
sa.nskAraiH sa.nskRRitaH pUrvaM yathAvachcharitavrataH |
jAtau guNavishiShTAyAM samAvarteta vedavit
shlokas.16:
svadAranirato dAntaH shiShTAchAro jitendriyaH |
pa~nchabhishcha mahAyaj~naiH shraddadhAno yajeta ha
shlokas.17:
devatAtithishiShTAshI nirato vedakarmasu |
ijyApradAnayuktashcha yathAshakti yathAvidhi
shlokas.18:
na pANipAdachapalo na netrachapalo muniH |
na cha vAga~Ngachapala iti shiShTasya gocharaH
shlokas.19:
nityayaj~nopavItI syAchChuklavAsAH shuchivrataH |
niyato damadAnAbhyAM sadA shiShTaishcha sa.nvishet
shlokas.20:
jitashishnodaro maitraH shiShTAchArasamAhitaH |
vaiNavIM dhArayedyaShTiM sodakaM cha kamaNDalum
shlokas.21:
adhItyAdhyApanaM kuryAttathA yajanayAjane |
dAnaM pratigrahaM chaiva ShaDguNAM vRRittimAcharet
shlokas.22:
trINi karmANi yAnIha brAhmaNAnAM tu jIvikA |
yAjanAdhyApane chobhe shuddhAchchApi pratigrahaH
shlokas.23:
avasheShANi chAnyAni trINi karmANi yAni tu |
dAnamadhyayanaM yaj~no dharmayuktAni tAni tu
shlokas.24:
teShvapramAdaM kurvIta triShu karmasu dharmavit |
dAnto maitraH kShamAyuktaH sarvabhUtasamo muniH
shlokas.25:
sarvametadyathAshakti vipro nirvartaya~nshuchiH |
evaM yukto jayetsvargaM gRRihasthaH sa.nshitavrataH

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
evametena mArgeNa pUrvoktena yathAvidhi |
adhItavAnyathAshakti tathaiva brahmacharyavAn
shlokas.2:
svadharmanirato vidvAnsarvendriyayato muniH |
guroH priyahite yuktaH satyadharmaparaH shuchiH
shlokas.3:
guruNA samanuj~nAto bhu~njItAnnamakutsayan |
haviShyabhaikShyabhukchApi sthAnAsanavihAravAn
shlokas.4:
dvikAlamagniM juhvAnaH shuchirbhUtvA samAhitaH |
dhArayIta sadA daNDaM bailvaM pAlAshameva vA
shlokas.5:
kShaumaM kArpAsikaM vApi mRRigAjinamathApi vA |
sarvaM kAShAyaraktaM syAdvAso vApi dvijasya ha
shlokas.6:
mekhalA cha bhavenmau~njI jaTI nityodakastathA |
yaj~nopavItI svAdhyAyI aluptaniyatavrataH
shlokas.7:
pUtAbhishcha tathaivAdbhiH sadA daivatatarpaNam |
bhAvena niyataH kurvanbrahmachArI prashasyate
shlokas.8:
evaM yukto jayetsvargamUrdhvaretAH samAhitaH |
na sa.nsarati jAtIShu paramaM sthAnamAshritaH
shlokas.9:
sa.nskRRitaH sarvasa.nskAraistathaiva brahmacharyavAn |
grAmAnniShkramya chAraNyaM muniH pravrajito vaset
shlokas.10:
charmavalkalasa.nvItaH svayaM prAtarupaspRRishet |
araNyagocharo nityaM na grAmaM pravishetpunaH
shlokas.11:
archayannatithInkAle dadyAchchApi pratishrayam |
phalapatrAvarairmUlaiH shyAmAkena cha vartayan
shlokas.12:
pravRRittamudakaM vAyuM sarvaM vAneyamA tRRiNAt |
prAshnIyAdAnupUrvyeNa yathAdIkShamatandritaH
shlokas.13:
AmUlaphalabhikShAbhirarchedatithimAgatam |
yadbhakShaH syAttato dadyAdbhikShAM nityamatandritaH
shlokas.14:
devatAtithipUrvaM cha sadA bhu~njIta vAgyataH |
askanditamanAshchaiva laghvAshI devatAshrayaH
shlokas.15:
dAnto maitraH kShamAyuktaH keshashmashru cha dhArayan |
juhvansvAdhyAyashIlashcha satyadharmaparAyaNaH
shlokas.16:
tyaktadehaH sadA dakSho vananityaH samAhitaH |
evaM yukto jayetsvargaM vAnaprastho jitendriyaH
shlokas.17:
gRRihastho brahmachArI cha vAnaprastho.atha vA punaH |
ya ichChenmokShamAsthAtumuttamAM vRRittimAshrayet
shlokas.18:
abhayaM sarvabhUtebhyo dattvA naiShkarmyamAcharet |
sarvabhUtahito maitraH sarvendriyayato muniH
shlokas.19:
ayAchitamasa~NkL^iptamupapannaM yadRRichChayA |
joShayeta sadA bhojyaM grAsamAgatamaspRRihaH
shlokas.20:
yAtrAmAtraM cha bhu~njIta kevalaM prANayAtrikam |
dharmalabdhaM tathAshnIyAnna kAmamanuvartayet
shlokas.21:
grAsAdAchChAdanAchchAnyanna gRRihNIyAtkatha~nchana |
yAvadAhArayettAvatpratigRRihNIta nAnyathA
shlokas.22:
parebhyo na pratigrAhyaM na cha deyaM kadAchana |
dainyabhAvAchcha bhUtAnAM sa.nvibhajya sadA budhaH
shlokas.23:
nAdadIta parasvAni na gRRihNIyAdayAchitam |
na ki~nchidviShayaM bhuktvA spRRihayettasya vai punaH
shlokas.24:
mRRidamApastathAshmAnaM patrapuShpaphalAni cha |
asa.nvRRitAni gRRihNIyAtpravRRittAnIha kAryavAn
shlokas.25:
na shilpajIvikAM jIveddvirannaM nota kAmayet |
na dveShTA nopadeShTA cha bhaveta nirupaskRRitaH
shraddhApUtAni bhu~njIta nimittAni vivarjayet
shlokas.26:
mudhAvRRittirasaktashcha sarvabhUtairasa.nvidam |
kRRitvA vahniM charedbhaikShyaM vidhUme bhuktavajjane
shlokas.27:
vRRitte sharAvasampAte bhaikShyaM lipseta mokShavit |
lAbhe na cha prahRRiShyeta nAlAbhe vimanA bhavet
shlokas.28:
mAtrAshI kAlamAkA~NkSha.nshcharedbhaikShyaM samAhitaH |
lAbhaM sAdhAraNaM nechChenna bhu~njItAbhipUjitaH
abhipUjitalAbhAddhi vijugupseta bhikShukaH
shlokas.29:
shuktAnyamlAni tiktAni kaShAyakaTukAni cha |
nAsvAdayIta bhu~njAno rasA.nshcha madhurA.nstathA
yAtrAmAtraM cha bhu~njIta kevalaM prANayAtrikam
shlokas.30:
asa.nrodhena bhUtAnAM vRRittiM lipseta mokShavit |
na chAnyamanubhikSheta bhikShamANaH katha~nchana
shlokas.31:
na saMnikAshayeddharmaM vivikte virajAshcharet |
shUnyAgAramaraNyaM vA vRRikShamUlaM nadIM tathA
pratishrayArthaM seveta pArvatIM vA punarguhAm
shlokas.32:
grAmaikarAtriko grIShme varShAsvekatra vA vaset |
adhvA sUryeNa nirdiShTaH kITavachcha charenmahIm
shlokas.33:
dayArthaM chaiva bhUtAnAM samIkShya pRRithivIM charet |
sa~nchayA.nshcha na kurvIta snehavAsaM cha varjayet
shlokas.34:
pUtena chAmbhasA nityaM kAryaM kurvIta mokShavit |
upaspRRisheduddhRRitAbhiradbhishcha puruShaH sadA
shlokas.35:
ahi.nsA brahmacharyaM cha satyamArjavameva cha |
akrodhashchAnasUyA cha damo nityamapaishunam
shlokas.36:
aShTAsveteShu yuktaH syAdvrateShu niyatendriyaH |
apApamashaThaM vRRittamajihmaM nityamAcharet
shlokas.37:
AshIryuktAni karmANi hi.nsAyuktAni yAni cha |
lokasa~NgrahadharmaM cha naiva kuryAnna kArayet
shlokas.38:
sarvabhAvAnatikramya laghumAtraH parivrajet |
samaH sarveShu bhUteShu sthAvareShu chareShu cha
shlokas.39:
paraM nodvejayetka~nchinna cha kasyachidudvijet |
vishvAsyaH sarvabhUtAnAmagryo mokShaviduchyate
shlokas.40:
anAgataM cha na dhyAyennAtItamanuchintayet |
vartamAnamupekSheta kAlAkA~NkShI samAhitaH
shlokas.41:
na chakShuShA na manasA na vAchA dUShayetkvachit |
na pratyakShaM parokShaM vA ki~nchidduShTaM samAcharet
shlokas.43:
nirdva.ndvo nirnamaskAro niHsvAhAkAra eva cha |
nirmamo niraha~NkAro niryogakShema eva cha
shlokas.44:
nirAshIH sarvabhUteShu nirAsa~Ngo nirAshrayaH |
sarvaj~naH sarvato mukto muchyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.45:
apANipAdapRRiShThaM tamashiraskamanUdaram |
prahINaguNakarmANaM kevalaM vimalaM sthiram
shlokas.46:
agandharasamasparshamarUpAshabdameva cha |
atvagasthyatha vAmajjamamA.nsamapi chaiva ha
shlokas.47:
nishchintamavyayaM nityaM hRRidisthamapi nityadA |
sarvabhUtasthamAtmAnaM ye pashyanti na te mRRitAH
shlokas.48:
na tatra kramate buddhirnendriyANi na devatAH |
vedA yaj~nAshcha lokAshcha na tapo na parAkramaH
yatra j~nAnavatAM prAptirali~NgagrahaNA smRRitA
shlokas.49:
tasmAdali~Ngo dharmaj~no dharmavratamanuvrataH |
gUDhadharmAshrito vidvAnaj~nAtacharitaM charet
shlokas.50:
amUDho mUDharUpeNa chareddharmamadUShayan |
yathainamavamanyeranpare satatameva hi
shlokas.51:
tathAvRRittashchareddharmaM satAM vartmAvidUShayan |
yo hyevaM vRRittasampannaH sa muniH shreShTha uchyate
shlokas.52:
indriyANIndriyArthA.nshcha mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha cha |
manobuddhirathAtmAnamavyaktaM puruShaM tathA
shlokas.53:
sarvametatprasa~NkhyAya samyaksantyajya nirmalaH |
tataH svargamavApnoti vimuktaH sarvabandhanaiH
shlokas.54:
etadevAntavelAyAM parisa~NkhyAya tattvavit |
dhyAyedekAntamAsthAya muchyate.atha nirAshrayaH
shlokas.55:
nirmuktaH sarvasa~Ngebhyo vAyurAkAshago yathA |
kShINakosho nirAta~NkaH prApnoti paramaM padam

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
saMnyAsaM tapa ityAhurvRRiddhA nishchitadarshinaH |
brAhmaNA brahmayonisthA j~nAnaM brahma paraM viduH
shlokas.2:
avidUrAtparaM brahma vedavidyAvyapAshrayam |
nirdva.ndvaM nirguNaM nityamachintyaM guhyamuttamam
shlokas.3:
j~nAnena tapasA chaiva dhIrAH pashyanti tatpadam |
nirNiktatamasaH pUtA vyutkrAntarajaso.amalAH
shlokas.4:
tapasA kShemamadhvAnaM gachChanti paramaiShiNaH |
saMnyAsaniratA nityaM ye brahmaviduSho janAH
shlokas.5:
tapaH pradIpa ityAhurAchAro dharmasAdhakaH |
j~nAnaM tveva paraM vidma saMnyAsastapa uttamam
shlokas.6:
yastu veda nirAbAdhaM j~nAnaM tattvavinishchayAt |
sarvabhUtasthamAtmAnaM sa sarvagatiriShyate
shlokas.7:
yo vidvAnsahavAsaM cha vivAsaM chaiva pashyati |
tathaivaikatvanAnAtve sa duHkhAtparimuchyate
shlokas.8:
yo na kAmayate ki~nchinna ki~nchidavamanyate |
ihalokastha evaiSha brahmabhUyAya kalpate
shlokas.9:
pradhAnaguNatattvaj~naH sarvabhUtavidhAnavit |
nirmamo niraha~NkAro muchyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
nirdva.ndvo nirnamaskAro niHsvadhAkAra eva cha |
nirguNaM nityamadva.ndvaM prashamenaiva gachChati
shlokas.11:
hitvA guNamayaM sarvaM karma jantuH shubhAshubham |
ubhe satyAnRRite hitvA muchyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.12:
avyaktabIjaprabhavo buddhiskandhamayo mahAn |
mahAha~NkAraviTapa indriyAntarakoTaraH
shlokas.13:
mahAbhUtavishAkhashcha visheShapratishAkhavAn |
sadAparNaH sadApuShpaH shubhAshubhaphalodayaH
AjIvaH sarvabhUtAnAM brahmavRRikShaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.14:
etachChittvA cha bhittvA cha j~nAnena paramAsinA |
hitvA chAmaratAM prApya jahyAdvai mRRityujanmanI
nirmamo niraha~NkAro muchyate nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.15:
dvAvetau pakShiNau nityau sakhAyau chApyachetanau |
etAbhyAM tu paro yasya chetanAvAniti smRRitaH
shlokas.16:
achetanaH sattvasa~NghAtayuktaH; sattvAtparaM chetayate.antarAtmA |
sa kShetraj~naH sattvasa~NghAtabuddhi;rguNAtigo muchyate mRRityupAshAt

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
kechidbrahmamayaM vRRikShaM kechidbrahmamayaM mahat |
kechitpuruShamavyaktaM kechitparamanAmayam
manyante sarvamapyetadavyaktaprabhavAvyayam
shlokas.2:
uchChvAsamAtramapi chedyo.antakAle samo bhavet |
AtmAnamupasa~Ngamya so.amRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.3:
nimeShamAtramapi chetsa.nyamyAtmAnamAtmani |
gachChatyAtmaprasAdena viduShAM prAptimavyayAm
shlokas.4:
prANAyAmairatha prANAnsa.nyamya sa punaH punaH |
dashadvAdashabhirvApi chaturvi.nshAtparaM tataH
shlokas.5:
evaM pUrvaM prasannAtmA labhate yadyadichChati |
avyaktAtsattvamudriktamamRRitatvAya kalpate
shlokas.6:
sattvAtparataraM nAnyatprasha.nsantIha tadvidaH |
anumAnAdvijAnImaH puruShaM sattvasa.nshrayam
na shakyamanyathA gantuM puruShaM tamatho dvijAH
shlokas.7:
kShamA dhRRitirahi.nsA cha samatA satyamArjavam |
j~nAnaM tyAgo.atha saMnyAsaH sAttvikaM vRRittamiShyate
shlokas.8:
etenaivAnumAnena manyante.atha manIShiNaH |
sattvaM cha puruShashchaikastatra nAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.9:
Ahureke cha vidvA.nso ye j~nAne supratiShThitAH |
kShetraj~nasattvayoraikyamityetannopapadyate
shlokas.10:
pRRithagbhUtastato nityamityetadavichAritam |
pRRithagbhAvashcha vij~neyaH sahajashchApi tattvataH
shlokas.11:
tathaivaikatvanAnAtvamiShyate viduShAM nayaH |
mashakodumbare tvaikyaM pRRithaktvamapi dRRishyate
shlokas.12:
matsyo yathAnyaH syAdapsu samprayogastathAnayoH |
sambandhastoyabindUnAM parNe kokanadasya cha
shlokas.13:
gururuvAcha||
ityuktavantaM te viprAstadA lokapitAmaham |
punaH sa.nshayamApannAH paprachChurdvijasattamAH
shlokas.14:
RRiShaya UchuH||
kiM svideveha dharmANAmanuShTheyatamaM smRRitam |
vyAhatAmiva pashyAmo dharmasya vividhAM gatim
shlokas.15:
UrdhvaM dehAdvadantyeke naitadastIti chApare |
kechitsa.nshayitaM sarvaM niHsa.nshayamathApare
shlokas.16:
anityaM nityamityeke nAstyastItyapi chApare |
ekarUpaM dvidhetyeke vyAmishramiti chApare
ekameke pRRithakchAnye bahutvamiti chApare
shlokas.17:
manyante brAhmaNA evaM prAj~nAstattvArthadarshinaH |
jaTAjinadharAshchAnye muNDAH kechidasa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.18:
asnAnaM kechidichChanti snAnamityapi chApare |
AhAraM kechidichChanti kechichchAnashane ratAH
shlokas.19:
karma kechitprasha.nsanti prashAntimapi chApare |
deshakAlAvubhau kechinnaitadastIti chApare
kechinmokShaM prasha.nsanti kechidbhogAnpRRithagvidhAn
shlokas.20:
dhanAni kechidichChanti nirdhanatvaM tathApare |
upAsyasAdhanaM tveke naitadastIti chApare
shlokas.21:
ahi.nsAniratAshchAnye kechiddhi.nsAparAyaNAH |
puNyena yashasetyeke naitadastIti chApare
shlokas.22:
sadbhAvaniratAshchAnye kechitsa.nshayite sthitAH |
duHkhAdanye sukhAdanye dhyAnamityapare sthitAH
shlokas.23:
yaj~namityapare dhIrAH pradAnamiti chApare |
sarvameke prasha.nsanti na sarvamiti chApare
shlokas.24:
tapastvanye prasha.nsanti svAdhyAyamapare janAH |
j~nAnaM saMnyAsamityeke svabhAvaM bhUtachintakAH
shlokas.25:
evaM vyutthApite dharme bahudhA vipradhAvati |
nishchayaM nAdhigachChAmaH saMmUDhAH surasattama
shlokas.26:
idaM shreya idaM shreya ityevaM prasthito janaH |
yo hi yasminrato dharme sa taM pUjayate sadA
shlokas.27:
tatra no vihatA praj~nA manashcha bahulIkRRitam |
etadAkhyAtumichChAmaH shreyaH kimiti sattama
shlokas.28:
ataH paraM cha yadguhyaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati |
sattvakShetraj~nayoshchaiva sambandhaH kena hetunA
shlokas.29:
evamuktaH sa tairviprairbhagavA.NllokabhAvanaH |
tebhyaH shasha.nsa dharmAtmA yAthAtathyena buddhimAn

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
hanta vaH sampravakShyAmi yanmAM pRRichChatha sattamAH |
samastamiha tachChrutvA samyagevAvadhAryatAm
shlokas.2:
ahi.nsA sarvabhUtAnAmetatkRRityatamaM matam |
etatpadamanudvignaM variShThaM dharmalakShaNam
shlokas.3:
j~nAnaM niHshreya ityAhurvRRiddhA nishchayadarshinaH |
tasmAjj~nAnena shuddhena muchyate sarvapAtakaiH
shlokas.4:
hi.nsAparAshcha ye loke ye cha nAstikavRRittayaH |
lobhamohasamAyuktAste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.5:
AshIryuktAni karmANi kurvate ye tvatandritAH |
te.asmi.Nlloke pramodante jAyamAnAH punaH punaH
shlokas.6:
kurvate ye tu karmANi shraddadhAnA vipashchitaH |
anAshIryogasa.nyuktAste dhIrAH sAdhudarshinaH
shlokas.7:
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi sattvakShetraj~nayoryathA |
sa.nyogo viprayogashcha tannibodhata sattamAH
shlokas.8:
viShayo viShayitvaM cha sambandho.ayamihochyate |
viShayI puruSho nityaM sattvaM cha viShayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.9:
vyAkhyAtaM pUrvakalpena mashakodumbaraM yathA |
bhujyamAnaM na jAnIte nityaM sattvamachetanam
yastveva tu vijAnIte yo bhu~Nkte yashcha bhujyate
shlokas.10:
anityaM dva.ndvasa.nyuktaM sattvamAhurguNAtmakam |
nirdva.ndvo niShkalo nityaH kShetraj~no nirguNAtmakaH
shlokas.11:
samaH sa~nj~nAgatastvevaM yadA sarvatra dRRishyate |
upabhu~Nkte sadA sattvamApaH puShkaraparNavat
shlokas.12:
sarvairapi guNairvidvAnvyatiShakto na lipyate |
jalabinduryathA lolaH padminIpatrasa.nsthitaH
evamevApyasa.nsaktaH puruShaH syAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
dravyamAtramabhUtsattvaM puruShasyeti nishchayaH |
yathA dravyaM cha kartA cha sa.nyogo.apyanayostathA
shlokas.14:
yathA pradIpamAdAya kashchittamasi gachChati |
tathA sattvapradIpena gachChanti paramaiShiNaH
shlokas.15:
yAvaddravyaguNastAvatpradIpaH samprakAshate |
kShINadravyaguNaM jyotirantardhAnAya gachChati
shlokas.16:
vyaktaH sattvaguNastvevaM puruSho.avyakta iShyate |
etadviprA vijAnIta hanta bhUyo bravImi vaH
shlokas.17:
sahasreNApi durmedhA na vRRiddhimadhigachChati |
chaturthenApyathA.nshena buddhimAnsukhamedhate
shlokas.18:
evaM dharmasya vij~neyaM sa.nsAdhanamupAyataH |
upAyaj~no hi medhAvI sukhamatyantamashnute
shlokas.19:
yathAdhvAnamapAtheyaH prapanno mAnavaH kvachit |
kleshena yAti mahatA vinashyatyantarApi vA
shlokas.20:
tathA karmasu vij~neyaM phalaM bhavati vA na vA |
puruShasyAtmaniHshreyaH shubhAshubhanidarshanam
shlokas.21:
yathA cha dIrghamadhvAnaM padbhyAmeva prapadyate |
adRRiShTapUrvaM sahasA tattvadarshanavarjitaH
shlokas.22:
tameva cha yathAdhvAnaM rathenehAshugAminA |
yAyAdashvaprayuktena tathA buddhimatAM gatiH
shlokas.23:
uchchaM parvatamAruhya nAnvavekSheta bhUgatam |
rathena rathinaM pashyetklishyamAnamachetanam
shlokas.24:
yAvadrathapathastAvadrathena sa tu gachChati |
kShINe rathapathe prAj~no rathamutsRRijya gachChati
shlokas.25:
evaM gachChati medhAvI tattvayogavidhAnavit |
samAj~nAya mahAbuddhiruttarAduttarottaram
shlokas.26:
yathA mahArNavaM ghoramaplavaH sampragAhate |
bAhubhyAmeva saMmohAdvadhaM charchChatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.27:
nAvA chApi yathA prAj~no vibhAgaj~nastaritrayA |
aklAntaH salilaM gAhetkShipraM santarati dhruvam
shlokas.28:
tIrNo gachChetparaM pAraM nAvamutsRRijya nirmamaH |
vyAkhyAtaM pUrvakalpena yathA rathipadAtinau
shlokas.29:
snehAtsaMmohamApanno nAvi dAsho yathA tathA |
mamatvenAbhibhUtaH sa tatraiva parivartate
shlokas.30:
nAvaM na shakyamAruhya sthale viparivartitum |
tathaiva rathamAruhya nApsu charyA vidhIyate
shlokas.31:
evaM karma kRRitaM chitraM viShayasthaM pRRithakpRRithak |
yathA karma kRRitaM loke tathA tadupapadyate
shlokas.32:
yannaiva gandhino rasyaM na rUpasparshashabdavat |
manyante munayo buddhyA tatpradhAnaM prachakShate
shlokas.33:
tatra pradhAnamavyaktamavyaktasya guNo mahAn |
mahataH pradhAnabhUtasya guNo.aha~NkAra eva cha
shlokas.34:
aha~NkArapradhAnasya mahAbhUtakRRito guNaH |
pRRithaktvena hi bhUtAnAM viShayA vai guNAH smRRitAH
shlokas.35:
bIjadharmaM yathAvyaktaM tathaiva prasavAtmakam |
bIjadharmA mahAnAtmA prasavashcheti naH shrutam
shlokas.36:
bIjadharmA tvaha~NkAraH prasavashcha punaH punaH |
bIjaprasavadharmANi mahAbhUtAni pa~ncha vai
shlokas.37:
bIjadharmiNa ityAhuH prasavaM cha na kurvate |
visheShAH pa~nchabhUtAnAM teShAM vittaM visheShaNam
shlokas.38:
tatraikaguNamAkAshaM dviguNo vAyuruchyate |
triguNaM jyotirityAhurApashchApi chaturguNAH
shlokas.39:
pRRithvI pa~nchaguNA j~neyA trasasthAvarasa~NkulA |
sarvabhUtakarI devI shubhAshubhanidarshanA
shlokas.40:
shabdaH sparshastathA rUpaM raso gandhashcha pa~nchamaH |
ete pa~ncha guNA bhUmervij~neyA dvijasattamAH
shlokas.41:
pArthivashcha sadA gandho gandhashcha bahudhA smRRitaH |
tasya gandhasya vakShyAmi vistareNa bahUnguNAn
shlokas.42:
iShTashchAniShTagandhashcha madhuro.amlaH kaTustathA |
nirhArI saMhataH snigdho rUkSho vishada eva cha
evaM dashavidho j~neyaH pArthivo gandha ityuta
shlokas.43:
shabdaH sparshastathA rUpaM rasashchApAM guNAH smRRitAH |
rasaj~nAnaM tu vakShyAmi rasastu bahudhA smRRitaH
shlokas.44:
madhuro.amlaH kaTustiktaH kaShAyo lavaNastathA |
evaM ShaDvidhavistAro raso vArimayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.45:
shabdaH sparshastathA rUpaM triguNaM jyotiruchyate |
jyotiShashcha guNo rUpaM rUpaM cha bahudhA smRRitam
shlokas.46:
shuklaM kRRiShNaM tathA raktaM nIlaM pItAruNaM tathA |
hrasvaM dIrghaM tathA sthUlaM chaturasrANu vRRittakam
shlokas.47:
evaM dvAdashavistAraM tejaso rUpamuchyate |
vij~neyaM brAhmaNairnityaM dharmaj~naiH satyavAdibhiH
shlokas.48:
shabdasparshau cha vij~neyau dviguNo vAyuruchyate |
vAyoshchApi guNaH sparshaH sparshashcha bahudhA smRRitaH
shlokas.49:
uShNaH shItaH sukho duHkhaH snigdho vishada eva cha |
kaThinashchikkaNaH shlakShNaH pichChilo dAruNo mRRiduH
shlokas.50:
evaM dvAdashavistAro vAyavyo guNa uchyate |
vidhivadbrahmaNaiH siddhairdharmaj~naistattvadarshibhiH
shlokas.51:
tatraikaguNamAkAshaM shabda ityeva cha smRRitaH |
tasya shabdasya vakShyAmi vistareNa bahUnguNAn
shlokas.52:
ShaDjarShabhau cha gAndhAro madhyamaH pa~nchamastathA |
ataH paraM tu vij~neyo niShAdo dhaivatastathA
shlokas.53:
iShTo.aniShTashcha shabdastu saMhataH pravibhAgavAn |
evaM bahuvidho j~neyaH shabda AkAshasambhavaH
shlokas.54:
AkAshamuttamaM bhUtamaha~NkArastataH param |
aha~NkArAtparA buddhirbuddherAtmA tataH paraH
shlokas.55:
tasmAttu paramavyaktamavyaktAtpuruShaH paraH |
parAvaraj~no bhUtAnAM yaM prApyAnantyamashnute

shlokas.1:
brahmovAcha||
bhUtAnAmatha pa~nchAnAM yathaiShAmIshvaraM manaH |
niyame cha visarge cha bhUtAtmA mana eva cha
shlokas.2:
adhiShThAtA mano nityaM bhUtAnAM mahatAM tathA |
buddhiraishvaryamAchaShTe kShetraj~naH sarva uchyate
shlokas.3:
indriyANi mano yu~Nkte sadashvAniva sArathiH |
indriyANi mano buddhiM kShetraj~no yu~njate sadA
shlokas.4:
mahAbhUtasamAyuktaM buddhisa.nyamanaM ratham |
tamAruhya sa bhUtAtmA samantAtparidhAvati
shlokas.5:
indriyagrAmasa.nyukto manaHsArathireva cha |
buddhisa.nyamano nityaM mahAnbrahmamayo rathaH
shlokas.6:
evaM yo vetti vidvAnvai sadA brahmamayaM ratham |
sa dhIraH sarvalokeShu na mohamadhigachChati
shlokas.7:
avyaktAdi visheShAntaM trasasthAvarasa~Nkulam |
chandrasUryaprabhAlokaM grahanakShatramaNDitam
shlokas.8:
nadIparvatajAlaishcha sarvataH paribhUShitam |
vividhAbhistathAdbhishcha satataM samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.9:
AjIvaH sarvabhUtAnAM sarvaprANabhRRitAM gatiH |
etadbrahmavanaM nityaM yasmi.nshcharati kShetravit
shlokas.10:
loke.asminyAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
tAnyevAgre pralIyante pashchAdbhUtakRRitA guNAH
guNebhyaH pa~nchabhUtAni eSha bhUtasamuchChrayaH
shlokas.11:
devA manuShyA gandharvAH pishAchAsurarAkShasAH |
sarve svabhAvataH sRRiShTA na kriyAbhyo na kAraNAt
shlokas.12:
ete vishvakRRito viprA jAyante ha punaH punaH |
tebhyaH prasUtAsteShveva mahAbhUteShu pa~nchasu
pralIyante yathAkAlamUrmayaH sAgare yathA
shlokas.13:
vishvasRRigbhyastu bhUtebhyo mahAbhUtAni gachChati |
bhUtebhyashchApi pa~nchabhyo mukto gachChetprajApatim
shlokas.14:
prajApatiridaM sarvaM tapasaivAsRRijatprabhuH |
tathaiva vedAnRRiShayastapasA pratipedire
shlokas.15:
tapasashchAnupUrvyeNa phalamUlAshinastathA |
trailokyaM tapasA siddhAH pashyantIha samAhitAH
shlokas.16:
oShadhAnyagadAdInI nAnAvidyAshcha sarvashaH |
tapasaiva prasidhyanti tapomUlaM hi sAdhanam
shlokas.17:
yaddurApaM durAmnAyaM durAdharShaM duranvayam |
tatsarvaM tapasA sAdhyaM tapo hi duratikramam
shlokas.18:
surApo brahmahA steyI bhrUNahA gurutalpagaH |
tapasaiva sutaptena muchyante kilbiShAttataH
shlokas.19:
manuShyAH pitaro devAH pashavo mRRigapakShiNaH |
yAni chAnyAni bhUtAni trasAni sthAvarANi cha
shlokas.20:
tapaHparAyaNA nityaM sidhyante tapasA sadA |
tathaiva tapasA devA mahAbhAgA divaM gatAH
shlokas.21:
AshIryuktAni karmANi kurvate ye tvatandritAH |
aha~NkArasamAyuktAste sakAshe prajApateH
shlokas.22:
dhyAnayogena shuddhena nirmamA niraha~NkRRitAH |
prApnuvanti mahAtmAno mahAntaM lokamuttamam
shlokas.23:
dhyAnayogAdupAgamya prasannamatayaH sadA |
sukhopachayamavyaktaM pravishantyAtmavattayA
shlokas.24:
dhyAnayogAdupAgamya nirmamA niraha~NkRRitAH |
avyaktaM pravishantIha mahAntaM lokamuttamam
shlokas.25:
avyaktAdeva sambhUtaH samayaj~no gataH punaH |
tamorajobhyAM nirmuktaH sattvamAsthAya kevalam
shlokas.26:
vimuktaH sarvapApebhyaH sarvaM tyajati niShkalaH |
kShetraj~na iti taM vidyAdyastaM veda sa vedavit
shlokas.27:
chittaM chittAdupAgamya munirAsIta sa.nyataH |
yachchittastanmanA bhUtvA guhyametatsanAtanam
shlokas.28:
avyaktAdi visheShAntamavidyAlakShaNaM smRRitam |
nibodhata yathA hIdaM guNairlakShaNamityuta
shlokas.29:
dvyakSharastu bhavenmRRityustryakSharaM brahma shAshvatam |
mameti cha bhavenmRRityurna mameti cha shAshvatam
shlokas.30:
karma kechitprasha.nsanti mandabuddhitarA narAH |
ye tu buddhA mahAtmAno na prasha.nsanti karma te
shlokas.31:
karmaNA jAyate janturmUrtimAnShoDashAtmakaH |
puruShaM sRRijate.avidyA agrAhyamamRRitAshinam
shlokas.32:
tasmAtkarmasu niHsnehA ye kechitpAradarshinaH |
vidyAmayo.ayaM puruSho na tu karmamayaH smRRitaH
shlokas.33:
apUrvamamRRitaM nityaM ya enamavichAriNam |
ya enaM vindate.a.atmAnamagrAhyamamRRitAshinam
agrAhyo.amRRito bhavati ya ebhiH kAraNairdhruvaH
shlokas.34:
apohya sarvasa~NkalpAnsa.nyamyAtmAnamAtmani |
sa tadbrahma shubhaM vetti yasmAdbhUyo na vidyate
shlokas.35:
prasAdenaiva sattvasya prasAdaM samavApnuyAt |
lakShaNaM hi prasAdasya yathA syAtsvapnadarshanam
shlokas.36:
gatireShA tu muktAnAM ye j~nAnapariniShThitAH |
pravRRittayashcha yAH sarvAH pashyanti pariNAmajAH
shlokas.37:
eShA gatirasaktAnAmeSha dharmaH sanAtanaH |
eShA j~nAnavatAM prAptiretadvRRittamaninditam
shlokas.38:
samena sarvabhUteShu niHspRRiheNa nirAshiShA |
shakyA gatiriyaM gantuM sarvatra samadarshinA
shlokas.39:
