etadvaH sarvamAkhyAtaM mayA viprarShisattamAH |
evamAcharata kShipraM tataH siddhimavApsyatha
shlokas.40:
gururuvAcha||
ityuktAste tu munayo brahmaNA guruNA tathA |
kRRitavanto mahAtmAnastato lokAnavApnuvan
shlokas.41:
tvamapyetanmahAbhAga yathoktaM brahmaNo vachaH |
samyagAchara shuddhAtma.nstataH siddhimavApsyasi
shlokas.42:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA shiShyo guruNA dharmamuttamam |
chakAra sarvaM kaunteya tato mokShamavAptavAn
shlokas.43:
kRRitakRRityashcha sa tadA shiShyaH kurukulodvaha |
tatpadaM samanuprApto yatra gatvA na shochati
shlokas.44:
arjuna uvAcha||
ko nvasau brAhmaNaH kRRiShNa kashcha shiShyo janArdana |
shrotavyaM chenmayaitadvai tattvamAchakShva me vibho
shlokas.45:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
ahaM gururmahAbAho manaH shiShyaM cha viddhi me |
tvatprItyA guhyametachcha kathitaM me dhana~njaya
shlokas.46:
mayi chedasti te prItirnityaM kurukulodvaha |
adhyAtmametachChrutvA tvaM samyagAchara suvrata
shlokas.47:
tatastvaM samyagAchIrNe dharme.asminkurunandana |
sarvapApavishuddhAtmA mokShaM prApsyasi kevalam
shlokas.48:
pUrvamapyetadevoktaM yuddhakAla upasthite |
mayA tava mahAbAho tasmAdatra manaH kuru
shlokas.49:
mayA tu bharatashreShTha chiradRRiShTaH pitA vibho |
tamahaM draShTumichChAmi saMmate tava phalguna
shlokas.50:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktavachanaM kRRiShNaM pratyuvAcha dhana~njayaH |
gachChAvo nagaraM kRRiShNa gajasAhvayamadya vai
shlokas.51:
sametya tatra rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
samanuj~nApya durdharShaM svAM purIM yAtumarhasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.abhyachodayatkRRiShNo yujyatAmiti dArukam |
muhUrtAdiva chAchaShTa yuktamityeva dArukaH
shlokas.2:
tathaiva chAnuyAtrANi chodayAmAsa pANDavaH |
sajjayadhvaM prayAsyAmo nagaraM gajasAhvayam
shlokas.3:
ityuktAH sainikAste tu sajjIbhUtA vishAM pate |
AchakhyuH sajjamityeva pArthAyAmitatejase
shlokas.4:
tatastau rathamAsthAya prayAtau kRRiShNapANDavau |
vikurvANau kathAshchitrAH prIyamANau vishAM pate
shlokas.5:
rathasthaM tu mahAtejA vAsudevaM dhana~njayaH |
punarevAbravIdvAkyamidaM bharatasattama
shlokas.6:
tvatprasAdAjjayaH prApto rAj~nA vRRiShNikulodvaha |
nihatAH shatravashchApi prAptaM rAjyamakaNTakam
shlokas.7:
nAthavantashcha bhavatA pANDavA madhusUdana |
bhavantaM plavamAsAdya tIrNAH sma kurusAgaram
shlokas.8:
vishvakarmannamaste.astu vishvAtmanvishvasambhava |
yathAhaM tvA vijAnAmi yathA chAhaM bhavanmanAH
shlokas.9:
tvattejaHsambhavo nityaM hutAsho madhusUdana |
ratiH krIDAmayI tubhyaM mAyA te rodasI vibho
shlokas.10:
tvayi sarvamidaM vishvaM yadidaM sthANuja~Ngamam |
tvaM hi sarvaM vikuruShe bhUtagrAmaM sanAtanam
shlokas.11:
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha tathA sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
hasitaM te.amalA jyotsnA RRitavashchendriyAnvayAH
shlokas.12:
prANo vAyuH satatagaH krodho mRRityuH sanAtanaH |
prasAde chApi padmA shrIrnityaM tvayi mahAmate
shlokas.13:
ratistuShTirdhRRitiH kShAntistvayi chedaM charAcharam |
tvameveha yugAnteShu nidhanaM prochyase.anagha
shlokas.14:
sudIrgheNApi kAlena na te shakyA guNA mayA |
AtmA cha paramo vaktuM namaste nalinekShaNa
shlokas.15:
vidito me.asi durdharSha nAradAddevalAttathA |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanAchchaiva tathA kurupitAmahAt
shlokas.16:
tvayi sarvaM samAsaktaM tvamevaiko janeshvaraH |
yachchAnugrahasa.nyuktametaduktaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.17:
etatsarvamahaM samyagAchariShye janArdana |
idaM chAdbhutamatyarthaM kRRitamasmatpriyepsayA
shlokas.18:
yatpApo nihataH sa~Nkhye kauravyo dhRRitarAShTrajaH |
tvayA dagdhaM hi tatsainyaM mayA vijitamAhave
shlokas.19:
bhavatA tatkRRitaM karma yenAvApto jayo mayA |
duryodhanasya sa~NgrAme tava buddhiparAkramaiH
shlokas.20:
karNasya cha vadhopAyo yathAvatsampradarshitaH |
saindhavasya cha pApasya bhUrishravasa eva cha
shlokas.21:
ahaM cha prIyamANena tvayA devakinandana |
yaduktastatkariShyAmi na hi me.atra vichAraNA
shlokas.22:
rAjAnaM cha samAsAdya dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
chodayiShyAmi dharmaj~na gamanArthaM tavAnagha
shlokas.23:
ruchitaM hi mamaitatte dvArakAgamanaM prabho |
achirAchchaiva dRRiShTA tvaM mAtulaM madhusUdana
baladevaM cha durdharShaM tathAnyAnvRRiShNipu~NgavAn
shlokas.24:
evaM sambhAShamANau tau prAptau vAraNasAhvayam |
tathA vivishatushchobhau samprahRRiShTanarAkulam
shlokas.25:
tau gatvA dhRRitarAShTrasya gRRihaM shakragRRihopamam |
dadRRishAte mahArAja dhRRitarAShTraM janeshvaram
shlokas.26:
viduraM cha mahAbuddhiM rAjAnaM cha yudhiShThiram |
bhImasenaM cha durdharShaM mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
dhRRitarAShTramupAsInaM yuyutsuM chAparAjitam
shlokas.27:
gAndhArIM cha mahAprAj~nAM pRRithAM kRRiShNAM cha bhAminIm |
subhadrAdyAshcha tAH sarvA bharatAnAM striyastathA
dadRRishAte sthitAH sarvA gAndhArIM parivArya vai
shlokas.28:
tataH sametya rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTramari.ndamau |
nivedya nAmadheye sve tasya pAdAvagRRihNatAm
shlokas.29:
gAndhAryAshcha pRRithAyAshcha dharmarAj~nastathaiva cha |
bhImasya cha mahAtmAnau tathA pAdAvagRRihNatAm
shlokas.30:
kShattAraM chApi sampUjya pRRiShTvA kushalamavyayam |
taiH sArdhaM nRRipatiM vRRiddhaM tatastaM paryupAsatAm
shlokas.31:
tato nishi mahArAja dhRRitarAShTraH kurUdvahAn |
janArdanaM cha medhAvI vyasarjayata vai gRRihAn
shlokas.32:
te.anuj~nAtA nRRipatinA yayuH svaM svaM niveshanam |
dhana~njayagRRihAneva yayau kRRiShNastu vIryavAn
shlokas.33:
tatrArchito yathAnyAyaM sarvakAmairupasthitaH |
kRRiShNaH suShvApa medhAvI dhana~njayasahAyavAn
shlokas.34:
prabhAtAyAM tu sharvaryAM kRRitapUrvAhNikakriyau |
dharmarAjasya bhavanaM jagmatuH paramArchitau
yatrAste sa sahAmAtyo dharmarAjo mahAmanAH
shlokas.35:
tatastau tatpravishyAtha dadRRishAte mahAbalau |
dharmarAjAnamAsInaM devarAjamivAshvinau
shlokas.36:
tau samAsAdya rAjAnaM vArShNeyakurupu~Ngavau |
niShIdaturanuj~nAtau prIyamANena tena vai
shlokas.37:
tataH sa rAjA medhAvI vivakShU prekShya tAvubhau |
provAcha vadatAM shreShTho vachanaM rAjasattamaH
shlokas.38:
vivakShU hi yuvAM manye vIrau yadukurUdvahau |
brUta kartAsmi sarvaM vAM na chirAnmA vichAryatAm
shlokas.39:
ityukte phalgunastatra dharmarAjAnamabravIt |
vinItavadupAgamya vAkyaM vAkyavishAradaH
shlokas.40:
ayaM chiroShito rAjanvAsudevaH pratApavAn |
bhavantaM samanuj~nApya pitaraM draShTumichChati
shlokas.41:
sa gachChedabhyanuj~nAto bhavatA yadi manyase |
AnartanagarIM vIrastadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.42:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
puNDarIkAkSha bhadraM te gachCha tvaM madhusUdana |
purIM dvAravatImadya draShTuM shUrasutaM prabhum
shlokas.43:
rochate me mahAbAho gamanaM tava keshava |
mAtulashchiradRRiShTo me tvayA devI cha devakI
shlokas.44:
mAtulaM vasudevaM tvaM baladevaM cha mAdhava |
pUjayethA mahAprAj~na madvAkyena yathArhataH
shlokas.45:
smarethAshchApi mAM nityaM bhImaM cha balinAM varam |
phalgunaM nakulaM chaiva sahadevaM cha mAdhava
shlokas.46:
AnartAnavalokya tvaM pitaraM cha mahAbhuja |
vRRiShNI.nshcha punarAgachCherhayamedhe mamAnagha
shlokas.47:
sa gachCha ratnAnyAdAya vividhAni vasUni cha |
yachchApyanyanmanoj~naM te tadapyAdatsva sAtvata
shlokas.48:
iyaM hi vasudhA sarvA prasAdAttava mAdhava |
asmAnupagatA vIra nihatAshchApi shatravaH
shlokas.49:
evaM bruvati kauravye dharmarAje yudhiShThire |
vAsudevo varaH pu.nsAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.50:
tavaiva ratnAni dhanaM cha kevala;mdharA cha kRRitsnA tu mahAbhujAdya vai |
yadasti chAnyaddraviNaM gRRiheShu me; tvameva tasyeshvara nityamIshvaraH
shlokas.51:
tathetyathoktaH pratipUjitastadA; gadAgrajo dharmasutena vIryavAn |
pitRRiShvasAmabhyavadadyathAvidhi; sampUjitashchApyagamatpradakShiNam
shlokas.52:
tayA sa samyakpratinanditastadA; tathaiva sarvairvidurAdibhistataH |
viniryayau nAgapurAdgadAgrajo; rathena divyena chaturyujA hariH
shlokas.53:
rathaM subhadrAmadhiropya bhAminIM; yudhiShThirasyAnumate janArdanaH |
pitRRiShvasAyAshcha tathA mahAbhujo; viniryayau paurajanAbhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.54:
tamanvagAdvAnaravaryaketanaH; sasAtyakirmAdravatIsutAvapi |
agAdhabuddhirvidurashcha mAdhavaM; svayaM cha bhImo gajarAjavikramaH
shlokas.55:
nivartayitvA kururAShTravardhanAM;stataH sa sarvAnviduraM cha vIryavAn |
janArdano dArukamAha satvaraH; prachodayAshvAniti sAtyakistadA
shlokas.56:
tato yayau shatrugaNapramardanaH; shinipravIrAnugato janArdanaH |
yathA nihatyArigaNA~nshatakratu;rdivaM tathAnartapurIM pratApavAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA prayAntaM vArShNeyaM dvArakAM bharatarShabhAH |
pariShvajya nyavartanta sAnuyAtrAH parantapAH
shlokas.2:
punaH punashcha vArShNeyaM paryaShvajata phalgunaH |
A chakShurviShayAchchainaM dadarsha cha punaH punaH
shlokas.3:
kRRichChreNaiva cha tAM pArtho govinde viniveshitAm |
sa~njahAra tadA dRRiShTiM kRRiShNashchApyaparAjitaH
shlokas.4:
tasya prayANe yAnyAsannimittAni mahAtmanaH |
bahUnyadbhutarUpANi tAni me gadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.5:
vAyurvegena mahatA rathasya purato vavau |
kurvanniHsharkaraM mArgaM virajaskamakaNTakam
shlokas.6:
vavarSha vAsavashchApi toyaM shuchi sugandhi cha |
divyAni chaiva puShpANi purataH shAr~NgadhanvanaH
shlokas.7:
sa prayAto mahAbAhuH sameShu marudhanvasu |
dadarshAtha munishreShThamutta~Nkamamitaujasam
shlokas.8:
sa taM sampUjya tejasvI muniM pRRithulalochanaH |
pUjitastena cha tadA paryapRRichChadanAmayam
shlokas.9:
sa pRRiShTaH kushalaM tena sampUjya madhusUdanam |
utta~Nko brAhmaNashreShThastataH paprachCha mAdhavam
shlokas.10:
kachchichChaure tvayA gatvA kurupANDavasadma tat |
kRRitaM saubhrAtramachalaM tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.11:
abhisandhAya tAnvIrAnupAvRRitto.asi keshava |
sambandhinaH sudayitAnsatataM vRRiShNipu~Ngava
shlokas.12:
kachchitpANDusutAH pa~ncha dhRRitarAShTrasya chAtmajAH |
lokeShu vihariShyanti tvayA saha parantapa
shlokas.13:
svarAShTreShu cha rAjAnaH kachchitprApsyanti vai sukham |
kauraveShu prashAnteShu tvayA nAthena mAdhava
shlokas.14:
yA me sambhAvanA tAta tvayi nityamavartata |
api sA saphalA kRRiShNa kRRitA te bharatAnprati
shlokas.15:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
kRRito yatno mayA brahmansaubhrAtre kauravAnprati |
na chAshakyanta sandhAtuM te.adharmaruchayo mayA
shlokas.16:
tataste nidhanaM prAptAH sarve sasutabAndhavAH |
na diShTamabhyatikrAntuM shakyaM buddhyA balena vA
maharShe viditaM nUnaM sarvametattavAnagha
shlokas.17:
te.atyakrAmanmatiM mahyaM bhIShmasya vidurasya cha |
tato yamakShayaM jagmuH samAsAdyetaretaram
shlokas.18:
pa~ncha vai pANDavAH shiShTA hatamitrA hatAtmajAH |
dhArtarAShTrAshcha nihatAH sarve sasutabAndhavAH
shlokas.19:
ityuktavachane kRRiShNe bhRRishaM krodhasamanvitaH |
utta~NkaH pratyuvAchainaM roShAdutphAlya lochane
shlokas.20:
yasmAchChaktena te kRRiShNa na trAtAH kurupANDavAH |
sambandhinaH priyAstasmAchChapsye.ahaM tvAmasa.nshayam
shlokas.21:
na cha te prasabhaM yasmAtte nigRRihya nivartitAH |
tasmAnmanyuparItastvAM shapsyAmi madhusUdana
shlokas.22:
tvayA hi shaktena satA mithyAchAreNa mAdhava |
upachIrNAH kurushreShThA yastvetAnsamupekShathAH
shlokas.23:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
shRRiNu me vistareNedaM yadvakShye bhRRigunandana |
gRRihANAnunayaM chApi tapasvI hyasi bhArgava
shlokas.24:
shrutvA tvametadadhyAtmaM mu~nchethAH shApamadya vai |
na cha mAM tapasAlpena shakto.abhibhavituM pumAn
shlokas.25:
na cha te tapaso nAshamichChAmi japatAM vara |
tapaste sumahaddIptaM guravashchApi toShitAH
shlokas.26:
kaumAraM brahmacharyaM te jAnAmi dvijasattama |
duHkhArjitasya tapasastasmAnnechChAmi te vyayam

shlokas.1:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
brUhi keshava tattvena tvamadhyAtmamaninditam |
shrutvA shreyo.abhidhAsyAmi shApaM vA te janArdana
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tamo rajashcha sattvaM cha viddhi bhAvAnmadAshrayAn |
tathA rudrAnvasU.nshchApi viddhi matprabhavAndvija
shlokas.3:
mayi sarvANi bhUtAni sarvabhUteShu chApyaham |
sthita ityabhijAnIhi mA te.abhUdatra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
tathA daityagaNAnsarvAnyakSharAkShasapannagAn |
gandharvApsarasashchaiva viddhi matprabhavAndvija
shlokas.5:
sadasachchaiva yatprAhuravyaktaM vyaktameva cha |
akSharaM cha kSharaM chaiva sarvametanmadAtmakam
shlokas.6:
ye chAshrameShu vai dharmAshchaturShu vihitA mune |
daivAni chaiva karmANi viddhi sarvaM madAtmakam
shlokas.7:
asachcha sadasachchaiva yadvishvaM sadasataH param |
tataH paraM nAsti chaiva devadevAtsanAtanAt
shlokas.8:
o~NkAraprabhavAnvedAnviddhi mAM tvaM bhRRigUdvaha |
yUpaM somaM tathaiveha tridashApyAyanaM makhe
shlokas.9:
hotAramapi havyaM cha viddhi mAM bhRRigunandana |
adhvaryuH kalpakashchApi haviH paramasa.nskRRitam
shlokas.10:
udgAtA chApi mAM stauti gItaghoShairmahAdhvare |
prAyashchitteShu mAM brahma~nshAntima~NgalavAchakAH
stuvanti vishvakarmANaM satataM dvijasattamAH
shlokas.11:
viddhi mahyaM sutaM dharmamagrajaM dvijasattama |
mAnasaM dayitaM vipra sarvabhUtadayAtmakam
shlokas.12:
tatrAhaM vartamAnaishcha nivRRittaishchaiva mAnavaiH |
bahvIH sa.nsaramANo vai yonIrhi dvijasattama
shlokas.13:
dharmasa.nrakShaNArthAya dharmasa.nsthApanAya cha |
taistairveShaishcha rUpaishcha triShu lokeShu bhArgava
shlokas.14:
ahaM viShNurahaM brahmA shakro.atha prabhavApyayaH |
bhUtagrAmasya sarvasya sraShTA saMhAra eva cha
shlokas.15:
adharme vartamAnAnAM sarveShAmahamapyuta |
dharmasya setuM badhnAmi chalite chalite yuge
tAstA yonIH pravishyAhaM prajAnAM hitakAmyayA
shlokas.16:
yadA tvahaM devayonau vartAmi bhRRigunandana |
tadAhaM devavatsarvamAcharAmi na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
yadA gandharvayonau tu vartAmi bhRRigunandana |
tadA gandharvavachcheShTAH sarvAshcheShTAmi bhArgava
shlokas.18:
nAgayonau yadA chaiva tadA vartAmi nAgavat |
yakSharAkShasayonIshcha yathAvadvicharAmyaham
shlokas.19:
mAnuShye vartamAne tu kRRipaNaM yAchitA mayA |
na cha te jAtasaMmohA vacho gRRihNanti me hitam
shlokas.20:
bhayaM cha mahaduddishya trAsitAH kuravo mayA |
kruddheva bhUtvA cha punaryathAvadanudarshitAH
shlokas.21:
te.adharmeNeha sa.nyuktAH parItAH kAladharmaNA |
dharmeNa nihatA yuddhe gatAH svargaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.22:
lokeShu pANDavAshchaiva gatAH khyAtiM dvijottama |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
abhijAnAmi jagataH kartAraM tvAM janArdana |
nUnaM bhavatprasAdo.ayamiti me nAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.2:
chittaM cha suprasannaM me tvadbhAvagatamachyuta |
vinivRRittashcha me kopa iti viddhi parantapa
shlokas.3:
yadi tvanugrahaM ka~nchittvatto.arho.ahaM janArdana |
draShTumichChAmi te rUpamaishvaraM tannidarshaya
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa tasmai prItAtmA darshayAmAsa tadvapuH |
shAshvataM vaiShNavaM dhImAndadRRishe yaddhana~njayaH
shlokas.5:
sa dadarsha mahAtmAnaM vishvarUpaM mahAbhujam |
vismayaM cha yayau viprastaddRRiShTvA rUpamaishvaram
shlokas.6:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
vishvakarmannamaste.astu yasya te rUpamIdRRisham |
padbhyAM te pRRithivI vyAptA shirasA chAvRRitaM nabhaH
shlokas.7:
dyAvApRRithivyoryanmadhyaM jaThareNa tadAvRRitam |
bhujAbhyAmAvRRitAshchAshAstvamidaM sarvamachyuta
shlokas.8:
saMharasva punardeva rUpamakShayyamuttamam |
punastvAM svena rUpeNa draShTumichChAmi shAshvatam
shlokas.9:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tamuvAcha prasannAtmA govindo janamejaya |
varaM vRRiNIShveti tadA tamutta~Nko.abravIdidam
shlokas.10:
paryApta eSha evAdya varastvatto mahAdyute |
yatte rUpamidaM kRRiShNa pashyAmi prabhavApyayam
shlokas.11:
tamabravItpunaH kRRiShNo mA tvamatra vichAraya |
avashyametatkartavyamamoghaM darshanaM mama
shlokas.12:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
avashyakaraNIyaM vai yadyetanmanyase vibho |
toyamichChAmi yatreShTaM maruShvetaddhi durlabham
shlokas.13:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH saMhRRitya tattejaH provAchotta~NkamIshvaraH |
eShTavye sati chintyo.ahamityuktvA dvArakAM yayau
shlokas.14:
tataH kadAchidbhagavAnutta~NkastoyakA~NkShayA |
tRRiShitaH parichakrAma marau sasmAra chAchyutam
shlokas.15:
tato digvAsasaM dhImAnmAta~NgaM malapa~Nkinam |
apashyata marau tasmi~nshvayUthaparivAritam
shlokas.16:
bhIShaNaM baddhanistri.nshaM bANakArmukadhAriNam |
tasyAdhaH srotaso.apashyadvAri bhUri dvijottamaH
shlokas.17:
smaranneva cha taM prAha mAta~NgaH prahasanniva |
ehyutta~Nka pratIchChasva matto vAri bhRRigUdvaha
kRRipA hi me sumahatI tvAM dRRiShTvA tRRiTsamAhatam
shlokas.18:
ityuktastena sa munistattoyaM nAbhyanandata |
chikShepa cha sa taM dhImAnvAgbhirugrAbhirachyutam
shlokas.19:
punaH punashcha mAta~NgaH pibasveti tamabravIt |
na chApibatsa sakrodhaH kShubhitenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.20:
sa tathA nishchayAttena pratyAkhyAto mahAtmanA |
shvabhiH saha mahArAja tatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.21:
utta~NkastaM tathA dRRiShTvA tato vrIDitamAnasaH |
mene pralabdhamAtmAnaM kRRiShNenAmitraghAtinA
shlokas.22:
atha tenaiva mArgeNa sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH |
AjagAma mahAbAhurutta~NkashchainamabravIt
shlokas.23:
na yuktaM tAdRRishaM dAtuM tvayA puruShasattama |
salilaM vipramukhyebhyo mAta~NgasrotasA vibho
shlokas.24:
ityuktavachanaM dhImAnmahAbuddhirjanArdanaH |
utta~NkaM shlakShNayA vAchA sAntvayannidamabravIt
shlokas.25:
yAdRRisheneha rUpeNa yogyaM dAtuM vRRitena vai |
tAdRRishaM khalu me dattaM tvaM tu tannAvabudhyase
shlokas.26:
mayA tvadarthamukto hi vajrapANiH pura.ndaraH |
utta~NkAyAmRRitaM dehi toyarUpamiti prabhuH
shlokas.27:
sa mAmuvAcha devendro na martyo.amartyatAM vrajet |
anyamasmai varaM dehItyasakRRidbhRRigunandana
shlokas.28:
amRRitaM deyamityeva mayoktaH sa shachIpatiH |
sa mAM prasAdya devendraH punarevedamabravIt
shlokas.29:
yadi deyamavashyaM vai mAta~Ngo.ahaM mahAdyute |
bhUtvAmRRitaM pradAsyAmi bhArgavAya mahAtmane
shlokas.30:
yadyevaM pratigRRihNAti bhArgavo.amRRitamadya vai |
pradAtumeSha gachChAmi bhArgavAyAmRRitaM prabho
pratyAkhyAtastvahaM tena na dadyAmiti bhArgava
shlokas.31:
sa tathA samayaM kRRitvA tena rUpeNa vAsavaH |
upasthitastvayA chApi pratyAkhyAto.amRRitaM dadat
chaNDAlarUpI bhagavAnsumahA.nste vyatikramaH
shlokas.32:
yattu shakyaM mayA kartuM bhUya eva tavepsitam |
toyepsAM tava durdharSha kariShye saphalAmaham
shlokas.33:
yeShvahaHsu tava brahmansalilechChA bhaviShyati |
tadA marau bhaviShyanti jalapUrNAH payodharAH
shlokas.34:
rasavachcha pradAsyanti te toyaM bhRRigunandana |
utta~NkameghA ityuktAH khyAtiM yAsyanti chApi te
shlokas.35:
ityuktaH prItimAnvipraH kRRiShNena sa babhUva ha |
adyApyutta~NkameghAshcha marau varShanti bhArata

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
utta~NkaH kena tapasA sa.nyuktaH sumahAtapAH |
yaH shApaM dAtukAmo.abhUdviShNave prabhaviShNave
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
utta~Nko mahatA yuktastapasA janamejaya |
gurubhaktaH sa tejasvI nAnyaM ka~nchidapUjayat
shlokas.3:
sarveShAmRRiShiputrANAmeSha chAsInmanorathaH |
autta~NkIM guruvRRittiM vai prApnuyAmiti bhArata
shlokas.4:
gautamasya tu shiShyANAM bahUnAM janamejaya |
utta~Nke.abhyadhikA prItiH snehashchaivAbhavattadA
shlokas.5:
sa tasya damashauchAbhyAM vikrAntena cha karmaNA |
samyakchaivopachAreNa gautamaH prItimAnabhUt
shlokas.6:
atha shiShyasahasrANi samanuj~nAya gautamaH |
utta~NkaM parayA prItyA nAbhyanuj~nAtumaichChata
shlokas.7:
taM krameNa jarA tAta pratipede mahAmunim |
na chAnvabudhyata tadA sa munirguruvatsalaH
shlokas.8:
tataH kadAchidrAjendra kAShThAnyAnayituM yayau |
utta~NkaH kAShThabhAraM cha mahAntaM samupAnayat
shlokas.9:
sa tu bhArAbhibhUtAtmA kAShThabhAramari.ndama |
niShpipeSha kShitau rAjanparishrAnto bubhukShitaH
shlokas.10:
tasya kAShThe vilagnAbhUjjaTA rUpyasamaprabhA |
tataH kAShThaiH saha tadA papAta dharaNItale
shlokas.11:
tataH sa bhAraniShpiShTaH kShudhAviShTashcha bhArgavaH |
dRRiShTvA tAM vayaso.avasthAM rurodArtasvaraM tadA
shlokas.12:
tato gurusutA tasya padmapatranibhekShaNA |
jagrAhAshrUNi sushroNI kareNa pRRithulochanA
piturniyogAddharmaj~nA shirasAvanatA tadA
shlokas.13:
tasyA nipetaturdagdhau karau tairashrubindubhiH |
na hi tAnashrupAtAnvai shaktA dhArayituM mahI
shlokas.14:
gautamastvabravIdvipramutta~NkaM prItamAnasaH |
kasmAttAta tavAdyeha shokottaramidaM manaH
sa svairaM brUhi viprarShe shrotumichChAmi te vachaH
shlokas.15:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
bhavadgatena manasA bhavatpriyachikIrShayA |
bhavadbhaktigateneha bhavadbhAvAnugena cha
shlokas.16:
jareyaM nAvabuddhA me nAbhij~nAtaM sukhaM cha me |
shatavarShoShitaM hi tvaM na mAmabhyanujAnathAH
shlokas.17:
bhavatA hyabhyanuj~nAtAH shiShyAH pratyavarA mayA |
upapannA dvijashreShTha shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
gautama uvAcha||
tvatprItiyuktena mayA gurushushrUShayA tava |
vyatikrAmanmahAnkAlo nAvabuddho dvijarShabha
shlokas.19:
kiM tvadya yadi te shraddhA gamanaM prati bhArgava |
anuj~nAM gRRihya mattastvaM gRRihAngachChasva mA chiram
shlokas.20:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
gurvarthaM kaM prayachChAmi brUhi tvaM dvijasattama |
tamupAkRRitya gachCheyamanuj~nAtastvayA vibho
shlokas.21:
gautama uvAcha||
dakShiNA paritoSho vai gurUNAM sadbhiruchyate |
tava hyAcharato brahma.nstuShTo.ahaM vai na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.22:
itthaM cha parituShTaM mAM vijAnIhi bhRRigUdvaha |
yuvA ShoDashavarSho hi yadadya bhavitA bhavAn
shlokas.23:
dadAmi patnIM kanyAM cha svAM te duhitaraM dvija |
etAmRRite hi nAnyA vai tvattejo.arhati sevitum
shlokas.24:
tatastAM pratijagrAha yuvA bhUtvA yashasvinIm |
guruNA chAbhyanuj~nAto gurupatnImathAbravIt
shlokas.25:
kiM bhavatyai prayachChAmi gurvarthaM viniyu~NkShva mAm |
priyaM hi tava kA~NkShAmi prANairapi dhanairapi
shlokas.26:
yaddurlabhaM hi loke.asminratnamatyadbhutaM bhavet |
tadAnayeyaM tapasA na hi me.atrAsti sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
ahalyovAcha||
parituShTAsmi te putra nityaM bhagavatA saha |
paryAptaye tadbhadraM te gachCha tAta yathechChakam
shlokas.28:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
utta~Nkastu mahArAja punarevAbravIdvachaH |
Aj~nApayasva mAM mAtaH kartavyaM hi priyaM tava
shlokas.29:
ahalyovAcha||
saudAsapatnyA vidite divye vai maNikuNDale |
te samAnaya bhadraM te gurvarthaH sukRRito bhavet
shlokas.30:
sa tatheti pratishrutya jagAma janamejaya |
gurupatnIpriyArthaM vai te samAnayituM tadA
shlokas.31:
sa jagAma tataH shIghramutta~Nko brAhmaNarShabhaH |
saudAsaM puruShAdaM vai bhikShituM maNikuNDale
shlokas.32:
gautamastvabravItpatnImutta~Nko nAdya dRRishyate |
iti pRRiShTA tamAchaShTa kuNDalArthaM gataM tu vai
shlokas.33:
tataH provAcha patnIM sa na te samyagidaM kRRitam |
shaptaH sa pArthivo nUnaM brAhmaNaM taM vadhiShyati
shlokas.34:
ahalyovAcha||
ajAnantyA niyuktaH sa bhagavanbrAhmaNo.adya me |
bhavatprasAdAnna bhayaM ki~nchittasya bhaviShyati
shlokas.35:
ityuktaH prAha tAM patnImevamastviti gautamaH |
utta~Nko.api vane shUnye rAjAnaM taM dadarsha ha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa taM dRRiShTvA tathAbhUtaM rAjAnaM ghoradarshanam |
dIrghashmashrudharaM nR^INAM shoNitena samukShitam
shlokas.2:
chakAra na vyathAM vipro rAjA tvenamathAbravIt |
pratyutthAya mahAtejA bhayakartA yamopamaH
shlokas.3:
diShTyA tvamasi kalyANa ShaShThe kAle mamAntikam |
bhakShaM mRRigayamANasya samprApto dvijasattama
shlokas.4:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
rAjangurvarthinaM viddhi charantaM mAmihAgatam |
na cha gurvarthamudyuktaM hi.nsyamAhurmanIShiNaH
shlokas.5:
rAjovAcha||
ShaShThe kAle mamAhAro vihito dvijasattama |
na cha shakyaH samutsraShTuM kShudhitena mayAdya vai
shlokas.6:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
evamastu mahArAja samayaH kriyatAM tu me |
gurvarthamabhinirvartya punareShyAmi te vasham
shlokas.7:
sa.nshrutashcha mayA yo.artho gurave rAjasattama |
tvadadhInaH sa rAjendra taM tvA bhikShe nareshvara
shlokas.8:
dadAsi vipramukhyebhyastvaM hi ratnAni sarvashaH |
dAtA tvaM cha naravyAghra pAtrabhUtaH kShitAviha
pAtraM pratigrahe chApi viddhi mAM nRRipasattama
shlokas.9:
upAkRRitya gurorarthaM tvadAyattamari.ndama |
samayeneha rAjendra punareShyAmi te vasham
shlokas.10:
satyaM te pratijAnAmi nAtra mithyAsti ki~nchana |
anRRitaM noktapUrvaM me svaireShvapi kuto.anyathA
shlokas.11:
saudAsa uvAcha||
yadi mattastvadAyatto gurvarthaH kRRita eva saH |
yadi chAsmi pratigrAhyaH sAmprataM tadbravIhi me
shlokas.12:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
pratigrAhyo mato me tvaM sadaiva puruSharShabha |
so.ahaM tvAmanusamprApto bhikShituM maNikuNDale
shlokas.13:
saudAsa uvAcha||
patnyAste mama viprarShe ruchire maNikuNDale |
varayArthaM tvamanyaM vai taM te dAsyAmi suvrata
shlokas.14:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
alaM te vyapadeshena pramANaM yadi te vayam |
prayachCha kuNDale me tvaM satyavAgbhava pArthiva
shlokas.15:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktastvabravIdrAjA tamutta~NkaM punarvachaH |
gachCha madvachanAddevIM brUhi dehIti sattama
shlokas.16:
saivamuktA tvayA nUnaM madvAkyena shuchismitA |
pradAsyati dvijashreShTha kuNDale te na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
kva patnI bhavataH shakyA mayA draShTuM nareshvara |
svayaM vApi bhavAnpatnIM kimarthaM nopasarpati
shlokas.18:
saudAsa uvAcha||
drakShyate tAM bhavAnadya kasmi.nshchidvananirjhare |
ShaShThe kAle na hi mayA sA shakyA draShTumadya vai
shlokas.19:
utta~Nkastu tathoktaH sa jagAma bharatarShabha |
madayantIM cha dRRiShTvA so.aj~nApayatsvaM prayojanam
shlokas.20:
saudAsavachanaM shrutvA tataH sA pRRithulochanA |
pratyuvAcha mahAbuddhimutta~NkaM janamejaya
shlokas.21:
evametanmahAbrahmannAnRRitaM vadase.anagha |
abhij~nAnaM tu ki~nchittvaM samAnetumihArhasi
shlokas.22:
ime hi divye maNikuNDale me; devAshcha yakShAshcha mahoragAshcha |
taistairupAyaiH parihartukAmA;shChidreShu nityaM paritarkayanti
shlokas.23:
nikShiptametadbhuvi pannagAstu; ratnaM samAsAdya parAmRRiSheyuH |
yakShAstathochChiShTadhRRitaM surAshcha; nidrAvashaM tvA paridharShayeyuH
shlokas.24:
ChidreShveteShu hi sadA hyadhRRiShyeShu dvijarShabha |
devarAkShasanAgAnAmapramattena dhAryate
shlokas.25:
syandete hi divA rukmaM rAtrau cha dvijasattama |
naktaM nakShatratArANAM prabhAmAkShipya vartate
shlokas.26:
ete hyAmuchya bhagavankShutpipAsAbhayaM kutaH |
viShAgnishvApadebhyashcha bhayaM jAtu na vidyate
shlokas.27:
hrasvena chaite Amukte bhavato hrasvake tadA |
anurUpeNa chAmukte tatpramANe hi jAyataH
shlokas.28:
eva.nvidhe mamaite vai kuNDale paramArchite |
triShu lokeShu vikhyAte tadabhij~nAnamAnaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa mitrasahamAsAdya tvabhij~nAnamayAchata |
tasmai dadAvabhij~nAnaM sa chekShvAkuvarastadA
shlokas.2:
saudAsa uvAcha||
na chaivaiShA gatiH kShemyA na chAnyA vidyate gatiH |
etanme matamAj~nAya prayachCha maNikuNDale
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktastAmutta~Nkastu bharturvAkyamathAbravIt |
shrutvA cha sA tataH prAdAttasmai te maNikuNDale
shlokas.4:
avApya kuNDale te tu rAjAnaM punarabravIt |
kimetadguhyavachanaM shrotumichChAmi pArthiva
shlokas.5:
saudAsa uvAcha||
prajA nisargAdviprAnvai kShatriyAH pUjayanti ha |
viprebhyashchApi bahavo doShAH prAdurbhavanti naH
shlokas.6:
so.ahaM dvijebhyaH praNato viprAddoShamavAptavAn |
gatimanyAM na pashyAmi madayantIsahAyavAn
svargadvArasya gamane sthAne cheha dvijottama
shlokas.7:
na hi rAj~nA visheSheNa viruddhena dvijAtibhiH |
shakyaM nRRiloke sa.nsthAtuM pretya vA sukhamedhitum
shlokas.8:
tadiShTe te mayaivaite datte sve maNikuNDale |
yaH kRRitaste.adya samayaH saphalaM taM kuruShva me
shlokas.9:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
rAja.nstatheha kartAsmi punareShyAmi te vasham |
prashnaM tu ka~nchitpraShTuM tvAM vyavasiShye parantapa
shlokas.10:
saudAsa uvAcha||
brUhi vipra yathAkAmaM prativaktAsmi te vachaH |
ChettAsmi sa.nshayaM te.adya na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.11:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
prAhurvAksa~NgataM mitraM dharmanaipuNyadarshinaH |
mitreShu yashcha viShamaH stena ityeva taM viduH
shlokas.12:
sa bhavAnmitratAmadya samprApto mama pArthiva |
sa me buddhiM prayachChasva samAM buddhimatAM vara
shlokas.13:
avAptArtho.ahamadyeha bhavA.nshcha puruShAdakaH |
bhavatsakAshamAgantuM kShamaM mama na veti vA
shlokas.14:
saudAsa uvAcha||
kShamaM chediha vaktavyaM mayA dvijavarottama |
matsamIpaM dvijashreShTha nAgantavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
evaM tava prapashyAmi shreyo bhRRigukulodvaha |
AgachChato hi te vipra bhavenmRRityurasa.nshayam
shlokas.16:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA rAj~nA kShamaM buddhimatA hitam |
samanuj~nApya rAjAnamahalyAM prati jagmivAn
shlokas.17:
gRRihItvA kuNDale divye gurupatnyAH priya~NkaraH |
javena mahatA prAyAdgautamasyAshramaM prati
shlokas.18:
yathA tayo rakShaNaM cha madayantyAbhibhAShitam |
tathA te kuNDale baddhvA tathA kRRiShNAjine.anayat
shlokas.19:
sa kasmi.nshchitkShudhAviShTaH phalabhArasamanvitam |
bilvaM dadarsha kasmi.nshchidAruroha kShudhAnvitaH
shlokas.20:
shAkhAsvAsajya tasyaiva kRRiShNAjinamari.ndama |
yasmi.nste kuNDale baddhe tadA dvijavareNa vai
shlokas.21:
vishIrNabandhane tasmingate kRRiShNAjine mahIm |
apashyadbhujagaH kashchitte tatra maNikuNDale
shlokas.22:
airAvatakulotpannaH shIghro bhUtvA tadA sa vai |
vidashyAsyena valmIkaM viveshAtha sa kuNDale
shlokas.23:
hriyamANe tu dRRiShTvA sa kuNDale bhujagena ha |
papAta vRRikShAtsodvego duHkhAtparamakopanaH
shlokas.24:
sa daNDakAShThamAdAya valmIkamakhanattadA |
krodhAmarShAbhitaptA~Ngastato vai dvijapu~NgavaH
shlokas.25:
tasya vegamasahyaM tamasahantI vasundharA |
daNDakAShThAbhinunnA~NgI chachAla bhRRishamAturA
shlokas.26:
tataH khanata evAtha viprarSherdharaNItalam |
nAgalokasya panthAnaM kartukAmasya nishchayAt
shlokas.27:
rathena hariyuktena taM deshamupajagmivAn |
vajrapANirmahAtejA dadarsha cha dvijottamam
shlokas.28:
sa tu taM brAhmaNo bhUtvA tasya duHkhena duHkhitaH |
utta~NkamabravIttAta naitachChakyaM tvayeti vai
shlokas.29:
ito hi nAgaloko vai yojanAni sahasrashaH |
na daNDakAShThasAdhyaM cha manye kAryamidaM tava
shlokas.30:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
nAgaloke yadi brahmanna shakye kuNDale mayA |
prAptuM prANAnvimokShyAmi pashyataste dvijottama
shlokas.31:
yadA sa nAshakattasya nishchayaM kartumanyathA |
vajrapANistadA daNDaM vajrAstreNa yuyoja ha
shlokas.32:
tato vajraprahAraistairdAryamANA vasundharA |
nAgalokasya panthAnamakarojjanamejaya
shlokas.33:
sa tena mArgeNa tadA nAgalokaM vivesha ha |
dadarsha nAgalokaM cha yojanAni sahasrashaH
shlokas.34:
prAkAranichayairdivyairmaNimuktAbhyala~NkRRitaiH |
upapannaM mahAbhAga shAtakumbhamayaistathA
shlokas.35:
vApIH sphaTikasopAnA nadIshcha vimalodakAH |
dadarsha vRRikShA.nshcha bahUnnAnAdvijagaNAyutAn
shlokas.36:
tasya lokasya cha dvAraM dadarsha sa bhRRigUdvahaH |
pa~nchayojanavistAramAyataM shatayojanam
shlokas.37:
nAgalokamutta~Nkastu prekShya dIno.abhavattadA |
nirAshashchAbhavattAta kuNDalAharaNe punaH
shlokas.38:
tatra provAcha turagastaM kRRiShNashvetavAladhiH |
tAmrAsyanetraH kauravya prajvalanniva tejasA
shlokas.39:
dhamasvApAnametanme tatastvaM vipra lalpsyase |
airAvatasuteneha tavAnIte hi kuNDale
shlokas.40:
mA jugupsAM kRRithAH putra tvamatrArthe katha~nchana |
tvayaitaddhi samAchIrNaM gautamasyAshrame tadA
shlokas.41:
utta~Nka uvAcha||
kathaM bhavantaM jAnIyAmupAdhyAyAshramaM prati |
yanmayA chIrNapUrvaM cha shrotumichChAmi taddhyaham
shlokas.42:
ashva uvAcha||
gurorguruM mAM jAnIhi jvalitaM jAtavedasam |
tvayA hyahaM sadA vatsa gurorarthe.abhipUjitaH
shlokas.43:
satataM pUjito vipra shuchinA bhRRigunandana |
tasmAchChreyo vidhAsyAmi tavaivaM kuru mA chiram
shlokas.44:
ityuktaH sa tathAkArShIdutta~NkashchitrabhAnunA |
ghRRitArchiH prItimA.nshchApi prajajvAla didhakShayA
shlokas.45:
tato.asya romakUpebhyo dhmAyamAnasya bhArata |
ghanaH prAdurabhUddhUmo nAgalokabhayAvahaH
shlokas.46:
tena dhUmena sahasA vardhamAnena bhArata |
nAgaloke mahArAja na praj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.48:
na prakAshanta veshmAni dhUmaruddhAni bhArata |
nIhArasa.nvRRitAnIva vanAni girayastathA
shlokas.49:
te dhUmaraktanayanA vahnitejobhitApitAH |
AjagmurnishchayaM j~nAtuM bhArgavasyAtitejasaH
shlokas.50:
shrutvA cha nishchayaM tasya maharShestigmatejasaH |
sambhrAntamanasaH sarve pUjAM chakruryathAvidhi
shlokas.51:
sarve prA~njalayo nAgA vRRiddhabAlapurogamAH |
shirobhiH praNipatyochuH prasIda bhagavanniti
shlokas.52:
prasAdya brAhmaNaM te tu pAdyamarghyaM nivedya cha |
prAyachChankuNDale divye pannagAH paramArchite
shlokas.53:
tataH sampUjito nAgaistatrotta~NkaH pratApavAn |
agniM pradakShiNaM kRRitvA jagAma gurusadma tat
shlokas.54:
sa gatvA tvarito rAjangautamasya niveshanam |
prAyachChatkuNDale divye gurupatnyai tadAnagha
shlokas.55:
evaM mahAtmanA tena trI.NllokA~njanamejaya |
parikramyAhRRite divye tataste maNikuNDale
shlokas.56:
evamprabhAvaH sa munirutta~Nko bharatarShabha |
pareNa tapasA yukto yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
utta~NkAya varaM dattvA govindo dvijasattama |
ata UrdhvaM mahAbAhuH kiM chakAra mahAyashAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dattvA varamutta~NkAya prAyAtsAtyakinA saha |
dvArakAmeva govindaH shIghravegairmahAhayaiH
shlokas.3:
sarA.nsi cha nadIshchaiva vanAni vividhAni cha |
atikramya sasAdAtha ramyAM dvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.4:
vartamAne mahArAja mahe raivatakasya cha |
upAyAtpuNDarIkAkSho yuyudhAnAnugastadA
shlokas.5:
ala~NkRRitastu sa girirnAnArUpavichitritaiH |
babhau rukmamayaiH kAshaiH sarvataH puruSharShabha
shlokas.6:
kA~nchanasragbhiragryAbhiH sumanobhistathaiva cha |
vAsobhishcha mahAshailaH kalpavRRikShaishcha sarvashaH
shlokas.7:
dIpavRRikShaishcha sauvarNairabhIkShNamupashobhitaH |
guhAnirjharadesheShu divAbhUto babhUva ha
shlokas.8:
patAkAbhirvichitrAbhiH saghaNTAbhiH samantataH |
pumbhiH strIbhishcha sa~NghuShTaH pragIta iva chAbhavat
atIva prekShaNIyo.abhUnmerurmunigaNairiva
shlokas.9:
mattAnAM hRRiShTarUpANAM strINAM pu.nsAM cha bhArata |
gAyatAM parvatendrasya divaspRRigiva nisvanaH
shlokas.10:
pramattamattasaMmattakShveDitotkRRiShTasa~NkulA |
tathA kilakilAshabdairbhUrabhUtsumanoharA
shlokas.11:
vipaNApaNavAnramyo bhakShyabhojyavihAravAn |
vastramAlyotkarayuto vINAveNumRRida~NgavAn
shlokas.12:
surAmaireyamishreNa bhakShyabhojyena chaiva ha |
dInAndhakRRipaNAdibhyo dIyamAnena chAnisham
babhau paramakalyANo mahastasya mahAgireH
shlokas.13:
puNyAvasathavAnvIra puNyakRRidbhirniShevitaH |
vihAro vRRiShNivIrANAM mahe raivatakasya ha
sa nago veshmasa~NkIrNo devaloka ivAbabhau
shlokas.14:
tadA cha kRRiShNasAMnidhyamAsAdya bharatarShabha |
shakrasadmapratIkAsho babhUva sa hi shailarAT
shlokas.15:
tataH sampUjyamAnaH sa vivesha bhavanaM shubham |
govindaH sAtyakishchaiva jagAma bhavanaM svakam
shlokas.16:
vivesha cha sa hRRiShTAtmA chirakAlapravAsakaH |
kRRitvA nasukaraM karma dAnaveShviva vAsavaH
shlokas.17:
upayAtaM tu vArShNeyaM bhojavRRiShNyandhakAstadA |
abhyagachChanmahAtmAnaM devA iva shatakratum
shlokas.18:
sa tAnabhyarchya medhAvI pRRiShTvA cha kushalaM tadA |
abhyavAdayata prItaH pitaraM mAtaraM tathA
shlokas.19:
tAbhyAM cha sampariShvaktaH sAntvitashcha mahAbhujaH |
upopaviShTastaiH sarvairvRRiShNibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.20:
sa vishrAnto mahAtejAH kRRitapAdAvasechanaH |
kathayAmAsa taM kRRiShNaH pRRiShTaH pitrA mahAhavam

shlokas.1:
vasudeva uvAcha||
shrutavAnasmi vArShNeya sa~NgrAmaM paramAdbhutam |
narANAM vadatAM putra kathodghAteShu nityashaH
shlokas.2:
tvaM tu pratyakShadarshI cha kAryaj~nashcha mahAbhuja |
tasmAtprabrUhi sa~NgrAmaM yAthAtathyena me.anagha
shlokas.3:
yathA tadabhavadyuddhaM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
bhIShmakarNakRRipadroNashalyAdibhiranuttamam
shlokas.4:
anyeShAM kShatriyANAM cha kRRitAstrANAmanekashaH |
nAnAveShAkRRitimatAM nAnAdeshanivAsinAm
shlokas.5:
ityuktaH puNDarIkAkShaH pitrA mAtustadantike |
shasha.nsa kuruvIrANAM sa~NgrAme nidhanaM yathA
shlokas.6:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
atyadbhutAni karmANi kShatriyANAM mahAtmanAm |
bahulatvAnna sa~NkhyAtuM shakyAnyabdashatairapi
shlokas.7:
prAdhAnyatastu gadataH samAsenaiva me shRRiNu |
karmANi pRRithivIshAnAM yathAvadamaradyute
shlokas.8:
bhIShmaH senApatirabhUdekAdashachamUpatiH |
kauravyaH kauraveyANAM devAnAmiva vAsavaH
shlokas.9:
shikhaNDI pANDuputrANAM netA saptachamUpatiH |
babhUva rakShito dhImAndhImatA savyasAchinA
shlokas.10:
teShAM tadabhavadyuddhaM dashAhAni mahAtmanAm |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha sumahadromaharShaNam
shlokas.11:
tataH shikhaNDI gA~NgeyamayudhyantaM mahAhave |
jaghAna bahubhirbANaiH saha gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.12:
akarotsa tataH kAlaM sharatalpagato muniH |
ayanaM dakShiNaM hitvA samprApte chottarAyaNe
shlokas.13:
tataH senApatirabhUddroNo.astraviduShAM varaH |
pravIraH kauravendrasya kAvyo daityapateriva
shlokas.14:
akShauhiNIbhiH shiShTAbhirnavabhirdvijasattamaH |
sa.nvRRitaH samarashlAghI guptaH kRRipavRRiShAdibhiH
shlokas.15:
dhRRiShTadyumnastvabhUnnetA pANDavAnAM mahAstravit |
gupto bhImena tejasvI mitreNa varuNo yathA
shlokas.16:
pa~nchasenAparivRRito droNaprepsurmahAmanAH |
piturnikArAnsa.nsmRRitya raNe karmAkaronmahat
shlokas.17:
tasmi.nste pRRithivIpAlA droNapArShatasa~Ngare |
nAnAdigAgatA vIrAH prAyasho nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.18:
dinAni pa~ncha tadyuddhamabhUtparamadAruNam |
tato droNaH parishrAnto dhRRiShTadyumnavashaM gataH
shlokas.19:
tataH senApatirabhUtkarNo dauryodhane bale |
akShauhiNIbhiH shiShTAbhirvRRitaH pa~nchabhirAhave
shlokas.20:
tisrastu pANDuputrANAM chamvo bIbhatsupAlitAH |
hatapravIrabhUyiShThA babhUvuH samavasthitAH
shlokas.21:
tataH pArthaM samAsAdya pata~Nga iva pAvakam |
pa~nchatvamagamatsautirdvitIye.ahani dAruNe
shlokas.22:
hate karNe tu kauravyA nirutsAhA hataujasaH |
akShauhiNIbhistisRRibhirmadreshaM paryavArayan
shlokas.23:
hatavAhanabhUyiShThAH pANDavAstu yudhiShThiram |
akShauhiNyA nirutsAhAH shiShTayA paryavArayan
shlokas.24:
avadhInmadrarAjAnaM kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
tasmi.nstathArdhadivase karma kRRitvA suduShkaram
shlokas.25:
hate shalye tu shakuniM sahadevo mahAmanAH |
AhartAraM kalestasya jaghAnAmitavikramaH
shlokas.26:
nihate shakunau rAjA dhArtarAShTraH sudurmanAH |
apAkrAmadgadApANirhatabhUyiShThasainikaH
shlokas.27:
tamanvadhAvatsa~Nkruddho bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
hrade dvaipAyane chApi salilasthaM dadarsha tam
shlokas.28:
tataH shiShTena sainyena samantAtparivArya tam |
upopavivishurhRRiShTA hradasthaM pa~ncha pANDavAH
shlokas.29:
vigAhya salilaM tvAshu vAgbANairbhRRishavikShataH |
utthAya sa gadApANiryuddhAya samupasthitaH
shlokas.30:
tataH sa nihato rAjA dhArtarAShTro mahAmRRidhe |
bhImasenena vikramya pashyatAM pRRithivIkShitAm
shlokas.31:
tatastatpANDavaM sainyaM sa.nsuptaM shibire nishi |
nihataM droNaputreNa piturvadhamamRRiShyatA
shlokas.32:
hataputrA hatabalA hatamitrA mayA saha |
yuyudhAnadvitIyena pa~ncha shiShTAH sma pANDavAH
shlokas.33:
sahaiva kRRipabhojAbhyAM drauNiryuddhAdamuchyata |
yuyutsushchApi kauravyo muktaH pANDavasa.nshrayAt
shlokas.34:
nihate kauravendre cha sAnubandhe suyodhane |
viduraH sa~njayashchaiva dharmarAjamupasthitau
shlokas.35:
evaM tadabhavadyuddhamahAnyaShTAdasha prabho |
yatra te pRRithivIpAlA nihatAH svargamAvasan
shlokas.36:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shRRiNvatAM tu mahArAja kathAM tAM romaharShaNIm |
duHkhaharShaparikleshA vRRiShNInAmabhava.nstadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kathayanneva tu tadA vAsudevaH pratApavAn |
mahAbhAratayuddhaM tatkathAnte pituragrataH
shlokas.2:
abhimanyorvadhaM vIraH so.atyakrAmata bhArata |
apriyaM vasudevasya mA bhUditi mahAmanAH
shlokas.3:
mA dauhitravadhaM shrutvA vasudevo mahAtyayam |
duHkhashokAbhisantapto bhavediti mahAmatiH
shlokas.4:
subhadrA tu tamutkrAntamAtmajasya vadhaM raNe |
AchakShva kRRiShNa saubhadravadhamityapatadbhuvi
shlokas.5:
tAmapashyannipatitAM vasudevaH kShitau tadA |
dRRiShTvaiva cha papAtorvyAM so.api duHkhena mUrChitaH
shlokas.6:
tataH sa dauhitravadhAdduHkhashokasamanvitaH |
vasudevo mahArAja kRRiShNaM vAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.7:
nanu tvaM puNDarIkAkSha satyavAgbhuvi vishrutaH |
yaddauhitravadhaM me.adya na khyApayasi shatruhan
shlokas.8:
tadbhAgineyanidhanaM tattvenAchakShva me vibho |
sadRRishAkShastava kathaM shatrubhirnihato raNe
shlokas.9:
durmaraM bata vArShNeya kAle.aprApte nRRibhiH sadA |
yatra me hRRidayaM duHkhAchChatadhA na vidIryate
shlokas.10:
kimabravIttvA sa~NgrAme subhadrAM mAtaraM prati |
mAM chApi puNDarIkAkSha chapalAkShaH priyo mama
shlokas.11:
AhavaM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA kachchinna nihataH paraiH |
kachchinmukhaM na govinda tenAjau vikRRitaM kRRitam
shlokas.12:
sa hi kRRiShNa mahAtejAH shlAghanniva mamAgrataH |
bAlabhAvena vijayamAtmano.akathayatprabhuH
shlokas.13:
kachchinna vikRRito bAlo droNakarNakRRipAdibhiH |
dharaNyAM nihataH shete tanmamAchakShva keshava
shlokas.14:
sa hi droNaM cha bhIShmaM cha karNaM cha rathinAM varam |
spardhate sma raNe nityaM duhituH putrako mama
shlokas.15:
eva.nvidhaM bahu tadA vilapantaM suduHkhitam |
pitaraM duHkhitataro govindo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.16:
na tena vikRRitaM vaktraM kRRitaM sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
na pRRiShThataH kRRitashchApi sa~NgrAmastena dustaraH
shlokas.17:
nihatya pRRithivIpAlAnsahasrashatasa~NghashaH |
khedito droNakarNAbhyAM dauHshAsanivashaM gataH
shlokas.18:
eko hyekena satataM yudhyamAno yadi prabho |
na sa shakyeta sa~NgrAme nihantumapi vajriNA
shlokas.19:
samAhUte tu sa~NgrAme pArthe sa.nshaptakaistadA |
paryavAryata sa~NkruddhaiH sa droNAdibhirAhave
shlokas.20:
tataH shatrukShayaM kRRitvA sumahAntaM raNe pituH |
dauhitrastava vArShNeya dauHshAsanivashaM gataH
shlokas.21:
nUnaM cha sa gataH svargaM jahi shokaM mahAmate |
na hi vyasanamAsAdya sIdante sannarAH kvachit
shlokas.22:
droNakarNaprabhRRitayo yena pratisamAsitAH |
raNe mahendrapratimAH sa kathaM nApnuyAddivam
shlokas.23:
sa shokaM jahi durdharSha mA cha manyuvashaM gamaH |
shastrapUtAM hi sa gatiM gataH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.24:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre subhadreyaM svasA mama |
duHkhArtAtho pRRithAM prApya kurarIva nanAda ha
shlokas.25:
draupadIM cha samAsAdya paryapRRichChata duHkhitA |
Arye kva dArakAH sarve draShTumichChAmi tAnaham
shlokas.26:
asyAstu vachanaM shrutvA sarvAstAH kuruyoShitaH |
bhujAbhyAM parigRRihyainAM chukrushuH paramArtavat
shlokas.27:
uttarAM chAbravIdbhadrA bhadre bhartA kva te gataH |
kShipramAgamanaM mahyaM tasmai tvaM vedayasva ha
shlokas.28:
nanu nAma sa vairATi shrutvA mama giraM purA |
bhavanAnniShpatatyAshu kasmAnnAbhyeti te patiH
shlokas.29:
abhimanyo kushalino mAtulAste mahArathAH |
kushalaM chAbruvansarve tvAM yuyutsumihAgatam
shlokas.30:
AchakShva me.adya sa~NgrAmaM yathApUrvamari.ndama |
kasmAdeva vilapatIM nAdyeha pratibhAShase
shlokas.31:
evamAdi tu vArShNeyyAstadasyAH paridevitam |
shrutvA pRRithA suduHkhArtA shanairvAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.32:
subhadre vAsudevena tathA sAtyakinA raNe |
pitrA cha pAlito bAlaH sa hataH kAladharmaNA
shlokas.33:
IdRRisho martyadharmo.ayaM mA shucho yadunandini |
putro hi tava durdharShaH samprAptaH paramAM gatim
shlokas.34:
kule mahati jAtAsi kShatriyANAM mahAtmanAm |
mA shuchashchapalAkShaM tvaM puNDarIkanibhekShaNe
shlokas.35:
uttarAM tvamavekShasva garbhiNIM mA shuchaH shubhe |
putrameShA hi tasyAshu janayiShyati bhAminI
shlokas.36:
evamAshvAsayitvainAM kuntI yadukulodvaha |
vihAya shokaM durdharShaM shrAddhamasya hyakalpayat
shlokas.37:
samanuj~nApya dharmaj~nA rAjAnaM bhImameva cha |
yamau yamopamau chaiva dadau dAnAnyanekashaH
shlokas.38:
tataH pradAya bahvIrgA brAhmaNebhyo yadUdvaha |
samahRRiShyata vArShNeyI vairATIM chAbravIdidam
shlokas.39:
vairATi neha santApastvayA kAryo yashasvini |
bhartAraM prati sushroNi garbhasthaM rakSha me shishum
shlokas.40:
evamuktvA tataH kuntI virarAma mahAdyute |
tAmanuj~nApya chaivemAM subhadrAM samupAnayam
shlokas.41:
evaM sa nidhanaM prApto dauhitrastava mAdhava |
santApaM jahi durdharSha mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu putrasya vachaH shUrAtmajastadA |
vihAya shokaM dharmAtmA dadau shrAddhamanuttamam
shlokas.2:
tathaiva vAsudevo.api svasrIyasya mahAtmanaH |
dayitasya piturnityamakarodaurdhvadehikam
shlokas.3:
ShaShTiM shatasahasrANi brAhmaNAnAM mahAbhujaH |
vidhivadbhojayAmAsa bhojyaM sarvaguNAnvitam
shlokas.4:
AchChAdya cha mahAbAhurdhanatRRiShNAmapAnudat |
brAhmaNAnAM tadA kRRiShNastadabhUdromaharShaNam
shlokas.5:
suvarNaM chaiva gAshchaiva shayanAchChAdanaM tathA |
dIyamAnaM tadA viprAH prabhUtamiti chAbruvan
shlokas.6:
vAsudevo.atha dAshArho baladevaH sasAtyakiH |
abhimanyostadA shrAddhamakurvansatyakastadA
atIva duHkhasantaptA na shamaM chopalebhire
shlokas.7:
tathaiva pANDavA vIrA nagare nAgasAhvaye |
nopagachChanti vai shAntimabhimanyuvinAkRRitAH
shlokas.8:
subahUni cha rAjendra divasAni virATajA |
nAbhu~Nkta patishokArtA tadabhUtkaruNaM mahat
kukShistha eva tasyAstu sa garbhaH sampralIyata
shlokas.9:
AjagAma tato vyAso j~nAtvA divyena chakShuShA |
Agamya chAbravIddhImAnpRRithAM pRRithulalochanAm
uttarAM cha mahAtejAH shokaH santyajyatAmayam
shlokas.10:
janiShyati mahAtejAH putrastava yashasvini |
prabhAvAdvAsudevasya mama vyAharaNAdapi
pANDavAnAmayaM chAnte pAlayiShyati medinIm
shlokas.11:
dhana~njayaM cha samprekShya dharmarAjasya pashyataH |
vyAso vAkyamuvAchedaM harShayanniva bhArata
shlokas.12:
pautrastava mahAbAho janiShyati mahAmanAH |
pRRithvIM sAgaraparyantAM pAlayiShyati chaiva ha
shlokas.13:
tasmAchChokaM kurushreShTha jahi tvamarikarshana |
vichAryamatra na hi te satyametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
yachchApi vRRiShNivIreNa kRRiShNena kurunandana |
puroktaM tattathA bhAvi mA te.atrAstu vichAraNA
shlokas.15:
vibudhAnAM gato lokAnakShayAnAtmanirjitAn |
na sa shochyastvayA tAta na chAnyaiH kurubhistathA
shlokas.16:
evaM pitAmahenokto dharmAtmA sa dhana~njayaH |
tyaktvA shokaM mahArAja hRRiShTarUpo.abhavattadA
shlokas.17:
pitApi tava dharmaj~na garbhe tasminmahAmate |
avardhata yathAkAlaM shuklapakShe yathA shashI
shlokas.18:
tataH sa~nchodayAmAsa vyAso dharmAtmajaM nRRipam |
ashvamedhaM prati tadA tataH so.antarhito.abhavat
shlokas.19:
dharmarAjo.api medhAvI shrutvA vyAsasya tadvachaH |
vittopanayane tAta chakAra gamane matim

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
shrutvaitadvachanaM brahmanvyAsenoktaM mahAtmanA |
ashvamedhaM prati tadA kiM nRRipaH prachakAra ha
shlokas.2:
ratnaM cha yanmaruttena nihitaM pRRithivItale |
tadavApa kathaM cheti tanme brUhi dvijottama
shlokas.3:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA dvaipAyanavacho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtR^InsarvAnsamAnAyya kAle vachanamabravIt
arjunaM bhImasenaM cha mAdrIputrau yamAvapi
shlokas.4:
shrutaM vo vachanaM vIrAH sauhRRidAdyanmahAtmanA |
kurUNAM hitakAmena proktaM kRRiShNena dhImatA
shlokas.5:
tapovRRiddhena mahatA suhRRidAM bhUtimichChatA |
guruNA dharmashIlena vyAsenAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.6:
bhIShmeNa cha mahAprAj~na govindena cha dhImatA |
sa.nsmRRitya tadahaM samyakkartumichChAmi pANDavAH
shlokas.7:
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha sarveShAM taddhi no hitam |
anubandhe cha kalyANaM yadvacho brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.8:
iyaM hi vasudhA sarvA kShINaratnA kurUdvahAH |
tachchAchaShTa bahu vyAso maruttasya dhanaM nRRipAH
shlokas.9:
yadyetadvo bahumataM manyadhvaM vA kShamaM yadi |
tadAnayAmahe sarve kathaM vA bhIma manyase
shlokas.10:
ityuktavAkye nRRipatau tadA kurukulodvaha |
bhImaseno nRRipashreShThaM prA~njalirvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.11:
rochate me mahAbAho yadidaM bhAShitaM tvayA |
vyAsAkhyAtasya vittasya samupAnayanaM prati
shlokas.12:
yadi tatprApnuyAmeha dhanamAvikShitaM prabho |
kRRitameva mahArAja bhavediti matirmama
shlokas.13:
te vayaM praNipAtena girIshasya mahAtmanaH |
tadAnayAma bhadraM te samabhyarchya kapardinam
shlokas.14:
taM vibhuM devadeveshaM tasyaivAnucharA.nshcha tAn |
prasAdyArthamavApsyAmo nUnaM vAgbuddhikarmabhiH
shlokas.15:
rakShante ye cha taddravyaM ki~NkarA raudradarshanAH |
te cha vashyA bhaviShyanti prasanne vRRiShabhadhvaje
shlokas.16:
shrutvaivaM vadatastasya vAkyaM bhImasya bhArata |
prIto dharmAtmajo rAjA babhUvAtIva bhArata
arjunapramukhAshchApi tathetyevAbruvanmudA
shlokas.17:
kRRitvA tu pANDavAH sarve ratnAharaNanishchayam |
senAmAj~nApayAmAsurnakShatre.ahani cha dhruve
shlokas.18:
tato yayuH pANDusutA brAhmaNAnsvasti vAchya cha |
archayitvA surashreShThaM pUrvameva maheshvaram
shlokas.19:
modakaiH pAyasenAtha mA.nsApUpaistathaiva cha |
AshAsya cha mahAtmAnaM prayayurmuditA bhRRisham
shlokas.20:
teShAM prayAsyatAM tatra ma~NgalAni shubhAnyatha |
prAhuH prahRRiShTamanaso dvijAgryA nAgarAshcha te
shlokas.21:
tataH pradakShiNIkRRitya shirobhiH praNipatya cha |
brAhmaNAnagnisahitAnprayayuH pANDunandanAH
shlokas.22:
samanuj~nApya rAjAnaM putrashokasamAhatam |
dhRRitarAShTraM sabhAryaM vai pRRithAM pRRithulalochanAm
shlokas.23:
mUle nikShipya kauravyaM yuyutsuM dhRRitarAShTrajam |
sampUjyamAnAH pauraishcha brAhmaNaishcha manIShibhiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste prayayurhRRiShTAH prahRRiShTanaravAhanAH |
rathaghoSheNa mahatA pUrayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.2:
sa.nstUyamAnAH stutibhiH sUtamAgadhabandibhiH |
svena sainyena sa.nvItA yathAdityAH svarashmibhiH
shlokas.3:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
babhau yudhiShThirastatra paurNamAsyAmivoDurAT
shlokas.4:
jayAshiShaH prahRRiShTAnAM narANAM pathi pANDavaH |
pratyagRRihNAdyathAnyAyaM yathAvatpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.5:
tathaiva sainikA rAjanrAjAnamanuyAnti ye |
teShAM halahalAshabdo divaM stabdhvA vyatiShThata
shlokas.6:
sa sarA.nsi nadIshchaiva vanAnyupavanAni cha |
atyakrAmanmahArAjo giriM chaivAnvapadyata
shlokas.7:
tasmindeshe cha rAjendra yatra taddravyamuttamam |
chakre niveshanaM rAjA pANDavaH saha sainikaiH
shive deshe same chaiva tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.8:
agrato brAhmaNAnkRRitvA tapovidyAdamAnvitAn |
purohitaM cha kauravya vedavedA~NgapAragam
shlokas.9:
prA~NniveshAttu rAjAnaM brAhmaNAH sapurodhasaH |
kRRitvA shAntiM yathAnyAyaM sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.10:
kRRitvA cha madhye rAjAnamamAtyA.nshcha yathAvidhi |
ShaTpathaM navasa.nsthAnaM niveshaM chakrire dvijAH
shlokas.11:
mattAnAM vAraNendrANAM niveshaM cha yathAvidhi |
kArayitvA sa rAjendro brAhmaNAnidamabravIt
shlokas.12:
asminkArye dvijashreShThA nakShatre divase shubhe |
yathA bhavanto manyante kartumarhatha tattathA
shlokas.13:
na naH kAlAtyayo vai syAdihaiva parilambatAm |
iti nishchitya viprendrAH kriyatAM yadanantaram
shlokas.14:
shrutvaitadvachanaM rAj~no brAhmaNAH sapurodhasaH |
idamUchurvacho hRRiShTA dharmarAjapriyepsavaH
shlokas.15:
adyaiva nakShatramahashcha puNyaM; yatAmahe shreShThatamaM kriyAsu |
ambhobhiradyeha vasAma rAja;nnupoShyatAM chApi bhavadbhiradya
shlokas.16:
shrutvA tu teShAM dvijasattamAnAM; kRRitopavAsA rajanIM narendrAH |
UShuH pratItAH kushasa.nstareShu; yathAdhvareShu jvalitA havyavAhAH
shlokas.17:
tato nishA sA vyagamanmahAtmanAM; sa.nshRRiNvatAM viprasamIritA giraH |
tataH prabhAte vimale dvijarShabhA; vacho.abruvandharmasutaM narAdhipam

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNA UchuH||
kriyatAmupahAro.adya tryambakasya mahAtmanaH |
kRRitvopahAraM nRRipate tataH svArthe yatAmahe
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tu vachanaM teShAM brAhmaNAnAM yudhiShThiraH |
girIshasya yathAnyAyamupahAramupAharat
shlokas.3:
Ajyena tarpayitvAgniM vidhivatsa.nskRRitena ha |
mantrasiddhaM charuM kRRitvA purodhAH prayayau tadA
shlokas.4:
sa gRRihItvA sumanaso mantrapUtA janAdhipa |
modakaiH pAyasenAtha mA.nsaishchopAharadbalim
shlokas.5:
sumanobhishcha chitrAbhirlAjairuchchAvachairapi |
sarvaM sviShTakRRitaM kRRitvA vidhivadvedapAragaH
ki~NkarANAM tataH pashchAchchakAra balimuttamam
shlokas.6:
yakShendrAya kuberAya maNibhadrAya chaiva ha |
tathAnyeShAM cha yakShANAM bhUtAdhipatayashcha ye
shlokas.7:
kRRisareNa samA.nsena nivApaistilasa.nyutaiH |
shushubhe sthAnamatyarthaM devadevasya pArthiva
shlokas.8:
kRRitvA tu pUjAM rudrasya gaNAnAM chaiva sarvashaH |
yayau vyAsaM puraskRRitya nRRipo ratnanidhiM prati
shlokas.9:
pUjayitvA dhanAdhyakShaM praNipatyAbhivAdya cha |
sumanobhirvichitrAbhirapUpaiH kRRisareNa cha
shlokas.10:
sha~NkhAdI.nshcha nidhInsarvAnnidhipAlA.nshcha sarvashaH |
archayitvA dvijAgryAnsa svasti vAchya cha vIryavAn
shlokas.11:
teShAM puNyAhaghoSheNa tejasA samavasthitaH |
prItimAnsa kurushreShThaH khAnayAmAsa taM nidhim
shlokas.12:
tataH pAtryaH sakarakAH sAshmantakamanoramAH |
bhRRi~NgArANi kaTAhAni kalashAnvardhamAnakAn
shlokas.13:
bahUni cha vichitrANi bhAjanAni sahasrashaH |
uddhArayAmAsa tadA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.14:
teShAM lakShaNamapyAsInmahAnkarapuTastathA |
trilakShaM bhAjanaM rAja.nstulArdhamabhavannRRipa
shlokas.15:
vAhanaM pANDuputrasya tatrAsIttu vishAM pate |
ShaShTiruShTrasahasrANi shatAni dviguNA hayAH
shlokas.16:
vAraNAshcha mahArAja sahasrashatasaMmitAH |
shakaTAni rathAshchaiva tAvadeva kareNavaH
kharANAM puruShANAM cha parisa~NkhyA na vidyate
shlokas.17:
etadvittaM tadabhavadyaduddadhre yudhiShThiraH |
ShoDashAShTau chaturvi.nshatsahasraM bhAralakShaNam
shlokas.18:
eteShvAdhAya taddravyaM punarabhyarchya pANDavaH |
mahAdevaM prati yayau puraM nAgAhvayaM prati
shlokas.19:
dvaipAyanAbhyanuj~nAtaH puraskRRitya purohitam |
goyute goyute chaiva nyavasatpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.20:
sA purAbhimukhI rAja~njagAma mahatI chamUH |
kRRichChrAddraviNabhArArtA harShayantI kurUdvahAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etasminneva kAle tu vAsudevo.api vIryavAn |
upAyAdvRRiShNibhiH sArdhaM puraM vAraNasAhvayam
shlokas.2:
samayaM vAjimedhasya viditvA puruSharShabhaH |
yathokto dharmaputreNa vrajansa svapurIM prati
shlokas.3:
raukmiNeyena sahito yuyudhAnena chaiva ha |
chArudeShNena sAmbena gadena kRRitavarmaNA
shlokas.4:
sAraNena cha vIreNa nishaThenolmukena cha |
baladevaM puraskRRitya subhadrAsahitastadA
shlokas.5:
draupadImuttarAM chaiva pRRithAM chApyavalokakaH |
samAshvAsayituM chApi kShatriyA nihateshvarAH
shlokas.6:
tAnAgatAnsamIkShyaiva dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
pratyagRRihNAdyathAnyAyaM vidurashcha mahAmanAH
shlokas.7:
tatraiva nyavasatkRRiShNaH svarchitaH puruSharShabhaH |
vidureNa mahAtejAstathaiva cha yuyutsunA
shlokas.8:
vasatsu vRRiShNivIreShu tatrAtha janamejaya |
jaj~ne tava pitA rAjanparikShitparavIrahA
shlokas.9:
sa tu rAjA mahArAja brahmAstreNAbhipIDitaH |
shavo babhUva nishcheShTo harShashokavivardhanaH
shlokas.10:
hRRiShTAnAM siMhanAdena janAnAM tatra nisvanaH |
Avishya pradishaH sarvAH punareva vyupAramat
shlokas.11:
tataH so.atitvaraH kRRiShNo viveshAntaHpuraM tadA |
yuyudhAnadvitIyo vai vyathitendriyamAnasaH
shlokas.12:
tatastvaritamAyAntIM dadarsha svAM pitRRiShvasAm |
kroshantImabhidhAveti vAsudevaM punaH punaH
shlokas.13:
pRRiShThato draupadIM chaiva subhadrAM cha yashasvinIm |
savikroshaM sakaruNaM bAndhavAnAM striyo nRRipa
shlokas.14:
tataH kRRiShNaM samAsAdya kuntI rAjasutA tadA |
provAcha rAjashArdUla bAShpagadgadayA girA
shlokas.15:
vAsudeva mahAbAho suprajA devakI tvayA |
tvaM no gatiH pratiShThA cha tvadAyattamidaM kulam
shlokas.16:
yadupravIra yo.ayaM te svasrIyasyAtmajaH prabho |
ashvatthAmnA hato jAtastamujjIvaya keshava
shlokas.17:
tvayA hyetatpratij~nAtamaiShIke yadunandana |
ahaM sa~njIvayiShyAmi mRRitaM jAtamiti prabho
shlokas.18:
so.ayaM jAto mRRitastAta pashyainaM puruSharShabha |
uttarAM cha subhadrAM cha draupadIM mAM cha mAdhava
shlokas.19:
dharmaputraM cha bhImaM cha phalgunaM nakulaM tathA |
sahadevaM cha durdharSha sarvAnnastrAtumarhasi
shlokas.20:
asminprANAH samAyattAH pANDavAnAM mamaiva cha |
pANDoshcha piNDo dAshArha tathaiva shvashurasya me
shlokas.21:
abhimanyoshcha bhadraM te priyasya sadRRishasya cha |
priyamutpAdayAdya tvaM pretasyApi janArdana
shlokas.22:
uttarA hi priyoktaM vai kathayatyarisUdana |
abhimanyorvachaH kRRiShNa priyatvAtte na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
abravItkila dAshArha vairATImArjuniH purA |
mAtulasya kulaM bhadre tava putro gamiShyati
shlokas.24:
gatvA vRRiShNyandhakakulaM dhanurvedaM grahIShyati |
astrANi cha vichitrANi nItishAstraM cha kevalam
shlokas.25:
ityetatpraNayAttAta saubhadraH paravIrahA |
kathayAmAsa durdharShastathA chaitanna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
tAstvAM vayaM praNamyeha yAchAmo madhusUdana |
kulasyAsya hitArthaM tvaM kuru kalyANamuttamam
shlokas.27:
evamuktvA tu vArShNeyaM pRRithA pRRithulalochanA |
uchChritya bAhU duHkhArtA tAshchAnyAH prApatanbhuvi
shlokas.28:
abruva.nshcha mahArAja sarvAH sAsrAvilekShaNAH |
svasrIyo vAsudevasya mRRito jAta iti prabho
shlokas.29:
evamukte tataH kuntIM pratyagRRihNAjjanArdanaH |
bhUmau nipatitAM chainAM sAntvayAmAsa bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
utthitAyAM pRRithAyAM tu subhadrA bhrAtaraM tadA |
dRRiShTvA chukrosha duHkhArtA vachanaM chedamabravIt
shlokas.2:
puNDarIkAkSha pashyasva pautraM pArthasya dhImataH |
parikShINeShu kuruShu parikShINaM gatAyuSham
shlokas.3:
iShIkA droNaputreNa bhImasenArthamudyatA |
sottarAyAM nipatitA vijaye mayi chaiva ha
shlokas.4:
seyaM jvalantI hRRidaye mayi tiShThati keshava |
yanna pashyAmi durdharSha mama putrasutaM vibho
shlokas.5:
kiM nu vakShyati dharmAtmA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhImasenArjunau chApi mAdravatyAH sutau cha tau
shlokas.6:
shrutvAbhimanyostanayaM jAtaM cha mRRitameva cha |
muShitA iva vArShNeya droNaputreNa pANDavAH
shlokas.7:
abhimanyuH priyaH kRRiShNa pitR^INAM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
te shrutvA kiM nu vakShyanti droNaputrAstranirjitAH
shlokas.8:
bhavitAtaH paraM duHkhaM kiM nu manye janArdana |
abhimanyoH sutAtkRRiShNa mRRitAjjAtAdari.ndama
shlokas.9:
sAhaM prasAdaye kRRiShNa tvAmadya shirasA natA |
pRRitheyaM draupadI chaiva tAH pashya puruShottama
shlokas.10:
yadA droNasuto garbhAnpANDUnAM hanti mAdhava |
tadA kila tvayA drauNiH kruddhenokto.arimardana
shlokas.11:
akAmaM tvA kariShyAmi brahmabandho narAdhama |
ahaM sa~njIvayiShyAmi kirITitanayAtmajam
shlokas.12:
ityetadvachanaM shrutvA jAnamAnA balaM tava |
prasAdaye tvA durdharSha jIvatAmabhimanyujaH
shlokas.13:
yadyevaM tvaM pratishrutya na karoShi vachaH shubham |
saphalaM vRRiShNishArdUla mRRitAM mAmupadhAraya
shlokas.14:
abhimanyoH suto vIra na sa~njIvati yadyayam |
jIvati tvayi durdharSha kiM kariShyAmyahaM tvayA
shlokas.15:
sa~njIvayainaM durdharSha mRRitaM tvamabhimanyujam |
sadRRishAkShasutaM vIra sasyaM varShannivAmbudaH
shlokas.16:
tvaM hi keshava dharmAtmA satyavAnsatyavikramaH |
sa tAM vAchamRRitAM kartumarhasi tvamari.ndama
shlokas.17:
ichChannapi hi lokA.nstrI~njIvayethA mRRitAnimAn |
kiM punardayitaM jAtaM svasrIyasyAtmajaM mRRitam
shlokas.18:
prabhAvaj~nAsmi te kRRiShNa tasmAdetadbravImi te |
kuruShva pANDuputrANAmimaM paramanugraham
shlokas.19:
svaseti vA mahAbAho hataputreti vA punaH |
prapannA mAmiyaM veti dayAM kartumihArhasi

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu rAjendra keshihA duHkhamUrChitaH |
tatheti vyAjahArochchairhlAdayanniva taM janam
shlokas.2:
vAkyena tena hi tadA taM janaM puruSharShabhaH |
hlAdayAmAsa sa vibhurgharmArtaM salilairiva
shlokas.3:
tataH sa prAvishattUrNaM janmaveshma pitustava |
architaM puruShavyAghra sitairmAlyairyathAvidhi
shlokas.4:
apAM kumbhaiH supUrNaishcha vinyastaiH sarvatodisham |
ghRRitena tindukAlAtaiH sarShapaishcha mahAbhuja
shlokas.5:
shastraishcha vimalairnyastaiH pAvakaishcha samantataH |
vRRiddhAbhishchAbhirAmAbhiH parichArArthamachyutaH
shlokas.6:
dakShaishcha parito vIra bhiShagbhiH kushalaistathA |
dadarsha cha sa tejasvI rakShoghnAnyapi sarvashaH
dravyANi sthApitAni sma vidhivatkushalairjanaiH
shlokas.7:
tathAyuktaM cha taddRRiShTvA janmaveshma pitustava |
hRRiShTo.abhavaddhRRiShIkeshaH sAdhu sAdhviti chAbravIt
shlokas.8:
tathA bruvati vArShNeye prahRRiShTavadane tadA |
draupadI tvaritA gatvA vairATIM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.9:
ayamAyAti te bhadre shvashuro madhusUdanaH |
purANarShirachintyAtmA samIpamaparAjitaH
shlokas.10:
sApi bAShpakalAM vAchaM nigRRihyAshrUNi chaiva ha |
susa.nvItAbhavaddevI devavatkRRiShNamIkShatI
shlokas.11:
sA tathA dUyamAnena hRRidayena tapasvinI |
dRRiShTvA govindamAyAntaM kRRipaNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.12:
puNDarIkAkSha pashyasva bAlAviha vinAkRRitau |
abhimanyuM cha mAM chaiva hatau tulyaM janArdana
shlokas.13:
vArShNeya madhuhanvIra shirasA tvAM prasAdaye |
droNaputrAstranirdagdhaM jIvayainaM mamAtmajam
shlokas.14:
yadi sma dharmarAj~nA vA bhImasenena vA punaH |
tvayA vA puNDarIkAkSha vAkyamuktamidaM bhavet
shlokas.15:
ajAnatImiShIkeyaM janitrIM hantviti prabho |
ahameva vinaShTA syAM nedameva~NgataM bhavet
shlokas.16:
garbhasthasyAsya bAlasya brahmAstreNa nipAtanam |
kRRitvA nRRisha.nsaM durbuddhirdrauNiH kiM phalamashnute
shlokas.17:
sA tvA prasAdya shirasA yAche shatrunibarhaNa |
prANA.nstyakShyAmi govinda nAyaM sa~njIvate yadi
shlokas.18:
asminhi bahavaH sAdho ye mamAsanmanorathAH |
te droNaputreNa hatAH kiM nu jIvAmi keshava
shlokas.19:
AsInmama matiH kRRiShNa pUrNotsa~NgA janArdana |
abhivAdayiShye diShTyeti tadidaM vitathIkRRitam
shlokas.20:
chapalAkShasya dAyAde mRRite.asminpuruSharShabha |
viphalA me kRRitAH kRRiShNa hRRidi sarve manorathAH
shlokas.21:
chapalAkShaH kilAtIva priyaste madhusUdana |
sutaM pashyasva tasyemaM brahmAstreNa nipAtitam
shlokas.22:
kRRitaghno.ayaM nRRisha.nso.ayaM yathAsya janakastathA |
yaH pANDavIM shriyaM tyaktvA gato.adya yamasAdanam
shlokas.23:
mayA chaitatpratij~nAtaM raNamUrdhani keshava |
abhimanyau hate vIra tvAmeShyAmyachirAditi
shlokas.24:
tachcha nAkaravaM kRRiShNa nRRisha.nsA jIvitapriyA |
idAnImAgatAM tatra kiM nu vakShyati phAlguniH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
saivaM vilapya karuNaM sonmAdeva tapasvinI |
uttarA nyapatadbhUmau kRRipaNA putragRRiddhinI
shlokas.2:
tAM tu dRRiShTvA nipatitAM hatabandhuparichChadAm |
chukrosha kuntI duHkhArtA sarvAshcha bharatastriyaH
shlokas.3:
muhUrtamiva tadrAjanpANDavAnAM niveshanam |
aprekShaNIyamabhavadArtasvaraninAditam
shlokas.4:
sA muhUrtaM cha rAjendra putrashokAbhipIDitA |
kashmalAbhihatA vIra vairATI tvabhavattadA
shlokas.5:
pratilabhya tu sA sa~nj~nAmuttarA bharatarShabha |
a~NkamAropya taM putramidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.6:
dharmaj~nasya sutaH sa.nstvamadharmamavabudhyase |
yastvaM vRRiShNipravIrasya kuruShe nAbhivAdanam
shlokas.7:
putra gatvA mama vacho brUyAstvaM pitaraM tava |
durmaraM prANinAM vIra kAle prApte katha~nchana
shlokas.8:
yAhaM tvayA vihInAdya patyA putreNa chaiva ha |
martavye sati jIvAmi hatasvastiraki~nchanA
shlokas.9:
atha vA dharmarAj~nAhamanuj~nAtA mahAbhuja |
bhakShayiShye viShaM tIkShNaM pravekShye vA hutAshanam
shlokas.10:
atha vA durmaraM tAta yadidaM me sahasradhA |
patiputravihInAyA hRRidayaM na vidIryate
shlokas.11:
uttiShTha putra pashyemAM duHkhitAM prapitAmahIm |
ArtAmupaplutAM dInAM nimagnAM shokasAgare
shlokas.12:
AryAM cha pashya pA~nchAlIM sAtvatIM cha tapasvinIm |
mAM cha pashya suduHkhArtAM vyAdhaviddhAM mRRigImiva
shlokas.13:
uttiShTha pashya vadanaM lokanAthasya dhImataH |
puNDarIkapalAshAkShaM pureva chapalekShaNam
shlokas.14:
evaM vipralapantIM tu dRRiShTvA nipatitAM punaH |
uttarAM tAH striyaH sarvAH punarutthApayantyuta
shlokas.15:
utthAya tu punardhairyAttadA matsyapateH sutA |
prA~njaliH puNDarIkAkShaM bhUmAvevAbhyavAdayat
shlokas.16:
shrutvA sa tasyA vipulaM vilApaM puruSharShabhaH |
upaspRRishya tataH kRRiShNo brahmAstraM sa~njahAra tat
shlokas.17:
pratijaj~ne cha dAshArhastasya jIvitamachyutaH |
abravIchcha vishuddhAtmA sarvaM vishrAvaya~njagat
shlokas.18:
na bravImyuttare mithyA satyametadbhaviShyati |
eSha sa~njIvayAmyenaM pashyatAM sarvadehinAm
shlokas.19:
noktapUrvaM mayA mithyA svaireShvapi kadAchana |
na cha yuddhe parAvRRittastathA sa~njIvatAmayam
shlokas.20:
yathA me dayito dharmo brAhmaNAshcha visheShataH |
abhimanyoH suto jAto mRRito jIvatvayaM tathA
shlokas.21:
yathAhaM nAbhijAnAmi vijayena kadAchana |
virodhaM tena satyena mRRito jIvatvayaM shishuH
shlokas.22:
yathA satyaM cha dharmashcha mayi nityaM pratiShThitau |
tathA mRRitaH shishurayaM jIvatAmabhimanyujaH
shlokas.23:
yathA ka.nsashcha keshI cha dharmeNa nihatau mayA |
tena satyena bAlo.ayaM punarujjIvatAmiha
shlokas.24:
ityukto vAsudevena sa bAlo bharatarShabha |
shanaiH shanairmahArAja prAspandata sachetanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
brahmAstraM tu yadA rAjankRRiShNena pratisaMhRRitam |
tadA tadveshma te pitrA tejasAbhividIpitam
shlokas.2:
tato rakShA.nsi sarvANi neshustyaktvA gRRihaM tu tat |
antarikShe cha vAgAsItsAdhu keshava sAdhviti
shlokas.3:
tadastraM jvalitaM chApi pitAmahamagAttadA |
tataH prANAnpunarlebhe pitA tava janeshvara
vyacheShTata cha bAlo.asau yathotsAhaM yathAbalam
shlokas.4:
babhUvurmuditA rAja.nstatastA bharatastriyaH |
brAhmaNAnvAchayAmAsurgovindasya cha shAsanAt
shlokas.5:
tatastA muditAH sarvAH prashasha.nsurjanArdanam |
striyo bharatasiMhAnAM nAvaM labdhveva pAragAH
shlokas.6:
kuntI drupadaputrI cha subhadrA chottarA tathA |
striyashchAnyA nRRisiMhAnAM babhUvurhRRiShTamAnasAH
shlokas.7:
tatra mallA naTA jhallA granthikAH saukhashAyikAH |
sUtamAgadhasa~NghAshchApyastuvanvai janArdanam
kuruva.nshastavAkhyAbhirAshIrbhirbharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
utthAya tu yathAkAlamuttarA yadunandanam |
abhyavAdayata prItA saha putreNa bhArata
tatastasyai dadau prIto bahuratnaM visheShataH
shlokas.9:
tathAnye vRRiShNishArdUlA nAma chAsyAkarotprabhuH |
pitustava mahArAja satyasandho janArdanaH
shlokas.10:
parikShINe kule yasmAjjAto.ayamabhimanyujaH |
parikShiditi nAmAsya bhavatvityabravIttadA
shlokas.11:
so.avardhata yathAkAlaM pitA tava narAdhipa |
manaHprahlAdanashchAsItsarvalokasya bhArata
shlokas.12:
mAsajAtastu te vIra pitA bhavati bhArata |
athAjagmuH subahulaM ratnamAdAya pANDavAH
shlokas.13:
tAnsamIpagatA~nshrutvA niryayurvRRiShNipu~NgavAH |
ala~nchakrushcha mAlyaughaiH puruShA nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.14:
patAkAbhirvichitrAbhirdhvajaishcha vividhairapi |
veshmAni samala~nchakruH paurAshchApi janAdhipa
shlokas.15:
devatAyatanAnAM cha pUjA bahuvidhAstathA |
sa.ndideshAtha viduraH pANDuputrapriyepsayA
shlokas.16:
rAjamArgAshcha tatrAsansumanobhirala~NkRRitAH |
shushubhe tatpuraM chApi samudraughanibhasvanam
shlokas.17:
nartakaishchApi nRRityadbhirgAyanAnAM cha nisvanaiH |
AsIdvaishravaNasyeva nivAsastatpuraM tadA
shlokas.18:
bandibhishcha narai rAjanstrIsahAyaiH sahasrashaH |
tatra tatra vivikteShu samantAdupashobhitam
shlokas.19:
patAkA dhUyamAnAshcha shvasatA mAtarishvanA |
adarshayanniva tadA kurUnvai dakShiNottarAn
shlokas.20:
aghoShayattadA chApi puruSho rAjadhUrgataH |
sarvarAtrivihAro.adya ratnAbharaNalakShaNaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tAnsamIpagatA~nshrutvA pANDavA~nshatrukarshanaH |
vAsudevaH sahAmAtyaH pratyudyAto didRRikShayA
shlokas.2:
te sametya yathAnyAyaM pANDavA vRRiShNibhiH saha |
vivishuH sahitA rAjanpuraM vAraNasAhvayam
shlokas.3:
mahatastasya sainyasya khuranemisvanena cha |
dyAvApRRithivyau khaM chaiva shabdenAsItsamAvRRitam
shlokas.4:
te koshamagrataH kRRitvA vivishuH svapuraM tadA |
pANDavAH prItamanasaH sAmAtyAH sasuhRRidgaNAH
shlokas.5:
te sametya yathAnyAyaM dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam |
kIrtayantaH svanAmAni tasya pAdau vavandire
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTrAdanu cha te gAndhArIM subalAtmajAm |
kuntIM cha rAjashArdUla tadA bharatasattamAH
shlokas.7:
viduraM pUjayitvA cha vaishyAputraM sametya cha |
pUjyamAnAH sma te vIrA vyarAjanta vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
tatastatparamAshcharyaM vichitraM mahadadbhutam |
shushruvuste tadA vIrAH pituste janma bhArata
shlokas.9:
tadupashrutya te karma vAsudevasya dhImataH |
pUjArhaM pUjayAmAsuH kRRiShNaM devakinandanam
shlokas.10:
tataH katipayAhasya vyAsaH satyavatIsutaH |
AjagAma mahAtejA nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.11:
tasya sarve yathAnyAyaM pUjAM chakruH kurUdvahAH |
saha vRRiShNyandhakavyAghrairupAsAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.12:
tatra nAnAvidhAkArAH kathAH samanukIrtya vai |
yudhiShThiro dharmasuto vyAsaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.13:
bhavatprasAdAdbhagavanyadidaM ratnamAhRRitam |
upayoktuM tadichChAmi vAjimedhe mahAkratau
shlokas.14:
tadanuj~nAtumichChAmi bhavatA munisattama |
tvadadhInA vayaM sarve kRRiShNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
vyAsa uvAcha||
anujAnAmi rAja.nstvAM kriyatAM yadanantaram |
yajasva vAjimedhena vidhivaddakShiNAvatA
shlokas.16:
ashvamedho hi rAjendra pAvanaH sarvapApmanAm |
teneShTvA tvaM vipApmA vai bhavitA nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.17:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tu dharmAtmA kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
ashvamedhasya kauravya chakArAharaNe matim
shlokas.18:
samanuj~nApya tu sa taM kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM nRRipaH |
vAsudevamathAmantrya vAgmI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.19:
devakI suprajA devI tvayA puruShasattama |
yadbrUyAM tvAM mahAbAho tatkRRithAstvamihAchyuta
shlokas.20:
tvatprabhAvArjitAnbhogAnashnIma yadunandana |
parAkrameNa buddhyA cha tvayeyaM nirjitA mahI
shlokas.21:
dIkShayasva tvamAtmAnaM tvaM naH paramako guruH |
tvayIShTavati dharmaj~na vipApmA syAmahaM vibho
tvaM hi yaj~no.akSharaH sarvastvaM dharmastvaM prajApatiH
shlokas.22:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
tvamevaitanmahAbAho vaktumarhasyari.ndama |
tvaM gatiH sarvabhUtAnAmiti me nishchitA matiH
shlokas.23:
tvaM chAdya kuruvIrANAM dharmeNAbhivirAjase |
guNabhUtAH sma te rAja.nstvaM no rAjanmato guruH
shlokas.24:
yajasva madanuj~nAtaH prApta eva kraturmayA |
yunaktu no bhavAnkArye yatra vA~nChasi bhArata
satyaM te pratijAnAmi sarvaM kartAsmi te.anagha
shlokas.25:
bhImasenArjunau chaiva tathA mAdravatIsutau |
iShTavanto bhaviShyanti tvayIShTavati bhArata

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu kRRiShNena dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
vyAsamAmantrya medhAvI tato vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
yathA kAlaM bhavAnvetti hayamedhasya tattvataH |
dIkShayasva tadA mA tvaM tvayyAyatto hi me kratuH
shlokas.3:
vyAsa uvAcha||
ahaM pailo.atha kaunteya yAj~navalkyastathaiva cha |
vidhAnaM yadyathAkAlaM tatkartAro na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.4:
chaitryAM hi paurNamAsyAM cha tava dIkShA bhaviShyati |
sambhArAH sambhriyantAM te yaj~nArthaM puruSharShabha
shlokas.5:
ashvavidyAvidashchaiva sUtA viprAshcha tadvidaH |
medhyamashvaM parIkShantAM tava yaj~nArthasiddhaye
shlokas.6:
tamutsRRijya yathAshAstraM pRRithivIM sAgarAmbarAm |
sa paryetu yasho nAmnA tava pArthiva vardhayan
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tathetyuktvA pANDavaH pRRithivIpatiH |
chakAra sarvaM rAjendra yathoktaM brahmavAdinA
sambhArAshchaiva rAjendra sarve sa~NkalpitAbhavan
shlokas.8:
sa sambhArAnsamAhRRitya nRRipo dharmAtmajastadA |
nyavedayadameyAtmA kRRiShNadvaipAyanAya vai
shlokas.9:
tato.abravInmahAtejA vyAso dharmAtmajaM nRRipam |
yathAkAlaM yathAyogaM sajjAH sma tava dIkShaNe
shlokas.10:
sphyashcha kUrchashcha sauvarNo yachchAnyadapi kaurava |
tatra yogyaM bhavetki~nchittadraukmaM kriyatAmiti
shlokas.11:
ashvashchotsRRijyatAmadya pRRithvyAmatha yathAkramam |
suguptashcha charatveSha yathAshAstraM yudhiShThira
shlokas.12:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ayamashvo mayA brahmannutsRRiShTaH pRRithivImimAm |
chariShyati yathAkAmaM tatra vai sa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.13:
pRRithivIM paryaTantaM hi turagaM kAmachAriNam |
kaH pAlayediti mune tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.14:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tu rAjendra kRRiShNadvaipAyano.abravIt |
bhImasenAdavarajaH shreShThaH sarvadhanuShmatAm
shlokas.15:
jiShNuH sahiShNurdhRRiShNushcha sa enaM pAlayiShyati |
shaktaH sa hi mahIM jetuM nivAtakavachAntakaH
shlokas.16:
tasminhyastrANi divyAni divyaM saMhananaM tathA |
divyaM dhanushcheShudhI cha sa enamanuyAsyati
shlokas.17:
sa hi dharmArthakushalaH sarvavidyAvishAradaH |
yathAshAstraM nRRipashreShTha chArayiShyati te hayam
shlokas.18:
rAjaputro mahAbAhuH shyAmo rAjIvalochanaH |
abhimanyoH pitA vIraH sa enamanuyAsyati
shlokas.19:
bhImaseno.api tejasvI kaunteyo.amitavikramaH |
samartho rakShituM rAShTraM nakulashcha vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
sahadevastu kauravya samAdhAsyati buddhimAn |
kuTumbatantraM vidhivatsarvameva mahAyashAH
shlokas.21:
tattu sarvaM yathAnyAyamuktaM kurukulodvahaH |
chakAra phalgunaM chApi sa.ndidesha hayaM prati
shlokas.22:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
ehyarjuna tvayA vIra hayo.ayaM paripAlyatAm |
tvamarho rakShituM hyenaM nAnyaH kashchana mAnavaH
shlokas.23:
ye chApi tvAM mahAbAho pratyudIyurnarAdhipAH |
tairvigraho yathA na syAttathA kAryaM tvayAnagha
shlokas.24:
AkhyAtavyashcha bhavatA yaj~no.ayaM mama sarvashaH |
pArthivebhyo mahAbAho samaye gamyatAmiti
shlokas.25:
evamuktvA sa dharmAtmA bhrAtaraM savyasAchinam |
bhImaM cha nakulaM chaiva puraguptau samAdadhat
shlokas.26:
kuTumbatantre cha tathA sahadevaM yudhAM patim |
anumAnya mahIpAlaM dhRRitarAShTraM yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dIkShAkAle tu samprApte tataste sumahartvijaH |
vidhivaddIkShayAmAsurashvamedhAya pArthivam
shlokas.2:
kRRitvA sa pashubandhA.nshcha dIkShitaH pANDunandanaH |
dharmarAjo mahAtejAH sahartvigbhirvyarochata
shlokas.3:
hayashcha hayamedhArthaM svayaM sa brahmavAdinA |
utsRRiShTaH shAstravidhinA vyAsenAmitatejasA
shlokas.4:
sa rAjA dharmajo rAjandIkShito vibabhau tadA |
hemamAlI rukmakaNThaH pradIpta iva pAvakaH
shlokas.5:
kRRiShNAjinI daNDapANiH kShaumavAsAH sa dharmajaH |
vibabhau dyutimAnbhUyaH prajApatirivAdhvare
shlokas.6:
tathaivAsyartvijaH sarve tulyaveShA vishAM pate |
babhUvurarjunashchaiva pradIpta iva pAvakaH
shlokas.7:
shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasAraM taM sasArAshvaM dhana~njayaH |
vidhivatpRRithivIpAla dharmarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.8:
vikShipangANDivaM rAjanbaddhagodhA~NgulitravAn |
tamashvaM pRRithivIpAla mudA yuktaH sasAra ha
shlokas.9:
AkumAraM tadA rAjannAgamattatpuraM vibho |
draShTukAmaM kurushreShThaM prayAsyantaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.10:
teShAmanyonyasaMmardAdUShmeva samajAyata |
didRRikShUNAM hayaM taM cha taM chaiva hayasAriNam
shlokas.11:
tataH shabdo mahArAja dashAshAH pratipUrayan |
babhUva prekShatAM nR^INAM kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.12:
eSha gachChati kaunteyasturagashchaiva dIptimAn |
yamanveti mahAbAhuH sa.nspRRishandhanuruttamam
shlokas.13:
evaM shushrAva vadatAM giro jiShNurudAradhIH |
svasti te.astu vrajAriShTaM punashchaihIti bhArata
shlokas.14:
athApare manuShyendra puruShA vAkyamabruvan |
nainaM pashyAma saMmarde dhanuretatpradRRishyate
shlokas.15:
etaddhi bhImanirhrAdaM vishrutaM gANDivaM dhanuH |
svasti gachChatvariShTaM vai panthAnamakutobhayam
nivRRittamenaM drakShyAmaH punarevaM cha te.abruvan
shlokas.16:
evamAdyA manuShyANAM strINAM cha bharatarShabha |
shushrAva madhurA vAchaH punaH punarudIritAH
shlokas.17:
yAj~navalkyasya shiShyashcha kushalo yaj~nakarmaNi |
prAyAtpArthena sahitaH shAntyarthaM vedapAragaH
shlokas.18:
brAhmaNAshcha mahIpAla bahavo vedapAragAH |
anujagmurmahAtmAnaM kShatriyAshcha visho.api cha
shlokas.19:
pANDavaiH pRRithivImashvo nirjitAmastratejasA |
chachAra sa mahArAja yathAdeshaM sa sattama
shlokas.20:
tatra yuddhAni vRRittAni yAnyAsanpANDavasya ha |
tAni vakShyAmi te vIra vichitrANi mahAnti cha
shlokas.21:
sa hayaH pRRithivIM rAjanpradakShiNamari.ndama |
sasArottarataH pUrvaM tannibodha mahIpate
shlokas.22:
avamRRidnansa rAShTrANi pArthivAnAM hayottamaH |
shanaistadA pariyayau shvetAshvashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.23:
tatra sa~NkalanA nAsti rAj~nAmayutashastadA |
ye.ayudhyanta mahArAja kShatriyA hatabAndhavAH
shlokas.24:
kirAtA vikRRitA rAjanbahavo.asidhanurdharAH |
mlechChAshchAnye bahuvidhAH pUrvaM vinikRRitA raNe
shlokas.25:
AryAshcha pRRithivIpAlAH prahRRiShTanaravAhanAH |
samIyuH pANDuputreNa bahavo yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.26:
evaM yuddhAni vRRittAni tatra tatra mahIpate |
arjunasya mahIpAlairnAnAdeshanivAsibhiH
shlokas.27:
yAni tUbhayato rAjanprataptAni mahAnti cha |
tAni yuddhAni vakShyAmi kaunteyasya tavAnagha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
trigartairabhavadyuddhaM kRRitavairaiH kirITinaH |
mahArathasamAj~nAtairhatAnAM putranaptRRibhiH
shlokas.2:
te samAj~nAya samprAptaM yaj~niyaM turagottamam |
viShayAnte tato vIrA da.nshitAH paryavArayan
shlokas.3:
rathino baddhatUNIrAH sadashvaiH samala~NkRRitaiH |
parivArya hayaM rAjangrahItuM samprachakramuH
shlokas.4:
tataH kirITI sa~nchintya teShAM rAj~nAM chikIrShitam |
vArayAmAsa tAnvIrAnsAntvapUrvamari.ndamaH
shlokas.5:
tamanAdRRitya te sarve sharairabhyahana.nstadA |
tamorajobhyAM sa~nChannA.nstAnkirITI nyavArayat
shlokas.6:
abravIchcha tato jiShNuH prahasanniva bhArata |
nivartadhvamadharmaj~nAH shreyo jIvitameva vaH
shlokas.7:
sa hi vIraH prayAsyanvai dharmarAjena vAritaH |
hatabAndhavA na te pArtha hantavyAH pArthivA iti
shlokas.8:
sa tadA tadvachaH shrutvA dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
tAnnivartadhvamityAha na nyavartanta chApi te
shlokas.9:
tatastrigartarAjAnaM sUryavarmANamAhave |
vitatya sharajAlena prajahAsa dhana~njayaH
shlokas.10:
tataste rathaghoSheNa khuranemisvanena cha |
pUrayanto dishaH sarvA dhana~njayamupAdravan
shlokas.11:
sUryavarmA tataH pArthe sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
shatAnyamu~nchadrAjendra laghvastramabhidarshayan
shlokas.12:
tathaivAnye maheShvAsA ye tasyaivAnuyAyinaH |
mumuchuH sharavarShANi dhana~njayavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.13:
sa tA~njyApu~NkhanirmuktairbahubhiH subahU~nsharAn |
chichCheda pANDavo rAja.nste bhUmau nyapata.nstadA
shlokas.14:
ketuvarmA tu tejasvI tasyaivAvarajo yuvA |
yuyudhe bhrAturarthAya pANDavena mahAtmanA
shlokas.15:
tamApatantaM samprekShya ketuvarmANamAhave |
abhyaghnannishitairbANairbIbhatsuH paravIrahA
shlokas.16:
ketuvarmaNyabhihate dhRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
rathenAshu samAvRRitya sharairjiShNumavAkirat
shlokas.17:
tasya tAM shIghratAmIkShya tutoShAtIva vIryavAn |
guDAkesho mahAtejA bAlasya dhRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.18:
na sa.ndadhAnaM dadRRishe nAdadAnaM cha taM tadA |
kirantameva sa sharAndadRRishe pAkashAsaniH
shlokas.19:
sa tu taM pUjayAmAsa dhRRitavarmANamAhave |
manasA sa muhUrtaM vai raNe samabhiharShayan
shlokas.20:
taM pannagamiva kruddhaM kuruvIraH smayanniva |
prItipUrvaM mahArAja prANairna vyaparopayat
shlokas.21:
sa tathA rakShyamANo vai pArthenAmitatejasA |
dhRRitavarmA sharaM tIkShNaM mumocha vijaye tadA
shlokas.22:
sa tena vijayastUrNamasyanviddhaH kare bhRRisham |
mumocha gANDIvaM duHkhAttatpapAtAtha bhUtale
shlokas.23:
dhanuShaH patatastasya savyasAchikarAdvibho |
indrasyevAyudhasyAsIdrUpaM bharatasattama
shlokas.24:
tasminnipatite divye mahAdhanuShi pArthiva |
jahAsa sasvanaM hAsaM dhRRitavarmA mahAhave
shlokas.25:
tato roShAnvito jiShNuH pramRRijya rudhiraM karAt |
dhanurAdatta taddivyaM sharavarShaM vavarSha cha
shlokas.26:
tato halahalAshabdo divaspRRigabhavattadA |
nAnAvidhAnAM bhUtAnAM tatkarmAtIva sha.nsatAm
shlokas.27:
tataH samprekShya taM kruddhaM kAlAntakayamopamam |
jiShNuM traigartakA yodhAstvaritAH paryavArayan
shlokas.28:
abhisRRitya parIpsArthaM tataste dhRRitavarmaNaH |
parivavrurguDAkeshaM tatrAkrudhyaddhana~njayaH
shlokas.29:
tato yodhA~njaghAnAshu teShAM sa dasha chAShTa cha |
mahendravajrapratimairAyasairnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
tA.nstu prabhagnAnsamprekShya tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
sharairAshIviShAkArairjaghAna svanavaddhasan
shlokas.31:
te bhagnamanasaH sarve traigartakamahArathAH |
disho vidudruvuH sarvA dhana~njayasharArditAH
shlokas.32:
ta UchuH puruShavyAghraM sa.nshaptakaniShUdanam |
tava sma ki~NkarAH sarve sarve cha vashagAstava
shlokas.33:
Aj~nApayasva naH pArtha prahvAnpreShyAnavasthitAn |
kariShyAmaH priyaM sarvaM tava kauravanandana
shlokas.34:
etadAj~nAya vachanaM sarvA.nstAnabravIttadA |
jIvitaM rakShata nRRipAH shAsanaM gRRihyatAmiti

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prAgjyotiShamathAbhyetya vyacharatsa hayottamaH |
bhagadattAtmajastatra niryayau raNakarkashaH
shlokas.2:
sa hayaM pANDuputrasya viShayAntamupAgatam |
yuyudhe bharatashreShTha vajradatto mahIpatiH
shlokas.3:
so.abhiniryAya nagarAdbhagadattasuto nRRipaH |
ashvamAyAntamunmathya nagarAbhimukho yayau
shlokas.4:
tamAlakShya mahAbAhuH kurUNAmRRiShabhastadA |
gANDIvaM vikShipa.nstUrNaM sahasA samupAdravat
shlokas.5:
tato gANDIvanirmuktairiShubhirmohito nRRipaH |
hayamutsRRijya taM vIrastataH pArthamupAdravat
shlokas.6:
punaH pravishya nagaraM da.nshitaH sa nRRipottamaH |
Aruhya nAgapravaraM niryayau yuddhakA~NkShayA
shlokas.7:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
dodhUyatA chAmareNa shvetena cha mahArathaH
shlokas.8:
tataH pArthaM samAsAdya pANDavAnAM mahAratham |
AhvayAmAsa kauravyaM bAlyAnmohAchcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.9:
sa vAraNaM nagaprakhyaM prabhinnakaraTAmukham |
preShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhastataH shvetahayaM prati
shlokas.10:
vikSharantaM yathA meghaM paravAraNavAraNam |
shAstravatkalpitaM sa~Nkhye trisAhaM yuddhadurmadam
shlokas.11:
prachodyamAnaH sa gajastena rAj~nA mahAbalaH |
tadA~Nkushena vibabhAvutpatiShyannivAmbaram
shlokas.12:
tamApatantaM samprekShya kruddho rAjandhana~njayaH |
bhUmiShTho vAraNagataM yodhayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.13:
vajradattastu sa~Nkruddho mumochAshu dhana~njaye |
tomarAnagnisa~NkAshA~nshalabhAniva vegitAn
shlokas.14:
arjunastAnasamprAptAngANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
dvidhA tridhA cha chichCheda kha eva khagamaistadA
shlokas.15:
sa tAndRRiShTvA tathA ChinnA.nstomarAnbhagadattajaH |
iShUnasaktA.nstvaritaH prAhiNotpANDavaM prati
shlokas.16:
tato.arjunastUrNataraM rukmapu~NkhAnajihmagAn |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho bhagadattAtmajaM prati
shlokas.17:
sa tairviddho mahAtejA vajradatto mahAhave |
bhRRishAhataH papAtorvyAM na tvenamajahAtsmRRitiH
shlokas.18:
tataH sa punarAruhya vAraNapravaraM raNe |
avyagraH preShayAmAsa jayArthI vijayaM prati
shlokas.19:
tasmai bANA.nstato jiShNurnirmuktAshIviShopamAn |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho jvalitAniva pAvakAn
shlokas.20:
sa tairviddho mahAnAgo visravanrudhiraM babhau |
himavAniva shailendro bahuprasravaNastadA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM trirAtramabhavattadyuddhaM bharatarShabha |
arjunasya narendreNa vRRitreNeva shatakratoH
shlokas.2:
tatashchaturthe divase vajradatto mahAbalaH |
jahAsa sasvanaM hAsaM vAkyaM chedamathAbravIt
shlokas.3:
arjunArjuna tiShThasva na me jIvanvimokShyase |
tvAM nihatya kariShyAmi pitustoyaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.4:
tvayA vRRiddho mama pitA bhagadattaH pituH sakhA |
hato vRRiddho.apachAyitvAchChishuM mAmadya yodhaya
shlokas.5:
ityevamuktvA sa~Nkruddho vajradatto narAdhipaH |
preShayAmAsa kauravya vAraNaM pANDavaM prati
shlokas.6:
sampreShyamANo nAgendro vajradattena dhImatA |
utpatiShyannivAkAshamabhidudrAva pANDavam
shlokas.7:
agrahastapramuktena shIkareNa sa phalgunam |
samukShata mahArAja shailaM nIla ivAmbudaH
shlokas.8:
sa tena preShito rAj~nA meghavanninadanmuhuH |
mukhADambaraghoSheNa samAdravata phalgunam
shlokas.9:
sa nRRityanniva nAgendro vajradattaprachoditaH |
AsasAda drutaM rAjankauravANAM mahAratham
shlokas.10:
tamApatantaM samprekShya vajradattasya vAraNam |
gANDIvamAshritya balI na vyakampata shatruhA
shlokas.11:
chukrodha balavachchApi pANDavastasya bhUpateH |
kAryavighnamanusmRRitya pUrvavairaM cha bhArata
shlokas.12:
tatastaM vAraNaM kruddhaH sharajAlena pANDavaH |
nivArayAmAsa tadA veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.13:
sa nAgapravaro vIryAdarjunena nivAritaH |
tasthau sharairvitunnA~NgaH shvAvichChalalito yathA
shlokas.14:
nivAritaM gajaM dRRiShTvA bhagadattAtmajo nRRipaH |
utsasarja shitAnbANAnarjune krodhamUrChitaH
shlokas.15:
arjunastu mahArAja sharaiH sharavighAtibhiH |
vArayAmAsa tAnastA.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.16:
