tataH punaratikruddho rAjA prAgjyotiShAdhipaH |
preShayAmAsa nAgendraM balavachChvasanopamam
shlokas.17:
tamApatantaM samprekShya balavAnpAkashAsaniH |
nArAchamagnisa~NkAshaM prAhiNodvAraNaM prati
shlokas.18:
sa tena vAraNo rAjanmarmaNyabhihato bhRRisham |
papAta sahasA bhUmau vajrarugNa ivAchalaH
shlokas.19:
sa pata~nshushubhe nAgo dhana~njayasharAhataH |
vishanniva mahAshailo mahIM vajraprapIDitaH
shlokas.20:
tasminnipatite nAge vajradattasya pANDavaH |
taM na bhetavyamityAha tato bhUmigataM nRRipam
shlokas.21:
abravIddhi mahAtejAH prasthitaM mAM yudhiShThiraH |
rAjAnaste na hantavyA dhana~njaya katha~nchana
shlokas.22:
sarvametannaravyAghra bhavatvetAvatA kRRitam |
yodhAshchApi na hantavyA dhana~njaya raNe tvayA
shlokas.23:
vaktavyAshchApi rAjAnaH sarvaiH saha suhRRijjanaiH |
yudhiShThirasyAshvamedho bhavadbhiranubhUyatAm
shlokas.24:
iti bhrAtRRivachaH shrutvA na hanmi tvAM janAdhipa |
uttiShTha na bhayaM te.asti svastimAngachCha pArthiva
shlokas.25:
AgachChethA mahArAja parAM chaitrImupasthitAm |
tadAshvamedho bhavitA dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.26:
evamuktaH sa rAjA tu bhagadattAtmajastadA |
tathetyevAbravIdvAkyaM pANDavenAbhinirjitaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
saindhavairabhavadyuddhaM tatastasya kirITinaH |
hatasheShairmahArAja hatAnAM cha sutairapi
shlokas.2:
te.avatIrNamupashrutya viShayaM shvetavAhanam |
pratyudyayuramRRiShyanto rAjAnaH pANDavarShabham
shlokas.3:
ashvaM cha taM parAmRRishya viShayAnte viShopamAH |
na bhayaM chakrire pArthAdbhImasenAdanantarAt
shlokas.4:
te.avidUrAddhanuShpANiM yaj~niyasya hayasya cha |
bIbhatsuM pratyapadyanta padAtinamavasthitam
shlokas.5:
tataste tu mahAvIryA rAjAnaH paryavArayan |
jigIShanto naravyAghrAH pUrvaM vinikRRitA yudhi
shlokas.6:
te nAmAnyatha gotrANi karmANi vividhAni cha |
kIrtayantastadA pArthaM sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.7:
te kirantaH sharA.nstIkShNAnvAraNendranivAraNAn |
raNe jayamabhIpsantaH kaunteyaM paryavArayan
shlokas.8:
te.asamIkShyaiva taM vIramugrakarmANamAhave |
sarve yuyudhire vIrA rathasthAstaM padAtinam
shlokas.9:
te tamAjaghnire vIraM nivAtakavachAntakam |
sa.nshaptakanihantAraM hantAraM saindhavasya cha
shlokas.10:
tato rathasahasreNa hayAnAmayutena cha |
koShThakIkRRitya kaunteyaM samprahRRiShTamayodhayan
shlokas.11:
sa.nsmaranto vadhaM vIrAH sindhurAjasya dhImataH |
jayadrathasya kauravya samare savyasAchinA
shlokas.12:
tataH parjanyavatsarve sharavRRiShTimavAsRRijan |
taiH kIrNaH shushubhe pArtho ravirmeghAntare yathA
shlokas.13:
sa sharaiH samavachChanno dadRRishe pANDavarShabhaH |
pa~njarAntarasa~nchArI shakunta iva bhArata
shlokas.14:
tato hAhAkRRitaM sarvaM kaunteye sharapIDite |
trailokyamabhavadrAjanravishchAsIdrajoruNaH
shlokas.15:
tato vavau mahArAja mAruto romaharShaNaH |
rAhuragrasadAdityaM yugapatsomameva cha
shlokas.16:
ulkAshcha jaghnire sUryaM vikIryantyaH samantataH |
vepathushchAbhavadrAjankailAsasya mahAgireH
shlokas.17:
mumuchushchAsramatyuShNaM duHkhashokasamanvitAH |
saptarShayo jAtabhayAstathA devarShayo.api cha
shlokas.18:
shashashchAshu vinirbhidya maNDalaM shashino.apatat |
viparItastadA rAja.nstasminnutpAtalakShaNe
shlokas.19:
rAsabhAruNasa~NkAshA dhanuShmantaH savidyutaH |
AvRRitya gaganaM meghA mumuchurmA.nsashoNitam
shlokas.20:
evamAsIttadA vIre sharavarShAbhisa.nvRRite |
loke.asminbharatashreShTha tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.21:
tasya tenAvakIrNasya sharajAlena sarvashaH |
mohAtpapAta gANDIvamAvApashcha karAdapi
shlokas.22:
tasminmohamanuprApte sharajAlaM mahattaram |
saindhavA mumuchustUrNaM gatasattve mahArathe
shlokas.23:
tato mohasamApannaM j~nAtvA pArthaM divaukasaH |
sarve vitrastamanasastasya shAntiparAbhavan
shlokas.24:
tato devarShayaH sarve tathA saptarShayo.api cha |
brahmarShayashcha vijayaM jepuH pArthasya dhImataH
shlokas.25:
tataH pradIpite devaiH pArthatejasi pArthiva |
tasthAvachalavaddhImAnsa~NgrAme paramAstravit
shlokas.26:
vichakarSha dhanurdivyaM tataH kauravanandanaH |
yantrasyeveha shabdo.abhUnmahA.nstasya punaH punaH
shlokas.27:
tataH sa sharavarShANi pratyamitrAnprati prabhuH |
vavarSha dhanuShA pArtho varShANIva sureshvaraH
shlokas.28:
tataste saindhavA yodhAH sarva eva sarAjakAH |
nAdRRishyanta sharaiH kIrNAH shalabhairiva pAvakAH
shlokas.29:
tasya shabdena vitresurbhayArtAshcha vidudruvuH |
mumuchushchAshru shokArtAH suShupushchApi saindhavAH
shlokas.30:
tA.nstu sarvAnnarashreShThaH sarvato vicharanbalI |
alAtachakravadrAja~nsharajAlaiH samarpayat
shlokas.31:
tadindrajAlapratimaM bANajAlamamitrahA |
vyasRRijaddikShu sarvAsu mahendra iva vajrabhRRit
shlokas.32:
meghajAlanibhaM sainyaM vidArya sa raviprabhaH |
vibabhau kauravashreShThaH sharadIva divAkaraH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato gANDIvabhRRichChUro yuddhAya samavasthitaH |
vibabhau yudhi durdharSho himavAnachalo yathA
shlokas.2:
tataH saindhavayodhAste punareva vyavasthitAH |
vimu~nchantaH susa.nrabdhAH sharavarShANi bhArata
shlokas.3:
tAnprasahya mahAvIryaH punareva vyavasthitAn |
tataH provAcha kaunteyo mumUrShU~nshlakShNayA girA
shlokas.4:
yudhyadhvaM parayA shaktyA yatadhvaM cha vadhe mama |
kurudhvaM sarvakAryANi mahadvo bhayamAgatam
shlokas.5:
eSha yotsyAmi vaH sarvAnnivArya sharavAgurAm |
tiShThadhvaM yuddhamanaso darpaM vinayitAsmi vaH
shlokas.6:
etAvaduktvA kauravyo ruShA gANDIvabhRRittadA |
tato.atha vachanaM smRRitvA bhrAturjyeShThasya bhArata
shlokas.7:
na hantavyA raNe tAta kShatriyA vijigIShavaH |
jetavyAshcheti yatproktaM dharmarAj~nA mahAtmanA
chintayAmAsa cha tadA phalgunaH puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.8:
ityukto.ahaM narendreNa na hantavyA nRRipA iti |
kathaM tanna mRRiSheha syAddharmarAjavachaH shubham
shlokas.9:
na hanyera.nshcha rAjAno rAj~nashchAj~nA kRRitA bhavet |
iti sa~nchintya sa tadA bhrAtuH priyahite rataH
provAcha vAkyaM dharmaj~naH saindhavAnyuddhadurmadAn
shlokas.10:
bAlAnstriyo vA yuShmAkaM na haniShye vyavasthitAn |
yashcha vakShyati sa~NgrAme tavAsmIti parAjitaH
shlokas.11:
etachChrutvA vacho mahyaM kurudhvaM hitamAtmanaH |
ato.anyathA kRRichChragatA bhaviShyatha mayArditAH
shlokas.12:
evamuktvA tu tAnvIrAnyuyudhe kurupu~NgavaH |
atvarAvAnasa.nrabdhaH sa.nrabdhairvijigIShubhiH
shlokas.13:
tataH shatasahasrANi sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
mumuchuH saindhavA rAja.nstadA gANDIvadhanvani
shlokas.14:
sa tAnApatataH krUrAnAshIviShaviShopamAn |
chichCheda nishitairbANairantaraiva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.15:
ChittvA tu tAnAshugamAnka~NkapatrA~nshilAshitAn |
ekaikameSha dashabhirbibheda samare sharaiH
shlokas.16:
tataH prAsA.nshcha shaktIshcha punareva dhana~njaye |
jayadrathaM hataM smRRitvA chikShipuH saindhavA nRRipAH
shlokas.17:
teShAM kirITI sa~NkalpaM moghaM chakre mahAmanAH |
sarvA.nstAnantarA ChittvA mudA chukrosha pANDavaH
shlokas.18:
tathaivApatatAM teShAM yodhAnAM jayagRRiddhinAm |
shirA.nsi pAtayAmAsa bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.19:
teShAM pradravatAM chaiva punareva cha dhAvatAm |
nivartatAM cha shabdo.abhUtpUrNasyeva mahodadheH
shlokas.20:
te vadhyamAnAstu tadA pArthenAmitatejasA |
yathAprANaM yathotsAhaM yodhayAmAsurarjunam
shlokas.21:
tataste phalgunenAjau sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
kRRitA visa~nj~nA bhUyiShThAH klAntavAhanasainikAH
shlokas.22:
tA.nstu sarvAnpariglAnAnviditvA dhRRitarAShTrajA |
duHshalA bAlamAdAya naptAraM prayayau tadA
surathasya sutaM vIraM rathenAnAgasaM tadA
shlokas.23:
shAntyarthaM sarvayodhAnAmabhyagachChata pANDavam |
sA dhana~njayamAsAdya mumochArtasvaraM tadA
dhana~njayo.api tAM dRRiShTvA dhanurvisasRRije prabhuH
shlokas.24:
samutsRRiShTadhanuH pArtho vidhivadbhaginIM tadA |
prAha kiM karavANIti sA cha taM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.25:
eSha te bharatashreShTha svasrIyasyAtmajaH shishuH |
abhivAdayate vIra taM pashya puruSharShabha
shlokas.26:
ityuktastasya pitaraM sa paprachChArjunastadA |
kvAsAviti tato rAjanduHshalA vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.27:
pitRRishokAbhisantapto viShAdArto.asya vai pitA |
pa~nchatvamagamadvIra yathA tanme nibodha ha
shlokas.28:
sa pUrvaM pitaraM shrutvA hataM yuddhe tvayAnagha |
tvAmAgataM cha sa.nshrutya yuddhAya hayasAriNam
pitushcha mRRityuduHkhArto.ajahAtprANAndhana~njaya
shlokas.29:
prApto bIbhatsurityeva nAma shrutvaiva te.anagha |
viShAdArtaH papAtorvyAM mamAra cha mamAtmajaH
shlokas.30:
taM tu dRRiShTvA nipatitaM tatastasyAtmajaM vibho |
gRRihItvA samanuprAptA tvAmadya sharaNaiShiNI
shlokas.31:
ityuktvArtasvaraM sA tu mumocha dhRRitarAShTrajA |
dInA dInaM sthitaM pArthamabravIchchApyadhomukham
shlokas.32:
svasAraM mAmavekShasva svasrIyAtmajameva cha |
kartumarhasi dharmaj~na dayAM mayi kurUdvaha
vismRRitya kururAjAnaM taM cha mandaM jayadratham
shlokas.33:
abhimanyoryathA jAtaH parikShitparavIrahA |
tathAyaM surathAjjAto mama pautro mahAbhuja
shlokas.34:
tamAdAya naravyAghra samprAptAsmi tavAntikam |
shamArthaM sarvayodhAnAM shRRiNu chedaM vacho mama
shlokas.35:
Agato.ayaM mahAbAho tasya mandasya pautrakaH |
prasAdamasya bAlasya tasmAttvaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.36:
eSha prasAdya shirasA mayA sArdhamari.ndama |
yAchate tvAM mahAbAho shamaM gachCha dhana~njaya
shlokas.37:
bAlasya hatabandhoshcha pArtha ki~nchidajAnataH |
prasAdaM kuru dharmaj~na mA manyuvashamanvagAH
shlokas.38:
tamanAryaM nRRisha.nsaM cha vismRRityAsya pitAmaham |
AgaskAriNamatyarthaM prasAdaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.39:
evaM bruvatyAM karuNaM duHshalAyAM dhana~njayaH |
sa.nsmRRitya devIM gAndhArIM dhRRitarAShTraM cha pArthivam
provAcha duHkhashokArtaH kShatradharmaM vigarhayan
shlokas.40:
dhiktaM duryodhanaM kShudraM rAjyalubdhaM cha mAninam |
yatkRRite bAndhavAH sarve mayA nItA yamakShayam
shlokas.41:
ityuktvA bahu sAntvAdi prasAdamakarojjayaH |
pariShvajya cha tAM prIto visasarja gRRihAnprati
shlokas.42:
duHshalA chApi tAnyodhAnnivArya mahato raNAt |
sampUjya pArthaM prayayau gRRihAnprati shubhAnanA
shlokas.43:
tataH saindhavakAnyodhAnvinirjitya nararShabhaH |
punarevAnvadhAvatsa taM hayaM kAmachAriNam
shlokas.44:
sasAra yaj~niyaM vIro vidhivatsa vishAM pate |
tArAmRRigamivAkAshe devadevaH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.45:
sa cha vAjI yatheShTena tA.nstAndeshAnyathAsukham |
vichachAra yathAkAmaM karma pArthasya vardhayan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrutvA tu nRRipatirvIraM pitaraM babhruvAhanaH |
niryayau vinayenAryo brAhmaNArghyapuraHsaraH
shlokas.2:
maNipUreshvaraM tvevamupayAtaM dhana~njayaH |
nAbhyanandata medhAvI kShatradharmamanusmaran
shlokas.3:
uvAcha chainaM dharmAtmA samanyuH phalgunastadA |
prakriyeyaM na te yuktA bahistvaM kShatradharmataH
shlokas.4:
sa.nrakShyamANaM turagaM yaudhiShThiramupAgatam |
yaj~niyaM viShayAnte mAM nAyotsIH kiM nu putraka
shlokas.5:
dhiktvAmastu sudurbuddhiM kShatradharmAvishAradam |
yo mAM yuddhAya samprAptaM sAmnaivAtho tvamagrahIH
shlokas.6:
na tvayA puruShArthashcha kashchidastIha jIvatA |
yastvaM strIvadyudhA prAptaM sAmnA mAM pratyagRRihNathAH
shlokas.7:
yadyahaM nyastashastrastvAmAgachCheyaM sudurmate |
prakriyeyaM tato yuktA bhavettava narAdhama
shlokas.8:
tamevamuktaM bhartrA tu viditvA pannagAtmajA |
amRRiShyamANA bhittvorvImulUpI tamupAgamat
shlokas.9:
sA dadarsha tataH putraM vimRRishantamadhomukham |
santarjyamAnamasakRRidbhartrA yuddhArthinA vibho
shlokas.10:
tataH sA chArusarvA~NgI tamupetyoragAtmajA |
ulUpI prAha vachanaM kShatradharmavishAradA
shlokas.11:
ulUpIM mAM nibodha tvaM mAtaraM pannagAtmajAm |
kuruShva vachanaM putra dharmaste bhavitA paraH
shlokas.12:
yudhyasvainaM kurushreShThaM dhana~njayamari.ndama |
evameSha hi te prIto bhaviShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.13:
evamuddharShito mAtrA sa rAjA babhruvAhanaH |
manashchakre mahAtejA yuddhAya bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
saMnahya kA~nchanaM varma shirastrANaM cha bhAnumat |
tUNIrashatasambAdhamAruroha mahAratham
shlokas.15:
sarvopakaraNairyuktaM yuktamashvairmanojavaiH |
suchakropaskaraM dhImAnhemabhANDapariShkRRitam
shlokas.16:
paramArchitamuchChritya dhvajaM siMhaM hiraNmayam |
prayayau pArthamuddishya sa rAjA babhruvAhanaH
shlokas.17:
tato.abhyetya hayaM vIro yaj~niyaM pArtharakShitam |
grAhayAmAsa puruShairhayashikShAvishAradaiH
shlokas.18:
gRRihItaM vAjinaM dRRiShTvA prItAtmA sa dhana~njayaH |
putraM rathasthaM bhUmiShThaH saMnyavArayadAhave
shlokas.19:
tataH sa rAjA taM vIraM sharavrAtaiH sahasrashaH |
ardayAmAsa nishitairAshIviShaviShopamaiH
shlokas.20:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM pituH putrasya chAtulam |
devAsuraraNaprakhyamubhayoH prIyamANayoH
shlokas.21:
kirITinaM tu vivyAdha shareNa nataparvaNA |
jatrudeshe naravyAghraH prahasanbabhruvAhanaH
shlokas.22:
so.abhyagAtsaha pu~Nkhena valmIkamiva pannagaH |
vinirbhidya cha kaunteyaM mahItalamathAvishat
shlokas.23:
sa gADhavedano dhImAnAlambya dhanuruttamam |
divyaM tejaH samAvishya pramIta iva sambabhau
shlokas.24:
sa sa~nj~nAmupalabhyAtha prashasya puruSharShabhaH |
putraM shakrAtmajo vAkyamidamAha mahIpate
shlokas.25:
sAdhu sAdhu mahAbAho vatsa chitrA~NgadAtmaja |
sadRRishaM karma te dRRiShTvA prItimAnasmi putraka
shlokas.26:
vimu~nchAmyeSha bANA.nste putra yuddhe sthiro bhava |
ityevamuktvA nArAchairabhyavarShadamitrahA
shlokas.27:
tAnsa gANDIvanirmuktAnvajrAshanisamaprabhAn |
nArAchairachChinadrAjA sarvAneva tridhA tridhA
shlokas.28:
tasya pArthaH sharairdivyairdhvajaM hemapariShkRRitam |
suvarNatAlapratimaM kShureNApAharadrathAt
shlokas.29:
hayA.nshchAsya mahAkAyAnmahAvegaparAkramAn |
chakAra rAj~no nirjIvAnprahasanpANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.30:
sa rathAdavatIryAshu rAjA paramakopanaH |
padAtiH pitaraM kopAdyodhayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.31:
samprIyamANaH pANDUnAmRRiShabhaH putravikramAt |
nAtyarthaM pIDayAmAsa putraM vajradharAtmajaH
shlokas.32:
sa hanyamAno vimukhaM pitaraM babhruvAhanaH |
sharairAshIviShAkAraiH punarevArdayadbalI
shlokas.33:
tataH sa bAlyAtpitaraM vivyAdha hRRidi patriNA |
nishitena supu~Nkhena balavadbabhruvAhanaH
shlokas.34:
sa bANastejasA dIpto jvalanniva hutAshanaH |
vivesha pANDavaM rAjanmarma bhittvAtiduHkhakRRit
shlokas.35:
sa tenAtibhRRishaM viddhaH putreNa kurunandanaH |
mahIM jagAma mohArtastato rAjandhana~njayaH
shlokas.36:
tasminnipatite vIre kauravANAM dhurandhare |
so.api mohaM jagAmAshu tatashchitrA~NgadAsutaH
shlokas.37:
vyAyamya sa.nyuge rAjA dRRiShTvA cha pitaraM hatam |
pUrvameva cha bANaughairgADhaviddho.arjunena saH
shlokas.38:
bhartAraM nihataM dRRiShTvA putraM cha patitaM bhuvi |
chitrA~NgadA paritrastA pravivesha raNAjiram
shlokas.39:
shokasantaptahRRidayA rudatI sA tataH shubhA |
maNipUrapatermAtA dadarsha nihataM patim

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato bahuvidhaM bhIrurvilapya kamalekShaNA |
mumoha duHkhAddurdharShA nipapAta cha bhUtale
shlokas.2:
pratilabhya cha sA sa~nj~nAM devI divyavapurdharA |
ulUpIM pannagasutAM dRRiShTvedaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
ulUpi pashya bhartAraM shayAnaM nihataM raNe |
tvatkRRite mama putreNa bAlena samiti~njayam
shlokas.4:
nanu tvamArye dharmaj~nA nanu chAsi pativratA |
yattvatkRRite.ayaM patitaH patiste nihato raNe
shlokas.5:
kiM tu sarvAparAdho.ayaM yadi te.adya dhana~njayaH |
kShamasva yAchyamAnA me sa~njIvaya dhana~njayam
shlokas.6:
nanu tvamArye dharmaj~nA trailokyaviditA shubhe |
yadghAtayitvA bhartAraM putreNeha na shochasi
shlokas.7:
nAhaM shochAmi tanayaM nihataM pannagAtmaje |
patimeva tu shochAmi yasyAtithyamidaM kRRitam
shlokas.8:
ityuktvA sA tadA devImulUpIM pannagAtmajAm |
bhartAramabhigamyedamityuvAcha yashasvinI
shlokas.9:
uttiShTha kurumukhyasya priyakAma mama priya |
ayamashvo mahAbAho mayA te parimokShitaH
shlokas.10:
nanu nAma tvayA vIra dharmarAjasya yaj~niyaH |
ayamashvo.anusartavyaH sa sheShe kiM mahItale
shlokas.11:
tvayi prANAH samAyattAH kurUNAM kurunandana |
sa kasmAtprANado.anyeShAM prANAnsantyaktavAnasi
shlokas.12:
ulUpi sAdhu sampashya bhartAraM nihataM raNe |
putraM chainaM samutsAhya ghAtayitvA na shochasi
shlokas.13:
kAmaM svapitu bAlo.ayaM bhUmau pretagatiM gataH |
lohitAkSho guDAkesho vijayaH sAdhu jIvatu
shlokas.14:
nAparAdho.asti subhage narANAM bahubhAryatA |
nArINAM tu bhavatyetanmA te bhUdbuddhirIdRRishI
shlokas.15:
sakhyaM hyetatkRRitaM dhAtrA shAshvataM chAvyayaM cha ha |
sakhyaM samabhijAnIhi satyaM sa~Ngatamastu te
shlokas.16:
putreNa ghAtayitvemaM patiM yadi na me.adya vai |
jIvantaM darshayasyadya parityakShyAmi jIvitam
shlokas.17:
sAhaM duHkhAnvitA bhIru patiputravinAkRRitA |
ihaiva prAyamAshiShye prekShantyAste na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.18:
ityuktvA pannagasutAM sapatnIM chaitravAhinI |
tataH prAyamupAsInA tUShNImAsIjjanAdhipa

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA vilapyoparatA bhartuH pAdau pragRRihya sA |
upaviShTAbhavaddevI sochChvAsaM putramIkShatI
shlokas.2:
tataH sa~nj~nAM punarlabdhvA sa rAjA babhruvAhanaH |
mAtaraM tAmathAlokya raNabhUmAvathAbravIt
shlokas.3:
ito duHkhataraM kiM nu yanme mAtA sukhaidhitA |
bhUmau nipatitaM vIramanushete mRRitaM patim
shlokas.4:
nihantAraM raNe.arINAM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
mayA vinihataM sa~Nkhye prekShate durmaraM bata
shlokas.5:
aho.asyA hRRidayaM devyA dRRiDhaM yanna vidIryate |
vyUDhoraskaM mahAbAhuM prekShantyA nihataM patim
shlokas.6:
durmaraM puruSheNeha manye hyadhvanyanAgate |
yatra nAhaM na me mAtA viprayujyeta jIvitAt
shlokas.7:
aho dhikkuruvIrasya hyuraHsthaM kA~nchanaM bhuvi |
vyapaviddhaM hatasyeha mayA putreNa pashyata
shlokas.8:
bho bho pashyata me vIraM pitaraM brAhmaNA bhuvi |
shayAnaM vIrashayane mayA putreNa pAtitam
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNAH kurumukhyasya prayuktA hayasAriNaH |
kurvantu shAntikAM tvadya raNe yo.ayaM mayA hataH
shlokas.10:
vyAdishantu cha kiM viprAH prAyashchittamihAdya me |
sunRRisha.nsasya pApasya pitRRihantU raNAjire
shlokas.11:
dushcharA dvAdasha samA hatvA pitaramadya vai |
mameha sunRRisha.nsasya sa.nvItasyAsya charmaNA
shlokas.12:
shiraHkapAle chAsyaiva bhu~njataH pituradya me |
prAyashchittaM hi nAstyanyaddhatvAdya pitaraM mama
shlokas.13:
pashya nAgottamasute bhartAraM nihataM mayA |
kRRitaM priyaM mayA te.adya nihatya samare.arjunam
shlokas.14:
so.ahamapyadya yAsyAmi gatiM pitRRiniShevitAm |
na shaknomyAtmanAtmAnamahaM dhArayituM shubhe
shlokas.15:
sA tvaM mayi mRRite mAtastathA gANDIvadhanvani |
bhava prItimatI devi satyenAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.16:
ityuktvA sa tadA rAjA duHkhashokasamAhataH |
upaspRRishya mahArAja duHkhAdvachanamabravIt
shlokas.17:
shRRiNvantu sarvabhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
tvaM cha mAtaryathA satyaM bravImi bhujagottame
shlokas.18:
yadi nottiShThati jayaH pitA me bharatarShabhaH |
asminneva raNoddeshe shoShayiShye kalevaram
shlokas.19:
na hi me pitaraM hatvA niShkRRitirvidyate kvachit |
narakaM pratipatsyAmi dhruvaM guruvadhArditaH
shlokas.20:
vIraM hi kShatriyaM hatvA goshatena pramuchyate |
pitaraM tu nihatyaivaM dustarA niShkRRitirmayA
shlokas.21:
eSha hyeko mahAtejAH pANDuputro dhana~njayaH |
pitA cha mama dharmAtmA tasya me niShkRRitiH kutaH
shlokas.22:
ityevamuktvA nRRipate dhana~njayasuto nRRipaH |
upaspRRishyAbhavattUShNIM prAyopeto mahAmatiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prAyopaviShTe nRRipatau maNipUreshvare tadA |
pitRRishokasamAviShTe saha mAtrA parantapa
shlokas.2:
ulUpI chintayAmAsa tadA sa~njIvanaM maNim |
sa chopAtiShThata tadA pannagAnAM parAyaNam
shlokas.3:
taM gRRihItvA tu kauravya nAgarAjapateH sutA |
manaHprahlAdanIM vAchaM sainikAnAmathAbravIt
shlokas.4:
uttiShTha mA shuchaH putra naiSha jiShNustvayA hataH |
ajeyaH puruShaireSha devairvApi savAsavaiH
shlokas.5:
mayA tu mohinI nAma mAyaiShA samprayojitA |
priyArthaM puruShendrasya pituste.adya yashasvinaH
shlokas.6:
jij~nAsurhyeSha vai putra balasya tava kauravaH |
sa~NgrAme yudhyato rAjannAgataH paravIrahA
shlokas.7:
tasmAdasi mayA putra yuddhArthaM parichoditaH |
mA pApamAtmanaH putra sha~NkethAstvaNvapi prabho
shlokas.8:
RRiShireSha mahAtejAH puruShaH shAshvato.avyayaH |
nainaM shakto hi sa~NgrAme jetuM shakro.api putraka
shlokas.9:
ayaM tu me maNirdivyaH samAnIto vishAM pate |
mRRitAnmRRitAnpannagendrAnyo jIvayati nityadA
shlokas.10:
etamasyorasi tvaM tu sthApayasva pituH prabho |
sa~njIvitaM punaH putra tato draShTAsi pANDavam
shlokas.11:
ityuktaH sthApayAmAsa tasyorasi maNiM tadA |
pArthasyAmitatejAH sa pituH snehAdapApakRRit
shlokas.12:
tasminnyaste maNau vIra jiShNurujjIvitaH prabhuH |
suptotthita ivottasthau mRRiShTalohitalochanaH
shlokas.13:
tamutthitaM mahAtmAnaM labdhasa~nj~naM manasvinam |
samIkShya pitaraM svasthaM vavande babhruvAhanaH
shlokas.14:
utthite puruShavyAghre punarlakShmIvati prabho |
divyAH sumanasaH puNyA vavRRiShe pAkashAsanaH
shlokas.15:
anAhatA dundubhayaH praNedurmeghanisvanAH |
sAdhu sAdhviti chAkAshe babhUva sumahAnsvanaH
shlokas.16:
utthAya tu mahAbAhuH paryAshvasto dhana~njayaH |
babhruvAhanamAli~Ngya samAjighrata mUrdhani
shlokas.17:
dadarsha chAvidUre.asya mAtaraM shokakarshitAm |
ulUpyA saha tiShThantIM tato.apRRichChaddhana~njayaH
shlokas.18:
kimidaM lakShyate sarvaM shokavismayaharShavat |
raNAjiramamitraghna yadi jAnAsi sha.nsa me
shlokas.19:
jananI cha kimarthaM te raNabhUmimupAgatA |
nAgendraduhitA cheyamulUpI kimihAgatA
shlokas.20:
jAnAmyahamidaM yuddhaM tvayA madvachanAtkRRitam |
strINAmAgamane hetumahamichChAmi veditum
shlokas.21:
tamuvAcha tataH pRRiShTo maNipUrapatistadA |
prasAdya shirasA vidvAnulUpI pRRichChyatAmiti

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kimAgamanakRRityaM te kauravyakulanandini |
maNipUrapatermAtustathaiva cha raNAjire
shlokas.2:
kachchitkushalakAmAsi rAj~no.asya bhujagAtmaje |
mama vA cha~nchalApA~Nge kachchittvaM shubhamichChasi
shlokas.3:
kachchitte pRRithulashroNi nApriyaM shubhadarshane |
akArShamahamaj~nAnAdayaM vA babhruvAhanaH
shlokas.4:
kachchichcha rAjaputrI te sapatnI chaitravAhinI |
chitrA~NgadA varArohA nAparAdhyati ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
tamuvAchoragapaterduhitA prahasantyatha |
na me tvamaparAddho.asi na nRRipo babhruvAhanaH
na janitrI tathAsyeyaM mama yA preShyavatsthitA
shlokas.6:
shrUyatAM yadyathA chedaM mayA sarvaM vicheShTitam |
na me kopastvayA kAryaH shirasA tvAM prasAdaye
shlokas.7:
tvatprItyarthaM hi kauravya kRRitametanmayAnagha |
yattachChRRiNu mahAbAho nikhilena dhana~njaya
shlokas.8:
mahAbhAratayuddhe yattvayA shAntanavo nRRipaH |
adharmeNa hataH pArtha tasyaiShA niShkRRitiH kRRitA
shlokas.9:
na hi bhIShmastvayA vIra yudhyamAno nipAtitaH |
shikhaNDinA tu sa.nsaktastamAshritya hatastvayA
shlokas.10:
tasya shAntimakRRitvA tu tyajestvaM yadi jIvitam |
karmaNA tena pApena patethA niraye dhruvam
shlokas.11:
eShA tu vihitA shAntiH putrAdyAM prAptavAnasi |
vasubhirvasudhApAla ga~NgayA cha mahAmate
shlokas.12:
purA hi shrutametadvai vasubhiH kathitaM mayA |
ga~NgAyAstIramAgamya hate shAntanave nRRipe
shlokas.13:
Aplutya devA vasavaH sametya cha mahAnadIm |
idamUchurvacho ghoraM bhAgIrathyA mate tadA
shlokas.14:
eSha shAntanavo bhIShmo nihataH savyasAchinA |
ayudhyamAnaH sa~NgrAme sa.nsakto.anyena bhAmini
shlokas.15:
tadanenAbhiSha~NgeNa vayamapyarjunaM shubhe |
shApena yojayAmeti tathAstviti cha sAbravIt
shlokas.16:
tadahaM piturAvedya bhRRishaM pravyathitendriyA |
abhavaM sa cha tachChrutvA viShAdamagamatparam
shlokas.17:
pitA tu me vasUngatvA tvadarthaM samayAchata |
punaH punaH prasAdyainA.nsta enamidamabruvan
shlokas.18:
punastasya mahAbhAga maNipUreshvaro yuvA |
sa enaM raNamadhyasthaM sharaiH pAtayitA bhuvi
shlokas.19:
evaM kRRite sa nAgendra muktashApo bhaviShyati |
gachCheti vasubhishchokto mama chedaM shasha.nsa saH
shlokas.20:
tachChrutvA tvaM mayA tasmAchChApAdasi vimokShitaH |
na hi tvAM devarAjo.api samareShu parAjayet
shlokas.21:
AtmA putraH smRRitastasmAttenehAsi parAjitaH |
nAtra doSho mama mataH kathaM vA manyase vibho
shlokas.22:
ityevamukto vijayaH prasannAtmAbravIdidam |
sarvaM me supriyaM devi yadetatkRRitavatyasi
shlokas.23:
ityuktvAthAbravItputraM maNipUreshvaraM jayaH |
chitrA~NgadAyAH shRRiNvantyAH kauravyaduhitustathA
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThirasyAshvamedhaH parAM chaitrIM bhaviShyati |
tatrAgachCheH sahAmAtyo mAtRRibhyAM sahito nRRipa
shlokas.25:
ityevamuktaH pArthena sa rAjA babhruvAhanaH |
uvAcha pitaraM dhImAnidamasrAvilekShaNaH
shlokas.26:
upayAsyAmi dharmaj~na bhavataH shAsanAdaham |
ashvamedhe mahAyaj~ne dvijAtipariveShakaH
shlokas.27:
mama tvanugrahArthAya pravishasva puraM svakam |
bhAryAbhyAM saha shatrughna mA bhUtte.atra vichAraNA
shlokas.28:
uShitveha vishalyastvaM sukhaM sve veshmani prabho |
punarashvAnugamanaM kartAsi jayatAM vara
shlokas.29:
ityuktaH sa tu putreNa tadA vAnaraketanaH |
smayanprovAcha kaunteyastadA chitrA~NgadAsutam
shlokas.30:
viditaM te mahAbAho yathA dIkShAM charAmyaham |
na sa tAvatpravekShyAmi puraM te pRRithulochana
shlokas.31:
yathAkAmaM prayAtyeSha yaj~niyashcha tura~NgamaH |
svasti te.astu gamiShyAmi na sthAnaM vidyate mama
shlokas.32:
sa tatra vidhivattena pUjitaH pAkashAsaniH |
bhAryAbhyAmabhyanuj~nAtaH prAyAdbharatasattamaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa tu vAjI samudrAntAM paryetya pRRithivImimAm |
nivRRitto.abhimukho rAjanyena nAgAhvayaM puram
shlokas.2:
anugachCha.nshcha tejasvI nivRRitto.atha kirITabhRRit |
yadRRichChayA samApede puraM rAjagRRihaM tadA
shlokas.3:
tamabhyAshagataM rAjA jarAsandhAtmajAtmajaH |
kShatradharme sthito vIraH samarAyAjuhAva ha
shlokas.4:
tataH purAtsa niShkramya rathI dhanvI sharI talI |
meghasandhiH padAtiM taM dhana~njayamupAdravat
shlokas.5:
AsAdya cha mahAtejA meghasandhirdhana~njayam |
bAlabhAvAnmahArAja provAchedaM na kaushalAt
shlokas.6:
kimayaM chAryate vAjI strImadhya iva bhArata |
hayamenaM hariShyAmi prayatasva vimokShaNe
shlokas.7:
adattAnunayo yuddhe yadi tvaM pitRRibhirmama |
kariShyAmi tavAtithyaM prahara praharAmi vA
shlokas.8:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchainaM pANDavaH prahasanniva |
vighnakartA mayA vArya iti me vratamAhitam
shlokas.9:
bhrAtrA jyeShThena nRRipate tavApi viditaM dhruvam |
praharasva yathAshakti na manyurvidyate mama
shlokas.10:
ityuktaH prAharatpUrvaM pANDavaM magadheshvaraH |
kira~nsharasahasrANi varShANIva sahasradRRik
shlokas.11:
tato gANDIvabhRRichChUro gANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
chakAra moghA.nstAnbANAnayatnAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
sa moghaM tasya bANaughaM kRRitvA vAnaraketanaH |
sharAnmumocha jvalitAndIptAsyAniva pannagAn
shlokas.13:
dhvaje patAkAdaNDeShu rathayantre hayeShu cha |
anyeShu cha rathA~NgeShu na sharIre na sArathau
shlokas.14:
sa.nrakShyamANaH pArthena sharIre phalgunasya ha |
manyamAnaH svavIryaM tanmAgadhaH prAhiNochCharAn
shlokas.15:
tato gANDIvabhRRichChUro mAgadhena samAhataH |
babhau vAsantika iva palAshaH puShpito mahAn
shlokas.16:
avadhyamAnaH so.abhyaghnanmAgadhaH pANDavarShabham |
tena tasthau sa kauravya lokavIrasya darshane
shlokas.17:
savyasAchI tu sa~Nkruddho vikRRiShya balavaddhanuH |
hayA.nshchakAra nirdehAnsAratheshcha shiro.aharat
shlokas.18:
dhanushchAsya mahachchitraM kShureNa prachakarta ha |
hastAvApaM patAkAM cha dhvajaM chAsya nyapAtayat
shlokas.19:
sa rAjA vyathito vyashvo vidhanurhatasArathiH |
gadAmAdAya kaunteyamabhidudrAva vegavAn
shlokas.20:
tasyApatata evAshu gadAM hemapariShkRRitAm |
sharaishchakarta bahudhA bahubhirgRRidhravAjitaiH
shlokas.21:
sA gadA shakalIbhUtA vishIrNamaNibandhanA |
vyAlI nirmuchyamAneva papAtAsya sahasradhA
shlokas.22:
virathaM taM vidhanvAnaM gadayA parivarjitam |
naichChattADayituM dhImAnarjunaH samarAgraNIH
shlokas.23:
tata enaM vimanasaM kShatradharme samAsthitam |
sAntvapUrvamidaM vAkyamabravItkapiketanaH
shlokas.24:
paryAptaH kShatradharmo.ayaM darshitaH putra gamyatAm |
bahvetatsamare karma tava bAlasya pArthiva
shlokas.25:
yudhiShThirasya sa.ndesho na hantavyA nRRipA iti |
tena jIvasi rAja.nstvamaparAddho.api me raNe
shlokas.26:
iti matvA sa chAtmAnaM pratyAdiShTaM sma mAgadhaH |
tathyamityavagamyainaM prA~njaliH pratyapUjayat
shlokas.27:
tamarjunaH samAshvAsya punarevedamabravIt |
AgantavyaM parAM chaitrImashvamedhe nRRipasya naH
shlokas.28:
ityuktaH sa tathetyuktvA pUjayAmAsa taM hayam |
phalgunaM cha yudhAM shreShThaM vidhivatsahadevajaH
shlokas.29:
tato yatheShTamagamatpunareva sa kesarI |
tataH samudratIreNa va~NgAnpuNDrAnsakeralAn
shlokas.30:
tatra tatra cha bhUrINi mlechChasainyAnyanekashaH |
vijigye dhanuShA rAjangANDIvena dhana~njayaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
mAgadhenArchito rAjanpANDavaH shvetavAhanaH |
dakShiNAM dishamAsthAya chArayAmAsa taM hayam
shlokas.2:
tataH sa punarAvRRitya hayaH kAmacharo balI |
AsasAda purIM ramyAM chedInAM shuktisAhvayAm
shlokas.3:
sharabheNArchitastatra shishupAlAtmajena saH |
yuddhapUrveNa mAnena pUjayA cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
tatrArchito yayau rAja.nstadA sa turagottamaH |
kAshInandhrAnkosalA.nshcha kirAtAnatha ta~NgaNAn
shlokas.5:
tatra pUjAM yathAnyAyaM pratigRRihya sa pANDavaH |
punarAvRRitya kaunteyo dashArNAnagamattadA
shlokas.6:
tatra chitrA~Ngado nAma balavAnvasudhAdhipaH |
tena yuddhamabhUttasya vijayasyAtibhairavam
shlokas.7:
taM chApi vashamAnIya kirITI puruSharShabhaH |
niShAdarAj~no viShayamekalavyasya jagmivAn
shlokas.8:
ekalavyasutashchainaM yuddhena jagRRihe tadA |
tatashchakre niShAdaiH sa sa~NgrAmaM romaharShaNam
shlokas.9:
tatastamapi kaunteyaH samareShvaparAjitaH |
jigAya samare vIro yaj~navighnArthamudyatam
shlokas.10:
sa taM jitvA mahArAja naiShAdiM pAkashAsaniH |
architaH prayayau bhUyo dakShiNaM salilArNavam
shlokas.11:
tatrApi draviDairandhrai raudrairmAhiShakairapi |
tathA kollagireyaishcha yuddhamAsItkirITinaH
shlokas.12:
turagasya vashenAtha surAShTrAnabhito yayau |
gokarNamapi chAsAdya prabhAsamapi jagmivAn
shlokas.13:
tato dvAravatIM ramyAM vRRiShNivIrAbhirakShitAm |
AsasAda hayaH shrImAnkururAjasya yaj~niyaH
shlokas.14:
tamunmathya hayashreShThaM yAdavAnAM kumArakAH |
prayayustA.nstadA rAjannugraseno nyavArayat
shlokas.15:
tataH puryA viniShkramya vRRiShNyandhakapatistadA |
sahito vasudevena mAtulena kirITinaH
shlokas.16:
tau sametya kurushreShThaM vidhivatprItipUrvakam |
parayA bharatashreShThaM pUjayA samavasthitau
tatastAbhyAmanuj~nAto yayau yena hayo gataH
shlokas.17:
tataH sa pashchimaM deshaM samudrasya tadA hayaH |
krameNa vyacharatsphItaM tataH pa~nchanadaM yayau
shlokas.18:
tasmAdapi sa kauravya gAndhAraviShayaM hayaH |
vichachAra yathAkAmaM kaunteyAnugatastadA
shlokas.19:
tatra gAndhArarAjena yuddhamAsInmahAtmanaH |
ghoraM shakuniputreNa pUrvavairAnusAriNA

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shakunestu suto vIro gAndhArANAM mahArathaH |
pratyudyayau guDAkeshaM sainyena mahatA vRRitaH
hastyashvarathapUrNena patAkAdhvajamAlinA
shlokas.2:
amRRiShyamANAste yodhA nRRipateH shakunervadham |
abhyayuH sahitAH pArthaM pragRRihItasharAsanAH
shlokas.3:
tAnuvAcha sa dharmAtmA bIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
yudhiShThirasya vachanaM na cha te jagRRihurhitam
shlokas.4:
vAryamANAstu pArthena sAntvapUrvamamarShitAH |
parivArya hayaM jagmustatashchukrodha pANDavaH
shlokas.5:
tataH shirA.nsi dIptAgraisteShAM chichCheda pANDavaH |
kShurairgANDIvanirmuktairnAtiyatnAdivArjunaH
shlokas.6:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena hayamutsRRijya sambhramAt |
nyavartanta mahArAja sharavarShArditA bhRRisham
shlokas.7:
vitudyamAnastaishchApi gAndhAraiH pANDavarShabhaH |
AdishyAdishya tejasvI shirA.nsyeShAM nyapAtayat
shlokas.8:
vadhyamAneShu teShvAjau gAndhAreShu samantataH |
sa rAjA shakuneH putraH pANDavaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.9:
taM yudhyamAnaM rAjAnaM kShatradharme vyavasthitam |
pArtho.abravInna me vadhyA rAjAno rAjashAsanAt
alaM yuddhena te vIra na te.astyadya parAjayaH
shlokas.10:
ityuktastadanAdRRitya vAkyamaj~nAnamohitaH |
sa shakrasamakarmANamavAkirata sAyakaiH
shlokas.11:
tasya pArthaH shirastrANamardhachandreNa patriNA |
apAharadasambhrAnto jayadrathashiro yathA
shlokas.12:
taddRRiShTvA vismayaM jagmurgAndhArAH sarva eva te |
ichChatA tena na hato rAjetyapi cha te viduH
shlokas.13:
gAndhArarAjaputrastu palAyanakRRitakShaNaH |
babhau taireva sahitastrastaiH kShudramRRigairiva
shlokas.14:
teShAM tu tarasA pArthastatraiva paridhAvatAm |
vijahArottamA~NgAni bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.15:
uchChritA.nstu bhujAnkechinnAbudhyanta sharairhRRitAn |
sharairgANDIvanirmuktaiH pRRithubhiH pArthachoditaiH
shlokas.16:
sambhrAntanaranAgAshvamatha tadvidrutaM balam |
hatavidhvastabhUyiShThamAvartata muhurmuhuH
shlokas.17:
na hyadRRishyanta vIrasya kechidagre.agryakarmaNaH |
ripavaH pAtyamAnA vai ye saheyurmahAsharAn
shlokas.18:
tato gAndhArarAjasya mantrivRRiddhapuraHsarA |
jananI niryayau bhItA puraskRRityArghyamuttamam
shlokas.19:
sA nyavArayadavyagrA taM putraM yuddhadurmadam |
prasAdayAmAsa cha taM jiShNumakliShTakAriNam
shlokas.20:
tAM pUjayitvA kaunteyaH prasAdamakarottadA |
shakuneshchApi tanayaM sAntvayannidamabravIt
shlokas.21:
na me priyaM mahAbAho yatte buddhiriyaM kRRitA |
pratiyoddhumamitraghna bhrAtaiva tvaM mamAnagha
shlokas.22:
gAndhArIM mAtaraM smRRitvA dhRRitarAShTrakRRitena cha |
tena jIvasi rAja.nstvaM nihatAstvanugAstava
shlokas.23:
maivaM bhUH shAmyatAM vairaM mA te bhUdbuddhirIdRRishI |
AgantavyaM parAM chaitrImashvamedhe nRRipasya naH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvAnuyayau pArtho hayaM taM kAmachAriNam |
nyavartata tato vAjI yena nAgAhvayaM puram
shlokas.2:
taM nivRRittaM tu shushrAva chAreNaiva yudhiShThiraH |
shrutvArjunaM kushalinaM sa cha hRRiShTamanAbhavat
shlokas.3:
vijayasya cha tatkarma gAndhAraviShaye tadA |
shrutvAnyeShu cha desheShu sa suprIto.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.4:
etasminneva kAle tu dvAdashIM mAghapAkShikIm |
iShTaM gRRihItvA nakShatraM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
samAnAyya mahAtejAH sarvAnbhrAtR^InmahAmanAH |
bhImaM cha nakulaM chaiva sahadevaM cha kauravaH
shlokas.6:
provAchedaM vachaH kAle tadA dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
Amantrya vadatAM shreShTho bhImaM bhImaparAkramam
shlokas.7:
AyAti bhImasenAsau sahAshvena tavAnujaH |
yathA me puruShAH prAhurye dhana~njayasAriNaH
shlokas.8:
upasthitashcha kAlo.ayamabhito vartate hayaH |
mAghI cha paurNamAsIyaM mAsaH sheSho vRRikodara
shlokas.9:
tatprasthApyantu vidvA.nso brAhmaNA vedapAragAH |
vAjimedhArthasiddhyarthaM deshaM pashyantu yaj~niyam
shlokas.10:
ityuktaH sa tu tachchakre bhImo nRRipatishAsanam |
hRRiShTaH shrutvA narapaterAyAntaM savyasAchinam
shlokas.11:
tato yayau bhImasenaH prAj~naiH sthapatibhiH saha |
brAhmaNAnagrataH kRRitvA kushalAnyaj~nakarmasu
shlokas.12:
taM sashAlachayagrAmaM sampratolIviTa~Nkinam |
mApayAmAsa kauravyo yaj~navATaM yathAvidhi
shlokas.13:
sadaH sapatnIsadanaM sAgnIdhramapi chottaram |
kArayAmAsa vidhivanmaNihemavibhUShitam
shlokas.14:
stambhAnkanakachitrA.nshcha toraNAni bRRihanti cha |
yaj~nAyatanadesheShu dattvA shuddhaM cha kA~nchanam
shlokas.15:
antaHpurANi rAj~nAM cha nAnAdeshanivAsinAm |
kArayAmAsa dharmAtmA tatra tatra yathAvidhi
shlokas.16:
brAhmaNAnAM cha veshmAni nAnAdeshasameyuShAm |
kArayAmAsa bhImaH sa vividhAni hyanekashaH
shlokas.17:
tathA sampreShayAmAsa dUtAnnRRipatishAsanAt |
bhImaseno mahArAja rAj~nAmakliShTakarmaNAm
shlokas.18:
te priyArthaM kurupaterAyayurnRRipasattamAH |
ratnAnyanekAnyAdAya striyo.ashvAnAyudhAni cha
shlokas.19:
teShAM nivishatAM teShu shibireShu sahasrashaH |
nardataH sAgarasyeva shabdo divamivAspRRishat
shlokas.20:
teShAmabhyAgatAnAM sa rAjA rAjIvalochanaH |
vyAdideshAnnapAnAni shayyAshchApyatimAnuShAH
shlokas.21:
vAhanAnAM cha vividhAH shAlAH shAlIkShugorasaiH |
upetAH puruShavyAghra vyAdidesha sa dharmarAT
shlokas.22:
tathA tasminmahAyaj~ne dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
samAjagmurmunigaNA bahavo brahmavAdinaH
shlokas.23:
ye cha dvijAtipravarAstatrAsanpRRithivIpate |
samAjagmuH sashiShyA.nstAnpratijagrAha kauravaH
shlokas.24:
sarvA.nshcha tAnanuyayau yAvadAvasathAditi |
svayameva mahAtejA dambhaM tyaktvA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.25:
tataH kRRitvA sthapatayaH shilpino.anye cha ye tadA |
kRRitsnaM yaj~navidhiM rAjandharmarAj~ne nyavedayan
shlokas.26:
tachChrutvA dharmarAjaH sa kRRitaM sarvamaninditam |
hRRiShTarUpo.abhavadrAjA saha bhrAtRRibhirachyutaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasminyaj~ne pravRRitte tu vAgmino hetuvAdinaH |
hetuvAdAnbahUnprAhuH parasparajigIShavaH
shlokas.2:
dadRRishustaM nRRipatayo yaj~nasya vidhimuttamam |
devendrasyeva vihitaM bhImena kurunandana
shlokas.3:
dadRRishustoraNAnyatra shAtakumbhamayAni te |
shayyAsanavihArA.nshcha subahUnratnabhUShitAn
shlokas.4:
ghaTAnpAtrIH kaTAhAni kalashAnvardhamAnakAn |
na hi ki~nchidasauvarNamapashya.nstatra pArthivAH
shlokas.5:
yUpA.nshcha shAstrapaThitAndAravAnhemabhUShitAn |
upakL^iptAnyathAkAlaM vidhivadbhUrivarchasaH
shlokas.6:
sthalajA jalajA ye cha pashavaH kechana prabho |
sarvAneva samAnItA.nstAnapashyanta te nRRipAH
shlokas.7:
gAshchaiva mahiShIshchaiva tathA vRRiddhAH striyo.api cha |
audakAni cha sattvAni shvApadAni vayA.nsi cha
shlokas.8:
jarAyujAnyaNDajAni svedajAnyudbhidAni cha |
parvatAnUpavanyAni bhUtAni dadRRishushcha te
shlokas.9:
evaM pramuditaM sarvaM pashugodhanadhAnyataH |
yaj~navATaM nRRipA dRRiShTvA paraM vismayamAgaman
brAhmaNAnAM vishAM chaiva bahumRRiShTAnnamRRiddhimat
shlokas.10:
pUrNe shatasahasre tu viprANAM tatra bhu~njatAm |
dundubhirmeghanirghoSho muhurmuhuratADyata
shlokas.11:
vinanAdAsakRRitso.atha divase divase tadA |
evaM sa vavRRite yaj~no dharmarAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.12:
annasya bahavo rAjannutsargAH parvatopamAH |
dadhikulyAshcha dadRRishuH sarpiShashcha hradA~njanAH
shlokas.13:
jambUdvIpo hi sakalo nAnAjanapadAyutaH |
rAjannadRRishyataikastho rAj~nastasminmahAkratau
shlokas.14:
tatra jAtisahasrANi puruShANAM tatastataH |
gRRihItvA dhanamAjagmurbahUni bharatarShabha
shlokas.15:
rAjAnaH sragviNashchApi sumRRiShTamaNikuNDalAH |
paryaveShandvijAgryA.nstA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.16:
vividhAnyannapAnAni puruShA ye.anuyAyinaH |
teShAM nRRipopabhojyAni brAhmaNebhyo daduH sma te

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
samAgatAnvedavido rAj~nashcha pRRithivIshvarAn |
dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImasenamathAbravIt
shlokas.2:
upayAtA naravyAghrA ya ime jagadIshvarAH |
eteShAM kriyatAM pUjA pUjArhA hi nareshvarAH
shlokas.3:
ityuktaH sa tathA chakre narendreNa yashasvinA |
bhImaseno mahAtejA yamAbhyAM saha bhArata
shlokas.4:
athAbhyagachChadgovindo vRRiShNibhiH saha dharmajam |
baladevaM puraskRRitya sarvaprANabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.5:
yuyudhAnena sahitaH pradyumnena gadena cha |
nishaThenAtha sAmbena tathaiva kRRitavarmaNA
shlokas.6:
teShAmapi parAM pUjAM chakre bhImo mahAbhujaH |
vivishuste cha veshmAni ratnavanti nararShabhAH
shlokas.7:
yudhiShThirasamIpe tu kathAnte madhusUdanaH |
arjunaM kathayAmAsa bahusa~NgrAmakarshitam
shlokas.8:
sa taM paprachCha kaunteyaH punaH punarari.ndamam |
dharmarADbhrAtaraM jiShNuM samAchaShTa jagatpatiH
shlokas.9:
AgamaddvArakAvAsI mamAptaH puruSho nRRipa |
yo.adrAkShItpANDavashreShThaM bahusa~NgrAmakarshitam
shlokas.10:
samIpe cha mahAbAhumAchaShTa cha mama prabho |
kuru kAryANi kaunteya hayamedhArthasiddhaye
shlokas.11:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchainaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
diShTyA sa kushalI jiShNurupayAti cha mAdhava
shlokas.12:
tava yatsa.ndideshAsau pANDavAnAM balAgraNIH |
tadAkhyAtumihechChAmi bhavatA yadunandana
shlokas.13:
ityukte rAjashArdUla vRRiShNyandhakapatistadA |
provAchedaM vacho vAgmI dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.14:
idamAha mahArAja pArthavAkyaM naraH sa mAm |
vAchyo yudhiShThiraH kRRiShNa kAle vAkyamidaM mama
shlokas.15:
AgamiShyanti rAjAnaH sarvataH kauravAnprati |
teShAmekaikashaH pUjA kAryetyetatkShamaM hi naH
shlokas.16:
ityetadvachanAdrAjA vij~nApyo mama mAnada |
na tadAtyayikaM hi syAdyadarghyAnayane bhavet
shlokas.17:
kartumarhati tadrAjA bhavA.nshchApyanumanyatAm |
rAjadveShAdvinashyeyurnemA rAjanprajAH punaH
shlokas.18:
idamanyachcha kaunteya vachaH sa puruSho.abravIt |
dhana~njayasya nRRipate tanme nigadataH shRRiNu
shlokas.19:
upayAsyati yaj~naM no maNipUrapatirnRRipaH |
putro mama mahAtejA dayito babhruvAhanaH
shlokas.20:
taM bhavAnmadapekShArthaM vidhivatpratipUjayet |
sa hi bhakto.anuraktashcha mama nityamiti prabho
shlokas.21:
ityetadvachanaM shrutvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
abhinandyAsya tadvAkyamidaM vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutaM priyamidaM kRRiShNa yattvamarhasi bhAShitum |
tanme.amRRitarasaprakhyaM mano hlAdayate vibho
shlokas.2:
bahUni kila yuddhAni vijayasya narAdhipaiH |
punarAsanhRRiShIkesha tatra tatreti me shrutam
shlokas.3:
mannimittaM hi sa sadA pArthaH sukhavivarjitaH |
atIva vijayo dhImAniti me dUyate manaH
shlokas.4:
sa~nchintayAmi vArShNeya sadA kuntIsutaM rahaH |
kiM nu tasya sharIre.asti sarvalakShaNapUjite
aniShTaM lakShaNaM kRRiShNa yena duHkhAnyupAshnute
shlokas.5:
atIva duHkhabhAgI sa satataM kuntinandanaH |
na cha pashyAmi bIbhatsornindyaM gAtreShu ki~nchana
shrotavyaM chenmayaitadvai tanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.6:
ityuktaH sa hRRiShIkesho dhyAtvA sumahadantaram |
rAjAnaM bhojarAjanyavardhano viShNurabravIt
shlokas.7:
na hyasya nRRipate ki~nchidaniShTamupalakShaye |
RRite puruShasiMhasya piNDike.asyAtikAyataH
shlokas.8:
tAbhyAM sa puruShavyAghro nityamadhvasu yujyate |
na hyanyadanupashyAmi yenAsau duHkhabhAgjayaH
shlokas.9:
ityuktaH sa kurushreShThastathyaM kRRiShNena dhImatA |
provAcha vRRiShNishArdUlamevametaditi prabho
shlokas.10:
kRRiShNA tu draupadI kRRiShNaM tiryaksAsUyamaikShata |
pratijagrAha tasyAstaM praNayaM chApi keshihA
sakhyuH sakhA hRRiShIkeshaH sAkShAdiva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
tatra bhImAdayaste tu kuravo yAdavAstathA |
remuH shrutvA vichitrArthA dhana~njayakathA vibho
shlokas.12:
tathA kathayatAmeva teShAmarjunasa~NkathAH |
upAyAdvachanAnmartyo vijayasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
so.abhigamya kurushreShThaM namaskRRitya cha buddhimAn |
upAyAtaM naravyAghramarjunaM pratyavedayat
shlokas.14:
tachChrutvA nRRipatistasya harShabAShpAkulekShaNaH |
priyAkhyAnanimittaM vai dadau bahu dhanaM tadA
shlokas.15:
tato dvitIye divase mahA~nshabdo vyavardhata |
AyAti puruShavyAghre pANDavAnAM dhurandhare
shlokas.16:
tato reNuH samudbhUto vibabhau tasya vAjinaH |
abhito vartamAnasya yathochchaiHshravasastathA
shlokas.17:
tatra harShakalA vAcho narANAM shushruve.arjunaH |
diShTyAsi pArtha kushalI dhanyo rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
ko.anyo hi pRRithivIM kRRitsnAmavajitya sapArthivAm |
chArayitvA hayashreShThamupAyAyAdRRite.arjunam
shlokas.19:
ye vyatItA mahAtmAno rAjAnaH sagarAdayaH |
teShAmapIdRRishaM karma na ki~nchidanushushruma
shlokas.20:
naitadanye kariShyanti bhaviShyAH pRRithivIkShitaH |
yattvaM kurukulashreShTha duShkaraM kRRitavAniha
shlokas.21:
ityevaM vadatAM teShAM nR^INAM shrutisukhA giraH |
shRRiNvanvivesha dharmAtmA phalguno yaj~nasa.nstaram
shlokas.22:
tato rAjA sahAmAtyaH kRRiShNashcha yadunandanaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya te taM pratyudyayustadA
shlokas.23:
so.abhivAdya pituH pAdau dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
bhImAdI.nshchApi sampUjya paryaShvajata keshavam
shlokas.24:
taiH sametyArchitastAnsa pratyarchya cha yathAvidhi |
vishashrAmAtha dharmAtmA tIraM labdhveva pAragaH
shlokas.25:
etasminneva kAle tu sa rAjA babhruvAhanaH |
mAtRRibhyAM sahito dhImAnkurUnabhyAjagAma ha
shlokas.26:
sa sametya kurUnsarvAnsarvaistairabhinanditaH |
pravivesha pitAmahyAH kuntyA bhavanamuttamam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa pravishya yathAnyAyaM pANDavAnAM niveshanam |
pitAmahImabhyavadatsAmnA paramavalgunA
shlokas.2:
tathA chitrA~NgadA devI kauravyasyAtmajApi cha |
pRRithAM kRRiShNAM cha sahite vinayenAbhijagmatuH
subhadrAM cha yathAnyAyaM yAshchAnyAH kuruyoShitaH
shlokas.3:
dadau kuntI tatastAbhyAM ratnAni vividhAni cha |
draupadI cha subhadrA cha yAshchApyanyA daduH striyaH
shlokas.4:
UShatustatra te devyau mahArhashayanAsane |
supUjite svayaM kuntyA pArthasya priyakAmyayA
shlokas.5:
sa cha rAjA mahAvIryaH pUjito babhruvAhanaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahIpAlamupatasthe yathAvidhi
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThiraM cha rAjAnaM bhImAdI.nshchApi pANDavAn |
upagamya mahAtejA vinayenAbhyavAdayat
shlokas.7:
sa taiH premNA pariShvaktaH pUjitashcha yathAvidhi |
dhanaM chAsmai dadurbhUri prIyamANA mahArathAH
shlokas.8:
tathaiva sa mahIpAlaH kRRiShNaM chakragadAdharam |
pradyumna iva govindaM vinayenopatasthivAn
shlokas.9:
tasmai kRRiShNo dadau rAj~ne mahArhamabhipUjitam |
rathaM hemapariShkAraM divyAshvayujamuttamam
shlokas.10:
dharmarAjashcha bhImashcha yamajau phalgunastathA |
pRRithakpRRithagatIvainaM mAnArhaM samapUjayan
shlokas.11:
tatastRRitIye divase satyavatyAH suto muniH |
yudhiShThiraM samabhyetya vAgmI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
adya prabhRRiti kaunteya yajasva samayo hi te |
muhUrto yaj~niyaH prAptashchodayanti cha yAjakAH
shlokas.13:
ahIno nAma rAjendra kratuste.ayaM vikalpavAn |
bahutvAtkA~nchanasyAsya khyAto bahusuvarNakaH
shlokas.14:
evameva mahArAja dakShiNAM triguNAM kuru |
tritvaM vrajatu te rAjanbrAhmaNA hyatra kAraNam
shlokas.15:
trInashvamedhAnatra tvaM samprApya bahudakShiNAn |
j~nAtivadhyAkRRitaM pApaM prahAsyasi narAdhipa
shlokas.16:
pavitraM paramaM hyetatpAvanAnAM cha pAvanam |
yadashvamedhAvabhRRithaM prApsyase kurunandana
shlokas.17:
ityuktaH sa tu tejasvI vyAsenAmitatejasA |
dIkShAM vivesha dharmAtmA vAjimedhAptaye tadA
narAdhipaH prAyajata vAjimedhaM mahAkratum
shlokas.18:
tatra vedavido rAja.nshchakruH karmANi yAjakAH |
parikramantaH shAstraj~nA vidhivatsAdhushikShitAH
shlokas.19:
na teShAM skhalitaM tatra nAsIdapahutaM tathA |
kramayuktaM cha yuktaM cha chakrustatra dvijarShabhAH
shlokas.20:
kRRitvA pravargyaM dharmaj~nA yathAvaddvijasattamAH |
chakruste vidhivadrAja.nstathaivAbhiShavaM dvijAH
shlokas.21:
abhiShUya tato rAjansomaM somapasattamAH |
savanAnyAnupUrvyeNa chakruH shAstrAnusAriNaH
shlokas.22:
na tatra kRRipaNaH kashchinna daridro babhUva ha |
kShudhito duHkhito vApi prAkRRito vApi mAnavaH
shlokas.23:
bhojanaM bhojanArthibhyo dApayAmAsa nityadA |
bhImaseno mahAtejAH satataM rAjashAsanAt
shlokas.24:
sa.nstare kushalAshchApi sarvakarmANi yAjakAH |
divase divase chakruryathAshAstrArthachakShuShaH
shlokas.25:
nAShaDa~NgavidatrAsItsadasyastasya dhImataH |
nAvrato nAnupAdhyAyo na cha vAdAkShamo dvijaH
shlokas.26:
tato yUpochChraye prApte ShaDbailvAnbharatarShabha |
khAdirAnbilvasamitA.nstAvataH sarvavarNinaH
shlokas.27:
devadArumayau dvau tu yUpau kurupateH kratau |
shleShmAtakamayaM chaikaM yAjakAH samakArayan
shlokas.28:
shobhArthaM chAparAnyUpAnkA~nchanAnpuruSharShabha |
sa bhImaH kArayAmAsa dharmarAjasya shAsanAt
shlokas.29:
te vyarAjanta rAjarShe vAsobhirupashobhitAH |
narendrAbhigatA devAnyathA saptarShayo divi
shlokas.30:
iShTakAH kA~nchanIshchAtra chayanArthaM kRRitAbhavan |
shushubhe chayanaM tatra dakShasyeva prajApateH
shlokas.31:
chatushchityaH sa tasyAsIdaShTAdashakarAtmakaH |
sa rukmapakSho nichitastriguNo garuDAkRRitiH
shlokas.32:
tato niyuktAH pashavo yathAshAstraM manIShibhiH |
taM taM devaM samuddishya pakShiNaH pashavashcha ye
shlokas.33:
RRiShabhAH shAstrapaThitAstathA jalacharAshcha ye |
sarvA.nstAnabhyayu~nja.nste tatrAgnichayakarmaNi
shlokas.34:
yUpeShu niyataM chAsItpashUnAM trishataM tathA |
ashvaratnottaraM rAj~naH kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.35:
sa yaj~naH shushubhe tasya sAkShAddevarShisa~NkulaH |
gandharvagaNasa~NkIrNaH shobhito.apsarasAM gaNaiH
shlokas.36:
sa kimpuruShagItaishcha kiMnarairupashobhitaH |
siddhavipranivAsaishcha samantAdabhisa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.37:
tasminsadasi nityAstu vyAsashiShyA dvijottamAH |
sarvashAstrapraNetAraH kushalA yaj~nakarmasu
shlokas.38:
nAradashcha babhUvAtra tumburushcha mahAdyutiH |
vishvAvasushchitrasenastathAnye gItakovidAH
shlokas.39:
gandharvA gItakushalA nRRitteShu cha vishAradAH |
ramayanti sma tAnviprAnyaj~nakarmAntareShvatha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shamayitvA pashUnanyAnvidhivaddvijasattamAH |
turagaM taM yathAshAstramAlabhanta dvijAtayaH
shlokas.2:
tataH sa~nj~nApya turagaM vidhivadyAjakarShabhAH |
upasa.nveshayanrAja.nstatastAM drupadAtmajAm
kalAbhistisRRibhI rAjanyathAvidhi manasvinIm
shlokas.3:
uddhRRitya tu vapAM tasya yathAshAstraM dvijarShabhAH |
shrapayAmAsuravyagrAH shAstravadbharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
taM vapAdhUmagandhaM tu dharmarAjaH sahAnujaH |
upAjighradyathAnyAyaM sarvapApmApahaM tadA
shlokas.5:
shiShTAnya~NgAni yAnyAsa.nstasyAshvasya narAdhipa |
tAnyagnau juhuvurdhIrAH samastAH ShoDashartvijaH
shlokas.6:
sa.nsthApyaivaM tasya rAj~nastaM kratuM shakratejasaH |
vyAsaH sashiShyo bhagavAnvardhayAmAsa taM nRRipam
shlokas.7:
tato yudhiShThiraH prAdAtsadasyebhyo yathAvidhi |
koTIsahasraM niShkANAM vyAsAya tu vasundharAm
shlokas.8:
pratigRRihya dharAM rAjanvyAsaH satyavatIsutaH |
abravIdbharatashreShThaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.9:
pRRithivI bhavatastveShA saMnyastA rAjasattama |
niShkrayo dIyatAM mahyaM brAhmaNA hi dhanArthinaH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThirastu tAnviprAnpratyuvAcha mahAmanAH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito dhImAnmadhye rAj~nAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.11:
ashvamedhe mahAyaj~ne pRRithivI dakShiNA smRRitA |
arjunena jitA seyamRRitvigbhyaH prApitA mayA
shlokas.12:
vanaM pravekShye viprendrA vibhajadhvaM mahImimAm |
chaturdhA pRRithivIM kRRitvA chAturhotrapramANataH
shlokas.13:
nAhamAdAtumichChAmi brahmasvaM munisattamAH |
idaM hi me mataM nityaM bhrAtR^INAM cha mamAnaghAH
shlokas.14:
ityuktavati tasmi.nste bhrAtaro draupadI cha sA |
evametaditi prAhustadabhUdromaharShaNam
shlokas.15:
tato.antarikShe vAgAsItsAdhu sAdhviti bhArata |
tathaiva dvijasa~NghAnAM sha.nsatAM vibabhau svanaH
shlokas.16:
dvaipAyanastathoktastu punareva yudhiShThiram |
uvAcha madhye viprANAmidaM sampUjayanmuniH
shlokas.17:
dattaiShA bhavatA mahyaM tAM te pratidadAmyaham |
hiraNyaM dIyatAmebhyo dvijAtibhyo dharAstu te
shlokas.18:
tato.abravIdvAsudevo dharmarAjaM yudhiShThiram |
yathAha bhagavAnvyAsastathA tatkartumarhasi
shlokas.19:
ityuktaH sa kurushreShThaH prItAtmA bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
koTikoTikRRitAM prAdAddakShiNAM triguNAM kratoH
shlokas.20:
na kariShyati talloke kashchidanyo narAdhipaH |
yatkRRitaM kurusiMhena maruttasyAnukurvatA
shlokas.21:
pratigRRihya tu taddravyaM kRRiShNadvaipAyanaH prabhuH |
RRitvigbhyaH pradadau vidvA.nshchaturdhA vyabhaja.nshcha te
shlokas.22:
pRRithivyA niShkrayaM dattvA taddhiraNyaM yudhiShThiraH |
dhUtapApmA jitasvargo mumude bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.23:
RRitvijastamaparyantaM suvarNanichayaM tadA |
vyabhajanta dvijAtibhyo yathotsAhaM yathAbalam
shlokas.24:
yaj~navATe tu yatki~nchiddhiraNyamapi bhUShaNam |
toraNAni cha yUpA.nshcha ghaTAH pAtrIstatheShTakAH
yudhiShThirAbhyanuj~nAtAH sarvaM tadvyabhajandvijAH
shlokas.25:
anantaraM brAhmaNebhyaH kShatriyA jahrire vasu |
tathA viTshUdrasa~NghAshcha tathAnye mlechChajAtayaH
kAlena mahatA jahrustatsuvarNaM tatastataH
shlokas.26:
tataste brAhmaNAH sarve muditA jagmurAlayAn |
tarpitA vasunA tena dharmarAj~nA mahAtmanA
shlokas.27:
svama.nshaM bhagavAnvyAsaH kuntyai pAdAbhivAdanAt |
pradadau tasya mahato hiraNyasya mahAdyutiH
shlokas.28:
shvashurAtprItidAyaM taM prApya sA prItamAnasA |
chakAra puNyaM loke tu sumahAntaM pRRithA tadA
shlokas.29:
gatvA tvavabhRRithaM rAjA vipApmA bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
sabhAjyamAnaH shushubhe mahendro daivatairiva
shlokas.30:
pANDavAshcha mahIpAlaiH sametaiH sa.nvRRitAstadA |
ashobhanta mahArAja grahAstArAgaNairiva
shlokas.31:
rAjabhyo.api tataH prAdAdratnAni vividhAni cha |
gajAnashvAnala~NkArAnstriyo vastrANi kA~nchanam
shlokas.32:
taddhanaughamaparyantaM pArthaH pArthivamaNDale |
visRRija~nshushubhe rAjA yathA vaishravaNastathA
shlokas.33:
AnAyya cha tathA vIraM rAjAnaM babhruvAhanam |
pradAya vipulaM vittaM gRRihAnprAsthApayattadA
shlokas.34:
duHshalAyAshcha taM pautraM bAlakaM pArthivarShabha |
svarAjye pitRRibhirgupte prItyA samabhiShechayat
shlokas.35:
rAj~nashchaivApi tAnsarvAnsuvibhaktAnsupUjitAn |
prasthApayAmAsa vashI kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.36:
evaM babhUva yaj~naH sa dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
bahvannadhanaratnaughaH surAmaireyasAgaraH
shlokas.37:
sarpiHpa~NkA hradA yatra bahavashchAnnaparvatAH |
rasAlAkardamAH kulyA babhUvurbharatarShabha
shlokas.38:
bhakShyaShANDavarAgANAM kriyatAM bhujyatAmiti |
pashUnAM vadhyatAM chApi nAntastatra sma dRRishyate
shlokas.40:
dIyatAM bhujyatAM cheti divArAtramavAritam |
taM mahotsavasa~NkAshamatihRRiShTajanAkulam
kathayanti sma puruShA nAnAdeshanivAsinaH
shlokas.41:
varShitvA dhanadhArAbhiH kAmai ratnairdhanaistathA |
vipApmA bharatashreShThaH kRRitArthaH prAvishatpuram

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
pitAmahasya me yaj~ne dharmaputrasya dhImataH |
yadAshcharyamabhUtki~nchittadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
shrUyatAM rAjashArdUla mahadAshcharyamuttamam |
ashvamedhe mahAyaj~ne nivRRitte yadabhUdvibho
shlokas.3:
tarpiteShu dvijAgryeShu j~nAtisambandhibandhuShu |
dInAndhakRRipaNe chApi tadA bharatasattama
shlokas.4:
ghuShyamANe mahAdAne dikShu sarvAsu bhArata |
patatsu puShpavarSheShu dharmarAjasya mUrdhani
shlokas.5:
bilAnniShkramya nakulo rukmapArshvastadAnagha |
vajrAshanisamaM nAdamamu~nchata vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
sakRRidutsRRijya taM nAdaM trAsayAno mRRigadvijAn |
mAnuShaM vachanaM prAha dhRRiShTo bilashayo mahAn
shlokas.7:
saktuprasthena vo nAyaM yaj~nastulyo narAdhipAH |
u~nChavRRittervadAnyasya kurukShetranivAsinaH
shlokas.8:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA nakulasya vishAM pate |
vismayaM paramaM jagmuH sarve te brAhmaNarShabhAH
shlokas.9:
tataH sametya nakulaM paryapRRichChanta te dvijAH |
kutastvaM samanuprApto yaj~naM sAdhusamAgamam
shlokas.10:
kiM balaM paramaM tubhyaM kiM shrutaM kiM parAyaNam |
kathaM bhavantaM vidyAma yo no yaj~naM vigarhase
shlokas.11:
avilupyAgamaM kRRitsnaM vidhij~nairyAjakaiH kRRitam |
yathAgamaM yathAnyAyaM kartavyaM cha yathAkRRitam
shlokas.12:
pUjArhAH pUjitAshchAtra vidhivachChAstrachakShuShA |
mantrapUtaM hutashchAgnirdattaM deyamamatsaram
shlokas.13:
tuShTA dvijarShabhAshchAtra dAnairbahuvidhairapi |
kShatriyAshcha suyuddhena shrAddhairapi pitAmahAH
shlokas.14:
pAlanena vishastuShTAH kAmaistuShTA varastriyaH |
anukroshaistathA shUdrA dAnasheShaiH pRRithagjanAH
shlokas.15:
j~nAtisambandhinastuShTAH shauchena cha nRRipasya naH |
devA havirbhiH puNyaishcha rakShaNaiH sharaNAgatAH
shlokas.16:
yadatra tathyaM tadbrUhi satyasandha dvijAtiShu |
yathAshrutaM yathAdRRiShTaM pRRiShTo brAhmaNakAmyayA
shlokas.17:
shraddheyavAkyaH prAj~nastvaM divyaM rUpaM bibharShi cha |
samAgatashcha vipraistvaM tattvato vaktumarhasi
shlokas.18:
iti pRRiShTo dvijaistaiH sa prahasya nakulo.abravIt |
naiShAnRRitA mayA vANI proktA darpeNa vA dvijAH
shlokas.19:
yanmayoktamidaM ki~nchidyuShmAbhishchApyupashrutam |
saktuprasthena vo nAyaM yaj~nastulyo narAdhipAH
u~nChavRRittervadAnyasya kurukShetranivAsinaH
shlokas.20:
ityavashyaM mayaitadvo vaktavyaM dvijapu~NgavAH |
shRRiNutAvyagramanasaH sha.nsato me dvijarShabhAH
shlokas.21:
anubhUtaM cha dRRiShTaM cha yanmayAdbhutamuttamam |
u~nChavRRitteryathAvRRittaM kurukShetranivAsinaH
shlokas.22:
svargaM yena dvijaH prAptaH sabhAryaH sasutasnuShaH |
yathA chArdhaM sharIrasya mamedaM kA~nchanIkRRitam

shlokas.1:
nakula uvAcha||
hanta vo vartayiShyAmi dAnasya paramaM phalam |
nyAyalabdhasya sUkShmasya vipradattasya yaddvijAH
shlokas.2:
dharmakShetre kurukShetre dharmaj~nairbahubhirvRRite |
u~nChavRRittirdvijaH kashchitkApotirabhavatpurA
shlokas.3:
sabhAryaH saha putreNa sasnuShastapasi sthitaH |
vadhUchaturtho vRRiddhaH sa dharmAtmA niyatendriyaH
shlokas.4:
ShaShThe kAle tadA vipro bhu~Nkte taiH saha suvrataH |
ShaShThe kAle kadAchichcha tasyAhAro na vidyate
bhu~Nkte.anyasminkadAchitsa ShaShThe kAle dvijottamaH
shlokas.5:
kapotadharmiNastasya durbhikShe sati dAruNe |
nAvidyata tadA viprAH sa~nchayastAnnibodhata
kShINauShadhisamAvAyo dravyahIno.abhavattadA
shlokas.6:
kAle kAle.asya samprApte naiva vidyeta bhojanam |
kShudhAparigatAH sarve prAtiShThanta tadA tu te
shlokas.7:
u~nCha.nstadA shuklapakShe madhyaM tapati bhAskare |
uShNArtashcha kShudhArtashcha sa viprastapasi sthitaH
u~nChamaprAptavAneva sArdhaM parijanena ha
shlokas.8:
sa tathaiva kShudhAviShTaH spRRiShTvA toyaM yathAvidhi |
kShapayAmAsa taM kAlaM kRRichChraprANo dvijottamaH
shlokas.9:
atha ShaShThe gate kAle yavaprasthamupArjayat |
yavaprasthaM cha te saktUnakurvanta tapasvinaH
shlokas.10:
kRRitajapyAhvikAste tu hutvA vahniM yathAvidhi |
kuDavaM kuDavaM sarve vyabhajanta tapasvinaH
shlokas.11:
athAgachChaddvijaH kashchidatithirbhu~njatAM tadA |
te taM dRRiShTvAtithiM tatra prahRRiShTamanaso.abhavan
shlokas.12:
te.abhivAdya sukhaprashnaM pRRiShTvA tamatithiM tadA |
vishuddhamanaso dAntAH shraddhAdamasamanvitAH
shlokas.13:
anasUyavo gatakrodhAH sAdhavo gatamatsarAH |
tyaktamAnA jitakrodhA dharmaj~nA dvijasattamAH
shlokas.14:
sabrahmacharyaM svaM gotraM samAkhyAya parasparam |
kuTIM praveshayAmAsuH kShudhArtamatithiM tadA
shlokas.15:
idamarghyaM cha pAdyaM cha bRRisI cheyaM tavAnagha |
shuchayaH saktavashcheme niyamopArjitAH prabho
pratigRRihNIShva bhadraM te mayA dattA dvijottama
shlokas.16:
ityuktaH pratigRRihyAtha saktUnAM kuDavaM dvijaH |
bhakShayAmAsa rAjendra na cha tuShTiM jagAma saH
shlokas.17:
sa u~nChavRRittiH taM prekShya kShudhAparigataM dvijam |
AhAraM chintayAmAsa kathaM tuShTo bhavediti
shlokas.18:
tasya bhAryAbravIdrAjanmadbhAgo dIyatAmiti |
gachChatveSha yathAkAmaM santuShTo dvijasattamaH
shlokas.19:
iti bruvantIM tAM sAdhvIM dharmAtmA sa dvijarShabhaH |
kShudhAparigatAM j~nAtvA saktU.nstAnnAbhyanandata
shlokas.20:
jAnanvRRiddhAM kShudhArtAM cha shrAntAM glAnAM tapasvinIm |
tvagasthibhUtAM vepantIM tato bhAryAmuvAcha tAm
shlokas.21:
api kITapata~NgAnAM mRRigANAM chaiva shobhane |
striyo rakShyAshcha poShyAshcha naivaM tvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.22:
anukampito naro nAryA puShTo rakShita eva cha |
prapatedyashaso dIptAnna cha lokAnavApnuyAt
shlokas.23:
ityuktA sA tataH prAha dharmArthau nau samau dvija |
saktuprasthachaturbhAgaM gRRihANemaM prasIda me
shlokas.24:
satyaM ratishcha dharmashcha svargashcha guNanirjitaH |
strINAM patisamAdhInaM kA~NkShitaM cha dvijottama
shlokas.25:
RRiturmAtuH piturbIjaM daivataM paramaM patiH |
bhartuH prasAdAtstrINAM vai ratiH putraphalaM tathA
shlokas.26:
pAlanAddhi patistvaM me bhartAsi bharaNAnmama |
putrapradAnAdvaradastasmAtsaktUngRRihANa me
shlokas.27:
jarAparigato vRRiddhaH kShudhArto durbalo bhRRisham |
upavAsaparishrAnto yadA tvamapi karshitaH
shlokas.28:
ityuktaH sa tayA saktUnpragRRihyedaM vacho.abravIt |
dvija saktUnimAnbhUyaH pratigRRihNIShva sattama
shlokas.29:
sa tAnpragRRihya bhuktvA cha na tuShTimagamaddvijaH |
tamu~nChavRRittirAlakShya tatashchintAparo.abhavat
shlokas.30:
putra uvAcha||
saktUnimAnpragRRihya tvaM dehi viprAya sattama |
ityevaM sukRRitaM manye tasmAdetatkaromyaham
shlokas.31:
bhavAnhi paripAlyo me sarvayatnairdvijottama |
sAdhUnAM kA~NkShitaM hyetatpiturvRRiddhasya poShaNam
shlokas.32:
putrArtho vihito hyeSha sthAvirye paripAlanam |
shrutireShA hi viprarShe triShu lokeShu vishrutA
shlokas.33:
prANadhAraNamAtreNa shakyaM kartuM tapastvayA |
prANo hi paramo dharmaH sthito deheShu dehinAm
shlokas.34:
pitovAcha||
api varShasahasrI tvaM bAla eva mato mama |
utpAdya putraM hi pitA kRRitakRRityo bhavatyuta
shlokas.35:
bAlAnAM kShudbalavatI jAnAmyetadahaM vibho |
vRRiddho.ahaM dhArayiShyAmi tvaM balI bhava putraka
shlokas.36:
jIrNena vayasA putra na mA kShudbAdhate.api cha |
dIrghakAlaM tapastaptaM na me maraNato bhayam
shlokas.37:
putra uvAcha||
apatyamasmi te putrastrANAtputro hi vishrutaH |
AtmA putraH smRRitastasmAttrAhyAtmAnamihAtmanA
shlokas.38:
pitovAcha||
rUpeNa sadRRishastvaM me shIlena cha damena cha |
parIkShitashcha bahudhA saktUnAdadmi te tataH
shlokas.39:
ityuktvAdAya tAnsaktUnprItAtmA dvijasattamaH |
prahasanniva viprAya sa tasmai pradadau tadA
shlokas.40:
bhuktvA tAnapi saktUnsa naiva tuShTo babhUva ha |
u~nChavRRittistu savrIDo babhUva dvijasattamaH
shlokas.41:
taM vai vadhUH sthitA sAdhvI brAhmaNapriyakAmyayA |
saktUnAdAya saMhRRiShTA guruM taM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.42:
santAnAttava santAnaM mama vipra bhaviShyati |
saktUnimAnatithaye gRRihItvA tvaM prayachCha me
shlokas.43:
tava prasavanirvRRityA mama lokAH kilAkShayAH |
pautreNa tAnavApnoti yatra gatvA na shochati
shlokas.44:
dharmAdyA hi yathA tretA vahnitretA tathaiva cha |
tathaiva putrapautrANAM svarge tretA kilAkShayA
shlokas.45:
pitR^I.nstrANAttArayati putra ityanushushruma |
putrapautraishcha niyataM sAdhulokAnupAshnute
shlokas.46:
shvashura uvAcha||
vAtAtapavishIrNA~NgIM tvAM vivarNAM nirIkShya vai |
karshitAM suvratAchAre kShudhAvihvalachetasam
shlokas.47:
kathaM saktUngrahIShyAmi bhUtvA dharmopaghAtakaH |
kalyANavRRitte kalyANi naivaM tvaM vaktumarhasi
shlokas.48:
ShaShThe kAle vratavatIM shIlashauchasamanvitAm |
kRRichChravRRittiM nirAhArAM drakShyAmi tvAM kathaM nvaham
shlokas.49:
bAlA kShudhArtA nArI cha rakShyA tvaM satataM mayA |
upavAsaparishrAntA tvaM hi bAndhavanandinI
shlokas.50:
snuShovAcha||
gurormama gurustvaM vai yato daivatadaivatam |
devAtidevastasmAttvaM saktUnAdatsva me vibho
shlokas.51:
dehaH prANashcha dharmashcha shushrUShArthamidaM guroH |
tava vipra prasAdena lokAnprApsyAmyabhIpsitAn
shlokas.52:
avekShyA iti kRRitvA tvaM dRRiDhabhaktyeti vA dvija |
chintyA mameyamiti vA saktUnAdAtumarhasi
shlokas.53:
shvashura uvAcha||
anena nityaM sAdhvI tvaM shIlavRRittena shobhase |
yA tvaM dharmavratopetA guruvRRittimavekShase
shlokas.54:
tasmAtsaktUngrahIShyAmi vadhUrnArhasi va~nchanAm |
gaNayitvA mahAbhAge tvaM hi dharmabhRRitAM varA
shlokas.56:
prItAtmA sa tu taM vAkyamidamAha dvijarShabham |
vAgmI tadA dvijashreShTho dharmaH puruShavigrahaH
shlokas.57:
shuddhena tava dAnena nyAyopAttena yatnataH |
yathAshakti vimuktena prIto.asmi dvijasattama
shlokas.58:
aho dAnaM ghuShyate te svarge svarganivAsibhiH |
gaganAtpuShpavarShaM cha pashyasva patitaM bhuvi
shlokas.59:
surarShidevagandharvA ye cha devapuraHsarAH |
stuvanto devadUtAshcha sthitA dAnena vismitAH
shlokas.60:
brahmarShayo vimAnasthA brahmalokagatAshcha ye |
kA~NkShante darshanaM tubhyaM divaM gachCha dvijarShabha
shlokas.61:
pitRRilokagatAH sarve tAritAH pitarastvayA |
anAgatAshcha bahavaH subahUni yugAni cha
shlokas.62:
brahmacharyeNa yaj~nena dAnena tapasA tathA |
agahvareNa dharmeNa tasmAdgachCha divaM dvija
shlokas.63:
shraddhayA parayA yastvaM tapashcharasi suvrata |
tasmAddevAstavAnena prItA dvijavarottama
shlokas.64:
sarvasvametadyasmAtte tyaktaM shuddhena chetasA |
kRRichChrakAle tataH svargo jito.ayaM tava karmaNA
shlokas.65:
kShudhA nirNudati praj~nAM dharmyAM buddhiM vyapohati |
kShudhAparigataj~nAno dhRRitiM tyajati chaiva ha
shlokas.66:
bubhukShAM jayate yastu sa svargaM jayate dhruvam |
yadA dAnaruchirbhavati tadA dharmo na sIdati
shlokas.67:
anavekShya sutasnehaM kalatrasnehameva cha |
dharmameva guruM j~nAtvA tRRiShNA na gaNitA tvayA
shlokas.68:
dravyAgamo nRRiNAM sUkShmaH pAtre dAnaM tataH param |
kAlaH parataro dAnAchChraddhA chApi tataH parA
shlokas.69:
svargadvAraM susUkShmaM hi narairmohAnna dRRishyate |
svargArgalaM lobhabIjaM rAgaguptaM durAsadam
shlokas.70:
tattu pashyanti puruShA jitakrodhA jitendriyAH |
brAhmaNAstapasA yuktA yathAshaktipradAyinaH
shlokas.71:
sahasrashaktishcha shataM shatashaktirdashApi cha |
dadyAdapashcha yaH shaktyA sarve tulyaphalAH smRRitAH
shlokas.72:
rantidevo hi nRRipatirapaH prAdAdaki~nchanaH |
shuddhena manasA vipra nAkapRRiShThaM tato gataH
shlokas.73:
na dharmaH prIyate tAta dAnairdattairmahAphalaiH |
nyAyalabdhairyathA sUkShmaiH shraddhApUtaiH sa tuShyati
shlokas.74:
gopradAnasahasrANi dvijebhyo.adAnnRRigo nRRipaH |
ekAM dattvA sa pArakyAM narakaM samavAptavAn
shlokas.75:
AtmamA.nsapradAnena shibiraushInaro nRRipaH |
prApya puNyakRRitA.NllokAnmodate divi suvrataH
shlokas.76:
vibhave na nRRiNAM puNyaM svashaktyA svarjitaM satAm |
na yaj~nairvividhairvipra yathAnyAyena sa~nchitaiH
shlokas.77:
krodho dAnaphalaM hanti lobhAtsvargaM na gachChati |
nyAyavRRittirhi tapasA dAnavitsvargamashnute
shlokas.78:
na rAjasUyairbahubhiriShTvA vipuladakShiNaiH |
na chAshvamedhairbahubhiH phalaM samamidaM tava
shlokas.79:
saktuprasthena hi jito brahmalokastvayAnagha |
virajo brahmabhavanaM gachCha vipra yathechChakam
shlokas.80:
sarveShAM vo dvijashreShTha divyaM yAnamupasthitam |
Arohata yathAkAmaM dharmo.asmi dvija pashya mAm
shlokas.81:
pAvito hi tvayA deho loke kIrtiH sthirA cha te |
sabhAryaH sahaputrashcha sasnuShashcha divaM vraja
shlokas.82:
ityuktavAkyo dharmeNa yAnamAruhya sa dvijaH |
sabhAryaH sasutashchApi sasnuShashcha divaM yayau
shlokas.83:
tasminvipre gate svargaM sasute sasnuShe tadA |
bhAryAchaturthe dharmaj~ne tato.ahaM niHsRRito bilAt
shlokas.84:
tatastu saktugandhena kledena salilasya cha |
divyapuShpAvamardAchcha sAdhordAnalavaishcha taiH
viprasya tapasA tasya shiro me kA~nchanIkRRitam
shlokas.85:
tasya satyAbhisandhasya sUkShmadAnena chaiva ha |
sharIrArdhaM cha me viprAH shAtakumbhamayaM kRRitam
pashyatedaM suvipulaM tapasA tasya dhImataH
shlokas.86:
kathameva.nvidhaM me syAdanyatpArshvamiti dvijAH |
tapovanAni yaj~nA.nshcha hRRiShTo.abhyemi punaH punaH
shlokas.87:
yaj~naM tvahamimaM shrutvA kururAjasya dhImataH |
AshayA parayA prApto na chAhaM kA~nchanIkRRitaH
shlokas.88:
tato mayoktaM tadvAkyaM prahasya dvijasattamAH |
saktuprasthena yaj~no.ayaM saMmito neti sarvathA
shlokas.89:
saktuprasthalavaistairhi tadAhaM kA~nchanIkRRitaH |
na hi yaj~no mahAneSha sadRRishastairmato mama
shlokas.90:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA nakulaH sarvAnyaj~ne dvijavarA.nstadA |
jagAmAdarshanaM rAjanviprAste cha yayurgRRihAn
shlokas.91:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM mayA parapura~njaya |
yadAshcharyamabhUttasminvAjimedhe mahAkratau
shlokas.92:
na vismayaste nRRipate yaj~ne kAryaH katha~nchana |
RRiShikoTisahasrANi tapobhirye divaM gatAH
shlokas.93:
adrohaH sarvabhUteShu santoShaH shIlamArjavam |
tapo damashcha satyaM cha dAnaM cheti samaM matam

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
yaj~ne saktA nRRipatayastapaHsaktA maharShayaH |
shAntivyavasitA viprAH shamo dama iti prabho
shlokas.2:
tasmAdyaj~naphalaistulyaM na ki~nchidiha vidyate |
iti me vartate buddhistathA chaitadasa.nshayam
shlokas.3:
yaj~nairiShTvA hi bahavo rAjAno dvijasattama |
iha kIrtiM parAM prApya pretya svargamito gatAH
shlokas.4:
devarAjaH sahasrAkShaH kratubhirbhUridakShiNaiH |
devarAjyaM mahAtejAH prAptavAnakhilaM vibhuH
shlokas.5:
yathA yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImArjunapuraHsaraH |
sadRRisho devarAjena samRRiddhyA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.6:
atha kasmAtsa nakulo garhayAmAsa taM kratum |
ashvamedhaM mahAyaj~naM rAj~nastasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.7:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yaj~nasya vidhimagryaM vai phalaM chaiva nararShabha |
gadataH shRRiNu me rAjanyathAvadiha bhArata
shlokas.8:
purA shakrasya yajataH sarva UchurmaharShayaH |
RRitvikShu karmavyagreShu vitate yaj~nakarmaNi
shlokas.9:
hUyamAne tathA vahnau hotre bahuguNAnvite |
deveShvAhUyamAneShu sthiteShu paramarShiShu
shlokas.10:
supratItaistadA vipraiH svAgamaiH susvanairnRRipa |
ashrAntaishchApi laghubhiradhvaryuvRRiShabhaistathA
shlokas.11:
Alambhasamaye tasmingRRihIteShu pashuShvatha |
maharShayo mahArAja sambabhUvuH kRRipAnvitAH
shlokas.12:
tato dInAnpashUndRRiShTvA RRiShayaste tapodhanAH |
UchuH shakraM samAgamya nAyaM yaj~navidhiH shubhaH
shlokas.13:
apavij~nAnametatte mahAntaM dharmamichChataH |
na hi yaj~ne pashugaNA vidhidRRiShTAH pura.ndara
shlokas.14:
dharmopaghAtakastveSha samArambhastava prabho |
nAyaM dharmakRRito dharmo na hi.nsA dharma uchyate
shlokas.15:
Agamenaiva te yaj~naM kurvantu yadi hechChasi |
vidhidRRiShTena yaj~nena dharmaste sumahAnbhavet
shlokas.16:
yaja bIjaiH sahasrAkSha trivarShaparamoShitaiH |
eSha dharmo mahA~nshakra chintyamAno.adhigamyate
shlokas.17:
shatakratustu tadvAkyamRRiShibhistattvadarshibhiH |
uktaM na pratijagrAha mAnamohavashAnugaH
shlokas.18:
teShAM vivAdaH sumahA~njaj~ne shakramaharShiNAm |
ja~NgamaiH sthAvarairvApi yaShTavyamiti bhArata
shlokas.19:
te tu khinnA vivAdena RRiShayastattvadarshinaH |
tataH sandhAya shakreNa paprachChurnRRipatiM vasum
shlokas.20:
mahAbhAga kathaM yaj~neShvAgamo nRRipate smRRitaH |
yaShTavyaM pashubhirmedhyairatho bIjairajairapi
shlokas.21:
tachChrutvA tu vachasteShAmavichArya balAbalam |
yathopanItairyaShTavyamiti provAcha pArthivaH
shlokas.22:
evamuktvA sa nRRipatiH pravivesha rasAtalam |
uktveha vitathaM rAja.nshchedInAmIshvaraH prabhuH
shlokas.23:
anyAyopagataM dravyamatItaM yo hyapaNDitaH |
dharmAbhikA~NkShI yajate na dharmaphalamashnute
shlokas.24:
dharmavaita.nsiko yastu pApAtmA puruShastathA |
dadAti dAnaM viprebhyo lokavishvAsakArakam
shlokas.25:
pApena karmaNA vipro dhanaM labdhvA nira~NkushaH |
rAgamohAnvitaH so.ante kaluShAM gatimApnute
shlokas.26:
tena dattAni dAnAni pApena hatabuddhinA |
tAni sattvamanAsAdya nashyanti vipulAnyapi
shlokas.27:
tasyAdharmapravRRittasya hi.nsakasya durAtmanaH |
dAne na kIrtirbhavati pretya cheha cha durmateH
shlokas.28:
api sa~nchayabuddhirhi lobhamohavasha~NgataH |
udvejayati bhUtAni hi.nsayA pApachetanaH
shlokas.29:
evaM labdhvA dhanaM lobhAdyajate yo dadAti cha |
sa kRRitvA karmaNA tena na sidhyati durAgamAt
shlokas.30:
u~nChaM mUlaM phalaM shAkamudapAtraM tapodhanAH |
dAnaM vibhavato dattvA narAH svaryAnti dharmiNaH
shlokas.31:
eSha dharmo mahA.nstyAgo dAnaM bhUtadayA tathA |
brahmacharyaM tathA satyamanukrosho dhRRitiH kShamA
sanAtanasya dharmasya mUlametatsanAtanam
shlokas.32:
shrUyante hi purA viprA vishvAmitrAdayo nRRipAH |
vishvAmitro.asitashchaiva janakashcha mahIpatiH
kakShasenArShTiSheNau cha sindhudvIpashcha pArthivaH
shlokas.33:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH siddhiM paramikAM gatAH |
nRRipAH satyaishcha dAnaishcha nyAyalabdhaistapodhanAH
shlokas.34:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrA ye chAshritAstapaH |
dAnadharmAgninA shuddhAste svargaM yAnti bhArata

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
dharmAgatena tyAgena bhagavansarvamasti chet |
etanme sarvamAchakShva kushalo hyasi bhAShitum
shlokas.2:
tato~nChavRRitteryadvRRittaM saktudAne phalaM mahat |
kathitaM me mahadbrahma.nstathyametadasa.nshayam
shlokas.3:
kathaM hi sarvayaj~neShu nishchayaH paramo bhavet |
etadarhasi me vaktuM nikhilena dvijarShabha
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
atrApyudAharantImamitihAsaM purAtanam |
agastyasya mahAyaj~ne purAvRRittamari.ndama
shlokas.5:
purAgastyo mahAtejA dIkShAM dvAdashavArShikIm |
pravivesha mahArAja sarvabhUtahite rataH
shlokas.6:
tatrAgnikalpA hotAra Asansatre mahAtmanaH |
mUlAhArA nirAhArAH sAshmakuTTA marIchipAH
shlokas.7:
parighRRiShTikA vaighasikAH samprakShAlAstathaiva cha |
yatayo bhikShavashchAtra babhUvuH paryavasthitAH
shlokas.8:
sarve pratyakShadharmANo jitakrodhA jitendriyAH |
dame sthitAshcha te sarve dambhamohavivarjitAH
shlokas.9:
vRRitte shuddhe sthitA nityamindriyaishchApyavAhitAH |
upAsate sma taM yaj~naM bhu~njAnAste maharShayaH
shlokas.10:
yathAshaktyA bhagavatA tadannaM samupArjitam |
tasminsatre tu yatki~nchidayogyaM tatra nAbhavat
tathA hyanekairmunibhirmahAntaH kratavaH kRRitAH
shlokas.11:
eva.nvidhestvagastyasya vartamAne mahAdhvare |
na vavarSha sahasrAkShastadA bharatasattama
shlokas.12:
tataH karmAntare rAjannagastyasya mahAtmanaH |
katheyamabhinirvRRittA munInAM bhAvitAtmanAm
shlokas.13:
agastyo yajamAno.asau dadAtyannaM vimatsaraH |
na cha varShati parjanyaH kathamannaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.14:
satraM chedaM mahadviprA munerdvAdashavArShikam |
na varShiShyati devashcha varShANyetAni dvAdasha
shlokas.15:
etadbhavantaH sa~nchintya maharSherasya dhImataH |
agastyasyAtitapasaH kartumarhantyanugraham
shlokas.16:
ityevamukte vachane tato.agastyaH pratApavAn |
provAchedaM vacho vAgmI prasAdya shirasA munIn
shlokas.17:
yadi dvAdashavarShANi na varShiShyati vAsavaH |
chintAyaj~naM kariShyAmi vidhireSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.18:
yadi dvAdashavarShANi na varShiShyati vAsavaH |
vyAyAmenAhariShyAmi yaj~nAnanyAnativratAn
shlokas.19:
bIjayaj~no mayAyaM vai bahuvarShasamAchitaH |
bIjaiH kRRitaiH kariShye cha nAtra vighno bhaviShyati
shlokas.20:
nedaM shakyaM vRRithA kartuM mama satraM katha~nchana |
varShiShyatIha vA devo na vA devo bhaviShyati
shlokas.21:
atha vAbhyarthanAmindraH kuryAnna tviha kAmataH |
svayamindro bhaviShyAmi jIvayiShyAmi cha prajAH
shlokas.22:
yo yadAhArajAtashcha sa tathaiva bhaviShyati |
visheShaM chaiva kartAsmi punaH punaratIva hi
shlokas.23:
adyeha svarNamabhyetu yachchAnyadvasu durlabham |
triShu lokeShu yachchAsti tadihAgachChatAM svayam
shlokas.24:
divyAshchApsarasAM sa~NghAH sagandharvAH sakiMnarAH |
vishvAvasushcha ye chAnye te.apyupAsantu vaH sadA
shlokas.25:
uttarebhyaH kurubhyashcha yatki~nchidvasu vidyate |
sarvaM tadiha yaj~ne me svayamevopatiShThatu
svargaM svargasadashchaiva dharmashcha svayameva tu
shlokas.26:
ityukte sarvamevaitadabhavattasya dhImataH |
tataste munayo dRRiShTvA munestasya tapobalam
vismitA vachanaM prAhuridaM sarve mahArthavat
shlokas.27:
prItAH sma tava vAkyena na tvichChAmastapovyayam |
svaireva yaj~naistuShTAH smo nyAyenechChAmahe vayam
shlokas.28:
yaj~nAndIkShAstathA homAnyachchAnyanmRRigayAmahe |
tanno.astu svakRRitairyaj~nairnAnyato mRRigayAmahe
shlokas.29:
nyAyenopArjitAhArAH svakarmaniratA vayam |
vedA.nshcha brahmacharyeNa nyAyataH prArthayAmahe
shlokas.30:
nyAyenottarakAlaM cha gRRihebhyo niHsRRitA vayam |
dharmadRRiShTairvidhidvAraistapastapsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.31:
bhavataH samyageShA hi buddhirhi.nsAvivarjitA |
etAmahi.nsAM yaj~neShu brUyAstvaM satataM prabho
shlokas.32:
prItAstato bhaviShyAmo vayaM dvijavarottama |
visarjitAH samAptau cha satrAdasmAdvrajAmahe
shlokas.33:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA kathayatAmeva devarAjaH pura.ndaraH |
vavarSha sumahAtejA dRRiShTvA tasya tapobalam
shlokas.34:
asamAptau cha yaj~nasya tasyAmitaparAkramaH |
nikAmavarShI devendro babhUva janamejaya
shlokas.35:
prasAdayAmAsa cha tamagastyaM tridasheshvaraH |
svayamabhyetya rAjarShe puraskRRitya bRRihaspatim
shlokas.36:
tato yaj~nasamAptau tAnvisasarja mahAmunIn |
agastyaH paramaprItaH pUjayitvA yathAvidhi

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
ko.asau nakularUpeNa shirasA kA~nchanena vai |
prAha mAnuShavadvAchametatpRRiShTo vadasva me
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etatpUrvaM na pRRiShTo.ahaM na chAsmAbhiH prabhAShitam |
shrUyatAM nakulo yo.asau yathA vAgasya mAnuShI
shlokas.3:
shrAddhaM sa~NkalpayAmAsa jamadagniH purA kila |
homadhenustamAgAchcha svayaM chApi dudoha tAm
shlokas.4:
tatkShIraM sthApayAmAsa nave bhANDe dRRiDhe shuchau |
tachcha krodhaH svarUpeNa piTharaM paryavartayat
shlokas.5:
jij~nAsustamRRiShishreShThaM kiM kuryAdvipriye kRRite |
iti sa~nchintya durmedhA dharShayAmAsa tatpayaH
shlokas.6:
tamAj~nAya muniH krodhaM naivAsya chukupe tataH |
sa tu krodhastamAhedaM prA~njalirmUrtimAnsthitaH
shlokas.7:
jito.asmIti bhRRigushreShTha bhRRigavo hyatiroShaNAH |
loke mithyApravAdo.ayaM yattvayAsmi parAjitaH
shlokas.8:
so.ahaM tvayi sthito hyadya kShamAvati mahAtmani |
bibhemi tapasaH sAdho prasAdaM kuru me vibho
shlokas.9:
janamejaya uvAcha||
sAkShAddRRiShTo.asi me krodha gachCha tvaM vigatajvaraH |
na mamApakRRitaM te.adya na manyurvidyate mama
shlokas.10:
yAnuddishya tu sa~NkalpaH payaso.asya kRRito mayA |
pitaraste mahAbhAgAstebhyo budhyasva gamyatAm
shlokas.11:
ityukto jAtasantrAsaH sa tatrAntaradhIyata |
pitR^INAmabhiSha~NgAttu nakulatvamupAgataH
shlokas.12:
sa tAnprasAdayAmAsa shApasyAnto bhavediti |
taishchApyukto yadA dharmaM kShepsyase mokShyase tadA
shlokas.13:
taishchokto yaj~niyAndeshAndharmAraNyAni chaiva ha |
jugupsanparidhAvansa yaj~naM taM samupAsadat
shlokas.14:
dharmaputramathAkShipya saktuprasthena tena saH |
muktaH shApAttataH krodho dharmo hyAsIdyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.15:
evametattadA vRRittaM tasya yaj~ne mahAtmanaH |
pashyatAM chApi nastatra nakulo.antarhitastadA
